No offense, but that cucumber, onion, tomato- olive oil  combo has been a Mediterranean delicacy for thousands of years, and Israel is a fairly new country of European Jews (85%) who have only been introduced to the cuisine in 1948. Where is the Jewish flavor or contribution? Suddenly falafel is Jewish? Did the French call Morocco's couscous 'French'-- I think not.   The staff seems so programmed to always call it 'Israeli' salad, which is simply weird and mildly offensive. Secondly, tabbouli is not supposed to have more bulger grain than parsley. Either the cooks don't want to spend the day chopping parsley--or the grain is cheaper. All in all, the hot sauce is great, the pitas a bit thicker than I'd like -- and I'm impressed that they have Omba, (origin- Iraq).

I wanted to try out this eatery after hearing about from friends. But I was disappointed. Nothing was wow. I enjoyed the steamed mussels as it had a good chilli factor and the foie gras was good. Buttermilk chicken was on par to Popeyes chicken but a little more bland. Served with uninviting coleslaw. Service... 2/5, the girl seemed like she didnt want to serve us and her polite im happy waitress pretence persona was written on her forehead. I felt like this place was trying to be something they are not.... I would have recommended 3 stars but the service and long wait for fried chicken was disappointing. Hmm popeyes anyone?

I rarely write reviews. However, I felt it necessary to write this, as my experience was so negative that it was difficult to enjoy my meal. My friends and I decided to go for brunch Sunday afternoon. I was 1 out of an 8-person party, though 1 member of our group did not eat and only drank water. As a sidenote, I used to be a server and understand that an extremely busy shift can entail a lot of situations that are (sometimes) out of your control. It WAS very busy, so a wait was very understandable. We received glasses of water while we waited for a table, which was very appreciated. After about 25-30 minutes of waiting, we were seated outside because it was the first table available. I would estimate that we sat for about 10 minutes before our waitress actually came to our table (she breezed by several other times, saying she'd be with us in a moment), and at that point another employee had brought half of our party more water. Already, the group and I were feeling restless, hungry, and a little annoyed. The waitress introduced herself, counted how many of us needed more water, and then took our drink order. It took another 10-15 minutes to receive our drinks (where only 1 out of the 8 was an alcoholic beverage). After this, she would disappear for moments on end. We actually had to ASK her if we could put our food order in, and then waited another 30-40 minutes. The food was good. However, the overall experience made us rush through the meal just so we could get the heck out of there. The waitress was inattentive and borderline rude. Again, I understand being busy - but it's important to be kind and as attentive as possible to your tables; this is especially so when you are attaching an obligatory 20% tip to the bill. The manager has already been notified, so I found it unnecessary to use the server's name. I hope this experience was a fluke, but I can't say I'll rush back to Silk City for food anytime soon.
Can't wait to head back in! Extensive beer list and awesome food! Music was on point! Indoor and outdoor seating.
The food was great!  Loved my spicy BBQ chicken. Didn't take long to be seated or served. Open 24 hours
What a great little place. Food was great. We alter out orders to be off the menu. Very accommodating . Best little breakfast place !!
These tacos are the best! My favourite are the fish, shrimp and adobo tacos. The menu may be small but you don't really need anything else.
This is great idea with a terrible business plan. The food is good but the prices are unjustified. A hamburger (without bread and any sides ) for $10

I used to love Joe Allen. Our most recent visit was such a disappointment. The service was simply OK.  Our meals were very lackluster. The escargot was simply below par. Aside from the establishment's history and lineage, I would not recommend dining here.  There are simply much better places out there.

Market was not as big as I originally thought. There is a good variety of food, including 2 Peking duck places, as wells as several cheesesteak ones (you know which ones are popular by the lines that snake around the stall). Tommy DiNic's looked good too, but the queue was too long for me.

Soup Dumpings & Shanghai Noodles. Those are the only things you need to get when you're here. I think soup dumplings are good in general, but these are really as good as it gets. This is basically the only place you have to come to if you want to show people around NYC or if you're coming as a tourist or if you're just in the mood for some really amazing soup dumplings. The wait is pretty short (there can be a line because it's THAT popular & good), but the food comes out really fast, like EXTREMELY fast. Also, even if it doesn't seem like it, the waiters do understand english pretty well because there are a lot of non-Chinese people that come through the restaurant. However, the menu can get really overwhelming, but I swear you just need to keep ordering soup dumplings and a few plates of Shanghai noodles and you're set to go. There are either crab or pork soup dumplings. I recommend getting both at first and then ordering more of whichever based on your taste. Basically, if you ever get the chance, you HAVE to stop by here at least once in your lifetime cause you're going to keep coming back for more.
They had great food but closed down now. I don't know if they are re-locating.

Very, very good pizza; especially the cappacolla. Lovely ambiance, very rustic and simple. However, the wait staff can be a little snooty. When I began to order an "appetizer/starter" I was curtly cut off with, "have you been here before?" to which I replied that I had. She then said, "then you know how it works here, right? It'll come out when it comes out." So, the food is delicious and it's a very lovely space but someone needs to teach the wait staff to be a little more gracious and polite.

I visited this past week on a Tuesday night and off the back I want to say it's a lot smaller than the website and photos lead on. My date and I arrived earlier than our reservation and we were seated right away. We were able to get a window seat which let us see the entire city. We sat down as the sun was setting so we were able to experience the restaurant during some daylight and at night. And I have to admit it looks so much more beautiful and romantic at night. Our waitress was Stephanie and she was awesome- very attentive, polite and sweet. As an appetizer we ordered the tostone nacho which was so delicious. You could eat that the whole night and be happy. For the main course I had the pernil- tender, juicy, overall good- and he had the chicken breast- very flavorful, all white tender meat. The entire experience was worth it. We planned accordingly based on previous reviews and it worked out well  (i.e. visiting on a weekday rather than the weekend, making a reservation rather than just showing up, etc.) Chances are high that we'll visit again. Side note: Ladies it's a beautiful spot to get a little more dressed up for. Think heels, pencil skirt and a blouse.

My husband and I decided to give this place a try after checking out there menu and yelp reviews. Plus it wasn't too far of a walk from our hotel. We were quite disappointed with the place though. I don't think I will be returning. The food was decent and the staff was friendly but the atmosphere inside the restaurant turned me off. The hostess asked us if we would like to eat outside on the patio or inside the restaurant. Well seeing as it's late July and we've been in the heat most of the day we asked that we be seated inside. However, the place was so hot and the front door was wide open. We basically had to sweat through our meal which made the experience pretty awful. I had the Victors favorite pizza and my husband had a chicken Parmesan sandwich....both recommended by our server. They were both good choices but not great.
Delicious food, some of the best I've ever had. A little pricey but worth every penny ps get the truffle fries they're to die for

Exquisite. Great menu. Excellent service. English pea tortellini in mushroom bouillon with opal basil was delicious. Baked cod with paprika roasted peppers, picholine olives, basil and artichoke was fantastic. The Maine scallops, with asparagus, maitake, potato puree and lobster butter, were the best I've ever had.
It was amazing to find so many gluten free options! I had the angel food cake and it was excellent.

Well I am from Benares and this food is not at all a sample of Benares food. The paneer in paneer makhani was chewy instead of soft. Mutton (goat meat) didn't have any flavor that it should have. Seemed like the food was made a day before and served to us on a Sunday night dinner.
i love your Burritos!!!!
Best fried chicken I've ever had ! I get red velvet waffles and chicken with the hibiscus sweet tea every time. Super delishhhh
They hired possibly the most annoying waitress/bartender. Listening to her describe Korean cuisine is painful. Go there and check it out.
Really good brunch spot. Duck confit was off the charts. Service was solid, and the atmosphere was great. Would recommend it to anyone.

I live a block away from here and would live here if I could.  I've tried many Brasilian spots and this one is the smallest, but by far the best.  And what's better is that it's like being home. Very comfortable setting and warm atmosphere. Always busy and bustling and the food is always fresh. Even if you don't go for the BBQ meats(served in the back through a window not many notice), their buffet selection boasts a huge variety that includes both hot and cold foods, soups, and various meats and fish.  It is especially great for those days when I need food comforting.  And don't forget to top your meal off with a brigadeiro or a slice of brigadeiro cake and you're good to go.

The food was delicious and we can't wait to order take out sometime! Unfortunately, I have pretty much never experienced worst service in my life. We asked to sit outside but were told that it was full, fine we sat inside. 2 minutes later another couple walked in and they were ASKED if they wanted to sit outside and escorted out... We sat for a while before the order was taken and when we ordered a lamb dish we were told they were all out of lamb. This is an indian place, lamb is a huge percentage of the the menu. It would have been nice to be told that in the beginning. Then rather than make suggestions for alternate meals or say "ill give you a second to decide on something else" we were awkwardly stared at until we quickly picked something else. We requested a bucket to ice our wine. We had to ask about 2 times before they brought out a bucket filled with room temp water. It was all very strange and it FELT like they had enough staff for the people that were there but I have no idea how big the outside was.

Thanks to YELP my sister and I found Maysville!!! We went for Sunday brunch, we started with ice tea  which was as good as my grandmas , every bite of our meal was incredible , the music the service everything 5 stars!!!
Good food, but absolutely horrible service. Also, they should consider investing in a new air conditioner.

Consistently good and fresh and actually pretty amazing considering the price. The veggie quesadillas are awesome--really anything with their sauteed mushrooms.  The  people working there are cool and very patient when you try out your pathetic Spanish when ordering and picking up. Their cart on the corner of Elm and Bway is great for lunch--fast and reliable.

I had lunch here today and it was ok. The pad Thai was a bit too tangy and overly sweet. They have great lunch specials however the service is not very attentive and it's extremely slow. They serve Thai ice tea in mason jars which is super cute however that isn't enough to make me come back. If I want better Thai I'll just walk up the block and go to yum yum they have better food and slightly cheaper prices.

I absolutely love this place. Yes it's a whole in the wall but the pho amazing. And the ladies that work there are so nice and remember you when you come in. Yes the place is limited to only pho but honestly that's all you need.
Good, affordable vegetarian food in Philadelphia. We always make a stop when we're in town.

This restaurant was amazing! After reading the yelp reviews, my boyfriend and I decided to eat at Jones. The reviews were 100% accurate. The food was delicious, and the vibe of the restaurant was very fun. I would recommend ordering the mac n cheese....so creamy and cheesy!

Great neighborhood restaurant. We've eaten there a few times since moving to the area and the food is consistently great.  The servers are always so kind and efficient. Prices are reasonable and the portion sizes are perfect. The restaurant appears clean on the inside and carryout times are quick. Highly recommend this restaurant, its one of the best in the area!

This place was great!  I am so excited I got to taste a kangaroo burger.  Staff was phenomenal and so patient answering all our questions.  I loved all the recommendations and am looking forward to bringing more friends to try this place.  Next time I'll be saving room for dessert. Thank you Thirsty Koala!

Yes it is a tourist trap but it lives up to it's reputation by offering a large variety of options, many of which are unique.  The service was very good.  The outdoor patio seating in the theater district was great.  And the cheesecake.  Outstanding.

Came here for a family birthday brunch at 2pm on a Sunday. The space is beautiful and our table was nice and spacious! It took a while for us to get service, both for preliminary drinks and for food, but when our server was around he was very friendly and offered great recommendations to my family members. My reasons for knocking a few stars is that i (annoyingly) have celiac disease and so need to be extra careful about my gluten allergy. The server didn't seem to know whic items were gluten free (which is fine, it can be a lot to remember!) so I asked him to check on a few things before ordering. Then these things I asked him to check on simply came out with the rest of our food. When i asked a runner if an item was gluten free he said "ummmmm yes?" i asked "are you sure" and he said "no. I can check." I ended up being too nervous about whether or not my food was safe for me to eat to actually eat much/enjoy eating here. However, my other family members absolutely loved it. Moral : if you have allergens, maybe not the best place to go. If not, this place seems delicious!

First time I tried Kochi in September 2013, soon after its opening, and visiting often after that. Kochi is the best Indian cuisine that I have ever tasted in North America. I feel like home when I am in Kochi. The food has authentic Kerala standards. The staff in Kochi are very welcoming, friendly and enthusiastic in doing their job. Owner Thomas, chef Mathew, and the serving staff, all have professional training in the field and you can identify their talent by tasting the food. I tasted a number of items including Kerala puttu-kadala curry, kappa-meen curry, Egg curry, different snacks including halwa, neyyappam and all of them were great!  Kochi offer lunch buffet every working days. They recently started offering dinner buffets on Mondays and is having amazing variety dishes. Among the side dishes, what I like the most is their appam--simply amazing! Rice payasam is one of their best dissert! Kochi deserves a six star, but I can only give a five. I would definitely visit Kochi again!

Ahoy octopus, you gettin' in my belly! Love a good Greek restaurant and I'm so happy this place opened up months ago so I do not have to trek into Queens for their delicious dessert. Sometimes I wish I can fast forward the meal just to get to the dessert! Odd layout though. I had to wait for a table and ended up just loitering the area and bar because there weren't any room to wait in the front without being in the way of other customers coming in.

If you want a quick bite this is definitely a great place to check out.. food is better then most Mexican restaurant I came across and you get a good portion of food... the menu is very simply burritos, tacos, or plato... service is rather quick so if you in a hurry like I'm always in don't worry...

The food was really excellent.The produce was very fresh and the food was very clean tasting but also flavorful. My water cress salad and vegetable pasta dish both had very unique flavors that were unlike anything I'd tasted before. I would like to say that I wish there were more vegetarian options. I've heard such great things about the burgers, so I'd love to see a unique veggie burger. I also found that the wait staff could not give me a clear answer on the ingredients in the dishes I asked about, which is of great concern to me as a vegetarian and a person with food allergies. I would recommend Crescent Grill to a friend but until there are more vegetarian options on the menu that I can be sure I can eat because I know the ingredients, I don't see this as a place I would return again and again, which is a shame because I did enjoy my meal.

It's hard to write a review for a place I haven't been able to try! A few friends and I tried going last night around 6:45pm (google and the door says opened until 9) and the doors were locked. The two staff members inside ignored our knocking until we eventually made eye contact with one. We were told the store was closed for the day because they ran out of food. With the 20minute drive we took to get there, it's needless to say we were completely disappointed. I'm not sure when any of us will find time to go again- such a long trip for a place that is unprepared enough to run out of food with a staff that will ignore potential customers...

One of the best lunches I've had in ages. Devils on horseback--so good. My mom loved the Mrs Palmer. Her trout was one of the best fish dishes she's ever had. Loved my smoked trout. Awesome bananas foster. Please read other reviews for descriptions of the ambiance. It's super cool, I'm just still too full and sleepy to continue.

Came by myself they were nice sat at the bar got a local brew. The food was great! The clam chowder is not what you expect it is fantastic! The hostess was really nice. Parking was a pain but the people and food overwhelmingly make up for it!!
Everything here is delicious, it's impossible to pick a favorite because everything is so damn good. It's worth going back to try everything & they serve wine!!

Paneer tikka butter masala, saag paneer, navratan korma, vegetable biryani, aloo papri chaat .... and the list goes on!! I could never stop falling in love with this place every time I go there! I mean, it is SO perfect!! I had tried a couple of places for authentic Indian food in and around Philly, but nothing beats KARMA! No one could, actually! The food is so sumptuous here; you would definitely get whatever and exactly the way you want it! Their chef is just apt for an Indian restaurant that while eating, you tend to forget you are not in India. The service is 'what any customer wishes for'; their manager is amazing and owner Jiji Thomas is super-friendly. Believe you me, they make the BEST naans (Indian breads) ever! They are so fresh and delicious.... especially the garlic naan is to die for!! I definitely recommend Kandhari Naan (bread stuffed with pistachios, raisins, and some nuts), which could also be ordered as a dessert with mouthwatering mango chutney. My husband just loves the chicken and shrimp biryani they make with amazing spices. He is all praises for The Rack of Lamb, Chicken Tikka Masala, Tootak (Chicken Wings)  and what not!! We both CAN'T have enough of Karma ever!!
Great ambience and pasta, and it a fun neighborhood for a drink afterwards. Really lovely dishes, though portions are a bit small for the price. Definitely get a pasta dish and try the tartare.
We dined in regularly at their old location (11th and Moore) and cannot wait to visit Teddy and crew in their new home. Great sushi, great service, very reasonably priced. See you guys soon!!!

Stopped in for a quick bite and drinks with friends. From the moment we came in we were treated to a lovely setting, great service and good food. We chatted-it-up and never felt rushed. Must come back for the brunch - it's apparently something you should not miss!

I requested Italian food and got brought to this place by a friend. The doors and windows were open and the weather was perfect. This restaurant is perfection for date night. The food was amazing I ordered the rigatoni and the pink sauce it comes with is absolutely delicious. My friend tried it and ordered just the sauce for his chicken. I got the tiramisu and it was amazing!!!! They served it in a mason jar I only wished it were a little bigger. Would definitely come here again! Only problem is they don't serve pizza :(
Can't go wrong with any choice here, except not going Chronic style on your order.  Usually end up getting the 5 deal and then ordering 3 more.  Try and stop by here every time in in LES.

Quick and tasty, came here on a Sunday evening for a light dinner.  Shared the hummus and feta sandwich with a side of arugula/salmon salad and it was just the right amount of food.  Everything was flavorful, fresh, and simple, I left feeling full and healthy.  The staff behind the counter was helpful and friendly.
The hostess not only looks like a homeless woman but had a nasty attitude. The place was empty so I see no reason to not smile and act pleasant when someone walks in the door.

This has been my best dining experience in NYC. Their sauces are better than any other place I have been to. Get the spinach gnocchi and the ravioli in pink sauce. Spaghetti in fresh tomate sauce is great too. Amazing for vegetarians!

Thank Goodness for the Groupon discount! Still spent additional $100 on top of the $70 for $120 deal. I'll tip my hat off to their freshness. The Hamachi melts in yo mouf! Although their sushi is fresh, Zento is quite too expensive for their serving sizes. $8 for a hand roll that you can devour in a single bite is ridiculous. Oh. Don't get the Ramen. I was just curious toward the end of my meal, and you really just need to order the sushi! The ramen noodles were too thin to be ramen, and the broth was more on the salty side for my palette. Also, appetizer Calamari was also too breaded! Not enjoyable.
Great late night spot - I prefer the mixed platter. Make sure to get extra white sauce!

I ate here with a friend and the appetizer we chose was the  "BBQ Thai Wings ". They were the best damn wings I've had in a while. I wish they were a main dish. I then had the seafood and noodle soup (with shrimp and squid) which was good. The squid was a bit tough to chew but other than that, good soup. I forgot the dish my friend ordered. All I remember is it was a curry dish. I tried a bit of it and found it weird tasting. To me anyway. I'd eat here again if I was in the neighborhood.

We came here because it was highly recommended as one of the best pork sandwiches place and it was! We had a pull pork sandwich with hot pepper, cheese and broccoli.  The pork was tender.  The bread was fresh.  It was yum to the last bite.

Full disclosure: I've been delaying posting a Yelp review on Vino Levantino for the past month because I'm afraid this could quickly become the next "go-to wine bar" on the Upper West Side. That being said, this is easily the best spot in the neighborhood. Save yourself the hype and pricetag of more "sceney" UWS venus. Vino Levantino is the best place to unwind and have a great conversation, either with friends of the staff, who are all fantastic. Perks: Great wine selection, fantastic homemade food, and a perfect environment to catch up with friends. I've been coming here 1-3 times a week for the past month, and I'm still excited to try more items on their menu. I've tried the chicken kebab, the roasted half eggplant, and the tomato raynado. I've heard great things about their lamb, tuna tartare, and octopus salad. Pro Tip: Their happy hour is 7 days a week from 5 - 7. Fantastic deal on wine and some appetizers (go for the eggplant crostini!)

i had my daughter's bridal shower in the cozy, light-filled back room at palo santo.  the guests were greeted with cheery glasses of bubbling prosecco, perfect for ramping up the festive feel and toasting the special occasion.  the food was scrumptious, served family style on large platters that never seemed to empty, as replacements were brought in as soon as guests began devouring what was there.  everything was delicious, but the pollo guisado and heritage pork were divine with lovely little morsels of pupusas to round out the flavors.  gonzalo, the events coordinator, could not have been more gracious or accommodating.  i highly recommend this venue!

Amazing- their chicken is unbelievably tasty but very soft, their rib eye is very juicy and yummy, and I love their fake candle that doesn't look so fake ;)! Overall, I feel this place is a must go, and if I drop by this area again, I will Definitely come again!!!

When my 30th birthday rolled around, I knew I wanted some upscale Mexican food. A couple of Best Of lists and a bunch of yelp reviews later, I decided on Toloache. We considered all three locations, but opted for the Village location to be closer to bars after dinner. I'm so happy that we did! The entire experience at Toloache was great, and it ended up being the perfect birthday dinner. The Food: There were three of us, so we opted to share and eat tapas style. We started with the guacamole trio. It is a MUST TRY! Amazing. The price is a bit steep at $24, but I didn't regret it for a second. The Frutas (guac with mango and pomegranate!) and the Rojo were both to die for. We then shared the fish tacos, the quesadilla de huitlacoche y trufas (mushroom and truffles), and the hamachi ceviche. My boyfriend loved the quesadilla, but I thought the ceviche was the winner. Each dish was great though. The Drinks: The margaritas were all excellent, but to really have your mind blown, make sure to order the mezcalita cocktail with grilled pineapple and jalapeño. I wish I had one right now. So good! So good! So good! The Service: The service was the best part. Our server was patient through all of our annoying questions, gave great advice about what to order and once he heard it was my birthday, was sure that he and his servers gave me an appropriately embarrassing and totally fun birthday song and (delicious!) flan dessert. And, before we even mentioned my birthday, the manager Luis stopped by just to make sure that we were enjoying ourselves. My boyfriend made some joke that he enjoyed, which led him to bring us a round of tequila shots on the house. So fun! I will certainly be back! Highly recommended!
I love this place!  Great food and nice people.  Loved the vibe.  I highly recommend it!!!!

The veggie pizza is very good. Order the pizza with thin crust. You can add desired toppings to your pizza. Sometimes pizza comes slightly over salted but mostly the pizza is just the perfect!. Staff behave politely and keep the takeout timings. I would definitely go there again.

This restaurant is amazing! The food was delicious (I had the Spicy Drunken Noodle and my friend had The Dark Night). My only reason for not giving it 5 stars is because it was a little pricier than your average thai place. The ambiance, decor was great. They also offer cooking classes on the weekend!! How cute/amazing is that?

I always mean to try other things on the menu when I visit here, but I end up stuffing myself with pork soup dumplings before I even get to ordering other dishes. The hot soup in the dumplings is divine, and the dumpling skin is incredibly thin and tender. As with many Chinatown spots, service is brusque and space is extremely limited - don't be surprised to be sitting elbow to elbow with strangers. Also, try and come during off-peak hours to avoid waiting.
Wonderful! Creative and delicious menu, personal service. Don't miss the corn brûlée dessert!

Delicious!! Got a Carnitas burrito and it was as good as (or better than) Anna's Taqueria in Boston, which is no small feat. Way better than Chipotle, no contest. Cute little place that moves quick! And close to the park, great place to take your food to go!

Incredible authentic Italian food, warm, friendly service in a cozy atmosphere. My husband and I vacationed in central Jersey (OK, I'm originally a Jersey girl) so we could take day trips to Princeton, the Sculpture Garden in Hamilton, the Jersey shore and visit family. On our way back to the hotel from the Sculpture Garden, we came upon Mamma Rosa's. Being fans of locally-owned restaurants, we pulled in. We were served by the owner and his daughter, treated like family -- the perfect balance of care and attention and time to ourselves and had one of the best meals ever. My husband used to own a restaurant and worked in the business most of his life -- he knows restaurants and food. We would both go out of our way to eat there again. Delicioso!
Excellent food, service, and atmosphere.  I was in town on business and saw positive Yelp reviews.  Didn't dissapoint
great food - try wonton noodle soup.  Hong Kong quality.  Xiao Long Bao also delicious.  Service can be better though.  Need smile.

Mix is one of my all time favorite places for PIZZA! Let me reiterate, for Pizza. I give them 4 solid stars based on my love their pizza. If I were rating them on other foods as well I'd probably go with a 3. I'm not a huge fan of pizza and I have to be in a mood for it. That being said Mix was one of the first places that won me over instantly with their pizza. And Is THE place I compare all other pizza places to. Something about that wood fired dough. Thin (but not too thin) and crunchy. A very flavorful dough. The perfect combination of spice and grease from the pepperoni. It's heaven. The pizza at mix is garlic-y. Perhaps a bit too garlic-y for my tastes but that doesn't stop me from thoroughly enjoying their pie. When I'm in Philly I stop at Mix quite a bit. I've tried several of their dishes none of which I've ever been inspired to have again. In fact nothing I can say I really enjoyed. Once dish in particular the watermelon gazpacho I actually returned. That soup was horrible. A watery broth that tasted nothing of watermelon and diced herbs and veggies floating around in it. I thought gazpacho was supposed to be pureed? Well this wasn't. Hopefully they have taken this off the menu by now. The restaurant itself is very cute. Be prepared to swelter if you sit near the front because that oven throws off some serious heat. Design flaw, the restrooms sit smack dab in the middle of the restaurant. So be prepared to feel super awkward if you have the need to relieve yourself. Also do not by any means get those few tables situated right outside the restroom. AWKWARD. Not to mention gross.

Loved the poached egg salad and wine, but the salad was a limited time item :( Love the ambiance. I feel happy and sophisticated when I go there- very courteous staff. A nice gem near Columbia University!

Delicious! I'd have Brooklyn Taco over Chipotle any day! Limited menu choices but what they do offer is great! Love meatless Mondays since my husband doesn't eat meat. Guacamole is delicious chunkiness. A bit on the pricey side but they definitely give you your money's worth! A must try!!!
Everything i've had here is amazing. Especially their vegetarian ramen!

across the street from the brooklyn museum, this place looks like a run down shack.  we came around 530 pm on sunday and was greeted by a lady sitting on the stool instructing the 2 lady cooks behind the counter.  Everyone is very nice, there is 2 tables outside and additional seating upstairs.  Its really cramped quarters and while i waited a good half hour after i ordered my food, i saw a ton of people from all walks of life come through and order takeout and sit in.   I ordered a small plate of oxtail, which is very large still.  Came with three gigantic pieces in a delicious subtle sauce, not spicy.  Came with rice and peas and veggies which looked like boiled cabbage, corn and some other indistinguishable greens.  the salad was just some leaves with a slice of tomato with olive oil drizzled on top. I also order the mac and cheese.  It was baked with breadcrumbs on top.  I prefer my mac and cheese bursting with flavor and super cheesy, this was on the milder side, might work for some people.  i also had some of my dates stew chicken.  the skin had a crispness to it that made me think the chicken may have been fried first. overall it was decent food the place is ran so poorly and disorganized.  i wont be going back.

I came for Hibachi with a Groupon and overall I will give 3.5 stars. I was seated right away but rest of service was slowish but courteous. Our hostess came to check with the table only once. Also, I had to request chopsticks since they only put 1 fork per person, no other cutlery was offered (?) 3 stars Food was good and plentiful. I liked that their vegetable selection is more varied than most, their noodles & fried rice (extra $2) were delicious and chicken & salmon were well cooked though I had better. The Miso soup was really tasty. 4 stars The chef in the table next to us was amazing and had us laughing from across the room. Out chef was nice but wasn't as entertaining. I guess is the luck of the draw. 3.5 stars The prices even without the Groupon were reasonable and I may come back if I am in the area.

I had a pretty long day and I needed to catch up on some reading and unwind a bit. My buddy told me there was a good cafe up the street called "Henry something something on the right". I got the straight black coffee and a chocolate croissant. This was pretty much exactly what I was hoping for. More cafés should be like this. TL;DR: Solid cafe. Reasonably priced; good atmosphere; nice coffee.

Not sure what the hype is about. Average bar food at best. Weak atmosphere and loud. Onion rings tasted like onion rings, "secret sauce" was honey mustard out of a bottle.... And .50c for a refill of it,... Won't be returning.

GREAT food and great service. Loved that it was byob too! I got the cali-turkey sandwich and absolutely loved it. My boyfriend the huevos rancheros and was impressed. The portions are huge and our waitress was very nice and attentive. Definitely going back!

I was really looking forward to dining here and experiencing a broad array of Brazilian food.  The reviews were great, I had a Groupon, so I figured this was the perfect opportunity.  We visited on a Tuesday night.  Maybe my expectations were too high, or maybe I'm just picky, or maybe it was just a slow night for them because the buffet options were limited and all the meats were dried out (except for the lamb) like they'd been sitting around warming for far too long. Maybe if they cooked larger pieces, they wouldn't dry out so fast.  I asked for med-rare, but med to med-well was about all they could offer.  The beef was very salty as well. As I stated, the buffet options appeared limited to me for a Brazilian restaurant, there were only about 8 different sides on it besides salad.   I enjoyed the quinoa and collards, black beans, rice cakes and lamb, but that was about it.  Didn't really eat much of the meat since most of it was so dry.  We ended up spending $60 for 3 people and I'm glad I had a Groupon, because I didn't enjoy it very much.  It's ok, but definitely no where near as good as a Fogo de Chao.  I've had great BraziIian food before and this is lacking in comparison.  I won't be returning.
Tuesday night trivia was a lot of fun. Cheese steaks are great plus their new buffalo fries are amazing!!!!

Too much food!!! I got the Thali lunch special and when I got it I thought it was for two. Anyways... It was amazing. And the folks running the place are just beautiful. So welcoming and friendly. I live all the way in Brooklyn and will definitely make the journey back this way. And what a bargain. Loved it!!!

This place is the definition of hit or miss for me. I have probably had some of the best sushi I have ever had from there, but I have also had some bad experiences. My previous order arrived it was like a ball of mush, and I had to throw most of it out.  But the time before they had me wanting more. I'll be back but with my expectations have been lowered.

I've been dining at Minetta for years, and it's hands down the best restaurant in NYC. The food is always incredible (bone marrow, lamb saddle, cote de bouef, pomme frittes and the black label are can't misses).  The Pistachio de la Rosa is my favorite cocktail in the city. What makes Minetta so special, is the staff. Their genuine warmth and hospitality should serve as an inspiration to every restaurant in NYC. Minetta is a can't miss.

They give you a really great complementary sweet after your email And it taste so greek in other words. Good and sweet.  Try the fish bait( its fried) with calamari ( fried) with any fish they have. It is really good and nice outside sitting area.  But you do have to deal with this one host who might tell you her life story of how long she sits people down ( when you try to tell her is my party next to be seated). Cause they dont do RSVP so come during a good time as in non busy time or you will wait anxiously for table.

Good food, good cocktails, excellent service, excellent atmosphere. The decor is dark and sexy. An excellent date spot. The owner, Erika, is always here and always an amazing host. However, the thing that sets this place apart from most is the incredibly sexy atmosphere. The food, drink, decor, service; they all create something unique. A very special place with a good future ahead!
Get the Pork Belly Banh Mi  and the Kimchi Fries. AMAZINGGGGGGG!
Wonderful family place to eat. Staff is very friendly and this is a great location to bring friends.

Good service, great food. Been here 3 times, consistently good. Broccoli rabe dish is my favorite. My fiancé thinks they should fill up the wine glasses more. Will definitely be back again. There's always a wait but what do you expect when a place is good

really love this place.  Not only do they have one of the largest selections of beer I've seen they have such tasty sandwiches.  The tuna is fantastic and rolls are sooo good. They serve summer cocktails and have really good evening specials.  It's super casual.. wooden booths and a communal table.

I literally cannot. I lack the ability to even. this place is the most amazing combination of southern cooking and New York class ever. the chicken and rosemary waffles are great, but the drinks and desserts are out of this world. Jair's recommendations were spot on. He's kind of a bad ass.

Roaming around in the West Village I stumbled on this place. Loved the yelp reviews it had and decided to try. I ordered the Spinach Gnocchi. As other reviewers have said - it was totally amazing!!! I will be back as much as my budget allows to me come here because I have become a big fan.

I've been talking about the sandwich I had here for three years now, and just realized I never Yelped about it. Better late than never! Brisket, provolone cheese, broccoli rabe. Best sandwich I've ever had. Yes the line was long, but it was so worth it. It was also worth standing in line again on my last day in Philly to get one to take to the airport. And I still talk about it whenever discussion turns to Philadelphia, or sandwiches.
I do enjoy their pizza and salad. The wait times are usually pretty quick and the ambiance is nice! Menu is a little small.

I searched high and low for an impressive but local/seasonal place to treat my hard-to-please boyfriend for his 35th. We've gone to Blue Ribbon and Mas, and our experience with the tasting menu at Prospect was BY FAR OUR BEST DINING EXPERIENCE IN NYC to date. We sat at the chef's table and I had pre-called the day before to alert them to one vegetarian tasting and asked if they could include candles on the dessert. The staff was accommodating, and pleasant. Front of the house staff were sweet, attentive but not oppressive and enhanced our enjoyment. The wine pairing was impeccable. A refreshingly unique rose to start with integrity, amazing whites and reds and a Croatian dessert wine paired with tres-leches cake (neither item I've ever liked, but here at Prospect? Absolutely astounding). The chef, Nathan, was friendly, entertaining, knowledgeable and killed it with every course. They specialize in vegetables and it's clear they know what they're doing. We even ended up next to their local-farm vegetable finder. The kitchen was a perfectly-oiled machine operating with 3 and the back staff were polished and graceful. I can't say enough about how much we loved this place other than it was so good we want to send them flowers.
This place has an amazing happy hour @4:30! The staff makes you feel at home. Moses is my favorite and always makes sure we have everything we need. This is a great spot!
You must order the fried brussels sprouts!! Not breaded like I imagined but wonderfully crunchy and completely amazing! Service was excellent, house made ravioli was incredible. All wins!
Food is to die for. I love this place. Great design, love the atmosphere.

Not only is this the best food in Brooklyn but the service and management go out of their way to make you feel welcome. Last week, my partner and I had a lovely dinner. After getting back home I noticed I had a Facebook message from the manager Eric telling me I had left my wallet. He had found my name from my ID, sent me a friend request and message. Needless to say, my wallet was safe and sound, not a dollar missing. This is Brooklyn at its best.

The food here is GREAT! I've only been here a few times, but will definitely visit again! i love italian food and thought about trying this place out with a friend. she got the manicotti and I got the penne vodka. They were both excellent. Dessert was even better!

I looked online to see where to get the best cheesecake in New York and and Junior's popped up several times. Did not disappoint at all. It's family owned so everything seems like it still matters. The food was great and the staff was very friendly. We ended up sitting at the bar so we could be seated right away and the bartender was very attentive and personable. Never tried any other cheesecake while in New York but I can say that it's probably the best I've had. Definitely gotta use their online delivery in the future.

If you are looking for the best slice of pie you've ever tasted, look no further. RK's coconut creme pie is by far the best dessert I could indulge in. Not to say the entrees aren't delicious (we also had the salad rolls, nachos, and pad thai...all fresh and amazing) but this pie. The thick chocolate crust and delicious fleshy coconut smothered in a fresh whipped cream...perfection!
Good, but nothing amazing.  Nice interior, food was okay

1st review ever for me but a must. The Zutto Pork Belly bun was devine 11/10. I couldn't get over how amazing It was and then the Maine sushi was amazing too. I'm from Australia and in culture we don't do reviews but my wife and I had such an amazing experience here I just had To review.. Thanks again staff was amazing also cheers!!!!!!

i hit up stix daily and am never disappointed in the product.  Tina in particular greets me with a fantastic smile and described me as "smelling rich."  which i appreciated.  Love this joint..order coffee stay for the good vibes. winner.

This place is my favorite in the Nolita area. Lived in Little Italy last year and frequented BarBossa for drinks and dinner often. Also got takeout several times but made sure to pick it up so my friend and I could grab a drink at the bar while we waited. I think only once did I not order the seafood stew - it's so good I find myself craving it if I haven't eaten it in a while. It's the perfect portion size and even tastes great as takeout! This place is awesome, go!!!

I been going to Wafas since its inception around 2007. A lot has changed as its business transformed from a 4 seater take out restaurant to a 30 diner restaurant with 3 servers including the owner's sons. The food is excellent packed full of flavor but I do warn you if you are looking for Lamb or Chicken please do not order the Platter. The term Platter generally indicates large portion of the good stuff. However you will be disappointed because the same serving of Lamb or Chicken in the Platter is the same serving in the Sandwich. Keep in mind the Sandwich is $7-9 dollars whereas the Platter is $15-18. What you get for the extra 10 dollars is a overload of sides it can be pounds of rice or humas your choice. The amount of sides are overkill compared to 4 small cubes of Lamb or Chicken. If you really want Lamb or Chicken I suggest the sandwich . No need to pay extra 10 dollars for rice and humas . As a result you get three stars for portion. If you don't believe me order the Platter and see for your self. Recommend action: Serve more Lamb to balance the sides.

AMAZING food! I ate here last night with my friend, who raved about his previous experiences here. I'm somewhat new to Spanish food (and COMPLETLY new to tapas), so I was nervous about trying something new. I wasn't disappointed! The calamari was stellar, and the tres leches cake was to die for! My only complaint: the service. Waiters walked by our table several times without so much as glancing at us, and our dinner ended up taking almost 3 hours due to the slow service! Nonetheless, I can't wait to come back!

If you are a spicy seeker try the top level spicy wings. I reckon I am in the 90th percentile for spicy tolerance, but  these wings are seriously spicy. I was eating them at home, so after every two wings my dog came over to make sure I was ok (I could eat two then I had to wait five minutes in between wings). After four wings, I could feel the blood pulsing through my face and my teeth were tingling. After six I had to get up and walk around the kitchen. Eventually I sat down and concentrated on my breathing. To sum, if you REALLY LIKE SPICY and it has been too long since you have really had that wig pushed back, I recommend the wings top level hot, I promise it is hot.

Omg amazing meatloaf sandwich. Cute and quiet space In my neighborhood  that I always go to because it's cheap, cozy, always has great music at just the right volume, the bartenders are always sweet, and everyone else lets you mind your own business. Highly recommend sitting outside in the summer!
THE BEST IN NYC! Waits can be long, but go in a smaller group and you'll be just fine!
Love this place. The pizza is how pizza is supposed to be. The staff and management is always friendly and helpful. I come here every now and then when I have some spending cash.
best ramen ever.

If you are a fan of Japanese food, eat here!  Amazing, unique touches to traditional Japanese cuisine. Delicious food. Excellent, friendly service. It was quite crowded with people who were waiting. I went alone and was seated right away.

Great ambience the dark lighting gave a cozy feel but horrible for crappy camera phones. We didn't have to wait much. The food was good but I was disappointed. I discover them at the big Apple barbecue and the food was awesome. I guess I build up the experience in my head. However Sunday the brisket was charred on top and even though the meat was tender underneath that charred taste ruined the experience. Four dollars for a glass of cream soda masquerading as a pint. Appetizer was three tiny pieces of chicken. At the end of the day the food was good but the experience was disappointing. Oh yeah no parking so you gotta hunt for a spot. And if you're going to give this place a try I highly recommend you make a reservation because even on a Sunday it was crowded.

I love soup dumplings anywhere, and this was no exception. I'm also told by those more knowledgeable on the subject, that these were exceptionally good soup dumplings on account of the soup itself. Good enough for me. The eggplant in garlic sauce was good too.

The delivery was prompt. No plates, crushed peppers or parmesan cheese for the pizza even though I told them delivery is to the hotel. Pizza was just ok.  Don't expect NY style or anything delicious. Good for late hours when nothing is open.
Ended up randomly having dinner here and couldn't have been happier with it.  The atmosphere is amazing as is the food.

I have been hoping around from place to place living in Bloomfield I have had some very bad experiences with Chinese food. I must say lucky star is the best in the area, that I have tried so far. I have tried quiet a few. Delivery time isn't something that gets to me as long as freshness is there. Until they wrong me I am sticking with this place.
I love love love this place, the people, the atmosphere, the food. It can be very touristy...but I never mind it. I love whenever I get the chance to come here!

The staff was extremely friendly. I wanted the chicken satay tacos but my eyes were drawn to the chicken katsu platter. The platter was tasty and the portion was decent for $5. I was content. Coming back for more.

We stumbled onto Lena's during a biking trip last weekend. This place is a real gem. It oozes visual charm from the inside out. Tastefully decorated with a charming, friendly staff. The food was a terrific payoff for the exterior trappings. We had pannini sandwiches that were delicious and plentiful. We also had a side of a quiona salad that was tasty and unusual. Happy to go back again!! Buon mangiare!

Good Thai food, definitely more of the traditional family owned feel and style food that I prefer.  There's some other modern/fusion Thai available in the area, but it's far more expensive and I prefer this style anyway.  They deliver free in the area, and it's always really fast.  I live just a block off the Liberties Walk so this is one of my go to joints.

Five stars for service! I met up with some old friends here. We laughed (probably obnoxiously loud at times) and caught up for three hours. Even after we were the only table left, they didn't pressure us to leave or make us feel uncomfortable. Our waitress was fantastic and super accommodating, even taking pictures of us. She even commented on how jealous she was of how much fun we were having. I'm sure as we were leaving sometime after 10pm, they wanted to give a kick on the way out, but everyone wished us a good night. I would return for these reasons alone. Now for the food. Three stars. I really enjoyed the fresh bread basket with the dipping oil/spices. The spinach artichoke dip was tasty, but really greasy in the bottom of the bowl. Also, it had a strange smoky flavor that just didn't belong. The caesar salad was good with a nice strong caesar flavor dressing (not watery or bland like most I've encountered). The pizza was pretty good, but the underlying crust was a tad on the soggy side. I think they overdid the toppings and skimped on the cheese. Overall, it was a great night and when in the area again, I'll definitely return.

Nach vielen Empfehlungen waren wir mit der Familie in Joe's. Getränke sind außer dem Bier gewohnt günstig, Preise vom Essen sind in Ordnung. Man sitzt mit Fremdem an einem großen Tisch,kein Problem. Von den 3 Gerichten die wir hatten waren 3 sehr gut und 1 ganz ok. Jedes Kölner Chinarestaurant kann bei den Nudeln mithalten, die anderen Gerichte waren jedoch sehr lecker. Toilletten sind nicht sehr hygienisch. Alles in allem ein leckeres Essen bei außergewöhnlichem Ambiente.. Die Stars an der Wand sprechen für das leckere Essen. Der Eindruck von außen täuscht!!

This place is an all around solid and great restaurant. Great location, nice ambiance, modern decor, good vibe, outdoor seating. The food is delicious and consistent and very fairly priced. The cocktails are some of the best in town although they are a little on the small side. My wife loves the "adult milkshakes." Tonight, I had the chicken noodle soup which was obviously homemade but nothing too special and the chicken quesadillas which were really good. My wife LOVED her Moroccan Salmon Salad! The salmon was perfectly cooked and had a delicious cinnamon rub. She switched out the greens for kale and was very pleased. I've had burgers here before as well as some of their specials and was always satisfied.   Definitely recommend this place for solid, delicious, fairly priced (if a little unimagined) food.

You don't find many GOOD BYOB Sushi restuarants in the city and it makes me so happy that this is one of the best and only one block from my apt. You can't go wrong with any of their apps and the Medusa roll is amazing. They are very accommodating, although when they are very busy, it seems a few waiters can take a bit longer to get to you. Other than that, SO good.

Got there just as breakfast was changing to lunch. Didn't get to try the eggs Florentine but did have the mozzarella sandwich. Really great. Fresh and flavorful arugula and pesto without the typical oilyness. Also, the mac and cheese is the best EVER. Creamy inside crunchy outside. Walk the highline afterward to work off the calories though :-)

Had brunch with a girl friend.  Excited to try given all the hype and I love Element with same owner.  Thought it was just ok.  We got 6, 7 dishes to share - overall pretty good; presentation very nice but a bit heavy on the salt.  Service was good.  For this price, would expect more.  Perhaps dinner is different but overall it's decent but don't feel like it's great.

Tonight was the second time, in as many weeks, that my husband and I ventured out to the new Nolita Restaurant in East Hartford.  The food was DELICIOUS and fresh.  It was plated to appeal to the eye. as well as the palate.  The homemade pasta was beyond words and the salmon was Frrresh and wonderfully seasoned.   The only problem I had was that my martini was served in, get this, a bulbous red wine glass.  It took so much away from the martini experience.  All we got from the server was "lip service" via way of apology.  I know this might seem like a simple thing, but a martini by definition is served in a special glass.  Waiting for the drink to reach my lips was torture.  My second martini came in the appropriate glass.  Also, to add insult to injury, there was neither olive nor onion as a garnish.  I love olives with my martini.  The garden salad was fresh and the homemade dressing was flavorful; it had a nice balance of vinegar to sweetness ratio.  Our dessert was fresh cheesecake medallions with chocolate mouse medallions.  I thoroughly enjoyed the lightness and the distinctive flavors of the chocolate, the mango and the ricotta cheesecake.  My husband didn't care for the ricotta texture of the cheesecake.  Being from Brooklyn, he prefers a creamy  "NY style" cheesecake.   We have plans to return to Nolita this month with friends.  Hopefully the bar will have enough glasses in stock; perhaps I'll order another stye drink or bring my own glass.

Service was great! Very nice. They charged my iPhone for me. The pictures should do the talking. I had the "beef." It was a pretty hanger steak. They didn't ask how I wanted it which I thought was strange. I tasted the pork. Very tasty. I had the green bean salad. Pretty good when you ate all the bits. Had a lot of the desserts and the cheese platter.

A jewel on the upper west side! The menu offers an incredible amount of diversity for a Mediterranean restaurant. From vegetarian friendly dishes to decadent seafood pasta and a sensational filet mignon -- there is really something for everyone. Great staff as well! Our waiter, Jake, was very attentive and refreshingly familiar with every item on both the food and wine menu. He suggested the most wonderful French Syrah with my entree. Also, the bartender introduced us to a sensational white wine - I highly recommend the Gruner Veltiner. Overall - great restaurant, would highly recommend.

Bill's is your basic breakfast and lunch items at a cheap price.  Contrary to what a few yelpers have said, it IS clean and the food is prepared in front of you.  The salad items are displayed and are always fresh and clean.  You won't get a gourmet lunch here and there's not a lot of sit-down space, but that's not what Bill's is about.  It can get crazy busy around lunch time with lunch take-outs, but that's because everyone in the area knows it's reliable, well prepared, no-surprise basics.

My boyfriend and i stumbled upon this place and decided we would give it a try. The staff was great, the facility is quaint, and food was delicious. I told  my friends about this place. I would definitely go back!

This place is great!  The UES is really stepping up its game in the restaurant category.  Drunken Monkey is definitely at the top of the list.  Excellent food and really nice for large parties (I went recently for a birthday party).  You have to try the crispy okra and the punch bowl.

Incredibly overpriced for the food and atmosphere. Food is mediocre. Highly doubt if anyone goes there fpr a second time. Whatwver else you do, wherever else u go it will be a better way to spend your money. The wholefoods burrata tastes much better than what the eddy offers. Only good thing is the beef tongue pastramy. I never write reviews but this time i couldnt stop myself.

I used to live on Dean Street, but I moved away many years ago.  My friend still lives in the neighborhood and told me about this spot.  I went in and was immediately greeted.  I ordered the 1lb crab platter with potatoes and corn to go.  OMGGGG.  I made a complete pig of myself when I got home.  It was so good.  Everything was cooked to perfection; not oily, not salty, just damn good food.  NOM NOM

Barbuto has a great atmosphere and it's perfect for a warm evening since the front of the restaurant opens up and it feels like you are dining alfresco but it is VERY noisy.  The service wasn't very good.  Our waiter was lovely but wasn't around very often. We tried to order starters while waiting for a member of our party and we were told that the chef likes to receive complete orders so we could have the Salumi but nothing else until we were ready to order dinner.  The Salumi was good but not very large. We had: the eggplant bruschetta, kale salad and squid salad to start.  The winner was hands-down the bruschetta.  It was really fantastic. Everyone also loved the kale salad but I found it a bit too salty (I'd say the saltiness was an arching theme to the meal and I LOVE salt).  The squid was very good but a little small. We had the gnocchi and the Bolognese.  The Bolognese was the standout of the evening.  It was really delicious.  The gnocchi were fine but I thought they were just too salty. We ordered the steak, lamb, chicken and swordfish.  We all liked the steak and most of the table liked the chicken.  The chicken was very good but I didn't care for the salsa verde at all.  One of my dining companions said she has eaten comparable birds at Pio Pio.  The swordfish was good but a little small.  The lamb was okay. I ordered it medium-rare and had to send it back to the kitchen because it was over-cooked (I have actually never done that before).  The peppers and onions that came with the lamb were excellent. The fried potatoes were another highlight of the meal.  We also had the fagioli which were very good. We had the chocolate pudding for dessert which was delicious and we also had the blueberry torte with honey ice cream which was phenomenal.  We ordered 2 bottles of wine and with tip it came to $100 per/person. We had a very nice evening but I probably wouldn't return.
We LOVE this restaurant! We eat here at least once a month. The staff, the atmosphere, and the food are phenomenal! We are never disappointed when we come here.

New Moon is a good place to cozy up and get to work, and many students in the area do just that. For their free wifi and spacious seating, it is pretty good. The last time I went there, I waited at least half an hour for a sandwich midday when the lines were down. And employee even painstakingly made a (his?) sandwich directly in front of me without acknowledging me at all. When mine was finally made, they gave it to the wrong person. I'm usually not this picky about places, as I understand how tiring it can be to work in the food service industry, but the inadequate service here left a bad taste in my mouth. Not to mention the grilled vegetable sandwich really wasn't anything special.

A really nice welcome from the owner behind the bar. Huge Ceasar salad that is excellent. Pizza was awesome. We tried to order a large but she talked us in to a medium that was still too much. Andrea was a terrific server. Cheese cake and tiramisu was awesome. An amazing NY Italian family dining experience.
The macarons are exceptional. The bests are: fleur d'oranger and vanilla. A must to have.
Awesome!! Excellent food and service, free wifi and its Byob. There are great belly dancers and cool decor.
Food was excellent . Our group tried a variety of dishes . Our waiter R (don't remember his full name) was knowledgeable and helpful. I will go again

This place is by far the best Thai food in NYC! It can be a really cool date place and a fun hangout spot with friends also! Love the red curry and calamari+shrimp mixture pad Thai! Very unique and legitimate Thai food!

As the old saying goes, "You've tried the rest, now try the best!"... I am a New Yorker who has tasted bagels all over Manhattan; a self-proclaimed bagel officianato...the food here deserves the highest Zagat rating possible! The staff is incredibly knowledgeable and quick and friendly. Watch out, Manhattan! Plaza Bagels should open a Manhattan location! They're that great!

Beef brisket flavor is to die for. I don't typically go for red meat but now I totally understand why brisket is such a big deal to some people. This first try left me speechless. Smokey, juicy, and just perfection for the tastebuds. Pulled pork was good but forgettable next to that brisket. Looking forward to trying the beans with burnt ends.

Best sushi ever. EVER. We are sushi fanatics and are always looking for a good place to eat with quality ingredients. Well this place is an hour away for us and we still come as much as possible. Husband and wife run this place together and are always friendly. Prices are great and we never leave hungry. Their sushi is always tasty and the ingredients are always fresh.  The romantic roll and crunchy spicy tuna are our favorites. And the mochi ice cream at the end is the best part of our day. We went today for my husband's birthday and we were not disappointed. Our meal consisted of tea, miso soup, edamame, shrimp sashimi, 4 rolls and dessert all for under $45. Don't let the construction or location dissuade you from going! You will not be sorry you made the trip.

Keep trying to give this place another chance, but just continue to be disappointed whenever I order a bagel. This used to be my go-to spot, but not anymore. I just ordered an everything bagel w/ cream cheese, opened the foil and immediately regretted it. My bagel tasted (and felt) like 4 day old stale bread, and was not even warm despite my specifying "toasted". Seems petty to be so angry and annoyed about a bagel, but you're a cafe, and the bagels used to be on point. Sorry Milkcrate, I tried. What happened?
Such a fun place! The food is delicious especially the Mac and cheese! Great place to watch a game or have a delish dinner!

Hit this place by accident! Just wanted a quick bite after shopping. We were pleasantly surprised. From start to finish everyone was so pleasant! Our waitress, Erica was helpful with our decisions and we can be taxing with questions! The Ploughman's Sampler was a good size. Open Corned Beef was good. Artichoke Chicken was very good. I ordered with grilled chicken and was not dry or bland - thoroughly enjoyed. Beer selection great. We had Sugar Wash Moonshine first, then Bronx  Summer Ale both hit the spot ! We'll visit again!

Just the best pizza on the planet.  The sauce is homemade.  Not too sweet, not too acidic.  Spiced to perfections, but not too much.  Fresh cheese, fresh dough, frsh basil, and all made to order.  Worth the long wait, and worth the price.  Di Fara is a Brooklyn institution, but it should not be forgotten that it is revered because the pizza is sublime!  If you want quick, disgusting pizza, go to Domino's -- I'll stick with Di Fara.

Montana sure does have a lot of friends... its unbelievable that this place has almost no bad reviews... other than in the press I can't fathom anyone returning to this restaurant... unfortunately because i live in the neighborhood I have returned multiple times and each time has been worse than the rest... The food is obnoxiously over priced. under portioned. and not good... watery greens, greasy chicken... even greasier vegetables (which is weird vegetables shouldn't be greasy) The service literally couldn't be worse... never in my life have a heard the word "chill" used to describe menu items... and not just once it was for every single thing.... there was nothing "chill" about any of my experiences... The commodore is a perfect bar/restaurant severing similar food at half the cost, half the wait time and twice as good. I whole heartedly agree with the review written in the observer.   this is a Disney land theme restaurant trying to cash in on and aesthetic... the saddest part is what they don't know is that they're not pioneers... North east kingdom has been in the neighborhood for what? 7 maybe even 8 years? There's a cafe down the block with a waterfall in it!!! They're not trailblazer or trendsetters... the neighborhood is already dead and over... they might as well be selling "jefftown" hats and T shirts and beer cozys at a lil stand out front... if you want a drink. go to pearls. From what i can tell its an honest version of what Montana is trying to rip-off... it was nice of him to at least not open too close to them... oh wait.... it's a block away....

I went here with 5 of my friends for a special occasion and it was INCREDIBLE. We had an outstanding waiter who was very knowledgeable about the dishes and wine. The food was beautifully presented and delicious. We didn't have to wait long at all and the main course was a HUGE amount of food. The desserts were outstanding. I absolutely loved my time here and will definitely be back. What a first class establishment. The vibe was non-pretentious and fun.
Most delicious halal I've ever had didn't think I was ever gonna like the bread but once I tried it here I'm willing to eat it anywhere

Wow! I had such high hopes for this place, and of course I was extremely disappointed by the usual sub-par customer service found in most New Haven pubs. The "bouncer" and his cronies were smoking outside with the smoke coming into the restaurant. The host was not welcoming on our entrance, or our departure. The bartenders were weird, non-social, and on their Facebook the entire time. Difficult to get a drink when it wasn't busy at all. The food was nothing special. Greasy over cooked "Waffles" (fries) and the special sauce was thick and fatty mayo with some bland seasoning. Don't waste your time here. This is my 3rd time, and it'll hopefully be my last.
Eat at the bar: it's more reasonable. Great spot to sit outside and eat. Food is very average.

We went twice in one night to Riposa 72.  We were in UWS and wanted a comfortable and reviewed Wine Bar.  We chose this one for the reviews were great about the food and they were right!  We were greeted by a lovely waiter who gave us the window table.  We got wine and a cheese platter with Parmaggiano Reggiano that was beautiful and delicious!  The platter was perfect for two people and very filling. We also ordered the herbed olives.  Wow!  We were thoroughly impressed.  We are olive fanatics and not only were they fabulous but plentiful.  A big bowl of them including toasted baguette slices.   Wish I had room for the talked about vegetarian  flatbread, which I am surely having on our next visit . Our friends went back with us for more wine after a dinner at Cafe Talulah, and we had a great relaxing night enjoying a nice wine selection.
Only tried the kimchi soondubu but was really good!

The bread they use for their sandwiches is SO good. You can tell it's homemade bread and they cut the slices super thick. Yes the sandwich I got, the Vermont cured and smoked turkey, was great but I could just keep raving about the bread alone. Great deli spot right in the middle of downtown.
open to late midnight. Perfect to shopper

What a great destination! After visiting the WTC Memorial and Museum with my parents, we tried this upscale food court for a laid-back dinner. They are in their 70s and careful with their diet (no fast food) so I was really happy to find plenty of healthy options here. From Num Pang, got Pork Belly sandwich, Lemonade Gingerade, Blood Orange Gingerade. From Digg Inn Seasonal Market, got Grilled Salmon and Kale Apple Salad. Everything was delicious and my parents were very impressed. Brookfield Place is still under renovation so the food court was difficult to find and was not crowded. Most of the customers work in building or live nearby, but this food court is worth visiting on weekend or evenings (they are open til 9pm). It is modern, airy and spacious -- and a great place to catch the sunset! I will definitely be coming back!

I hate leaving negative reviews and I have a lot of empathy for people in the service industry. That said, the service here sucked and it ruined our entire experience. I came with a group of six people and we were seated within ten minutes. Not bad for a Friday night. But that was the end of the good times. The waiter kept confusing our order and wasn't very helpful. My friend ordered alcohol but it didn't get served until 20 minutes later. We never received water. Three burgers came out within half an hour but the other--which was also just a burger--took almost an hour. We did the polite thing and waited of our friend to be served before eating which meant our food got cold. We got chocolate cakes instead of chocolate shakes. Although that's a forgivable error, they brought out the cakes before our food. (Does cafeteria have a dessert first policy?) After all that wait, the food just wasn't worth it. When we spoke to the manager to complain about our experience, he said, "Wrll, don't tip your waiter then." Wow. How incredibly rude and unhelpful! Cafeteria won't get my money again. There are better places with people who actually care about their customers.
It was sooo good!

Had a great time! Service was excellent! Nice ambiance. We had the Non-veg Tandoori Platter which was so good! It came out steaming hot :) We also had the Chicken Tikki Masala which was cooked to perfection. That with the garlic naan???? DELISH! Don't forget to bring some wine and check in to get the free Mango Lassi!!!! I made two people in my table check in because it was that good! Lol

Celebrated 2 year anniversary here with my bf.  We had no past experience with this place and knew that although we loved fogo,  we just wouldn't be able to stomach it.  We ordered the Wasabi mango lobster app and the Peking duck on fried buns and it was a great start to a perfect meal.  He ordered the Thai red snapper and I had the Chilean sea bass in which we shared Wasabi mashed potatoes. The entrees were great- his snapper was fried perfectly and arrived in this cool arrangement of being deconstructed and put together with the original fish spine,  served with this sweet and spicy sauce complimenting the fish very well.  I had the Chilean sea bass which was soft and flavorful with good old stir vegetables.  Definitely will come back again

If you need finding some filipino also American you can take a trip here with the best part of your choice.This is an especial place in this city as they have stuff from different countries.Inviting others to take trip here because they take order even through phone.Like to agree with others review obviously it location convenient amazing service friendly.
The salteñas, pockets of stewed beef with an egg and other things, are really good. Also have good homemade sodas with passion fruit and other interesting flavors.
There food is okay, not going to lie. But I stopped eating here after they were closed for 2 weeks due to health violations. That's enough to make me stop going there.

I have been here 3 times and each time the food and service was excellent.  The grilled banana bread is yummy, the biscuits and gravy delicious, the homefries dish fantastic! I will eat here every time I stay in Burlington! Prompt, courteous service makes the dining even more pleasurable.

Tandoori rabbit was delicious, but oh so small. My date had a fish plate, also yummy, but a tiny portion. I understand you stress fresh quality of ingredients, but you must actually feed people. It's like we got appetizer portions for dinner prices. I'm a slender female and I left the place feeling hungry after spending $60 on dinner. Suggestions: add a side to the plates, potatoes, rice, noodles, some starch or something to actually make it a normal sized dinner plate. I'm also used to proper portion sizes (not huge American portions), but you can't charge $15 for an ice-cream size bowl of curry (Curry Laksa) with only 1 shrimp. That's just a rip off. No freshness of ingredients and quality makes up for such scarcity of food. Period. I'd come back for a snack may be, but dinner, it just isn't.

I've gone here twice, both experiences a little different. The first time, the waiter was so nice and friendly. The grande nachos are dynamite! For my entree, I got enchiladas which were very good. The strawberry daiquiri could've been improved. The second time, the food orders came out so quickly, we didn't get a chance to digest or finish the appetizer. The waitress wasn't as friendly and brought the food out so fast, it was a little too much!

Really amazingly delicious cuban food and really great service from everyone at the restaurant. The salsa music selection was the perfect touch to the atmosphere! The chicken were pretty dry. And the shrimp were good but the sauce was just eh. I have to say I've had better.

Great ambience in a hotel with personality. The restaurant is great. The menu is excellent and the wine list, though over priced, has diverse choice. We started with the octopus special that was very tasty. For our entree, we ordered the cumin rubbed venison ($32). The special was exquisite, with exotic flavors. The wine we chose was Yolupa from Australia ($40) The service was fabulous. The bill, with appetizer, 2 entries and wine came to $135, not including tip. For the experience and taste, that's a bargain.

Fries with aioli sauce were really delicious. Everyone in our party was happy with food. Service was a little slow due to understaffing but when I mentioned to our waiter that we were in a hurry to get to a concert he worked very hard at getting our food out quickly and getting us out on time. Good choice of beers on tap and good happy hour prices and choices. We would definitely go back! We sat on the street which adds to good Philly vibe.
Awsome the best sub place around hands-down had 2 different subs both awesome staff very nice very clean it is better then the 2 other sub places
Absolutely my new favorite spot when I visit NY.great service,great atmosphere and some of the best mussels I've ever had!
Soup dumplings are the best ever.   Great service.
Small space and often very busy & crowded, but great pizza. I stopped in here a few times for a late night slice while wandering around Times Square.
Best bar in Philly!  Great food, great beer, great atmosphere!

Don't waste your time.  I had the brisket and my wife had the pulled chicken. The brisket was half fat and the chicken super dry. Ignore those four star ratings they have never had real BBQ.  The staff was great location ok , but the food was horrible.  My wife's only comment was glad didn't barf..

I love this place. I've picked up lunch while at work, had intimate dinners, and frequent take out and I am never disappointed. The owners are this cute Thai couple who are as nice as ever. The food is delicious- I love the Paneng Curry! The restaurant itself is tiny (townhouse living room sized) and the tables are a bit close to eachother. That's probably the only thing that isn't my favorite, but stopping by when it isn't busy makes for a pleasant experience.

Food is excellent, but sorry to say that the service was pretty horrible :( we had a reservation for 10 on a Saturday and it took about 2 hours to get our food and only about 3 other tables in there. :( our waitress was very unfriendly and barely came to check on us or let us know why food was taking long. Our out of town guests commented how food was delicious but how horrible the service was. Wouldn't go there with a larger party.
Get the chicken biscuit! It's so good. The cajun burger is meh.
Your food was incredible and I want to come back despite the photos of the rats leaking on the table. Did someone set you up? Your still one of my fav breakfast spot in the city.
huge fan of the decor- gave it a lot of nostalgia to the bar. staff very attentive and friendly! food/cocktails were tasty treats- id hit it up again.

Yay Brooklyn Proper! This place is super adorable and charming with delicious cocktails! It's amaZing for a girls night out or a sweet date night. :) The staff are so nice and obviously seem really invested in the neighborhood and the food. Everything is sourced locally and is really fresh and tasty. :) Definitely recommend.
Great service!  Friendly staff!  Great food!  Would certainly go again
Excellent sushi...
Best cheesecake ever! I really recommend to go for the classic number 1 cheesecake, showed in the picture...you won't regret.
My mentor took me there for my first week of work. We worked at a historic business and this was from history as well. Perfect.

I made a reservation on open table for 8 people for Sunday brunch. One of my friends has a severe peanut and shellfish allergy so I emailed them asking about it. They clarified that he would be fine and he should just stay away from fish dishes. They called me two hours before to confirm the reservation which was great! Then when we arrived the manager came up to me and specifically asked who had the allergy and spoke with my friend about exactly what he should eat. When my friend placed the order the server was also already aware. The level of attention to detail was amazing... also they were just as attentive with the unlimited mimosas. We had a couple orders of the skillets, the flat bread appetizer and the meatballs. Everything was fantastic! I really suggest ordering the french toast for the table because it was on point. All and all amazing way to celebrate a Sunday.

One of the best burgers I've ever had the pleasure consuming! I'm not one for shoestring fries, but they did go really well when added atop the gorgeously cooked meat.
