Also, the pumpkin salad (special) was absolutely incredible! Not a lot of room to enjoy your food, but well worth making the trip, just to enjoy their burger!

Love this place! ! I live for their Hemingway daiquiri (if you get the right bartender to make it) I've tried a couple of items on the menu and have never been disappointed.  The presentation of their food shows the cooks take great pride. Additionally the owner is very friendly, kind, humble person. Could easily be mistaken for costumer
Delicious food and nice people!

The most delicious, romantic pizzeria in town.  The ingredients are always top quality and fresh, and the pizza is a bit fancier than at your typical corner pizzeria, but without pretension or sacrificing a traditional feel.  The service is friendly and prompt, the wine is good, and the atmosphere is cozy and nostalgic.  Only thing that would make it better is more dessert options (cannolis please) and coffee!

Right when I walked in, I knew this place was a winner. Outstanding service, delicious food, and an authentic neighborhood feel. Gila wasn't lying when she told my girlfriend "We have the best Chicken Shawarma in the city!" Looking forward to making many more visits to our new favorite neighborhood restaurant.

This restaurant  is very good, the food was really good, all the plates were empty.  The Perch was delicious and the Hanger steak was cooked  to perfection. Unfortunately, the service was not as good as I hoped, the waiter forgot our bread, the time between courses was long, so I had to knock it down  2 stars.
Great sangrias!! Gives about 7 glasses. Arepas were amazing! It was my first time trying Venezuelan food

me and a couple of friends wandered in here after exploring Williamsburg for the day and were very pleased. the atmosphere was great. Awesome décor and an open set up. The sinks near the bathroom work with a pedal which was so cool. The irish bartender was really funny and friendly. Will definitely be back.
Worth the wait and the weight. Best breakfast place in town, and arguably, in the state. Get a mimosa and the huevos rancheros!

This place has awesome food. AWESOME. It's so funny how Richard C. complains that the menu was written on a chalkboard - it's seasonal food that changes! Which is part of what makes it so good! What would be the point of printing menus if the menu is always changing. Anyway, food is great. If you see the chicken/waffles on the menu - jump on them!

Wonderful! Just visited tonite because we saw it on Triple D. As soon as we walked in we were greeted warmly and the staff and our waitress were the nicest people I ever encountered! So genuine. We enjoyed the cuban atmosphere and the food was great. We had the cod frittas appetizer. Sangria was delicious. Had the half chicken and fish in white wine and butter sauce and the best rice beans I ever had!  Plaintains were awesome. For dessert, got the guava with cream cheese and rice pudding was so good. Our waitress was very sweet and helpful with helping me choose along the way. Service was excellent!!! We enjoyed the way they celebrated someones Birthday! They make it very loud and clear so you cant miss it!! Very fun. So cute. So glad we visited!!

Coming from NYC, I'm on the quest for a decent slice here in Lebanon New Hampshire.  I went for their carnivore pizza.  It tasted like the 2 for $12 deals at the local pizzeria I had back in college when I was broke except I had to fork over $20 for a plain old mediocre pie.  They skimped on the toppings.  There was barely enough sauce on the pizza.  And the sauce:cheese ratio is way off.  The crust is ok.  I get it, this is New Hampshire, not New York we're talking about.  But no way is this even passable for a $20 pizza.  Even the rich college kids in Hanover may balk at this.  Will not be going back.
Excellent lobster roll.. fantastic food
A really good pizzeria serving great pizza.  A place where you can get great pizza, especially the tomato pie and friendly service. Clean and comfortable. They do delivery too.

Small place but the empanada were so good spicy chicken - 5 STARS!! chunks of chicken breast W/ mama's special picante sauce VIAGRA - 5 stars also!!! - mama's seafood stew with shimp, scallops and crab meat Cheesesteak were also good too ! Broccoli and cheese & mushrooms were also good too but the spicy chicken and viagra were too yummy definitely gonna try one more time before i go back to California:)

Loved loved loved! Went on 8/3 for brunch! It was excellent. Service is excellent. We had crispy dough breakfast was yummy! The puréed tomatoes were excellent. I must say the service was the best I had in NYC! Highly recommend!!!

The most amazing food that I have had in a long time .. I'm a big Italian food lover and this was a blast from my childhood ., the sauce was light and flavorful. If you are in NY you must try this place.. Amazing .

I have been here several times and I am never disappointed. I find the staff to be very friendly and the food very good. I'm a picky eater, so I wish the menu was a bit bigger, but that's my issue and no one else's. Went there last night and had the Broccollo Pizza. I love me a crispy crust and this crust is perfect. It's as if God himself reached down from the heavens, stuck his finger in some dough and said, "Let there be pizza crust." And behold, there was pizza crust. It's thin and crispy and just the way I like it. Keep up the good work. Shout out to Chad, the sever who is always so nice.
I've only ever been there for pizza and beer lunches, but for that they're great. Never had a bad slice or a bad time.

I went  to Brunch with a group of 8  friends in from California this past Sunday. The service was excellent. The Hostess was accomadating very very friendly. The service was vey good. The Goose Liver Pate'  was one of the best i have ever had. The Lobster Rolls were incredible. Everything was reasonably priced. I would definitely go back to this well run establishment. Danny Meyer knows how to run his restaurants. A definite 5 Star *****

Went here for some drinks after the dinner. We found seats at the bar and had some wines with Artisan Cheeses. Blueberry cheese was amazing! I had a rose wine and it was ok. Some places are too loud to hear what my friends are talking, or too quite to talk a lot with friends, but Twenty Manning is definitely a good place for hanging out and chatting with friends!!

Excellent food, excellent service. I think this restaurant is in competition with Tulsi for being the best Indian restaurant in the city. I've had the duck, the Bihari Ghost, chicken, Jaipur kofta...all outstanding. Service was warm and solicitous without being intrusive. Highly, highly recommend. And I should know...I grew up eating Indian food almost  every day of my life!

I found this online article recommending the top 10 Thai restaurants in NYC. Ngam was one of these restaurant recommendations. I was a little disappointed. I've bad better Thai food at Spice and Pure Thai Cookhouse -- places I frequent because they are close to my house and office. The food at Ngam is very salty and the portions are kind of small. But the atmosphere is pretty cool and the service average. To be honest, I probably will not come back to Ngam. There are definitely better Thai places in NYC.

This is a great place to go when you want to get a late dinner. The servers and owner were very nice, although maybe not the most attentive. It didn't take too long for food to arrive though. We got fried pickles to start which were very good, with delicious ranch and chipotle mayo. The burger was juicy, filling, and delicious. It has a hint of sweetness since it has pineapple on it.. but it really is just the perfect amount of sweet, not over powering at all. We also got the fried catfish sandwich which was huge and delicious.
Butcher bar has amazing burnt ends! they really are meat candy. I first tried the brisket sandwich and LIC food and flea. this place was worth the trip to astoria for sure.
Just go there. It's delicious.

Food is off the charts. I was full and still couldn't stop eating.  Highly recommend this place.  Everything we ordered was delicious.  And the waitress was courteous and prompt. Will return for sure.

I just happened to be in from out of town and decided to try this place. I had a chicken and pasta dish that was pretty good, I think its the best Ive had in a long while. The chicken was tender and not stringy and the pasta was cooked and seasoned just right. The service was pretty good, I did have to wait for a refil but other than that it was great. The place was clean and tidy. If I was in the area again, I would visit again.

What can I say about this place!! This is one of my all time favorite places!!! Everything is just sooo good here. Even though we moved away and there are pretty good Mexican places around I still miss this place.
Cute and quaint!
Some of the best pizza I've ever had.
I did not eat there food but I have to say the person i spoke to on the phone was so rude and unpleasant i will defiantly not ever eat at there restaurants.

What can I say? Food is great come on down to Brooklyn to experience BBQ meat at it's finest. The Mac and cheese as well as the coleslaw are amazing. Perfect for groups and kid friendly my son loved it!! Other parents come and enjoy food and drinks here so I felt at home with my 18 month old!!!

I braved the negative yelp reviews and decided to take my family here when they visited me this past weekend.  It was my Uncle's birthday.  We were sooo pleasantly surprised that the restaurant exceeded our expectations!! My Mom and I each ordered the special, which was 1 lb lobster with snow crab legs and a side.  She got the mac and cheese, I got the baked potato.  The meal was SO GOOD, we seriously couldn't stop talking about it all night.  Also, it was for a great price; our meals were $19 each.   My uncle and father ordered the swordfish, which they both really enjoyed, and my boyfriend ordered the Maple Salmon.  Everyone had a great meal.  The dessert that we had them bring out for my uncle's birthday was also very tasty.  I'm not sure what it was called but it was some sort of cream pie. The service was good, and I love the style of both the interior and exterior.   I'm sure I'll be back here for more lobster!  Yum!

How to be overwhelmed by Korean/Japanese food? 17 free side dishes! Believe me, order your meal accordingly. It is A LOT! The rib eye BBQ is also delicious, as well as the stone pot rice. The service is also very attentive. They show smile and like to chat a little - they just seem interested in attending to your meal. It is not located in the best neighborhood, but the interior surely does not disappoint. Price is on the scale of 2+ dollar sign. Despite its lackluster name, this place deserves a return visit!

Solid Thai restaurant with a lot of space in the back room. Reasonably priced for the city and I they were able to accommodate me on two separate big group dinners that I had there. Very good Pad Kee Mao and Curry.

I've eaten A LOT of burgers, and I must say this is one of the top 3 best burgers I've ever had. The prices are great, but the restaurant itself is not very visually appealing, especially from the outside. Do not be afraid; I can assure you that the food is outstanding.

I stopped by The Industry this weekend with my 10 month old and the rest of the family. They were very accommodating with my little one and we sat outside and ate. I had  fried chicken and waffles, but wasn't aware that it was super spicy regardless the food was good and I will return to try out other things on the menu. Oh yeah I also had the Mac N Cheese with kimchi definitely worth a try and my little one loved it too.

I've been here a couple of times and i declare myself to be a regular there bc i live so close but they don't see me that way.  The wife is a little rude and she could careless if i go in twice a week or not.  But i go there for the fresh sushi and not the service and they do have  one of the best sushi in town.  Their signature rolls are really delicious (Million dollar rolls, Dragon rolls, Spicy girl roll, rainbow roll) but there are only 2 sushi chefs working so there could be a long wait on weekends or evening.  The restaurant is very small and seatings are so tight that you can't have a private conversation w/ your guest.  You can hear everything someone in the corner is saying and i don't like the fact that you have no privacy.  All in all, they do have fresh sushi and love the ginger salad dressing and miso soup, but the service needs to be worked on and the parking is horrible.  You can't hardly see the cars coming while you back out! Therefore, i give them 3 stars.
Unexpected treat we found while walking along Flushing Avenue! Great host, great adult beverages and yummie wood-fired pizza. Highly recommend!
best affordable French restaurant in NY.  Fillet Mignon with Foie Gras is out of this world！  5 stars all around1
The food was fantastic (get the NY strip steak, it's seasoned perfectly!), the service was good, and the prix fixe menu is reasonably priced for a delicious and filling meal. Excellent wine menu!
Returned here while on jury duty a few weeks ago, still a great unique place with so many choices. It's pretty crowded in the summer, but you can handle it.
It's a somewhat expensive chain but the food is always good.
This is IT. Perfect for lunch and dinner. The different choices in pasta and sauces are awesome! Plus, Everyone is so nice. It's definitely a hidden gem in the Gramercy area. Yum!
Interesting experience, but I'm still hungry! For photos visit sooandthecity.com!

I went here on a Saturday night. This place is great for people in their 30s and it has a pretty attractive, laid back crowd for the most part. I had one of the ciders (the name is failing me) and it was probably one of the best beers I've ever had. Definitely a place to go if you're a beer drinker and want to hang out with some friends without drama.
Excellent food, very hospitable, lots of team work with refilling water, bread, etc... Not to expensive, depending on how much you order of course. I'll go back in a heart beat!

when we saw they serve fake syrup, and charge an extra $2.50 for real syrup...we left! hello, this IS a pancake house, right? just not right!  Why come here then when you can have the wonderful pancakes at Perkins right up the road in E. Windsor?

Ordered take out. Food was delivered hot and quickly however it was not good. The Mac and cheese was absolutely nothing special at all, very bland and not creamy but it was a large portion. Also, the butter that everyone raves about didn't come in our takeout. It was very basic and was completely melted when it arrived. Maybe if you eat at the restaurant you will have a better experience.
Possibly the best chicken pad Thai I've ever had. Great prices too. Get the coconut water. Quick service.

Terrific restaurant, the hype is justified. Totto was the last of the Big 3 NYC ramen houses that I visited (other two of course being Momofuku and Ippudo), and I'd have to day Totto was top dog. Food: Spicy Ramen was amazing, not way too spicy but not bland. The pork is perfectly cooked, and the egg add-on is a must-have for a proper experience. Service / Interior: the restaurant is cozy for sure, but service is great and the food makes up for the run-down look. Wait: I showed up about 15 minutes before opening so we were in the first round of people who went in once the restaurant opened. That said, by the time we left the wait for 2 people was about 45 min to an hour - this was on a Wednesday during the summer, imagine it can be worse during the weekends.
Wonderful food, wonderful service. The chef is super cool and they've got their priorities straight. Love this place!
Excellent atmosphere. Unique and flavorful menu. Wonderful open air dining. Live music and exotic cocktails.

I dedicate my first Yelp review to Pommes Frites because I seriously think I'm in love with this place! As a french fry enthusiast, I knew I had to check this place out so I went with a couple of friends and have no regrets at all! I was really tempted to order the largest size but decided to go with the small since reviews here say that the small is still a pretty good amount of fries (very true). The fries were just amazing! They were hot, thick, and crispy, just the way I like them! The mango chutney sauce seemed to be very popular and well received so I decided to try it out. Unfortunately, I had already consumed half of my fries by the time we walked to the park so I didn't get to dip a majority of my fries in the sauce so I just brought it home to dip in my broccoli and it tasted great! I think it has mayo as a base and would go great with shrimp! The only complaint that I can think of is that it is kind of hot, greasy and dirty in the restaurant so I recommend take out. And also the fact that I can't enjoy french fries at other establishments anymore after having Pommes Frites :) I really look forward to coming back to try more of their sauces and their poutine as well!
Tiny but a great find in Hell's Kitchen. Open 24-7!! Get the guac and plantain chips. So many empanadas to choose from, the arepas are amazing too!!
Very good mussel dishes and fries. Tried a bunch of the mussels and they all were good, but I thought the honey Dijon was a bit overpowering. Also a great list of beers Would go back
Very good, but pricey. Enjoyed the meal, but can't say I was blown away.

the gluten free bread was very good and tasty, but it was a little crumbly in my vegan delight sandwich. maybe it was just all the weight of the fillings that made it that way, though. even though i'm not a vegan i was a big fan of the vegetable combinations they used (avacado, hummus, eggplant, tofu, to name a few).
Exceptional lunch. Authentic. Not much seating but fab food and great value. And they serve beer.

Primero que todo, debo decir que la comida esta espectacular, especialmente la ropa vieja, el churrasco, la vaca frita, las masitas... y los precios, ni se diga.  If you are looking for delicious cuban food, this is the place to go!

The food is amazing. They have the best vegan burger in Philadelphia. That being said, the service has truly declined. We have been eating here since it's opening and were always happy with the service. Recently, we attempted to eat here on a Friday. We attempted to call ahead and order food. They would not allow us to order. We arrived and it was crowded. A very rude and abrupt cashier with blue hair asked us if we were eating in or carrying out. We answered eating in as she walked away from us she muttered 35 minutes. She then did not return to the counter. I had to yell across to her to ask if we could carry out. She then told us 45 minutes to carry out. I could understand her lack of manning the counter if she was helping out in the kitchen, but she was not. She was rude and brusque.

Such a cheerful, authentic and well priced place.  The food is delicious and nicely presented.  Can't wait to go back.  Only reservation is that the music is a tad loud and repetitive (just a little).
Cute coffee shop who know what a good flat white is. Awesome music and service. Washed brick walls and yummo avo toast.
Simply delicious! Noodle bowl was amazing and the banana cream pie was incredible. Definitely get some sangria as well!

After more than a year of waiting, this nice neighborhood Peruvian restaurant finally opened. The work they put into it really shows. While the store front doesn't stand out,  the inside is beautifully decorated. relaxing music is playing, the staff is courteous and well dressed. The bar also looks beautiful. We didn't have drinks this time but would definitely try it next time. The environment is one that you want to savor and get lost in. We ordered the lamb and paella. Both were delicious. The lamb was served with a large bone - impressive presentation. Would definitely recommend and try again.

This is traditional slow cooked working people food.  It's honest and well prepared.   I really do love the tongue and tripe sandwiches and bowls along with the spicy veal.   These are all slow cooked for hours and hours, very tender and the long hot they offer really completes the dish.   I love this kind of stuff.

I went to this place few times and I could not resist leaving a review although I don't do this a lot but anyway here we go: the restaurant staff is very friendly especially the Indian girl, she's always smiling and polite as well professional. the food taste great they have got too many vegetarian choices to choose from which Is a big plus for a Mediterranean restaurant. I personally think this place is hundred times better than Tikka way or Chipotle.  with so many options you'll never be burned out eating there. I'll personally recommend this place to anyone.
Man I love this place.  I do wish every location had more seating but the food is great and quick service makes this a place worth visiting.

My first trip to Burlington and what do I find?  Absolutely delicious homemade dumplings being sold from a street vendor! For $10 I got five huge chicken & pork dumplings and a load of veggie rice.  If I lived anywhere near Burlington I'd be a regular customer. By the way, the owner makes the dumplings right in front of you so you know they are as fresh as can be.  Don't miss out!
Awesome food awesome drinks...got a free pitcher of sangria just for checking into yelp!!
Breakfast and dinner are both killer here. Its one of the only places that makes food the way I would make them at home...but they do all the work!
Best mexican food around. I've never been disappointed here. Always super busy and it's a long wait- worth it though!
Very nice seafood spot with nice decor and great food. It can get a little loud in there but I don't mind it much. Tuna tartar and oysters where amazing.
Black eyed pea soup is vegan and delicious. The staff is super friendly and fast. I'll be back for more!

I would have given 5 stars but lack of variety is the reason for 4 stars. I am not a huge fan of pork yet EVERY ramen bowl has pork broth and/or pork in the soup. They can not substitute this for a different meat. The only exception is the vegan ramen but it is cold. I chose the modern ramen and after picking out the pork pieces, it was very good. I actually prefer Momofuku but this was very good as well. The food was excellent and our party of 7 really enjoyed it. I would recommend the eggplant/mushroom buns as an appetizer and others at the table loved the chicken and the pork buns.

It's a local place with an old school charm.  I don't think anything has been updated for about 30 years. My order is 2 rippers, relish, gravy fries and a birch beer.  The dogs are flavorful and unique.  The relish is sweet and tangy and compliments the dog nicely.  The cracked deep fried skin of the dog is also good.

Cocktails with the girls after work. Great atmosphere and great service from Scott our bartender/server. There is nothing worse then having a server who you feel is inconvenienced every time they have to come to the table. Scott was so warm and welcoming - we will be requesting him on our next Girls Night :)

I'm a steak guy simply put. I have been to numerous steakhouses and Ruth's Chris is my favorite by far. The staff is always attentive and food is great. I usually go in about 30 minutes before my reservations and grab a couple drinks at the bar. Once we are seated, I always get a steak, usually a NY Strip cooked mid rare and side of whipped potatoes. It always comes out in a timely manner and again always come out juicy and flavorful. I would have to say the same about all the Ruth's Chris I have visited. I always know what I am getting no matter which one I go to
Great gourmet Pizza! Everything looks wonderful and taste good. They also have a great selection of cocktails and wine! The only thing is that is a little pricey.
Impressed with: -architecture decor/ atmosphere 7/10 -food presentation 10/10 -customer service 8/10 May return. Thanks for a pleasant time!

My favorite Italian in New York.  I've been coming here for years.  They usually know my order even if it's been a year since my last visit.  The lobster cannelloni is def. the dish to have and do yourself a favor and order a bottle of the house red.  A true classic NYC dining experience.  However MAKE A RESERVATION!!!!!

A great spot in downtown Rutherford, and a great menu. Casual vibe and extremely friendly and helpful staff, always very attentive to guests needs. Menu is great, and their mofongo was fantastic. I've eaten some unreal homepage mofongo while in Puerto Rico, and while nothing can really compare, this comes very close. Not many Cuban spots around the area, so definitely check this out for something a little different.

Best wing spot ever!!! You know it's a true wing spot when they serve you wings and they don't give you a fork and knife.  Who eats wings with cutlery?!?!? Try the dragon wings and the honey ginger garlic wings. Delish!!!

A fun place to go based on the original & charming atmosphere. Waitstaff will not disappoint with quirky personality, jokes, & fun "attitude". Burgers are cooked in a vertical cast-iron grill, they come on white toast with the option of: cheese, onion, tomato and are served on a paper plate. House-made potato salad and small bags of chips available for sides. Connecticut's own Foxon Park sodas are available in bottles and other big name sodas in cans. You may not have any ketchup. The Library of Congress recognizes Louis' Lunch as "the birthplace of the hamburger sandwich".

I'm a huge fan of Lea. Great drinks (Same owners as the Castelo Plan), and the pasta is really interesting. No boring food here folks. Oh yeah, and they do some really nice thin crust pizza's as well.
Lunch sandwiches are delicious! The people that work there are extremely nice as well. I haven't had breakfast there but I've heard it's great. I'd highly recommend this place

Just ate at Hat City and inspired to write my first review.  YUM!   Food was delicious, hot and flavorful.  Best meal in the area in years, though not a bit healthy. :)  Had the fried chicken with pepper honey (hot, crunchy and moist!) and the catfish.  Calamari and sides were great too.  Took some bread pudding home since we were too full.  Service was efficient, professional and very friendly.  Only complaint - band was good, but way too loud.  Couldn't even hear each other.

We were a party of four going here on a Thursday night and we got a table right away, seated in the outdoorsy area which was really cosy. All the dishes were really, really good but unfortunately our waitress wasn't very helpful through the night. First we didn't know what and how much to order, and we didn't get any help with the ordering. The drinks we ordered with our entrée came in the middle of the meal, and the mains took over forty minutes to come to the table. We were all pleased with the food though (we ended up sharing a platter to start, then adding some extra smaller sides and having one entrée each). And the food itself could've made up for everything if it wasn't for the ice cold airconditioning that were on halfway through our dinner. We had to ask twice for the staff to turn it down but nothing happened and we ended up leaving early just because of it.

I had the pleasure of eating at Rahway Fried Chicken on multiple occasions and tried several different dishes other than the fried chicken and I'm just as impressed with the other dishes that I've eaten there. I recently started ordering the fried tilapia with rice and salad and it was great. The other reason why I go there as often as I do is because the owner and his staff really seem to appreciate your business.
Loved the general tso chicken and the mandarin fish. Unlike so many other Chinese take-out places the chicken is actually real 100% white meat chicken that you don't feel guilty eating.

The arepas are ON POINT. The combination of sweet from the sweet corn arepa with the spices from the meat and the creaminess of the guacamole just make it spectacular. And for $5-$7 you can't beat it. Highly recommend and the trucks are open until 4pm so you have plenty of time to check it out.
Excellent food and service. Isabella's is an Upper West Side institution, and for good reason.

Appetizer of steamed dumplings was great. The "chef's special"'of crispy chicken was pretty much inedible. Chicken was so thin and the frying process just made it chewy and stringy. I've always had a good meals here in the past. This was a huge disappointment. In their favor, they did take the meal off the bill hence the 3 stars.
the foods are okay,  Maybe I put too much expectation on here Since the reviews from yelp , but it is still a nice restaurant.

Some of the best food I have ever had! We started off with a few cocktails and the Spanish cheese charcuterie at the bar.  Dinner was really delicious. Everything was fresh and the flavors were perfect. I'll definitely being going back.
the pho here is consistent and cheap. It is my go-to spot in philly, and the service is quick and efficient.

Really delicious creative sandwiches on great bread. We had the Vermonter - highly recommend it and the BLT on French Bread  - also very good. And kids had the pb and J. They weren't fond of the bread, but ate it. Had to park a few blocks away but it's worth it. Would definitely go back again and try another one of their sandwich creations.
A great little spot in Old City section of Philly. Great italian dishes and equally great service. Entree comes with free glass of wine also; a nice touch!

I love Indian food and I have yet to find a place that combines delicious food with great décor and atmosphere, then I discovered this place.  Came here for a girl's night out dinner and cocktails.  We started with cocktails, I had Singapore Sling which was fantastic! The food was absolutely amazing - Crispy Okra, Tiger Prawns and Butter Chicken Masala are a must! All of our entries came with rice and Naan, which is a bonus. This was probably the best Indian food I've ever had.   The place is very intimate and has character, if I lived in the neighborhood I would definitely be a regular!
Best pizza I've had in Brooklyn. You need to check it out!!

The BEST sushi and service ever!! These guys always have a line out the door, and people come from far and wide to enjoy the delicious menu options. I love Johns roll, a little spicy. They give complimentary mussels, and little dessert yoghurts. My 5 yr old daughter loves going there, they give her little training chopsticks and a kid size chicken teriyaki. Yum!!!

As far as the staff and the food goes this place is really great. I came out today for lunch (my first time trying thai food) and I wasn't let down. I recommend getting the Thai iced tea, it's delicious and went great with my spicy shrimp peanut curry. Overall, the food is great, it's a very small restaurant, not very spacious but, don't let that stop you from trying the food.
an easy go-to bar for most any occasion; good cocktails that won't break the bank, great homemade potato chips to accompany a beer and a few seats outside when the weather is nice.

I have been celiacs for 2 years, and I have never been able to fully relax and feel confident in eating out. I haven't eaten authentic Italian food since then either! Maria immediately made me feel at home when I walked in and continued the hospitality throughout the dinner. Between my date and myself, we ordered GF bread, GF pizza, GF chicken parm and a GF brownie. Everything tasted incredible, and my date (who doesn't have celiacs or any gluten allergies), enjoyed every bite. :) I couldn't be more grateful to have experienced excellent service and delicious Italian cuisine without any guilt or painful allergic reactions!!
Grilled soy glazed eggplant and cold sake...oohh killem.
I love the atmosphere and my wine glass was always full! Thanks so much Scott, my friends and I will be back again soon!

At salt creek grill now. Drove 45 minutes to take my mother out to dinner because we both loved their coffee crusted steak and just found out they removed it for their summer menu. While being disappointed this kinda thing happens. But what was really disappointing is that the menu is no better than a chilis menu but cost much more and with a smaller selection. Seems this place is confused and not sure what type of restaurant they want to be. I wont be going back.
Love the deals and groupon options here. Also, a surprisingly great place to eat. There's definitley a club feel but they have some great bar food.
Wonderful classic pizza with just the right crust and super fresh ingredients.  Add a nice ambiance and great selection of drinks -- this makes for a winning combination. Highly recommend!

Really enjoyed this place! The ambiance is really nice and modern looking, the staff was SUPER friendly which I always look for when I go out to a place. We got $5 cabernet for happy hour that was delicious & the burger I had was great. My boyfriend had the chicken sanwich w avocado which was really fresh! I definitely would recommend this place for an after work spot!

Horrible customer service. Placed order on phone and waited over 40 minutes. I spoke with one of the workers and asked him what happen with my order. He told me to wait outside and he would get back with me but kept ignoring me. Didn't have a chance to have my lunch.

Wonderful dinner on a quiet Saturday night.  Calamari was best ever!  Veal chop delicious, as was the sushi grade tuna, grilled to perfection.  Our server, Gina was a delight. We were told that end of July, beginning of August is slow, so we enjoyed a quiet and enjoyable evening.
I went out with my wife and a family friend tonight. It was awesome, from the food to the setting. The bartender was great, and we had a great time.

One of those little hole in the walls. Cash only. It's all about the hot dogs. I bet you can't eat just one. Yes it small inside but it's big on flavor. Amazing creation of dogs. True they may not have all of the at all times but the list is big enough to find a great one. I say try them all!!!

So I haven't (yet) done a comprehensive coffee tour of Philly but this place is spot on....lattes are excellent (similar to Blue Bottle in my hometown), ambience is nice, baristas are legit, and the location is just seedy enough.  Have been going here the last few mornings and Square One is just adding to my impression that Philly is about to have a there there.

The atmosphere is amazing. I can come on a date with my husband or bring the whole family. The chef makes the best calamari around. Reasonable prices and they have every sporting event on tv. I recommend this place highly!!!!  Awesome!!!

Ive been in Italy several times, believe me, this place is like eating, smelling Italy! LOVE this place! They have tomatoes planted there, and cook with their own tomatoes and basil. Can't find anything more natural or authentic! BEST FOOD on PRINCETON!!!! And the owner is so nice! Everyone is so nice!!!!

The best tacos and quesadillas I've ever had hands down.   I don't just crave tacos, I crave the tacos from this specific place.  I'm fortunate to live nearby so yes I've had them consecutive days in a row.

Expectations were set high with a three-hour wait. Our party of four was seated at a six top booth with two inches space between the tables and bar stools added to make it seat eight. When the next four top was seated we joked with them about our proximity. Started with Devils on Horseback and bruetta.  Both were good. Was a little surprised at the tiny cheese serving for the price, but impressed with the flavor with the beans. By the time our entrees arrived we were all sweating in our crowded booth.  We realized we were luckier than the poor table with their back close to the bar getting hit by everyone walking by and closer to the loud annoying guys sitting at the bar. The two guys in our party separately went to the unisex bathroom and were hard-pressed to decide if it was better than a Texas porta potty in August.  They said it was cleaner, but melt-your-face hot and amazingly small. Entrees were fine. Service was fine.  We had planned on dessert, but were ready to leave the uncomfortable hot table and sprinted to the door when the check was paid. I think I might have loved this place if the wait was 45 min and the dining experience was reasonably comfortable. As it is, I say skip it.
Great service.  Delicious coffee and a great selection of sandwiches and treats.  Also great location by the park !!!

Went there for the first time several weeks ago and had an amazing experience.  Yes they do cost a little more than the usual Vietmanese, but the quality is worth it.  Their bahn mi sandwiches and veggies rock!!  This place hands down is one of the best restaurants in NYC!!

I LOVE this place! Was my 2nd time there last night, The owner is so sweet and kept making sure we understood the menu- she was delightful. Our waiter was informative and attentive Special of the night.. MY FAV! Grilled Octopus!! Brussels sprouts are amazing. swiss chard .. amazing.. LOVE LOVE LOVE. Wait.. I just hate the stool chairs with no backs.. wish there was more seating.. But otherwise it's awesome. Wish ya'll were UES.

Fabulous salads, fresh and crunchy. My daughter said "I usually don't like crunchy but this is the right kind of crunchy." We walked in just as they were closing and they stayed open just to serve us, and all the veggies were still super fresh. The service was a bit slow but I think that's because they had already packed everything away and had to rake it out especially fie us. The proprietors are super friendly and helpful and even though we didn't show them the Yelp offer, they gave us ice tea on the house.
Food terrible. "Modernization" of classic staples with terrible execution. Good service is the only thing keeping this from being a one-star review, but who needs bad food served to them well?
Just amazing.

I just had some of their fried chicken yesterday and man it was just freshly made and hot.  The salt and breading they put was just perfect.  The only problem is that they need to clean the tables often. I tend to just order out rather than sit.  However great place for fast food. P.S the cheese steak is a must taste. Definitely recommended. Thier french fries, not so much however.
Mediterranea is great hookah bar providing a pleasant expericnce with their supurb hookah flavors and great tasting food.

I picked this place because of all the good reviews.     I found this place to have a nice atmosphere.   I found a seat at the bar.   The woman behind the bar was beautiful  however her ability to service customers in an orderly fair fashion was undetectable  she seemed confused and inefficient.   She was obsessed with filing water bottles and not providing good customer service.   My lasagna came out moments after I ordered.   It was extremely hot,  leaving me to think it was microwaved.     I ordered a pizza to go and she didn't time it right forcing me to wait 25 minutes after my meal was complete. I asked her five times for the check.    Each time I watched her ignore my request.    Then when I finally got my bill it was $93    she "accidentally"  gave me the wrong check.    I didn't believe it for a moment. The pizza was just OK   I've had better at Dominos. I will never go back!
Hands down best pork buns I ever had!  This was the only thing I ordered here and it was that great!
Had an enjoyable meal here. The food was very tasty. My only complaints are that it was very noisy and hard to hear each other talk, and I found it quite hot.

This is possibly my favorite restaurant. The food is very high quality and absolutely delicious. Everything is prepared to a meticulous standard. The setting is on the formal side. You don't need to wear a suit or evening gown, but slacks and a shirt (business casual) would be fine. That makes it dressy enough to take someone out for a special occasion. Service is very good. It's friendly and professional, and they cater to you to make sure your visit is pleasant

My husband & our daughters went to Brooklyn Crab to celebrate his birthday. We ordered fried calamari, 2 orders of King crabs and beer battered cod fish with French fries. Everything was delicious & worth every penny. I ordered a piña colada which was delicious as well but the birthday boy drank it all lol and I had to order another which turned out to be even better! The staff & management are the BEST and were very attentive to us even though it was busy. The best part of our evening at Brooklyn crab was having the manager send over a banana split to say happy birthday (on the house).

Beautiful restaurant, fantastic food, great service, romantic ambience. The reason for only 3 stars?  I went there with my husband for a nice quiet dinner.  There was over an hour wait for an outside table on the water so we opted for inside since it was late. The noise level was almost unbearable. Not only couldn't we hear each other but the waiter had to ask us at least three times to repeat our order. We didn't stay for dessert. Couldn't wait to get out of there. Too bad

Got the Chicken Saag. It was a bit bland for my taste. Husband got vindaloo and said it was tasty. Friendly staff. Food was a bit overpriced for the portion size. Rice and cheese naan was a bit dry and tasteless. Overall not bad, but I wouldn't come again.

Food: very good - 8/10 Service: below average - 4/10 Decor: below average - 4/10 Cleanliness: below average - 4/10: I saw manager bringing jug of water with his finger touching water. He runs around the place clueless - he forgot my order and on another table he said I don't know what cook puts in a dish. But surprisingly cook knows what he is putting in the food. So my thali was very good, each of the three curries, rasam, and even dal makhani was nice and buttery.
Great drinks and service! Want some great martinis? This is the place to be! After you drink at this place you would never want to go anywhere else. You MUST make reservations in order to come in.

My daughter had her wedding after-party at The Bahche on Aug. 9, and we can't say enough good things about Corina (the events manager), the staff (who are all extremely helpful and friendly), the food (so delicious it disappeared very quickly), and the venue (perfect for dancing inside and relaxing outside). Corina was solicitous and helpful throughout the process and couldn't do enough to make sure everything was perfect. So, we highly recommend The Bahche if you're thinking of a venue for a party in Brooklyn where you want to dance and listen to amplified music or, as in our case, just great loud music from bands with a lot of horns and drums! Bravo, Bahche! Well done!
My choice would be the mash potato pizza!

Great sandwiches! This family run 'jewel of Main Street' is always fresh and the service is always friendly. Taylor Ham, Egg & Cheese is the simply the best! Kudos to one of the last of the true old school delis left. The only down side is that sometimes you have to wait for the best...but the conversation is always good.
Great place, and generous portions. Grapefruit with sea salt and honey was really good!
This place is really good and very great prices. The burgers were money, and the cheese fries were awesome.

Excellent food that had flavor and spice to it. We went with a big group and the service was excellent as well (lacking in many Indian restaurants unfortunately). Highly recommend this place and will be back soon.

Decent food, but the kitchen was slllooooooowwww.  Clearly a problem as the waitstaff was clustered at the pass through and nothing was coming out for ages.  The waitstaff was EXCELLENT in keeping the patrons patient.

I had really high expectations about food but I think I prefer prime 16 service but plan b burgers. I think the service was great, they atmosphere was great, but the burger options and veggie burger options was good but not as good as some other options in new haven. I would give this place a 3.75.

Great dining experience. The owner was very friendly and accommodating. There is a beautiful garden in the back, but you might need a reservation to get into the garden. The food is delicious, served in large, filling portions. The khachapuri (bread with cheese and egg) and khinkali (lamb dumplings) were delicious. Everything was served hot and right out of the oven.
Friday night = 45 min to an hour wait. Was it worth?  Heck yeah! The food is fresh and delish. Definitely a must try in Manhattan.
I ate here for the first time last night  and I was very impressed ! the Peking pork chops were AMAZINGG ! Also had roast pork , duck and chicken with fries rice and all were great !
Food was delicious! The lobster risotto was so good I had to go back and order it again later in the week. Service was amazing & friendly, too.
Delicious crab cakes, both the appetizer and the sandwich! Happy hour until 6:30 means all appetizers are just $6, so I couldn't pass them up! Bar staff were friendly, and kept my glasses full.

I came here for brunch/lunch recently on a Sunday. It was a party of 6, we ordered 3 appetizers and brunch/lunch entrées along with a bottle of wine. Let me start off by saying the food was absolutely wonderful! (Plates were a little too small) did not walk out full. However food was still amazing. I would give this restaurant 3.5 stars. I ordered the bottle of wine & paid for it in advance because I wanted to treat the table and not have it on the end of the food bill. I gave the waiter my card, I paid, I signed. When we were done enjoying our meal. We got the check for the food. We gave the waiter our credit cards, we paid, we signed, we said thank you and left. As I was walking the waiter asked me to wait he wanted to tell me something. I kindly waited while he was taking another parties order. He came up to me and said that I didn't leave a tip for the wine bill. In my head I was confused because we left a generous tip at the end of our meal and it was all the same table so what did it matter? I said oh I'm sorry. He said it's not about the money it's the principle. I kindly left him ANOTHER tip, however I was so embarrassed and ashamed that this man pulled me to the side and demanded another tip from me. Corrected me if I'm wrong but that was straight out rude. For that I will never come back or recommend anyone else to go there!

I love the food here!  The cornbread croutons in the kale caesar salad are unique and tasty and the pulled pork sliders are amazing!  The owner Shawn always comes over to say hello.  Helene is a great host and stops by to chat when I dine alone.  She takes amazing photos that you can see for yourself in B4!  I've taken many of my friends and my family here!  Delicious menu!

A cute coffee and crepe shop with a shabby, mismatched charm. Coffee is fairly good. Food is non-greasy and light tasting but not particularly flavorful. Service is friendly and polite. Overall no significant negatives but nothing to write home about.
Had the cinnamon pancakes, with Bacon. Very very good food, not the best but very fulfilling.  The butters are amazing.
Great place to get drinks.  Awesome old building with outdoor seating.  Super friendly staff and cheap drinks.

The food gets 5 stars. Seriously delicious stuff that I crave if I've gone too long without it. If you like New Orleans eating, you'll find a happy home here. The bar service gets 2 stars. I haven't experienced a whiff of hospitality on any visit.
Excellent service, knowledgeable and attentive waiting staff and the food was simply amazing! Great date venue!
Solid place great experience great service Would recommend everyone try at least once!
It's vegan. Don't be fooled by the big burger in front.
Not a lot of options for vegetarians, but I've never been disappointed with their build-your-own salad option.

Amazing. All round a fantastic experience. Service was impeccable. It was packed on a Saturday night; we waited maybe about 15 minutes to get seated for our reservation. The host was very apologetic even though we weren't in a rush to be seated. We had the magical Bihari Gohst, the meat just fell off the bone, such a medley of beautiful flavors. The Baingan Ka Salan was also mind-blowing. Desserts were spectacular. Fabulous. We will certainly be back!
Wasn't impressed. Attended bridal shower lunch. Food was mediocre at best but service was horrible/ wait staff clueless.

A friend of mine wanted to try something different and new, Pitaziki nails it--simple, good food that appeals to the gourmet foodie or the guy next door. Awesome, awesome, and more awesome. Just tried Pitaziki,  for the first time...will be going back for full lunch or dinner...or both

More like a 3.5 Yes they are a bit pricey but I love the fact that their food has quality ingredients and it's not a long wait. I always get the chicken lo mein. The only downside other then their pricing and parking situation is that occasionally the lo mein is a bit oily from them not draining it properly when putting it in the take out container. I'm always shocked they are still in business because it always seems like I am their only customer but maybe I'm just lucky. p.s. stop being stingy with the duck sauce please lol
Amazing chicken, and fries to match. There really is nothing complicated about it, simply amazing

Outstanding as always..... Their specials are unreal. Veal Rigatoni was the best I've ever had. My cousins were visiting from Italy and Rocco came out to conversate and make them feel welcome. Service is as great as their food ! Thanks Rocco ! !
I was very hungry near midnight and I was grateful these guys were open. These do make a nice pizza. Best choice after midnight...
Loved the matambre- very tender. Chicken was very good. Potatoes not cooked. Staff very nice

A great breakfast/brunch place with a range of options, from basic eggs and toast, to a rotating weekend brunch menu, each with several vegetarian and vegan options. It can be difficult to get a seat when the outdoor seating area is closed, but this points to the popularity of the place. Waitstaff are always friendly, and the interior is cozy.
Food was OK but a little to vinegary for me. DIdn't have a long wait on a Saturday at 7pm-ish. Would try again.
Excellent food and great atmosphere!!!  Had the scallops & pork belly special. Delicious
Hands down best chicken fingers in Philadelphia. The owner was great. He knows his chicken.

We ordered dinner for delivery from Palazzo in Montclair, 2 nights ago through delivery.com. Overall the food was excellent. The only reason I am not giving 5 stars at this time is because my blackened salmon entree was supposed to come with mushroom risotto (which I was secretly yearning for) but was replaced instead with whipped mashed potatoes. No one informed me as to the reason why this (less expensive) substitution was made. We had blackened salmon, cornish hen under a brick, sautéed spinach in garlic, and bread pudding for dessert. The food was excellent and the bread pudding was phenomenal. I will definitely visit the restaurant and I'm sure I will amend this rating to 5 stars!
Great drinks and excellent food!  Outside seating was beautiful for dinner. Service was outstanding!
Fantastic food and excellent service. it is to be noted that they failed a health inspection a few years ago.

Delicious! I had a vegan cheesesteak on Saturday night. Great texture to the seitan and it was very flavorful. Hibiscus has definitely earned that spot for their vegan cheesesteak to be considered one of the top three in Philadelphia. The staff was very friendly and the service was quick. I definitely recommend trying this place.
as a brazilian guy, i was very disappointed and vowed not to come back to this place. food was bland, there was no variety on the meat, just a meh. would go to a different place with more variety.

Enjoyed BBQ at a rehearsal dinner and it was one of the best we've ever had.  Loved the guacamole and fire roasted salsa and I can't say enough about the creole deviled eggs.  The Memphis style pulled pork was delicious with or without sauce.
I love the PorkChop, the Chicken biscuit and their selection of teas. Highly recommend.

Their food and ambiance is everything you'd ever want! Seating is quick I've been there twice to celebrate birthdays and was never disappointed. It's a little tight as far as tables but great nonetheless

I needed a nice, nutritious meal after a long day of traveling hungry and dehydrated. Thank you, ReViVer! I ordered the grilled mahi with the sauces on the side. Also got a free tea, thanks Yelp! You can choose green/black. They have Truvia (not Splenda!) packets, something unseen in Northern California. The food came out in a meal prep container like bowl. I love it. My mom, however, said it had no taste. I like it low sodium, sorry ma. She went and bought cookies/treats from the Bread Factory across the street afterwards to make up for it.

My review is solely based off of the Soba/Udon noodle station. The vegetable soba is delicious and reasonably priced! The man working behind the counter is also always super friendly. I love the selection you can get here, from the noodles to the add-ins to the broth. I like to be able to pick and choose what is in my dish. As someone who is meat and dairy free having the option to choose veggie broth is awesome! Most other places throw in whatever ingredients they have on hand and only have beef broth as an option. They also have different sauce add ins to make it sweet, spicy, etc. Would definitely recommend!

This was our first trip to Vermont and Montreal.  We really enjoyed Burlington.  Fortunately, we were staying within 1 block of this restaurant. My wife and I dined there twice...out of only three nights!  After the first visit, we couldn't wait to go back and so we did on the very next night.   Everything about this place is amongst the best.  Ambience, lighting, service, quality of ingredients, staff attitude and the FOOD!   First thing I noticed, is that the restaurant had privately labeled two bottles of wine from excellent producers in Oregon.  We have spent countless hours in the Willamette Valley, and love most of the wines from that region.  We ended up having both of their bottles both nights.  Couldn't help ourselves. The food was wonderful.  We ate at the food bar area in front of the cooks both nights.  All of the cooks and the Chef himself were obviously very serious about their profession and it showed.  Steak Tartar?  Watched the man make our dish and it was amazing.  Salads?  Watched the young lady prepare them with excellence and pride.  We had many small appetizer portions and never found anything that we just couldn't wait to have more of.  Homemade mozzarella salad?  Outstanding. Finally, I have to mention our server, Sophie.  She was excellent and she was able to serve us both nights. Friendly, knowledgeable, prompt and professional all in one beautiful young lady!   I will most likely never have the opportunity to visit Burlington again (this was a business trip), but if I do, I will go to this restaurant every chance I get.  If you go, just make sure to watch how well things are managed, smell the wonderful aromas and enjoy a wonderful time in an EXCELLENT restaurant.

Overall we had a nice dining experience- the food was freshly prepared and cooked well. We enjoyed our entrees (both specials) and especially loved the polenta fries as our side.  We were able to bring some of our favorite wine from our wine cellar to enjoy since this is a byob, which was a big plus for us.
it was okay, nothing special.  I got a watermelon salad that was blah.  Pizza is good though
One of the best cocktail bars in tribeca. Great kale salad, love the chicken wings, cocktails are excellent. Some of the portions are a bit small for the price but pretty standard for NYC

Sort of over this place. $2.50 for a mozzarella stick and watered down beer. It can be cozy in the winter but that's about the only lure. The waitress was rude and bartenders are not engaging or overly friendly.

I'm pretty sure this is the first and only Yelp review I'll ever do, but felt it was important to contribute to other Yelpers and also because Da Marcella is probably the only restaurant in the city I feel this religiously about. Alessandro (the owner), Patricia and Velmira (the two wait staff members my gf and I know best) make you feel like you're walking into your dining room at home. We've come here no fewer than 10x in the past two years. It's where we go when we bring friends and family from out of town and also when we just want to get a break from our daily grind. My pitch/review is pretty simple: - $12 for freshly made pastas in house with meats sourced from across the street - $19 for entrees that invoke no fancy techniques, only high-quality ingredients combined and cooked perfectly - $25-40 bottles of wine - Zero pretentiousness I've been to Babbo a few blocks away and don't get me wrong, it was fantastic- the black spaghetti is unreal. But reservations are hard to come by (my dinner there  was at 9:30p on a Tuesday in a crammed seating area) and the food/wine is double the price and the experience is, by its nature, a more highbrow one (which hey sometimes everyone wants). But, I go to Da Marcella for amazing food/wine for affordable prices, to let my hair down with a staff that welcomes you in with open arms, and to escape for 2 hours from the craziness of the West Village. --- Food recs Antipasti Burrata Polpo Marinato alla Griglia Primi Tagliatelle alla Bolognese On their specials menu, they have a Black Pepper Pappardelle with a ragu that rotates between wild boar and duck. Can't go wrong with either If you like lighter pastas, I'd recommend the Linguine alle Vongole. Nothing fancy, but very well done. Secondi Braised Short Rib of Beef w/ Polenta - if you're in the mood for beef and are debating between this and the seared peppered skirt steak, I'd go short rib hands down. Branzino - pretty awesome. It's a whole fish (bones and all). Again, nothing fancy, just great ingredients and perfectly cooked for a great dish. Wine Red I would definitely recommend the Nero on the cheaper side, Nebbiolo if you want to go more proper. If you want to splurge, the Brunello di Montalcino they have is fabulous as well. White It's still summer so if you want a good white, I'd highly recommend the Vermentino. It's got a really great dryness, yet still has smooth and fruity accents that come through. Can't go wrong w/ prosecco either.

Usually when I'm visiting my family in NJ for a weekend, I take a Monday 6am train from Metropark back to DC so I can get to work by 9am. This Quick Chek is perfectly located just on the other side of the Parkway from the station. At 5:30am there's usually not many people in the store, so it's very easy to pop in there before my train leaves. I always get a breakfast sandwich if I'm there, and sometimes I'll even get myself a sub for lunch. I personally like their subs better than Wawa, so it's a nice treat for me. The breakfast is nothing spectacular, but any breakfast sandwich (or really any sandwich) on their Portuguese rolls is gonna be delicious. That's one carb I just can't get enough of. It's a solid convenient store, and it's great if you're commuting from Metropark.

Yummers. If I lived in New York, this would be my new hangout. Also, quite friendly. Definitely try the back room, which is built like a library. I enjoy that they maintain an homage to Elaine's, which used to be in this location.

This place was wonderful. The service is impeccable: from the moment we walked in the door until we left, we were made to feel very welcome and appreciated. It is amazing how much of a difference that can make in an experience. The food was delicious as well. The pizza was wonderful and my husband loved his pasta dish. We were with family with a small child and the liveliness of the restaurant made for a very good kid-friendly atmosphere. At the end of the meal, they came around with trays of chocolate chip cookies to every table. Everyone agreed it was a great dining experience and didn't totally break the bank either.

I've only had the drinks here, but they are fantastic. Both the iced tea and iced coffee are my favorite in the neighborhood. The atmosphere and decor are very nice as well. And I do appreciate when a coffee shop puts your iced coffee in an actual glass and not a plastic cup.

I went there for brunch. Ordered the fried chicken with waffle and cappuccino. It is not bad but need to say the chicken is kind of dry. The taste is so different and unusual that I cant say I like it. But still good to try. I bet their pancake is good.

This location near the Barnes and Nobles is your standard Panera. Good service, well maintained and clean. Like all chains, it is busy on Saturdays at lunch but worth it if you're craving a decent soup and sandwich. If you're planning on eating your meal outside on a beautiful day while enjoying a good read, definitely plan to come a little after the lunch time rush for both optimal seating without the rush hour roar.
their masa ceviche is amazing, i ordered that twice last night. Do not forget to try their eggplant sandwich. good AYCE price. Must have green tea ice cream to be your dessert.
the pizza was sooooo good words cant explain, my mouth wanted to keep eating but my stomach wouldnt let me!! :'(
THIS place is a legend  but ever seince it went from the ITALIANS to the MEXICANS/MIDDLE easterns owners - the Quality of the Squares went down !
Hands down my favorite food spot in the neighborhood! The food is delicious. The matzah ball soup is to die for. Follow that up with a spinach quiche and you will be VERY happy!

They may be rude but the food is so good. It is best to avoid the barbecue items late at night. It is better to catch it during the day. Cheap + good food + open till late at night. Can't ask for me and makes me a regular to Noodle town after partying. The egg noodles, roast pork on rice, roast duck on rice, beef in egg sauce-- all these are very good. Try the noodle soups as well. My favorite: Salt baked shrimp. Those salt baked shrimps with the hot sauce on side are the best stuff you can have after one too many drinks! One can try the salt baked combo as well. The portions are just right and the food is just so tasty you want to go back over and over.
Delicious delicious Eat here and be so happy From drinks crazy jane martini To mesculen greens to amazing filet And oh I forgot those fries.   This place is amazing !!!

This is some good stuff. You can't get food like this everywhere. I love the authenticity of this joint. Every time I go I get something different and I haven't been let down yet. Get their carne asada tacos! You can't go wrong! Worth every penny!

A hidden gem in my favorite town of Bloomfield! I recently moved here and stumbled upon this place looking for a great steak to eat! My server Sue was extremely polite and knowledgable. The 10oz Pan-seared Filet Mignon was to die for!. Med-rare, melted blue cheese crumbles with port wine reduction over the steak. It was a perfect combination along side of my favorite homemade garlic mashed potatoes. The only place I know that has the strongest cocktails and welcoming staff. This place is just like home!
Food is fantastic. Exceptional service. Great for afterwork drinks or with a group. Will be back very soon. A+ all around!
finally found out why the line here is always so long! place was amazing, especially when you're starving at 3am! lol
Great plate of food!

I had been dying to go here the entire time I lived in the area but the brunch line was always ridiculously long! Finally on my last day I got a table and I was blown away. I had the chicken pesto sandwich and it was melt in your mouth good. The pesto was so delicious I asked the server (we sat at the bar) if I could get some to take home with me to make some pesto pasta for friends the next day. He went and asked the chef and she was more than happy to give me a cup for $6 which is way less than most gourmet pesto out there. I used it for the next few days in basically everything. Perfection. Four stars only because I wish it were bigger or took reservations for brunch.
Absolutely terrible. Unclean, and the food is just terrible. Do yourself a favor and steer clear of this place.

I love a good Italian sandwich so when I read the article on Philly.com I knew this was a place I wanted to try. I walk past it on my way to work and today was the day. I walked in to find a modern style deli counter with large paper rolls hanging on the wall with the menu written out. The menu was simple with about 8 sandwiches on it. The Capri caught my eye first since I love fresh mozzarella but after looking at all the choices I went with the Italian Stallion. All fresh Italian meats and cheeses including salami, coppa and sharp provolone served on a seeded Italian roll. The pepperoncini aioli was excellent with the right amount of spice.  It was the right balance of meat, cheese and bread. I will definitely be back to try the Capri and the Uncle G...roasted turkey with crispy pancetta? Yes, please!!

I loveeeee it here! Ropa Veja & coconut shrimp are the best! Bring your own that can be mixed into a sangria or mojito! Street & meter parking. The owner is a doll and always accommodating! Fun lively Saturday night out kind of place !
Great atmosphere, and good Mexican food. The drinks are pretty surprising. A nice place for a fun lunch or dinner.
Good happy hour, would definitely visit again!

Great place that we stumbled upon! I had the pork belly wafco, and it was so delicious! I went with my 2 year old, and while they had bar side seats (no high chairs) they were so sweet to him! Will definitely go back!

I hate how the place isn't so easy to find, but hearing good things about it, I went there with a friend, and it was WELL worth the trip. It's a classic "family-oriented" diner with amazing burgers and fries, as well as the best omelette I've ever had. I would DEFINITELY recommend the san diego omelette.

The lack of competition in the area really allows this place to shine: a medium sized fish in a small pond. The food is delicious, if salty and overpriced.  The beers are cold, if manhattan-priced. The proximity to the train station may explain this, but looking at rent in the area they definitely must be bringing home a lot of money. Average to above average in all aspects: food, service, decor. Waaay above average in terms of price, and I usually don't place a premium on quantity over everything else.

It was my first time in Philly and I came here with a friend during my short stay. The happy hour $3 drink deal with oysters was perfect after my long day in a conference hall listening to who knows what. I ended up having the steak for dinner which was done well and huge. Definitely got more than what I paid for. Their beer selection is all decent.

Carmela's pizza is the real deal. If you want true Italian pizza, hand crafted, by a true Italian, look no further. Rick and his wife came direct from Italy and opened this family operated establishment. The love good food, and they love making good food. When good people, with a passion for food open a restaurant, there is nothing but gourmet bliss. I live in Texas, where Chuckie Cheese is essentially the pizza standard, but I grew up in CT so I know a good pizza. Hands down, this is without a doubt, the BEST pizza in CT, and quite possibly New England. Don't let the location, or the modest decor fool you; these guys know what they are doing.

Slow to serve and only decent food. We had the Brazilian steak, calamari, chorizo, and one of their special pork plates. They were good but I've had better. The chorizo appetizer was huge! It was salty but nice and smokey. The service was nice but the food took forever to come out. This place is better as a bar than a restaurant, considering the clientele and how quick it took for drinks to arrive compared to food.

Great food! ~ The largest, juiciest buffalo wings I have ever bitten into! The tastiest bruchetta and pizza! Great Service ~ Unfortunately not enough staff to cover the busy times....but...Jud is great. Deserves a raise. One of the best personalities I have ever come across in a waiter/server. He cares for all his customers and treats them as if they are family. Great Atmosphere ~ The bar has a family feel to it...like Cheers!

Loved the service and the food. I had my bday dinner here with 20 people (they actually stuck the multiple tables to make a single long one) and we all had a great time with very delicious food. The Xiao Long Baos were the best I have had in Manhattan. Actually, I would say that it is on par with those I ate in Shanghai, China. All the food we ordered were very 'clean', making it high quailty and appetizing.   The staff were very accomodating and friendly, which made the experience just so much better. Everyone should definitely try this place out!

Review for service only....DiFaro's I've heard so much about you, but sadly it wasn't meant to be. I ordered and didn't mind the hour the lady at the front said it would take to get my pie. An hour came and went, I was told a half hour more. I don't care how good it's supposed to be, I was getting impatient. The last straw was when I asked if the pizza had even gone into the oven, an hour and 45 minutes into it, and she snapped at me for being impatient. Don't tell customers 1 hour when you mean 2+, just lemme know what I'm getting myself into! Terrible system and customer service. Not to say I didn't gain anything, I got bit by Mosquitos or bed bug or idk what those crawly things were. HORRIBLE SERVICE!

I made a reservation via Open Table, and the restaurant called to confirm my reservation on the day that we were to come. I showed up at the appointed reservation time, and there was nobody to greet us at the door. Someone shouted from across the room that they would be right with us. Then, a waiter came over and greeted us, and I informed them of our reservation. He went to check on it, but the table was not free yet. I was invited to sit at the bar, and we had a cocktail while waiting for our table. It seemed that we were forgotten, and after we almost finished our drinks, the bar tender (or another waiter) asked us if we were waiting for a table. I informed him that we were waiting for our table that we had made a reservation for. He went to check on it and another different waiter came back and told us the table was now ready "for whenever we wanted to move" and got ready to disappear again, we had to practically hold on to him to get to our table which we were more than ready for. I will take a moment here to state that there were a total of three waiters and they each seemed to be serving, bar tending, and greeting people as they came in the restaurant. Once at the table, we looked at our menus and decided what we each wanted to eat. We ordered the camembert alongside the duck breast and prosciutto di parma charcuteries to start. This was presented nicely on a wooden board with cornichons, mustard, a fig jam and pickled veggies, with some cut up baguette. With that we also ordered the baked figs stuffed with blue cheese and wrapped with bacon. The charcuterie board was very tasty, the baked figs were OK, nothing to write home about (the bacon was thick cut and overpowered the rest of the simple ingredients). After we finished our appetisers, one of the waiters asked us if we were (and I quote) "still waiting for food", not realising that we had already ordered mains. This seemed to be the main problem with the restaurant: there was no good communication between the waiters and the service was a bit slow and disorganised. For our mains we had the filet mignon and the duck leg confit. The beef was cooked perfectly and the sauce was stunning. My husband liked my dish better than his duck and he started to run his duck through the beef sauce because it was so good. I also tried the duck. It was a little on the drier side, but not terribly overcooked. During all of this, nobody seemed to bother too much about asking us if we wanted more drinks (the table was so small that we had to have our glasses on a shelf right next to the server station, so lack of visibility was not the problem here) or a refill of our water glasses. Apparently we looked stuffed because asking if we wanted dessert was also completely omitted. Overall the food and ambience was great, but the service was mediocre. Every person we dealt with was friendly, but again they were very disorganised and inattentive. If the service was better, I would have given this restaurant 4 stars easily.

There are not enough words to formulate to express how wonderful this restaurant is and how helpful they were with my party.  The library/dining room upstairs is intimate, cozy and rustic and combined with the delicious food and attention to detail, I could not have picked a better place to have a family gathering. Jessica, the restaurant's Events Manager was gracious and so lovely to deal with throughout this whole experience.  When my party had to be suddenly canceled, they were so helpful in rescheduling. The food is rustic, fabulous, plentiful and presented beautifully. I recommend everything but the meatballs, the fried artichokes and the CHEESECAKE were big hits! Thank you again Palma for making such a lovely party!

Villalobos is an excellent Mexican restaurant in the heart of downtown Montclair. Yesterday I ordered the fish & verduras tacos and a margarita (virgin but they are BYOB). The verduras taco was quite tasty. The corn was fresh & crisp and had the right amount of smoke. The fish taco was battered and topped with cole slaw. Their house-made tortillas taste even better than the ones at a typical Mexican food cart. Both accompanying salsa's (salsa verde and regular salsa) were fresh, well seasoned and authentic. I actually ended up ordering the same thing for lunch today along with an order of guacamole that was legit. It's really dangerous working directly next door to them so I'll have to schedule my visits. Adam, the owner, is a great dude. Go, you won't be disappointed!

I am sure I will never go to Outpost again.  These guys are a much better experience.  I visited here three times during my recent trip to Brooklyn.  Every sandwich was excellent, every cup of coffee superb.  The husband/wife team really make you feel welcome, they engage you in conversation, they make a serious effort to get to know you.  I felt like I was with friends while I was in Lunitas.  The Fulton sandwich is excellent, you must try it.  The caprese sandwich was delicious.  They cook to order, so its always fresh and warm.  The coffee is hand pressed throughout the day and I really loved their coffee.  Cannot wait to come back to Brooklyn to visit with them and try some more of their wonderful coffee and food offerings.  You must walk past Outpost and cross the street to try this place.  You will not be sorry.

The service was very good and the drinks were excellent. The place had a nice vibe. The food was OK; nothing great and it was overpriced. I wanted to try the Mac and cheese with my main entre since I had read so much about it and I was very disappointed. It had way too much garlic and was not very cheesy. As far as the chicken and waffle I ordered, the chicken didn't taste as good as the chicken at my grocery deli and the waffle lacked flavor. My friend had the short ribs which I tasted. It was a generous portion of food but I disliked the Asiatic barbeque sauce. The experience was a letdown.

Real Italian food and better yet: great service! House wine was delicious and very affordable and we did not feel rushed (didn't get the bill shoved under our nose after 20 min, something that can happen a lot in NYC).

This lunch was mediocre at best. I went with my boyfriend and simply got a burger and beer each. When the beer first came out the glasses they were in were extremely dirty, but they switched it out for us nicely. My boyfriend got the avocado burger and I got Ryan's burger. We both ordered medium and they we're both waaaaay over done. On top of it, the avocado on the avocado burger was a small wedge that was hard and browned. They only saving grace of this place is that the waitress was super sweet and they allow dogs on the patio. I would not suggest it for food though.

I am a HUGE fan of customer service.  This place has been in business for 11 years and they are proud of their "art".  For them, it is not just a function of financial gain or means, it is customer oriented experience and a zen environment.  Equally as important!  The food was really tasty and carefully prepared.  We quite enjoyed the stuffed chicken wings (a first for us), then we also had black pepper shrimp and the ginger chicken dish, both excellent!  They take the time to grow their herbs fresh and pride themselves in bringing forth authentic flavor.  It's truly a hidden gem.  I hope they never change their baseline as they grow, which is wonderful personalities and well prepared cuisine.  We plan to go again on ladies night very soon!

I've been to this pizzeria 4 times now. The pizza is fantastic!!! The reason that it gets such a low rating is the guy in the back doing all the other cooking is horrible. Every time I try to order buffalo wings I always get something different. Sometimes it BBQ sometimes it's just fried wings with nothing on it... The last two times I made my order there was a hair in it somewhere. Once in the pizza and once in the wings... My opinion, fire the fry cook and buy some hair nets.
If you want chicken and rice you have to go Halal Guys or risk becoming an old man, filled with regret, waiting to die alone. Also, beware the hot sauce is really hot!
The wait was ridiculous but got in for a great brunch. $18 for a nice brunch item + drink. Cute little restaurant.

First of all, you have to try their homemade butter! As good as it gets!! I tried the cinnamon and the pumpkin and both were absolutely to die for! I got the pancakes based off a former recommendation and I was definitely not let down (especially coupled with the homemade butter)! The bacon and eggs were great, too but after tasting all of them, I was especially impressed with the pancakes! Also, the coffee was delicious as well! The place is small and sort of crowded, but it fits the restaurant itself. There are so many things to look at on the walls and it got voted the greenest storefront in 2009 and 2004 (I think those were the years at least). I'm not from here so I loved watching all the people and the noise going through the restaurant! You will not be disappointed going to Tom's, promise!

all in all my favorite indian restaurant in new haven. I have got to say I love their buffet special. my favorite dish on here is the chicken tikka masala. I've been to indian restaurants all around but none are as good as at zaroka.
