When the waitress asked how it was and I said I was surprised by how little beef there was she just said ok and walked away. If you are a vegetarian it might be ok as long as you aren't looking for great service.

The best Italian ever! The food is excellent and the prices are great. I've ate the prosciutto with brie panini and a dishe with Buffala muzzarela with hamdmade Pesto and tomatoes, and are awsome! I highly recommend this place!

Garbage. We had a reservation for 8 people and 9pm and weren't seated until 10:20 after continuous "just a few more minutes" they then tried to squeeze 8 people onto two tiny tables that would seat 4 max. Not great, so we asked to move to an adjacent table after the people had finished, which was fine but added another 15 minute wait. I get it, that happens sometimes on a Saturday in Manhattan, and to be fair they gave us a round of drinks on the house. So that only knocks one star off. However, the waitress was AWFUL - she was pissed off about something and was so rude I nearly walked out there and then. She slammed dinner plates onto the table splashing tomorrow sauce up my shirt. Not only was she slow, miserable and totally inept, it was as if the very concept of serving food offended her in some way. Worst service in a Long time. The food was also pretty crap. A few stringy clams in overcooked pasta. I didn't like the look of anything anybody else ordered. The meat platter to start was fine but you can't really screw that up can you? The reason it doesn't get 1 star, is the ambiance is nice and the bar maid and hostess were both awesome. The hostess in particular. Sadly the awful waitress and the disgusting food means I will go out of my way to tell anyone who will listen to avoid this abysmal excuse of a restaurant.

While it may be unassuming from the tarp flyers on the outside this is some of the best Authentic Jersey Italian food you will get. The garlic shrimp sauce should be scraped clean with the excellent complimentary garlic bread. Every pasta I've tried has been top notch at a perfect temperature.  Highly recommended

I was really disappointed in this place. I ordered take out and when I came home and opened my order I had expected so much better. I ordered the pepper steak with a side of mixed rice and beans and avocado. I found in my order WHITE rice and SPOILED avocado. The pepper steak was really tough to chew and was a super small portion size. Also the plantains they gave me were burnt. Just because a patron isn't eating in doesn't mean they don't deserve quality food. I had traveled and hour by train to get to this place because of all the positive reviews, but it's safe to say I won't be returning.

Service was pretty standard. My real complaint lies within the food.  I got the lobster feast for $26 - overpriced for what you got. Lobster was decent, corn on the cob was soggy. My date got the fish and chips and ended up sending it back, first time in our years together that he had done that. He got the scallops instead, which were good but the portion was too tiny for the price. Overall it has been our worst dining experience since living in the city. I would recommend going to a better fish place instead of a "joes crab shack" type of place. On the plus side we did get free beers for our wait to redo the food. Still doesn't make up for our feelings afterwards though
This is restaurant is one of best restaurant so far I know. Not too expensive and great food! - Mr . Singleton, Newark, NJ

I have been here several times and I LOVE, LOVE, LOVE the food and ambiance. Their mac and cheese is slamming, the fried chicken is amazing and their seafood grits are the best grits I have ever tasted and I hate grits. I will definitely recommend and make reservations especially in the weekends because it gets packed and the wait is long.

This place was recommended by several friends, especially Debbie! She and everyone were so right! I thoroughly enjoyed everything !!! It makes you feel like you are In a great restaurant in Manhattan!
BBQ Pulled Pork.  Will not disappoint, i promise.

Great owners and staff!  Rice balls and stuffed peppers for appetizers.  Always a pork chop on special that is great.  Great little place to take a date.  Prices are very affordable for the quality of the food.  Must try!

this place is just hands down awesome as far as the atmosphere and food. great food, beer and decor. you don't see too many old school German restaurants especially in Staten island and this place really stands out. the food is also very affordable and even if it were more expensive,  the quality would still make it worth it

With all the buzz around having to try a Philly Cheese steak with a side by comparison of Pat's and Geno's I really had much higher expectations.   To be honest I've had better cheese steaks not in Philly so the only big difference which people who live in this area seem to really love is the wit wiz option which is basically that nacho cheese whiz filling which you can get at places like 7-Eleven on your nachos or by melting that Velveeta cheese.  Prepare to put on the calories though. The one thing I really enjoyed about this place over Pat's was their bread, it's soft and has a nice chewiness that goes well with the cheese steak however I found their steak meat to be overly dry and not as flavorful as Pat's. I wouldn't return here in the future, I've had my side by side comparison and satisfied my earning to see what the buzz was/is all about so my experience is complete. Everything here is ala carte as well, you gotta buy your cheese steak apart from your fries.  It's all cash too so at the end of the day for a combo meal you're paying more than $20 for fast food which is ridiculous. P.S. I also had the cheese fries which weren't that good, it's the same cheese whiz they slather in the cheese steak. CASH ONLY.

I was in the area for work, so I found this on yelp and thought I would give it a try.  I had never experienced a Brazilian steakhouse with a pay per pound system, but figured I would try it.  They had a small salad bar and the Gaucho was behind a carving counter by the grill, so they didn't serve you, you had to go up and have him carve what you wanted.  They had a few different meats, but only a couple steak.  The rest was chicken, etc.  The flavor of the meat was ok, they were cooked to my liking, but they were luke warm.  Not sure if I would go back, but it was a unique experience.  I had 3 plates full and it cost me $25.  So the price was definitely very good, but the food choices and the overall quality of food was average at best. Also the restaurant was in a neighborhood that was a little less than desirable late in the evening.

Flawless!!! A rare NYC gem!!! Contrada is the sort of restaurant people come back from travels to far flung places and rave about--they say it's worth going to XYZ just to eat there. Yes, Contrada is that exceptional! The food is delicious and creative and accessible and inexpensive (certainly by NYC standards.) The menu is comprised of dishes that represent seemingly different cuisines from mediterranean to Italian, yet they are each delicious and complementary and clean. The main ingredient takes center stage here, the sauces or seasoning are its supporting cast. Why is this impressive? It takes work! This approach to food doesn't allow the chef anywhere to hide. Speaking of the chef, he (whose name I do not know though I had the pleasure of speaking with him,) is one shining star in a myriad galaxy of glittering staff! Michael, an owner, the sommelier, and homme du maison, is what is missing from almost every other restaurant of this quality--he is PRESENT, PERSONABLE, AND KNOWLEDGEABLE!  For the plebeian California chard lover, the wine list is a bit inaccessible, which is to say, I had no idea what to pick. Michael was endlessly patient and attentive and informative without being didactic; and he had a sense of humor about wine, though he is obviously an oenophile.Michael managed to find three different bottles that my dinner companions and I loved, and that expanded our taste. Lastly, this restaurant takes its civic duty seriously. Contrada hosts seminars and discussions, the former taught by famous journalists, the latter between literary luminaries-9/17 is a memoir writing seminar with Daphne Merkin and on 9/22 Daphne Merkin is in conversation with Erica Jong. Contrada is not just someplace to eat, but rather it is an experience akin to be a guest at a dinner party: one where the host wants you to be happy, one that will leave you vying for the next invitation. In other words, make a reservation! P.S. My husband told  me that, while everything above is absolutely true, he fears it is too stellar and that maybe I should tone it down. NO! I am a native, almost life-long, NYer and foodie. I call it as I see it, or rather eat it!

My wife and I traveled into Essex to look for a breakfast restaurant when we came across this little diner.  I ordered a simple sausage, egg, and cheese breakfast sandwich on a croissant.  My wife ordered a traditional breakfast plate of bacon, scrambled eggs, and hash browns. My sandwich was average, I could get a similar sandwich at a corner store. My wife's dish was far worse, the bacon's taste was similar to eating coffee grounds with how overcooked it was, the eggs were as if the chef used double the amount of water necessary, and the hash browns had been over spiced (which I enjoyed as a fan of spice, but my wife did not). I would not recommend this "breakfast and lunch all day" restaurant until the chef can do more than fry an egg and burn bacon.
Great portuguese food. Come here every time we're in Newark - never had a bad meal & the waiters are great and accommodating.

we had such a great time at this place tonight!! we sat at the bar and ordered a drink and chatted with the friendly bartender. he made some awesome drinks including my friends old fashioned which was delish. i had a glass of malbec. adorable, cutely decorated and cozy restaurant/bar. burger night monday nights! come if you are in west village!!

16 beers on tap and always a nice variety.  As the reputation goes, the wings are crazy good.  Unique flavor from their other locations.  I really like their eggplants fries with marinara sauce.  Wish they put it on regular menu.  Draws a mixed crowd, lot of locals.  Waitresses are very good and have been around for a while.
Great brunch, reasonably priced. The sticky bun, the eggs benedict and the quiche are all really amazing. Dinner is pricey, but the food is pretty great, especially the flatbreads and the scallops.
This place was expensive, but so worth it. Amazing service, orgasmic food. You're paying for higher quality, not hype or pretentiousness. I will be back for special occasions.

Taste of Mexico is a reliably good spot.   The Breakfast are really good.  There is a wide variety of options from traditional breakfast to Mexican choices.  For lunch & dinner the choices are very good & a lot less $$$$ than Tortougas on Leigh.
Good service and great pizza make it perfect when you are in the pizza mood!

I love the music they play, specially last night, they had a live band singing rock en español music. However, we received no service at all... my husband and I walked in and didn't know whether to sit or order at the bar... and sat at a table for 20 minutes until we decided to get our own drinks at the bar. Even though the music and the decoration of the bar are very tasteful, the people there were so obnoxious. Whenever a great rock en español song came on, they would request to change it for a more pop- clubbing kind of song... and the DJ would actually change it.  Why didn't they just go to a different place that fit the kind of feel they were looking for?  In general we felt a bit uncomfortable but the music was great.
Love everything about this place. The food is great (burger!!), atmosphere is casual and fun, and bartenders are super friendly. Great place to watch a game too.
Great sandwiches. The staff is extremely friendly and the food is served quickly. I highly recommend stopping in next time you want a sub.
Great takeout. Pizza and burgers are to die for- and sides/apps are all tasty delicious greasy goodness. Miss this place now that I've moved away!

So good! The breads are absurdly good, great fusion of Cuban/deli. Garces has done it, again! Wish I could eat here, every day. Everything is seasoned to perfection- the steak I had was unbelievably perfect. Nice location and cute decor/good atmosphere.
If you rate this above a 1 you are probably a tourist. Pat's and Geno's are both overpriced and overrated. Unless you are in the area and drunk at 3am, go somewhere else.

Me and my friends heard of this newly open Asian fusion restaurant  in Sunnyside and said why not give it a try since we were in the neighborhood .   The service for me counts first . It makes the stay more fun and  food more enjoyable. For this place, I rated them more than excellent . It was around closed to 10 pm when we came . We were a large group and they  let us stayed half hour passed their closing time without making us feel rushed to leave. Very exceptional business gesture! Me and my ladies tried different appetizers.   The Fried calamari is tasteful. The shrimp is delectable . Their edamame is  heavenly. Their chicken satay is  pleasant tasting. And  these were all perfectly matched with our unique Thai iced tea. For the entree, their pad Thai  is the best pad Thai I have tasted.  Their spare ribs and steak are equivalently superb as well.  What gave us a surprise was when we tried their pana cotta dessert.  The taste is  immaculate .  Rare and to die for ! The atmosphere Is relaxing , the decoration is classically modern and presentation is exciting. Did I mentioned that they carry their trademark ( orchid) to each originally crafted food when served? Overall, love this place and will come back again.  Right now, their dinner menu has not been settled yet, so more better  experience is coming on its way on our next visit.
Love this place food and juice taste so good, and its all very healthy! I am not a vegan or vegetarian the setian is to DIE for!

A small storefront in Red Hook with prices to make one shudder and portion sizes that are laughable.  Our waitress, who had only two table to handle when we were there, was bored beyond belief and knew little to nothing about the wine list. She explained that all dishes were meant to share however when they arrived the four of us couldn't even each get a bite the portions were so small. The past with lamb jowel at $22 came in a small soup bowl and wasn't even a quarter full. My dinning companion got about 3 bites out of it and then finito! Between the cost, the portion sizes and the attitude I say skip it.
I like to hangout with my friends after work. I like the food here, and they service. The price is not too expensive. I love Japanese food :)
Great for brunch. Share a side order of crispy applewood bacon - it's too big for one! Had the lemon ricotta pancake with fresh berries. The blackberries were as big as quail eggs.

Went here for the first time this weekend. I'm a fan! I had mixed vegetables, Mediterranean chicken, falafel, hummus, chickpeas, spinach - all of it was delicious. The owner is very accommodating (eg. Grilled instead of frying for me, substituted a couple things) and cooks the food himself. Great value, plus I even had enough left over for a second dinner. I'll be back!

I have eaten here about 5 times now for breakfast.  Love the food.  The creme brulee French toast is soooooooo good.  Portions are large so you can share.  Service is quick and cash only.  Also tried the salted caramel latte the last time I went and loved it. If it's the weekend get there before 11 for breakfast or be prepared to wait.

This is a hidden gem.  Exquisite food, wonderful service, accommodating. Lovely, romantic atmosphere.   Eating very heartily, ordering about half the stuff on the menu, four people had a bill of $175, which included the downright cheap cocktails and a "quartile" (two glasses) of wine and two desserts.    Realize a lot of the food is rich (quiche, duck rillettes, chocolate mousse) so small plates are perfect.    The price is more Smith Street than Windsor Terrace, but so it the quality.  Michelin quality in fact.   It is not a burger joint.  If you want a burger joint, there is a great one across the street.  If what you prize is good food and good restaurants, get yourself out here.  Come for the restaurant, discover this terrific neighborhood.

Went here while in town for work based on Yelp reviews. Maybe it was a fluke, but I thought it was pretty meh. Chicken chow fun was fine, the noodles were too thick and the sauce bland. The rangoons were good but the dipping sauce was too sweet without any tang. It seemed like pretty mediocre food for $14 for one person.

I recommend this restaurant!!  The food is fresh and fantastic! Service is awesome. And they give you " na pososhok" goodbye drink.  Their vodkas presented in frosted glass and the quality is great. I also went to another Eastern European restaurant Mari Vanna. And found out low quality food and vodka. And their menus are similar. I strongly recommend Korchma Taras Bulba. I felt the ethnicity and hospitality. Like I was at Ukranian village.

This was my second dinner here over two different business trips in the last year.  Pizza oven is broken, and it seems that parts are hard to obtain.  Sat at the bar, and had wonderful, thoughtful service.  Ate arugula salad which was very good with the right amount of dressing.  Pine nut crusted scallops were great, and they accommodated my request for no potatoes but extra kale and no added salt.  Sauce appeared on the side, and wasn't needed.  The food was well prepared and spot on for what I wanted, good food after a long day.
Full review coming soon. This place is flawless.
It is not what is in the sandwich, all about the bread. Right now they are very crowed and hope we get the order soon.
Party of 6, 1 tuna, 1 chicken, 4 steak all excellent.  Great service, friendly staff.
The Avocado toast was good. Grainy, healthy and hearthy. I added an egg to it to make sure I'd get full.

The costumer service is superb! The food is pretty good. I had a chicken quesadilla, which was freshly made and tasty. There is a pretty standard selection to choose from in terms of breakfast/lunch. They have pastries, nice cafe drinks, and to top it all off ice cream, which is delicious. The location is perfect! There is a nice patio in the back that over looks the river and passaic (third ward) park. They also play lovely music that just sets the perfect mood for the morning/afternoon. I had a lovely afternoon there. I would definitely recommend you try this place out!

Stopped in here for dinner while in the area visiting family. The food was very good which is the reason for the two stars. I had one of the specials. Nothing to write home about but it was worth the cost and the two block walk over. However the service was spotty.  It wouldn't kill the bartender to smile a bit.  I think the biggest slap in the face is when two people sit down next to you, get water right away from the bartender and a huge hello.  Maybe they were better dressed then us, but have no idea.  My thought is service should be good too everyone and not just the two that only ordered drinks especially when you work for tips.

Ate here a while ago. Pizza was "ok". Nothing worth the long lines. Not clear what all the HYPE is about this pizza. Tourists LOVE it. Stand in line ALL day for it. No clue what they find so elusive about it. It is just a mediocre pizza
One of my favorite breakfast / lunch spots. Great service, fresh food, quiet atmosphere... Highly recommended !

The good: We were not attacked by animals or doused with feces. The bad: -$10 seaweed salad that consists of cheap, chewy seaweed that can be acquired at any Asian supermarket, and spicy mayonaise (two parts Kewpie, one part Sriracha). What the actual f*ck? -$12 "sesame" tofu that is anything but. Sesame tofu usually means - surprise! - sesame-flavored tofu. When done right, it is tender, creamy, and refreshing. Trying to pass tasteless store-bought tofu as "sesame tofu" is akin to plating sliced deli bread and dubbing it "almond croissant".   -Service so bad that my initial shock eventually gave way to anthropological curiosity. The ugly: The manager clearly thinks he's hot shit and can't be bothered to answer a few questions about the drink menu. He gave my boyfriend more attitude than a teenage employee at a MacDonald's drive-through, and was about as knowledgeable when it comes to shochu and sake. (Honey, you're not hot shit. You are a manager at a third-rate restaurant, and you are pretty damn awful at your job. I imagine that a life completely devoid of neck and any semblance of competence has been hard - but don't take it out on us, all right? We're just here to stuff our faces full of fish and give our livers something to cry about.) My boyfriend and I decided to cut our losses and eat somewhere - anywhere - else. After we told our waiter that we were leaving because of the manager's nasty attitude, he answered "shit happens." It certainly does.

Pommes Frites is actually one of my favorite places in the city- their belgian-style frites are always perfection and their incredible variety of sauces is literally unparalleled. However, I'm writing this review because I was incredibly disappointed by the service my boyfriend and I recieved on a recent trip in. I can understand a lack of courtesy when the place is packed, however, we went in early on a Monday evening and were alone in the restaurant when this happened- the men behind the counter were fairly awful. We asked to sample two sauces, and the man acted like we were doing him a giant injustice- he would not give my boyfriend a frite to dip into the sauce. He then acted really nasty and pretended he didn't hear when we asked for the sauce combo, When we listed the additional sauces we wanted, he literally started speaking in this super slow tone acting like we were idiots to let us know that he'd be giving us sauce in smaller cups than the free sauce that comes with each order. Like okay, but if you don't wait for us to finish talking, you're not going to get the order right. Finally the portion size- generally when I come here, I've split a small order with a friend and been unable to finish it, and the generous portions have always been a highlight- today the paltry number of fries we recieved were gone within two minutes. $4.50 for like ten frites is sort of ridiculous. As someone who's come here frequently, I've never encountered this level of rudeness and bad service before and I was really disappointed.

I was not sure what to order at first but I had a sudden craving for palabok. Honestly I was very pleased with what I had. The palabok was just like what I had back in the Philippines.  I couldn't finish it all so I took it home. My sister ate what I bought and she enjoyed it too. We plan on coming back soon to this place
Great atmosphere and best prices for seafood I've seen-and the seafood tastes fresh and was tasty! I loved my lobster roll abs my hubby loved his fish and chips.
Service Quality is going down hill... Have been @Fornos several times - the food is really good, you get the best and very fresh seafood, the issue is the service which is really really slow!
Overpriced and not as good as the place across the street from there. I won't be going back there.

Awesome gem on Staten Island! Sit out on the beautiful outdoor terrace and watch the tugboats go by, it's simply gorgeous out there. The wait staff is excellent, the food delicious. Lots of vegetarian options. I highly recommend the avocado carpaccio and the blue vegetable terrine. Yum!

Food is great. I add their hot peppers to everything. Long hots never disappoint. Chop or Cobb salads are awesome. Blackened Chicken, Cowboy or Sirloin Steaks and wings are my choices. Seafood is always fresh (balsamic calamari, clams & hotsy totsy mussel appetizers). Best bartenders ever!! Managers and staff are always friendly and funny. I love it!
Ok

Definitely not your average diner. I came here for the chicken and waffles and I definitely wish I didn't. The portions are huge but the food wasn't good. The waffles were too spicy and there wasn't any syrup. It was like a tea sauce/brine/goo. The chicken was ok though it left something to be desired. You'd think that for $23, you could get a good waffle. The only reason I'm even affording the two measly stars is because the service was ok.
Quick & easy..a lot of choices to choose from...awesome in the wall shop! I love this place!. True Mexican flavor! Dale

I will definitely seek elsewhere next. This one of the most disgusting restaurants I have ever been in this city . I have enjoyed pizza from most ever known pizza place here,NYC,Rome,Florence, Chicago,Boston, Providence. I had very low expectations, but this was unreal. The crust was doughy,pasty white, even after fully cooking the color was beige at best.All te topping were tasteless and useless, the cheese was that industrial ultra white cheese that one hopes never to encounter. I have no idea how this place stays in business, but be the later hours. The kitchen was filthy, there was a B on the card out front and under no circumstances will I have be hungry enough to go back there.

Found Tuome after reading an article in Vogue and decided to check it out with the boyfriend. SO GLAD I DID! We had the following... Amuse Bouche: YAAAASSSSSSSSSS. Pickled Papaya, tomato, and something else. OMG SO LIGHT AND REFRESHING. SWEET, SALTY- EVERYTHING YOU WANT IN LIFE. I WANTED TUOME TO AMUSE MY BOUCHE SOME MORE (sorry, I had to.. but seriously. It was that good). Chicken Liver: Great but nothing to write home about. Plus we thought the bread to mousse ratio was a bit off and wished there was a bit more bread to slather on some more of the chicken liver mousse. Oxtail Spring Rolls: The creamy cilantro sauce really put it over the top. I'd get it just for that Pig Out (for 2): Loved it- the crispy crispy skin on the pork with the delicious ginger/scallion condiment with the spicy peanut noodles... yum A+! Corn: Kaffir Lime-y, curry-ish goodness. Unexpected flavor profile in a seemingly innocent side dish. Packed a flavor punch and was quite delicious Summer Sundae: Citron was an interesting touch. For me, the texture of the ice cream was the star of this dessert The service was awesome and I thought everyone was super personable and friendly. The food has a lot of Asian flavors [Pig Out reminds me of Filipino Lechon Kawali, while the noodles remind me of something I've had at my boyfriend's house with his family (he's Chinese), and I feel the corn had definite Thai influence] and was executed perfectly. The ambiance is great and the venue has a lot of personality. Ok I'm going to have a fangirl moment now- Chef Chen (say that 5 times fast, I dare you) came out to speak to us. He's young, he's cute, and he can cook. HAYYYYY ~~(sorry, boyfriend)  He was so humble and clearly cares about his menu and his patrons' experience. I think I might have scared him a little bit when I blurted out "THOMAS CHEN?!?!" when he came over to our table. The highlight of my night was his answer to one of my questions. Me: The menu clearly has a lot of Asian influence.. would you say your food is remotely fusion-y? Chef Chen: I don't really like the term "fusion". I like to call it New American. Couldn't have said it better myself. Tuome is definitely going places and I'll cheer them on with the other happy patrons! ------------------------------- Perfect for: fuss-free date night, casual grub with friends
i have actually been here and can tell you the service is not that great food is okay but better off going to a 5 guys or checkers
I was extremely impressed with everything. It was very fresh tasting, and didn't skimp like a lot of places tend to.
The fact that people are posting back reviews because of something the restaurant did is uncalled for. Base it off their delicious food.

There are experiences, and there are life experiences, and there are life-changing experiences. Technically they're three shades of one happening, and what happened to me here falls squarely within the latter. This is fairly life-changing pizza. It's good. Really damn good. Downright incredible pizza. Some of the best if not best that I've ever had. These folks follow the tried and true method of doing one thing and doing it well. There are only a couple of options here, and you have to know about them to order them. Otherwise you order a pie, or a slice. It's hand-tossed dough, marinara, fresh mozz, and olive oil baked to perfection, then topped with fresh basil, more olive oil and grated parm. It's simple. It's made to order. And it's downright perfect. I guess you can get a square pie with thicker crust. You can get meat added on if you know that's an option. And, well, they do sell some sodas. But it's all about the pizza here, and the same guy has been doing it for ages. The downsides to this concept are immediately apparent. They open when they want to. They move as slow as they damn well please. And they only accept cash (as far as I can tell). Also this joint is way the hell out in Midwood, which is a trek for anyone from anywhere except Midwood. On the upside, the people-watching here is excellent. We made a pilgrimage here and showed up on a Sunday afternoon, to find the gate down but the window open, and a group of people hovering out front. It took maybe 10-15 minutes to make my way to the front of the line, and another few to converse with the dude writing orders on a lined paper pad. The quoted wait for a pie was two hours. Two. HOURS. But since we come from way out west, and made the trek, we waited. It took the full two hours for our pie to arrive, and was it worth the wait? Yes. For many reasons. First, it's delicious. The sauce, the flavors, the fresh basil, the crust... all good. Second, it's delicious. Third, this was my only chance to get it. If I lived in town, would I do it again? Sure, occasionally. But now that the taste of this pie is indelibly imprinted on my brain, I can always sweetly recall the wonders I experienced when consuming this pie while I wait a much, much shorter time somewhere else. But I'd still make it happen. Dom's only going to be slinging pies for so much longer, and I'd want to get as much of this in my belly as possible before he's done. This is serious business folks, and it takes serious dedication to do business here. But if you appreciate good food, it's your line of business.

Awesome service. Food was excellent (pork bhuna, scallops, spinach chaat, kheer). Service was top notch. Bar tender was super friendly. Love the spicy cocktails. Especially the lychee chili margarita.

I was a bit disappointed. The food was great, but a few aspects were underwhelming. --My wife and I had the chef's tasting menu, and while everything was very nice, the tiny portions left me pretty hungry at the end. --And we were both served the same dishes for each course. (Perhaps our expectations were too high after Vetri). --They seem proud of their bartender, but the cocktail menu is pretty limited, and each signature cocktail is either weak or includes at least one off-putting ingredient, so there were few choices for me. There is a full bar, though, so that is only a minor disappointment, not a critical flaw.

Reposting my review! When my parents from out of state wanted to throw us an engagement party, I was having a hard time finding somewhere that could accomodate a group, was affordable, and didn't want us to start at 12 in the afternoon. After doing some research, I stumbled upon Terre a Terre via Yelp and we decided to check it out. We went for brunch on a Sunday, and were presently surprised by not only the atmosphere of the restaurant, but the food! The steak and eggs was delicious, with flavorful sides of fruit salad and potatoes. I usually go for the sweeter side of breakfast, but was beyond pleased with my savory choice. We booked the party on the spot! In between then and the party we went back for my fiance's birthday dinner - all 6 of us enjoyed each course of our meal and there were zero complaints. Our party was this past weekend - chef Todd and staff were great from start to end. The planning process was smooth and easy; Todd is always very responsive to emails with questions. We had a group of about 25 adults and 4 kids. They even offered a kids menu for the little ones which was fantastic (and greatly appreciated by their parents). A bonus of Terre a Terre is that they are BYOB - perfect for our group of celebratory drinkers. I was able to drop off the beer and wine the night before which minimized the stress of having to remember everything the day of. Given that everyone was traveling to NJ for the party and the monsoon-like rain on Saturday, we had a few late-comers. The staff was very understanding and we were able to get the order in without feeling rushed. Everyone raved about the food throughout the party. The carrot-ginger soup was the winner - even my dad who doesn't eat carrot-ginger anything loved it and wanted more! They offered a choice of 4 entrees which everyone was pleased with. I had the steak and it was cooked to rare perfection. Three of my guests are pregnant and have dietary restrictions, and Todd was more than understanding when they sent their steaks back to the kitchen to be cooked well-done. A culinary sin in my opinion, but they were happy with the outcome and went on to enjoy their meals. Everyone also raved about the dessert. My only regret of the day is that I wasn't able to eat any because I was too busy mingling! Overall, we had a great experience and that staff made us feel welcomed and comfortable. I hope they weren't too frustrated with us as it was hard to get everyone to leave since people were catching up, chatting, and drinking. I tried to get the process moving but it took a little longer than expected. I would definitely recommend Terre a Terre and chef Todd for an event. We will definitely be back!!

This place is just awesome. My husband and I are hooked on their chicken roll and wings and don't even get me started with their pizzas and pastas. Just a few minutes walk from our place, this spot is truly a gem!!!
I watched all the vs. shows and Pats is the best the steak is moist and they give you a big portion. Just to be sure we went across the street and tried Geno's. No comparison Pats all the way.

I love the food here! Very interesting yet delicious twist of traditional Korean food. They have two different menus, yet was pretty flexible to satisfy our needs. However service was quit slow. Not the food was slow....the server
Outstanding authentic Mexican food!  Everything tastes so fresh and nicely presented. Inexpensive as well.

The food was good, the atmosphere was good, and the dessert - market cobbler with ice cream - was awesome. Definitely a good overall experience. Service was attentive, although it was not very busy at the time.

Need to update. I am usually very satisfied with them; but not sure what happened this time. The chicken with eggplant had no flavor to it and the beef I ordered very chewy. Maybe their regular cook took off; but if that's the case I hope he's back by the time I order again.
I was a bit disappointed to find out this is the not the traditional dim sum where they push carts around. However, it was still decent. The soup dumpling is the specialty there.

I really love Joya. Great service, great food, insanely low prices. The pad see yue and tom yum koong soup are my usual take out order, but I love the pad Thai, muscles. Fish dishes, I could go on and on. The folks at joya know their craft and they know it well. A top notch value in Brooklyn. If you love Thai then you have to go to Joya.

The food is uniquely presented: like the fish & chips-the fish is the whole fish, upright on the plate with a bright orange fish roe mohawk :) Its so good!!- the pop of the sweet roe with the succulent fish- YUM!! We loved the interesting food combinations: like foie gras & grape jelly inside a doughnut!! And best of all, every thing we ate was melt in your mouth delicious!!! That doughnut? i could have eaten several- the doughnut is slightly crispy on the outside with puffy yummy doughnut on the inside & the combo of the creamy foie gras with the jelly? HEAVEN!!! i also highly recommend the fried deviled eggs- i want to try making them for my next party!!! and the fatty lamb with fried eggs over easy & greens with vinaigrette dressing -perfect!!! Will definitely go back!!

We went out for a girls night dinner with a new baby and were expecting a long wait.  However, we kept getting passed up it seemed and waited a LONG time.  Finally the owner realized we had been waiting for a long time and recognized that we kept getting skipped, and had a new baby (who was very well behaved).  He made it right for us by automatically bringing us free appetizers and providing us a table immediately.   The food was awesome and I would most definitely return because the experience ended positively for us.

This truck is fantastic!  They pay great attention to detail and it shows.  I've had their specials each time I've gone. Food consumed:   1. Oxtail soup- Amazing! Came in a smaller cup than expected, but was delightfully filling and came with bread. 2. Tomato Bisque- Delish!  Came with bonus fresh mushrooms! 3. Watermelon Salad- Had mozzarella, basil, and vinaigrette.  Creative, pretty, and super tasty. I really need to try their regular menu items, but it has been so hot lately that I've been going for lighter items. I also want to mention that their customer service is outstanding.  The owner really cares about his product and it shows.  He is highly energetic and very engaging.  Pleasant truck to visit.

I went with a group of friends to this exclusive Spanish restaurant. The decor was fun with ample room and a Tuscan atmosphere. The food was subpar to average. The croquettes in particular were disappointing, tasting like they were from a stouffers box. This was on the restaurant week menu. Overall the experience was frustrating each time a course would arrive the initial excitement of what was coming would be met with the eventual sigh of over Americanized Spanish favorites. If you are looking for authentic Spanish flavors, this is not the place to go!

This restaurant has average burgers at best.    The service would maybe rate 2 stars.    With the great positive publicity they receive they definitely should rate no higher than one or two stars.   Stay away and save yourself some heartburn and heartache.
Came here a few weeks back, awful service, very slow and it wasn't even that packed to warrant it.
Not entirely sure why everyone is bashing this place. It's actually a pretty kick*ss place to hang and get a great burger.
We had the BEST time ever! The service was great the food is unbelievable and the atmosphere pleasant. Very recommended !!!

Mmm I love this place! I've only lived here a few weeks and have already repeated my visit. The brunch was on point; the manmosas were worth $10 and they even made them light on the OJ for me. The staff is so adorable and the food is delicious.

Well, what can I say? The stuffed waffles with egg, mushrooms, onions and peppers with basil aioili was great but the service wasn't. My brother and I were eating when we were asked to get up and vacate our table so it could be given to a bigger group. My brother couldn't believe the server had done that. It absolutely ruined my meal. I was disappointed. I wanted to go back again that same week but couldn't do it. UPDATE: I called the manager a few days later about the service and she was very apologetic. She stated that her restaurant didn't do that to customers and it wouldn't happen again. I felt good enough about the conversation to know I'd eat there again.

A very nice dinning experience.  From food, drink to people.  Hard to beat price for the superb quality and service.  The only restaurant experience in New York made me feel as warm as back to Texas. Will go all the time.
I've been twice over the past two months. The food is pretty good, a bit on the pricey side.

Went here last weekend with friends who were regulars. The food was good, but not incredible. I had fresh mozzarella with roasted red peppers. The peppers were amongst the best I ever had, and the mozzarella was fine. My wife had salmon for dinner. She said it was salty. I had the veal pizzaola. It was tasty. I did not notice the salt content until later in the evening, when I was parched. The portion was tiny. Dessert was the special chocolate creme brûlée. It was nothing special. Maria was very nice, but the service was incredibly slow and she had to step in to help. That should not happen.

This place is a gem frozen in time! Everything is fresh and made to order. There is no canned anything. Their dough is top notch and those ovens are something extraordinary. The end result is easily the best pizza you will ever have without having to go to Naples in Italy. Perfectly well done crust, burned a little at the edges, the house roasted red peppers, just until they begin to burn and then there is a clam pizza! Your hands will be a little black from the real coal ash on the bottom and your stomach will be very happy!
Egg sandwich on a bagel with prosciutto. Perfect breakfast! Also very friendly staff.
Fabulous breakfast,  luscious lunch, lovely setting, wonderful staff. Fresh, Fresh, Fresh. Go, go, go.
Really delicious burgers. Came in for lunch, real small place but worth the cramped location. I cannot wait to go back cash only.

I was recently here for dinner and the food is amazing. We had 2 appetizers, the pitakia kaisarias and the meatballs, both are great. Then for the entree I had the pastitsio which was to die for, and my friend had the lamb which was just delectable. Overall I will definitely come back and try other dishes.
My wife and I love this place. Great food, friendly service and a full bar.  Authentic and very reasonably priced. Nice addition to the neighborhood!

DElicious!!! Everyone keep telling us that the best pizza is in Brooklyn. I have to agree! I was definitely good. Ordered the White pizza and the Margarita w/ pepperoni. I was yummy in my tummy. Cheese and sauce was perfect!! I wished i had a slice right now.

this is far the best Pizza around, they have been here in town a long time, We have always enjoyed their Pizza sandwiches and the thin crust pizza is to die for. They have the best delivery, so fast. also all of there dinners and sandwiches are reasonable priced. Don't hesitate to give them a try.

Had their Pasta Vodka sauce last night (you can order just sauce, and tell your family you made it).  So delicious, more than generous portion.  I've never had better.  Plus, the service I received when calling was outstanding (Ron, I believe) and at pickup, so humble (Christopher).  This place would be on my speed dial if I lived anywhere within 100 miles.

Bella mama rose is the best. When I was like 5 and my parents said 'were going to Bella mama rose for dinner!' I would be like 'YAYYAYAYAYAYAYAYAYAAY I DINT EVEN KNOW WHO BELLA IS BUT SHES A REALLY GOOD COOK!!!!' And that's really all that my brain EVER thought when I was five, so it doesn't really count. It's a traditional family restaurant and the food is delicious. Parking is a little eh, service is like 97.527849 % because there's not that many waiters/ waitresses. It's a nice community and I always enjoy going there.

Just finished my third supper at the bounty. The food, as always, was exquisite.  the sous vide chicken--holy oh my god it's one of the best birds I've ever had. And happy hour oysters is always a nice great for the early birds. Kevin and Brian, the bar men, make yummy cocktails with care, and lance, the owner is gracious and welcoming.  Ambiance is lovely, service is great and most importantly, super excellent food. Nomnomnom!!!
Awesome place to visit. Stevie is great at serving the drinks and makes you feel very welcome. She even gives lessons on cocktail culture!
The service is awful and the food is a joke. Lackluster food combined with mediocre service is enough to keep me away...do yourself a favor and avoid this place
Best burgers in town! Great service!

I went to this place based on a recommendation of a co-worker. I was looking for a nice quiet Italian meal for me and my family and this place had lots of potential when I entered.  The place had plenty of seating when I entered so I don't know why they stuck us all the way in a back room that was filled to capacity and only had space for one last table for four. Everyone around us was extremely loud.  I felt like I was at a sports bar.  I had a reservation and I even arrived a little early.  There was barely anything on the table.  Missing table ware. Took forever to even get menus.  Service was beyond slow.  At this point I'm already disappointed.  Caesar Salad was so small and cost $9. Cajun Calamari was pretty good but not spectacular.  I ordered a $26 pork chop stuffed with figs and walnut.  It was disgusting. The stuffing was mush. The pork chop was a bit raw.  Who serves raw pork?  Little bit of mashed potatoes with some chopped up string beans that looked like they came out of a DelMonte can.  I couldn't wait to get out of there but of course I did because of the slow service.  $120 for two tiny salads, one appetizer, three entrees and a large bottle of Pellegrino.  What a waste of money for possibly one of the worst Italian meals I've ever had.  I wouldn't even give this place a second chance.

I used to order from them all the time - but since I go to college, I tend to have an issue with drivers telling me to walk to some weird parking lot like 5-10 minutes from my dorm room to pick up the food. Normally, I'll just politely make it clear that it's NOT an apartment building and to please come to the door and they'll do so without incident. It's happened three times now that they'll refuse to and just leave. The first two times, I just called the store and asked what the heck is going on and they send out a new driver with new food and it's okay. Normally they don't sound too happy about it, obviously, but it's their job. Every time, I've been exceedingly polite and patient with them. I used to work in food service (People's Choice Pizza, actually, in Wethersfield) and a few other places, so I ALWAYS tip well and am EXCEEDINGLY polite with them. This past time, however, was different. I ordered my usual online and waited for them to come here. About 40 minutes after I placed the order, I got a phone call from the driver. He asked me to come out, I made it clear that it was NOT an apartment building and to PLEASE come up to my door with the food. He seemed hesitant at first and said he had to call his manager, but after I made it clear that I just wanted him to come to my front door and described where it was he said okay. He said he wasn't sure where he was, but he would be there very soon. I was left waiting for 25 minutes. So I called him again to ask where he was and he didn't pick up. So I called the store to ask what was going on. It turns out that the driver had just LEFT after speaking with me - without so much as a word. Please keep in mind I paid by credit card. So, I complained. How is it okay for a driver to just leave like that without warning? I didn't (and don't) think that I was asking for too much to have the delivery driver come up to my door - rather than making me walk literally 5 minutes to get my food. I ended up somehow getting connected to the absolute rudest manager I have literally EVER spoken to. Possibly one of the rudest human beings - and I've worked in retail/sales for most of my career life. He talked over me - literally refused to listen to what I had to say. He actually told me that I was lying and the driver said I was rude and therefore it was okay for him to just leave without notifying me. He also said that the driver just leaving without letting me know or giving me a chance to walk over (because it's REALLY not that big of a deal - it's annoying, but if he flat out refused I would have done it anyway) was acceptable and he doesn't see why I'm upset. He even expressly told me that he doesn't want my business because I was being rude on the phone with him (at that point, I admit that I was getting pretty short because of what he'd been saying). He also then took it upon himself to cancel my order and hang up on me. I am NOT happy with what happened. Even if I WAS rude (which I KNOW I wasn't - I'm the most quiet, passive person you could ever meet -, but for the sake of argument, say I was), that is NOT acceptable customer service behavior. You do NOT tell the customer they're lying. You do NOT hang up on the customer. You do NOT just LEAVE with the customer's food after telling them you'll be right there. I have the phone conversation recorded, and you can believe I will be doing my best to take this to corporate levels. The food is fantastic here, but this is WILDLY inappropriate and unacceptable. They will NOT be getting any more of my business.
My mom Loves this place. I think the food is great. The Outdoor sating adds a lot the ambiance.
You come here to order the bucket of fried chicken and Mac and cheese. It's the best I ever had, and I'm from the south. Wth
I still haven't managed to get here for the famous sandwiches, but the Lunch baked goods are good enough for me! Get several and bring them to co workers and never experience workplace tension again.

Tinga has declined in quality, while its prices are slowly creeping up.  The food was badly lacking in taste.  The staff remains very friendly and it's child friendly as always.  But until the food improves, we will be looking for a different 'go to' Mexican restaurant.

Philly has some great byob Italian but Giorgio's is one my favs! Place is always packed so reservations are suggested but the pasta is fresh & delicious every time !  Always forth the wait if you want a satisfying Italian night out !

Went here with my boyfriend for tapas and was seated in the back garden area where we enjoyed the night breeze. We ordered the cervice mixto, fish taquitos, zapallitos, and entrana. Everything was delicious and all the seafood was fresh. We will definitely come back to check out their brunch menu!
Phenom pizza, sauces made from scratch, relish cuke salad w/hangar steak and 15 minute take out pick up....what's not to love!
My husband picked me up a grilled chicken, mozzarella,  roasted red pepper & balsamic vinegar on a semolina roll.  Absolutely delicious.   Need to get sandwiches from there more often.
Best Mexican food in Philly. Authentic,  delicious, great atmosphere and reasonably priced full bar.  Make a reservation.
The food is awesome but I hated the wait time. Why can't they get another person to chop the meat. Btw they got a new young staff up front.
Awesome food .and byob they do a great job with everything . I would recommend getting the hummus plate and the braised lamb dumpling for your appetizers .

Early dinner on Thursday 9/1114. This place was a surprise, a gem, and a definite place to come back to many times again!  We showed up with our 1 year old son at 4pm for our very first time, not sure it was kid friendly. The staff was incredibly welcoming and accommodating.  The food was so so good. The concept is great! Nonna's switiching in the kitchen every night, each bringing an authentic, regional take on Italian delicousness. As much as I love Brooklyn, I wish I loved close by so I could sample every menu, every night. On top of the food being fantastic, the waitress was so considerate and thoughtful about our son, we were blown away by her lovely attention. I can't wait to come back.
My coworkers and I order lunch take-out here almost weekly.  The hoagies are AMAZING.  My absolute favorite is the Old-Fashioned Italian; I haven't found a better hoagie anywhere!
Nothing That good about the food just OK But the service was extremely slow after I received my meal I never saw my server again till I was handed my Ckeck
What a great fun and unique dining experience. No night will ever be the same! Enjoy!

This place is great. I heard Heath Ledger used to own this place. I can tell because the restaurant is very well managed and is decorated with great taste. I will say that the wait time is always pretty outrageous but it's because this place is that good. I would say the food and atmosphere is worth the wait though. I would totally recommend this place to all of my friends.
Another superb beef brisket noodle. Portions big but yummy

Absolutely delightful.  High quality food and great atmosphere. Farm to table. Fresh! Reminds me of Italy's Agritorismo where everything served is fresh from the property you are dining. From the loaded artichoke heart appetizer to the nicolosi pork tenderloin, to the Jersey corn gelato, that's right corn gelato... Don't knock it till you try it. Chef Todd, you have out done yourself. Congratulations.

My friends took me here for my Birthday Dinner. We went to the bar to start and luckily for us it was kind oflike happy hour, we had a few cocktails, Jake is an excellent barttender. We moved into the dinnig room,  wher we worked our way thru some appetizers. Try the Lobster Lollypops, DEELicious, Clams and a tuna sushi trio. All were good. Moved on to the main course, I had a Delmonico Steak, which in case you dont know, here its a rib-eye. good size cut, but was a little grizzly. Had alot of side dishes. Overall, food was good, Service was fine, I would go back again FJM
Really good Garlic bread!  I had Chicken Parm and it was very fresh and delicious.  We'll definetely be back!
Good service today.  Don't let the strange name fool you it's pretty good. Craig Alan Lenhart  Arrowbear  CA

There is not anything here that does not make me very happy to be a New Yorker, and in New York, and  alive. It's just casual-smart-perfect, and even though the Patty Melt is a very very southern California invention, the one here is better than the best Tiny Naylor's.  Also I love the people who work there, who exude joy. Going there makes me happy the way Florent used to, the way Odeon still occasionally does.  I'd go here over Per Se any day of the week. Plus the deserts are absurd, in the best way.
Very good sushi.
Everything is right on. The service, the ambiance, and the food. It has a glamorous feel to it, perfect for a date or girls night. Would definitely recommend.
Sesame chicken was overly sweet... General tsous probably was too but I think the spice covered it up.  There was a lot of breading and the chicken was dry, so the food was pretty rough to chew on...
The staff was nothing to speak of but the food was outstanding, we would definitely go again.

Bring cash. I find that the mussels & my shrimp linguine was too salty. Maybe the chef added salt twice. Sadly I won't be back to give this place a 2nd chance. But if I did, I will request for "no salt"
I went here Summer 2013 after it just opened and it literally was the best burger I have ever had.  Juicy, medium rare meat and a delicious bun and the side sauces were all amazing.

The cocktails are delicious and the portions are sizable for the price (I just hope they stay that way). I tried the flat bread, the crab cakes and the salmon with rice, everything was cooked and seasoned perfectly. Make sure to give yourself a little time to really enjoy the atmosphere. Industrial at its most elegant.

Went for drinks and I enjoyed my peach sangria.  My companions enjoyed their cocktails as well. Great outdoor patio space, however none of the tables were cleared outside (dishes were left on them), so we had to clear our own to sit down. The bartender was fine, but not especially helpful.  As other reviewers have mentioned, go for the patio but the service is a major drawback.

We stopped here on a recommendation by the desk clerk at a nearby hotel. We were told that the food is prepared fresh and from local ingredients. We found the atmosphere to be casual and comfortable, but a little dark. I had to use the table candle to read the menu. Our waitress was very pleasant and knowledgable. Our group ordered several different items, including crab cakes, scallops, and the chicken piccata. We found the scallops and the chicken to be very good. The crab cakes, on the other hand were disappointing. Maybe it's because we live close to Baltimore and are used to a real Maryland crab cake but the ratio of filler to crab meat wasn't appealing. Over all, it was a pretty good meal.
The food is amazing. I will definitely be back,
Horrible delivery service. It took 1 hr and 20 mins for them to deliver. Called the restaurant, poor customer service and very rude. Food mediocre. Very disappointed.

This place is awesome! The service is good and the wait time is not bad either. The only thing is its a bit cramped but if u think about it that's a good thing cause that means its popular lol. Food is def on point and I recommend seafood lovers to come at least once.

Two stars too much! Unfortunately everything at this restaurant is horrible. I can't even get a glass of Coke right. Let me Associates is very watering... And underseasoned. The item on my was obviously severely frozen microwaved. Shumai was the doughy gelatinous  mess of an inedible creation. Definitely avoid this place at all cost
Food was okay, though chicken satay was pretty overcooked. Service was pretty bad, waitress couldn't be bothered to explain anything.

On Saturday September 13th partner and I enjoyed a beautiful day at Peaches. Garvey provided excellent customer service and accommodated our needs in a timely manner. The chicken and sausage gumbo was amazing! We have plans to return.

Ofrenda is one of the best Mexican restaurants in the city!!! Great selection of tekila!!! The service is what make my nite!! From mg to busboys !!! Oh. Mg send a complementary shots of tequila at the end of the meal!!!! I can't wait to come back!!!

Ellary's Greens has become one of my favorite restaurants: delicious, affordable, healthy and satisfying. I love the atmosphere, it's scrupulously clean, and everything about it just feels right. I follow a paleo diet but my vegetarian and vegan friends always find something good on the menu as well - with lots of options for their diets as well as mine. My favorite is the crispy roast chicken - always juicy and tender. Though I want to try new things every time I go, it's difficult to skip the Kabocha/Butternut Squash salad with Enoki Mushrooms & Pumpkin Seeds. My experiences have all been excellent here and this owner Leith Hill did something really wonderful: I came into the restaurant on a warm day when the doors and windows were open to let in the afternoon sun. The restaurant felt warmer than usual and I was fanning myself to cool down, not expecting anyone to notice. Leith came to the table, asked me if I was warm and said that she would turn the air on. I didn't even ask! She just offered. That's super nice. I was also, finally, able to tell her how much I love the food. (Thank you, Leith!) I've read complaints about the chairs, (they're not the most comfortable) as well as about the single restroom, but these are minor complaints at a restaurant this good. I send all my friends and they come back raving. Don't forget to try the vegan chocolate mousse. Delicious! (And I'm not even vegan.)

Never had Georigan food before. Was very good. I was drawn in by the dough boat filled with melted cheese, butter and poached egg. It was excellent but better shared with friends than on your own. Grilled eggplant was delicious and pork skewer was juicy. Would happily go back.
good food I tried drunken noodle and the green curry rice both are so good! It is surprise to have such a good Thai restaurant in Bloomfield ;)

Absolutely scrumptious! I went on the recommendation of my sister and it definitely lived up to expectations. Between the three of us we had some mac and cheese, fried chicken, salad and the meatloaf - all of which tasted as good as the next. Service was perfect and we were sitting up at the chefs table so could see two of the chefs preparing a lot of the meals. They were friendly enough to chat with us and answer questions as well as checking on how our meals were. It was so worth the visit and I'll be sure to recommend to my friends who are coming to nyc!
Ok
Fantastic food with friendly service. Loved our dinner and will return when we're in the area.
Great sushi.  Very peaceful eating.  Fresh fish.  Omakase is fantastic.  Very zen like.  Reminds me of Giro.  Overall wonderful experience.

So this was our first time to table 87 and well we absolutely enjoyed ourselves our server Jason was knowledgeable and kind. The food was delicious and timely. The only strange thing was the restroom! Great food great service!
Not impressed. Veggie burger was mostly breading and my fries were burnt. My husband described his huevos rancheros as weird. Would not come back for food. Yuck.

This place is not worth the wait or the money. I just went there tonight and was seated at 6pm and did not have my meal at my table until 8pm. We started out with there eggplant appetizer which to 30 mins to come out and it was soggy and warm at best. Then they proud the soup I ordered and it was full of grease and a few vegetables. Finally my pasta dish came out it had 3 pieces of chicken in it and covered in oil as you can see by the pics I have posted. After all this and sending my dish back it was still covered In oil and had no flavor. To top it off my coffee never got refilled and my water glass was empty more then half the time and I asked 3 times before they filled my water. Just bag

They get one because the empanadas (probably frozen brand) weren't so bad.  Service for a Friday night with 4 tables and a few people at the bar was terrible. Are they nice.. sure they all want tips.  But I'd watch your bill in this place... We had 3 extra drinks on our tab.. due to the "NEW COMPUTER SYSTEM".  Funny enough the waitress serving us had a friend at the bar with what seemed to be on our bill sitting in front of her.  A little shady.. You better know what the happy hour prices and specials are cause they don't.  Wings and beer 7 bucks... we didn't get that.  Look over your bill carefully especially if its crowded in there, and especially if the waitresses are paying extra attention to friends in the corner or at the bar.  Oh yeah, we ordered the "disco fries".. haha one layer of fries barely any cheese.. nothing like the picture.  I don't write bad reviews but this place deserved this one.  We had wings that were cold in the middle. WHAT?! that can get someone sick!.. not going back too many top notch places that also have TV's around.
Awesome pizza - best quality, flavor and prices around.  Quick delivery and friendly service.  Go Prime Time!
Good family spot!

Our dinner order arrived quickly, and the food was still warm. Everything was delicious. As a large group, we were able to sample several dishes. The starters: the Guac is great, so are the chips. Make sure you also order the tasty ceviche-like shrimp dip, which is amazing. As main dishes we had a little bit of everything. The salmon and the sauce it comes with are outstanding. So is the shrimp taco, which I particularly enjoyed. I also loved the Tinga burrito. Really, all dishes tasted great. And all this at an absolutely moderate price. Now I have to try items from the brunch menu... Highly recommend this place.

We just stumbled on this place and I'm glad we did. I ordered the bacon wrapped jalapeño dog and a cup mint lemonade. The food was great but I could of easily stayed and drank the lemonade all night, it was AMAZING. Breakfast looked delicious, with 3 more days in the city we may go back!
Great burgers, great people. Lots of interesting sauces and toppings. Burgers were seasoned well and cooked well. Eat here.
Don't miss the Sicilian slices @ Mr. Bruno's ... Perfect! The dinning area is clean and spacious. The staff very friendly. Glad they are in the Rutherford area.
It's really delicious! If I will go back to NY, I will go there again for their hot pot!

If you're a chili dog fan, Ranch House is a must try. The 'hot chili' is a bit inconsistent as far as heat - but when it's on, it's on! You will sweat, you will cry, and you will marvel at the blend of flavors of the deliciously grilled hot dog, the buttery toasted bun, and that secret recipe chili which - in my view - is the star of the Ranch House. Plenty of other fast food variety on the menu: the 'Ranch Burger' is as good or better than options at 'those other places', breakfast sandwiches are available all day. But those famous chili dogs will keep you coming back for more! The place ain't pretty but for what it is, it's pretty good.
Iconic place but they probably have slipped their standards in recent years. Got served a stone cold omelet for breakfast.
Love Cuban Pete's! It's just kind of a pain to wait to be seated sometimes. Wish they had a dedicated area to wait.

Awesome place for vegan and vedge-friendly food. Pan-fried vegetarian wontons and vegan spare ribs are killer. I'm a meat eater and can say that somehow they manage to get the texture exactly right for the fake seafood and meat.

Huge portions, cheap menu, great service, and happy tummies!! What else could you ask for?!? I ordered the linguini with broccoli and pesto sauce, and I couldn't be happier! It was delicious! My family also raved about the ziti Alfredo, baked ravioli and chicken Parmesan! Oh, and the garlic bread they serve with your entree is mouth watering! Soooo good! After a very pricey couple of traveling days, we sure did appreciate a budget friendly menu that catered to every taste bud in our family!
Loved the tuna dumplings and the Sansom roll! Will be back for more!! :D
Amazing service, food and atmosphere. There isn't a place in Curry Hill where you get more bang for your buck. Will be back very soon.
Love Reading Terminal - suggest everyone try this place!
Food was delicious! I had the chicken grill, and my friend had the braised lamb. We enjoyed the food enough to want to travel from the Bronx to Brooklyn again.
Fabulous new weekend brunch !!!! Try the Steak with Poached eggs or the phenomenal French toast with blue berries ! This place is a must for your weekend brunch !!!!

The #1 spot I go for all-you-can-eat sashimi!! The sea-weed salad and teriyaki squid is SO good... definitely start it off with that. I rarely eat sushi when I'm here because I chow down on sashimi. Don't get me wrong the sushi is slamming too but not a lot of places have all-you-can-eat sashimi so I make my visit worth it. The red bean ice cream is good and I usually end my meal with it mixed with vanilla ice cream.

Not good AT ALL u might as well go to Mighty Quinn's ... I would of put  0 stars but couldn't...  We ordered the short ribs they were VERY dry and chewy (I flossed my teeth and I think I still have meat stuck between them) mac and cheese was like the potato chips "Cheetos" yup dry also, not creamy at all, reminded me of the Kraft mac n cheese in a box, also some cold brisket no flavor, ummm collard greens what a disappointment it needed FLAVOR which was lacking for all of the food... Would I ever come here again ? No... I'm just mad I read all of these reviews praising this place and the food was horrible... Is pricey for no reason and  I thought to myself maybe I went on a bad day but how could have I ? I went on a Tuesday and they're closed on Mondays which means that there food should be fresh out of the smoker... I really feel like a lot of these people got paid to write a good review... (Even when u walk in and see the people eating they're chewing with their mouths open because the meat is so hard and chewy)... Either that or some people are lacking taste buds... Then to make matters worse they microwaved the food before putting the food inside the bag... After I saw that I felt disgusted and didn't even have an appetite to even eat and it explained why everything was dry and chewy... Why did I feel disgusted??? Because then I wondered how long the food had  been sitting there uncovered... And if it was food from over the weekend ughhh...Waste your money elsewhere.

Sit at the sushi bar and go for the omakase. Very reasonably priced and unlike Masa, the chef will actually select pieces based on what you tell him you like/dislike. It's a quiet restaurant and not particularly trendy, but if you're looking for excellent sushi, this is one of your best options.

Looking around for a place that wasn't completely casual, decided to give this a shot. Looking at the pictures of the place online, I was interested in the fact it looked like it was a converted house. I made my reservation online through the website and had no issues being seated (it was filled, but not completely). We were immediately greeted and sat I believe by one of the chefs, possibly the head chef. We were given menus and the wine menu right away. The menu is diverse and unique, you won't find the typical things like chicken parmigiana  or spaghetti and meatballs. They have a static menu to choose from as well as a list of specials. The only gripe I had all night was the initial wait to order once sat. After we were sat and given a wine list, our waiter took almost 15 minutes to come back, while going back to the table directly next to us not once, but TWICE and proceeded to chat up with them at length both times. Never once did he pop over and ask us at least if we wanted to start with a bottle of wine. Once the orders were taken, food was brought out at appropriate points as we ordered an appetizer, soup and salad, entree, and lastly coffee and desserts. Like most good Italian establishments, water and bread were brought out first. Olive oil was provided for dipping, as was a special eggplant mix for topping the bread with. While I'm not a fan of eggplant at all, I actually didn't mind it on top of the bread. For an appetizer, we shared the homemade fresh mozzarella with orange marmalade. While its not something you may have imagined together, it was extremely tasty. It's easily share-able between a couple or family as it comes with four slices of the mozzarella.  Next I had the minestrone soup which was fantastic, the girlfriend had the Caesar which looked decent, if not typical. For dinner I had the Shrimp Fra Diavolo. It was a good sized portion. The sauce was delicious, spicy, but not to the point that made me sweaty or bothered me (I like spicy food). The girlfriend had Veal Saltimbocca which she liked as well. For desert we shared a Sicilian Zeppoli which was delicious. Overall it was a good experience, but I've had better. All the food came out hot and aside from the initial long wait to order a bottle of wine, service was frequent and timely. I would like to come back one day and eat there again.

I discovered this place while searching for something new to try on groupon. They had a 14$ deal. Worth every penny! The crepes were so good and honestly one was enough for me AND my date. The servings do not disappoint.  The place is so clean and the staff is so friendly its hard not to rave about the place. My boyfriend is obsessed with their coconut coffee and i honestly have zero complaints about this location. GO! Just Go!

Overall, everything about Tops was excellent.  My only issue is that lines can be long.  If you decide to go on a Friday or weekend, I would recommend going during the off peak hours to beat the lines, which can be an hour long.   The food was great.  My friend ordered a penne pasta in white wine sauce with chicken and sausage.  The pasta had a flavorful, but not overwhelming sauce which was just right, and the chicken was tender and moist, which contrasts with the often chewy and dry chicken pastas found at most restaurants.  It also came with a loaf of tender bread and a soup of your choice.   I ordered a Cajun burger and requested that it was cooked rare.  Unlike most restaurants, Tops will actually serve a burger rare or medium rare, which was a pleasant surprise for me since most restaurants that I have ordered from only cook burgers to medium.  The burger had a juicy 10oz patty, and the lettuce and tomatoes that came with it were fresh.  The fries were good, but its pretty hard to do fries wrong.   We ordered a platter of nachos for an appetizer, and they were the best nachos that I have ever had.  The cheesecake that we ordered for dessert was excellent, featuring a creamy, airy texture and a cake like bottom.  Even though I expected a thick texture and a graham cracker base, I found that the style served at Tops was different, but still very good.   The pricing and service was also also excellent.  Even on a busy Friday night, our food was delivered quickly.  The nachos arrived within 5 minutes of placing our orders, and the entrees arrived right after we finished the nachos.  While the prices at Tops are slightly higher than what you would normally pay for at another diner, the fact that the portion sizes are generous and that the quality of the food there is superb justifies the higher price.

The food is upscale and very good.  The night we were there the noise level, including the music that kept getting louder and louder was so thunderously loud that I felt like my hearing was damaged.  Maybe all the 20-somethings there don't care, but i like to actually talk to my companions.  Also, the wine list is not only very small, but ignorant of what pairs well with Indian food.  Not a single Reisling or Gewürztraminer on the list.  Bizarre.   The food is better than 3 stars, but the noise level was so unpleasant and somehow at odds aesthetically with "upscale Indian" that I'm down-rating it.  I will never go back there unless management decides it wants customers over 30.
I went here last week for dinner with two if my friends.. The food was so sooo sooo good!!!!
Very very good! Great food, great people, great service!! Did I mention awesome pasta!! People please get the pasta!

My husband and I had a superb meal here. The plata primi of spaghetti with house  made Italian sausage and a light pecorino cream sauce with fresh black pepper was flavorful and melted in our mouths. For the main plate I had the smoked brisket with peaches and radicchio slaw that was very tender and had a wonderful sweet and smokey taste.  My husband had spit roasted pork that was tender , moist and gently seasoned with rosemary.  It was served with oven roasted potatoes and crunchy, crispy roasted pork skin. The homemade pistachio and lemon verbena  gelato was a perfect ending to a fabulous dining experience. Vincent was our waiter and provided great descriptions of the menu items to help us make our choices.  The restaurant decor is comfortably wine- country chic, impeccably clean and staff worked flawlessly as a  team providing us with first class and kind service. We highly recommend Osteria!

We ate here before Tom Petty show.  Service was very good and the water glass never sat waiting for a refill.  We each had a Gem Salad to start.  The salads were delicious with a perfect balance of lettuce, fresh radish, crisp bacon, and hard boiled eggs and the Russian dressing had the right zip.  A warm roll with butter after the salads while we enjoyed lemon-tinis.  Our meals arrived hot from the kitchen.  He had the strip steak with mushrooms and it was accurately cooked to a medium and tender.  I had the rigatoni bolognese and it was luscious with the tender shreds of meat in a rich tomato sauce with heavy dollop of ricotta.  Heavenly!  To finish he went with the carrot cake with pineapple sorbet and walnut strudel.  This is no exaggeration:  I had to chide him to keep him from licking the plate after he had scraped it clean with the spoon.  I had the chocolate cream pie and it was so large a serving I only made a dent in 1/4 of it.  The chocolate was velvety, and the graham cracker crust was crumbled over the top of the chocolate like sprinkles and the whipped cream was delicate and fresh.  The service remained consistent and prompt, we relaxed and enjoyed our meal fully.  We have been to DISH multiple times and have had the same consistent experience each time we've gone which is also lovely.

I'm sure this place doesn't need my review, but what the heck.  Here goes... I was told by several people that I needed to choose between either Pat's or Geno's when visiting Philadelphia.  By sheer chance, I ended up going to Geno's.  After all the hype, I was really expecting an amazing cheese steak sandwich.  In actuality, I thought the sandwich was just alright.  I was good, don't get me wrong; but I was expecting a mindblowingly tasty experience of orgasmic proportions based on everything that was told to me.  The meat was kind of bland and dry and the overall sandwich was kind of flat.  Again, nothing special about it at all. Truth be told, I think I've had a better cheese steak sandwich in Denver of all places.  There's a place off of Broadway that I still remember as being pretty amazing to this day after having visited years ago.  But who knows, maybe I was just exceptionally hungry when I tried that place.

I ordered the sweet Italian pasta it was delicious, my dinner partner ordered the salmon entree that was 22.00. The salmon was served on a bed of spinach. The salmon entree was over priced because the portion was so small and the salmon was below average on taste. I assumed the salmon would have came with some sort of starch like mashed potatoes rice for the cost. 3 stars because the price is too high for mediocre food. Also because you have to pay for you bread in the beginning when 90% of Italian restaurants serve bread as complimentary

Awesome food but such a long wait ! Coffee is awesome and so is brunch !! I like the staff to they are pretty down to earth. If you really can't find a seat try and sit by the bar. U night get lucky and be able to sit quicker that way.

Walk into a cloud of chocolate around 9:40 only to be told without a reservation it would be an hour wait. The hostess told me there maybe a spot at the bar. There wasn't. I looked on open table and wow there were many slots. I booked the 10:00 slot and went up to the hostess who seated us in two minutes.   As they were still turning away customers we had our dessert and was out the door by 10:30.  Dessert was good however customer service could be better.
Its such a beautiful and spacious place! Staff is friendly and try the baklava and the homemade Icetea- delicious! Prices are good too!

I have no idea how this restaurant got so many stars. Small portions, bland sauces. Three pasta dishes, all on the small side. Flavorless, Way overpriced. The bill was close to $100 for three dishes and the $24 bottle of house wine. Rip off. They probably paid three dollars for the bottle. Stay away.

This place is amazing. I only recieved takeout, but the nachos, wings, and tacos we ordered were awesome, and the sog-factor was only very minor. Delivery was less than piping hot, but flavor made up for it. I recommend the fried chicken taco and the nachos especially!
