Great thai fusion food, cozy and eclectic atmosphere,  and remarkable service. I highly recommend the Thai burger and the spicy watermelon slaw. Their ingredients taste fresh and the dishes are sufficiently complex. I loved it!
It is not the best but is pretty decent :)
highly overrated..
love this place, will go back again!
Excellent experience their during St Gennaro feast. A "must go there" pizzeria: pizza was great (the wine too) and staff was nice too.
this pizza is incredible.  what's the secret behind the crust? because it's yummy!

I have dined here twice before and I was happy with my meal. So I jumped at the chance for a groupon deal.  I called on a Saturday 11:30am and made a reservation for 5:30 on Sunday evening. I made sure to Say that I had a groupon and everything was set for Sunday.  My friend and I arrive at the restaurant and they cannot find our reservation but seat us anyway. I tell the hostess that I specifically made a reservation since it was a groupon. she says it's restaurant week so they are not accepting groupons.  But she will check with the manager. Now I feel that's reservation was deleted BECAUSE it was a groupon. The manager tells me they won't accept it and I explain to hime disappointment and that I feel that is bad business practices since I made the reservation like explained in groupon. Very disappointed and we decided to eat somewhere else. I drove 45 minutes away to enjoy this groupon with friends. The manager could have been more accommodating.

Staying locally & decided to try out "the best fried chicken in Brooklyn" it is pretty darn good. It comes in 3 heat temps, I got the med & my mouth was on fire!! Thank goodness they have full bar to put the fire out. The bartender Isabel is great - outstanding service!! Worth the visit!! I'll go back before I leave. Went back a few times and revisited the menu! All sooo good!! Discovered some awesome regulars and the main bartender Edward who runs a tight ship & pours an awesome drink!!!

Travelers could count their blessings if every exit off I-91 had an eatery like the Red Barn.  Just off the interstate, everything is homemade here by the charming family that runs the business.  You can't get a more sophisticated broccoli cheddar soup anywhere.  The perfect lunch spot.
Tasty stuff- I'm enjoying the chicken pad ew right now.
My wife got the Spinach Dosa and I got the Medha Vada for breakfast and both were very good and quite filling (including the dosa ;). Haven't tried anything else.

We tried the beef short rib, pork and Korean fried chicken tacos. Wow! They were all really yummy. I thought they were all equally good but for different reasons so definitely get a mixture to try a variety. We came during a slow lull on a sunny Monday afternoon. Really nice guy behind the counter and no wait for tables!

Artichoke is the best. Their artichoke pizza is amazing and arguably the best I've had in the city. It's unlike anything I've had. I could eat it any time of the day, and it's especially great for those late night pizza cravings since they open til 4 AM. Their slices are huge which justifies the $5 price. Can't recommend it enough! Make sure to bring cash and a big appetite.

I FRIGGIN LOVE BUDDAKAN!! I've been there about 5 times, the most recent time was this past Friday for Restaurant Week. My word they ALWAYS get it right. Firstly, the atmosphere/ambiance is fabulous. It is dimly lit but decorated in a tasteful, zen style centered around a giant, golden Buddah. The food is always fresh and yummy. This was my first time coming during Restaurant Week so I decided to partake in their special menu. I had the Yellowtail Sashimi for an appetizer. Yummy and briny. You can taste the capers, but it's not overwhelming. For the entree I had the Short Rib Chow Fun. I love their normal Sizzling Short Rib dish, so I was really excited about trying this new iteration of their amazing, fork tender short rib. It was unctuous and soothing. Such a comfort food. For dessert I didn't deviate from the script. I got what I always get: Dip Sum Donuts. ERMAGERD! They are the best little pillows of joy on the planet. They come with three dipping sauces: chocolate ganache, ginger cream cheese and blackberry jam. Since I'm not a big fan of chocolate, I always opt for an extra helping of ginger cream cheese in lieu of the ganache. I would honestly come to Buddakan just for those dern donuts, but I highly enjoy my whole meal every time I go. Some of my favorite dishes, other than my obvious love for those Dip Sum Donuts, are: Lamb Chops Sizzling Short Rib Five Spice Duck Breast (the spoonbread pudding that comes with it is heavenly) Peking Duck Buns (YUMMM) It's a great place for a nice night out on a date or a group of people. I definitely recommend getting a pitcher of the Zengria for the table.

My grandfather used to own a business down the street when I was a kid and he used to bring me here often. They have the best frituras ever. Acapurias are so delicious...rediculous! If you like good Puerto Rican cuisine and are in Hartford, I highly recommend a stop in. Relleno de papa, surullos, empanadas, pasteles, and more.
Recommended by Hilton to us, just walked in to a great song playing, favorite beer (Guinness) and bartender who didn't look at us like we just rolled in to town.  Texas approved and will be back.

Great Pork Chop Great Salmon Great Mac n Cheese Great Brussels Sprouts only thing that could have made them better was bacon! Will try a few other things next time Maisie was an excellent server always attentive and super helpful on choices/options

I will go here whenever I visit NYC. Great experience and surprisingly affordable considering the fact that I tried to order everything on the menu. Bring a partner so you can eat most of her food too.
Awesome bánh mì!!!!!! I usually have the grilled pork -- the bánh mì (buns) are always crunchy, the pork is delicious. Best place in the city for sure.
Cheesesteak sandwich was really good, better than the few I tried in Philly... French fries were soft and suggy. Still very much recommended!!!

Went in with a party of 8 for my birthday and thought the decor was really nice and modern; service staff was a little slow but it wasn't bad. The meatloaf was ok, as the texture was perfect but the flavors seemed to be a bit mellow. The gravy was a bit bland but their mashed potatoes and onion rings were fine. I've heard good things about the brussels sprouts so I of course ordered a side of it. For 8 dollars, I felt cheated. Instead of being grilled, or charred, it tasted as though they were boiled. The bland flavor and watery insides overwhelmed the scarce goat cheese and cranberries. In general though, my friends seemed content with their food. The star of the day was their lobster mac and cheese. I I didn't look at the bill, as my friends took care of it, but I later found out my meatloaf was priced as 29 dollars instead of the 19 dollars they put down on the menu. Of course nobody realized until after we paid and left. That definitely left a sour after taste to the night.

The place is dungy looking and they make you walk thru a storefront selling carpets and oil lamps.  The food is stale, most likely leftovers from the night before.  The first time we were here, we LOVED the food. The second time I wish I had stayed home and ate popcorn for dinner.  Very hit or miss, take your chances.

I want to love this place - their food and coffee is excellent, and I prefer to support local businesses. I really love their waffles and also their salads. But their staff is somewhat rude, inattentive, and slow.

Excellent food and service!!! Great for a large group of people.  My daughter and I ate here for the first time last night and servings were sized for meals for 4-6 people. Needless to say we had a ton of left overs to bring home.  Would recommend this restaurant for sure but wish they had a "Dinner for two" menu!
I just ate here and really enjoyed my food.  I had the felafel on a platter with 3 sides.  A bit pricey, but the food was very good.
Stop by for some rice over chicken with a selection of sauces.Sit nearby and watch the world go by.

Food : Food is a fusion of japanese + korean but the korean dishes are byfar more appetizing in my opinion. I ordered a miso soup with a korean soup and the soup was indeed fresh and tasty. I will definitley come back to this place as service was very professional and the interior is beautiful ! Most definitely aesthetically pleasing.

I live up the street from this new location and at first I was delighted to find we have a new Italian specialty sandwich spot in the neighborhood. I've given the place 3 tries and have pretty much been let down each time by both the food and the service. I gave it another shot today and ordered the Godfather. My Godfather hero consisted of regular ham, regular salami, and regular pepperoni. Really?? That can't be right.... I could have gotten this basic meat at Subway. No prosciutto, capicola, mortadella, or sopressata. I don't even think they had these meats on hand which is crazy. The staff/customer service also needs some help if they intend to survive. This location continues to give the John's Deli franchise a bad name and it's sad.

Stopped in here while walking near Central Park and fell in love. This is seriously the most adorable little shop. Small and atmospheric they really know how to make some coffee. Everything here is given great attention to detail and they made the best hot chocolate I have ever had. I had one there and ordered one to go. Everything is made fresh and it all tastes delicious. I also had the tomato, mozarella & basil sandwich and had them toast it for me as well, so good.

Simple....amazing, heavily, delicious.  Went chicken nachos and the flavor on the pulled chicken was well balanced and had a true authentic taste.  Portion too big for one but since when is that a problem.

I was very excited about going to this spot. I ordered lamb ribs and not only it took forever to arrive but the food was barely warm! I couldn't keep my friend waiting so I didn't send it back but it was very disappointing. The taste was ok but the texture of meat was like chewing on rubber. The staff appeared too full of themselves and I felt like I was supposed to drop on my knees and praise god for letting me be at their restaurant. I would've given them half a star if I could.

Epic. Next level flavors, creativity, service. The food is so good. Each dish, with the first bite I was so proud to have ordered it for my lady date. And oh, how I'd missed that broccoli. And marrow.
Very good! My bf from AZ swears this is closest thing to true Mexican he can find. Delivery takes a while, but worth it.

Another awesome find! This place is superb! Food is excellent as well as the service! Place is pretty busy so go with reservations. My husband and I walked in as another restaurant we intended to goto was closed. We ended up eating at the bar but was still awesome! We had the steak tartar, raw bar, tomato bisque soup, brisket and the oh so yummy oxtail bone marrow fried rice! I would like my fingers twice on how good the food was!  They had excellent drink selections! But the bill was definitely very pricey but oh so worth it!  Highly recommend!

Very friendly service great food. Thai Japanese and Chinese food.  Lots of food to chose from and service is fast, I ordered something that wasn't on the menu.and they had no problem making it.  I recommend this place for lunch and take out
Excellent food, excellent service. Everything about our meal was perfect. We will certainly be eating here again.
Love the staff, decor, atmosphere - food is really good, not mind blowing hence the 4 stars but highly recommend all the same.
Very small dishes. Nothing special. We eat 2 breakfast and stayed hungry.. Also expensive

This is a GREAT place to eat.   Their lasagnas are made to order in their own dish. I always get the same thing each time....the four cheese lasagna.  Best Bolognese lasagna too.    The atmosphere is great. We always try for the window table to watch people going by.  Good wine and dessert selection as well.
Excellent red curry with zucchini.  Opted for the added chicken and washed it down with a complimentary Tsing Tao thanks to the check in offer.  Wonderful quick lunch.

Took the wife and kid there for lunch and we loved the food. The Cuban sandwich is awesome and of so tasty and the grilled corn is amazingly delicious. Have one of the Jarritos flavored sodas with your meal for a palatable experience. They also have a take lout section next door.

In Cobble Hill, there are fliers posted 9/14-16 urging neighbors, angry at the music played at the Cafe's 10th anniversary party on Amity Street, to punish the restaurant by writing negative postings on YELP. I'm pretty sure the good people of Cobble Hill are above this kind of behavior.

So, for my first visit to blend on the water i must say I'm not easily impressed... but its kind of hard not to be in this atmosphere! I arrived during brunch which i wasn't expecting but it was cool nonetheless. The hostess sat my family and i down upon arrival, we got a nice window seat, with an amazing view! Our server (felicia) was there to greet us with a bubbly greeting, she informed us of the soup of the day which was a delicious sweet potato creamy soup my mother enjoyed.... for apps we tried the arepas which were a hit; even wanted to order some to-go but ended up too full to even try... the steak and eggs were delicious, i was a little upset they removed the red velvet waffles and switched them for mediocre buttermilk... i didn't even bother to try them. however the steak an eggs were a great substitute. Our server kept the laughs going, which my parents loved... its been a while since we went out and still felt at home.. i would have liked to see a better dessert menu though... & when the bill arrived decently priced, that was just the cherry on top! Million dollar service at blend on the water, id recommend it to everybody! kudos guys! Ill be back!

Believe the hype. This cart is amazing. I once got there and the line was all the way to the c town. I wondered whether or not it was worth the wait. People got in line behind me so I decided it was and was not disappointed. They give you a piece of falafel while you wait and their energy and good cheer is contagious. The food is to die for..any of it, all of it. I keep going back to try more and i cant get enough!

My husband and I decided to celebrate our 8th anniversary at Room 55. We read several positive reviews on Yelp and thought it seemed like a good choice. We definitely made the right decision. The wait staff was extremely attentive and pleasant. The food and drinks were spectacular! I ordered the clams for an appetizer, which was amazing, and the white sangria to start with. The sangria was delicious! I ended up switching to the blueberry spiked lemonade after my first drink and I couldn't believe how good it was. I don't even really like blueberries which is why I ordered the sangria but the waitress brought us a small sample of the lemonade and I was sold. My husband and I both ordered the steak for our entree. Neither one of us could believe how great it tasted. It practically melted in my mouth, it was so tender. The potatoes were seasoned so well, and the vegetables were perfect. For dessert, we did the trio special which is 3 mini versions of anything on the dessert menu. We chose the flourless chocolate cake, poached pears and NY cheese shake which is a cheesecake flavored milkshake. All three were fantastic! The head chef Vinny came over and wished us a happy anniversary and also gave us the desserts on the house. The experience really could not have been any better. I can't wait to go back with friends.
Crappy service. Poor, unprofessional management. Mediocre food.

Visited Amelie on an early Friday night, the bar is crowded already. Since it's a busy night, the services seems slow, not good for quick bite. I ordered food like escargots, foie gras, mussels, salmon, and pork tenderloin. My disappointment will be the mussels were not fresh, and salmon was under cook. I guess I shouldn't order seafood. The place is small and tables are very very packed. Music is loud, but the happy hour wine flight of 3 wines for $12 and rotating $6 appetizers are great value. I recommend to get a happy hour drink here and eat somewhere else.

This place was fantastic! We just went for dinner for our anniversary. The hostess and waitresses were attentive and very nice, and took the time to explain the menu. I had the fried chicken, which was amazing. My husband had the chicken liver pate and the mussels and said both were delicious as well. We also tried the switchel cocktails on recommendation of our waitress. It was fun to try something new, and it was right up my alley. Overall a great experience and a great meal.

Antinori was simply excellent from the moment I walked through the door.  Impressive service, wonderful ambience and simply terrific cuisine!  It was a warm evening in the city, and I enjoyed a cute table on the terrace.  I stay at the DoubleTree whenever I come to NYC on business, and  Antinori never disappoints.  So glad they are there to offer an excellent dining experience and a respite from a busy day.  I will be back!

I really don't like to give low reviews since I know how hard restaurants try with their ideas and food. We came here on a busy night. The fries were pretty good in texture and size but there was a really bad bittery aftertaste - this usually means dirty oil. Maybe they fried a lot of fries by the time we came so the oil was bitter by that point. I ordered the poutine. The gravy tasted like nothing. The cheese curds were pretty decent though. Maybe my expectations were too high? I don't know, I usually love fries from anywhere almost. I will give them another shot though, hopefully their won't have that same bittery aftertaste and I will definitely not order the poutine. I will probably try the Parmesan peppercorn dip, sounds good.

Decided to check this place out because of the great reviews it got on yelp. I ordered the smart duck sandwich since that seems like the most popular option and I honestly didn't really like it. I found the bread too hard and difficult to eat, and the ingredients themselves pretty bland. It might just be my personal taste, but I won't be ordering from here again.
Absolutely love their veggie burger titled "the best veggie burger ever" definitely lives up to its name. Made from all vegetables so none of that filler crap. And tastes delicious.

I feel like the review for this place can be very biased. If you had top of the line sushi then i understand this place isn't the best but i come here more for the atmosphere..its trendy and very modern and more targeted towards the younger crowed. You can't go wrong with the special plate deals they have . the liquor here isn't too shabby.

As a Greek person, I found the good here to be incredibly disappointing and inauthentic, and what made it worse were the absurd prices for dishes that seemed tasteless. I was so excited to get the food of my country but left with my tail between my legs. My non-Greek date even thought the food was less than average. That's saying something.

Love love love the food. I usually get shrimp shumai and salmon rolls. I love that they have so many options of food other than sushi since my husband isn't a fan. Also love you get a free item when using GrubHub when you spend a certain amount. Great food at a good price but the delivery guy always annoys me. Either they ring my bell like crazy people, knock on my door like the are the police, question if I paid online and call to check then just drive away without saying a word. Would have given 5 stars if it wasn't for the weird delivery people. (I must note that only on my last delivery did I get a nice delivery guy!)

Went here with a friend last month. It was a quiet night so not too crowded. The waiter was helpful and guided us through their menu. We opted to buy a number of things and share. Each dish was unique and well presented. Decent wine and beer selection as well. I would definitely come back here on a date. They have a few specialty meats as well that I didn't try but would love to.

We weren't sure what to expect from a restaurant in a store. We had one of the best meals we have eaten (compared on a global basis.) The vegetables were out of this world. Luckily we were there at the crossover between the peas many ways and the squash many ways, so we got to have both. Can hardly wait until next year when the peas come back. The staff was very informative and made sure that we lacked for nothing, including a little time after the meal to chat over coffee. Highly recommend this restaurant.

I created this Yelp account so I could write this. I came here on a first date and started out at the roofbar. It was perfect. We were enjoying the view and cocktails (they actually make more than margaritas and a rum & coke up there) that we had a few appetizers there. My date is a vegetarian and was happily able to order enough for a meal, not just side items. We had the cucumber and crispy chickpeas, bacon wrapped matzo balls (well I had them, and they were one of the best things I've eaten this summer), and the broccoli--it made a broccoli believer out of me for sure. The rest of dinner downstairs continued to impress--there is a more extensive cocktail menu in the main dining room and bar. We decided to eat at one of the bar tables.  I had their Negroni. The bartender explained that is was a "summer variation" and was a welcomed change to my usual Negroni, light and very refreshing. My date drank the cider on tap, which was described as crisp and light. She had the corn, shishito peppers with roasted eggplant, and carrot with almond cake. I ordered the poutine and then the sweetbreads with Cool Ranch hummus. Wow, definitely best sweetbreads I've ever had and describe anything as "Cool Ranch" and I'm in! I would go back just for a few cocktails and the sweetbreads. All in all a great night. Definitely worth the venture into Brooklyn!
I've been to The Gorbals in LA and in Brooklyn and I have to say, its amazing! Good food, good people, great times! I highly recommend this spot to  anybody.
Great food great staff great prices.....perfect for an impromptu dinner I love this restaurant
never had a bad meal at Forgione. Fabulous menu, great wait staff and beautiful location.  Not to be missed

I had a lovely time here with the BF. We sat outside, which featured nice tables and comfortable chairs. It was also a lot quieter than the inside seating area. I had the Pizzo Doro (sausage, pepperoni, and fresh mozzarella). The ingredients tasted very fresh --the pie was delicious! The BF had the Ruchetta E Proscutto (a white pizza with prosciutto, arugula, parmigiano, and balsamic dressing). He offered me a taste, and I have to say, I was a little skeptical as I've never had a white pizza that I thoroughly enjoyed. But oh man.. -Osteria Procaccini just took white pizza to a whole 'notha level! It was absolutely incredible! The flavors were so different and complex. And as a whole, the ingredients worked so well together. The pie was really a piece of art! The service was good too.  All that and at a good price, we will be back again! Of note, try to get a hold of solid directions to this place beforehand (don't just memorize/write down the address) if you are unfamiliar with the area. The house/business address numbers change abruptly at various points along Rt 27 consistent with the township boundaries. And as such, if you pass this restaurant accidentally (like we did!) and head down the road, the even numbers will be on the other side of the street as well as ascending in value. Somewhat confusing! (Btw, the restaurant is one building past a streetlight (if you are traveling northbound).) But it won't happen again, as we will be back soon!

Went for Sunday brunch. The food was great. Best French toast. Staff was genuinely nice and attentive. Very busy but had I had reservations I had made a week in advance. We were seated right away as soon as our entire group arrived.

I did not have a good experience eating at this restaurant even though the food is tasty. The service was so slow that it ruined the dinner for me. Our three course dinner from a fixed menu (limited options!) was dragged out for 2.5 hours. Sometimes this can be a wonderful thing when you and a romantic partner are lingering over wine and moonlight, but that was hardly the case on the particular Wednesday night when I ate at Zahav. My party of five consumed our food quickly once it arrived and then wondered, "Where IS that next course?" Note to Zahav: Not everyone with a 5:45 reservation expects to get their entrée at 7:30pm. If that's your MO, a little more bread and hummus would have been nice.
Great food and wonderful service. The waitress recommend a great beer that just came in that day! She was on top of her game!
GREAT FOOD!! Loved the service - friendly - nice - clean - first time trying Thai ice tea -in love -
Great ambiance, amazing food, and stellar service!!!

Great food but very slow with service and wish you didn't have to get BOTH FF and rice with certain dishes during lunch.  If you want a salad, it will cost more. Too many carbs.  We still like to go, that is how good the food is and it's inexpensive but there is only usually 1 waitress.   My advice is to go but expect to wait a bit.
Excellent fresh food, not your chain type restaurant.  The scones are absolutely to die for delicious!
Decent drinks. But: Too loud, Too crowded and Too hands-off. For my taste at least ...
great place to eat. the cheese steak is good. and the customer sevice is good for a busy place like that.
In one word, Fresh. The food and bar drinks were very clean and fresh tasting. Love the atmosphere. Fun place to go for date night! Only upset was the small portions. Otherwise, definitely returning.

OMG this place !! Now this place is a MUST try! We had so much here and it was EXCELLENT ! The white Sangria is on point ! Very crisp and refreshing ! I had the Herbed Eggs Scrambled with parsley & cilantro and scallions along with a side of French toast. The plate was incredible ! Served with fresh hummus and also a cucumber salad that was amazing ! The dressing on the cucumber salad alone was one of the best I've had ! I wish I had ordered some Mediterranean Dough to go because this I have never experienced ! My two friends got this dish, Mediterranean Crispy Dough with two eggs. It was soo yummy !! My fiancé got the grilled chicken sandwich which was really good too but I am more of a breakfast person. I highly recommend trying this place out ! Cute café style and wasn't that busy when we went late in the afternoon but from what I hear, this place packs up on the weekends ! And I understand why too ! It was simply one of the best breakfast meals I have had. The French toast simply melts in your mouth from its buttery taste ! I am craving this dish again and hope to be back soon to try some other items on their menu ! Thank you for the experience !

Wow, this place is terrible. Overpriced, the food was awful and they put rabbit litter all over the floor so its really slippery (seriously, rabbit litter!) For the food, I got the chicken curry, totally flavorless and a tiny portion. The rice it was served with was cold and undercooked. We also got the steak sliders. These were better but still a tiny portion - not worth 15$ at all. Even the drinks were mediocre and overpriced. Will not be coming back.

We had a lovely experience at Delaware and Hudson.  Dinner is a pre-fixe menu, which liberated us from our usual negotiation of what and how much to order.  We selected the Chatham Cod and the Vegetable Fritters as entrees, and could not decide which we preferred.  Both offer great flavors, and reflect the season.  The array of other dishes served were a true delight, and highlight the skill and creativity of Chef Jackson.    The compact wine list offers good variety and value.  Atmosphere is welcoming as is the service.  Stacey H. was gracious and knowledgeable and we never felt rushed.  The presence of Chef Jackson throughout the evening made us feel like guests in her home.  Definitely worth regular visits, as the menu selections will evolve with the seasons.

Amazing food and an even better experience. Staff is super friendly and welcoming, they make you feel like a special guest in their home. Where to begin with the food... I had a nice selection of oysters to start then The fish ribs, yes fish ribs are like nothing I have had before. The Moqueca (fishermans stew) with coconut rice explodes with flavor each and every bite. The cocktails are out of this world- can you say bacon infused bourbon!  Overall an exceptional experience, can't wait to go back.
Best burger in NYC. The best burger there costs 9.75 before taxes and the meat is the best ever.

The best Creamees in Burlington, hands down!  Very thick and excellent flavor.  Friendly service too. Vermont Maple Creamee is highly recommended! So delicious!!!! Next time I am getting sprinkles on my creemee.
The wings are okay I prefer Applebee's wings! The clams are my favorite from there during happy hour! From 4 to 7
Great grilled cheese! So many amazing options. And they have lagunitas on tap!!  I shall return.

Really good authentic food. If you want a great experience of the Asian culture, you will be captivated by the decor and the staff is awesome. They will stay open even after closing hours to accommodate diners. Thanks for the referral Emzee .
This place is fantastic!  Food is great em zee took us here and we had a great dinner
Outrageous tacos!

Completely rude staff and owner. If they make a mistake or you tell them a complaint -- they are completely unapologetic, yell at their customers, call names and make sarcastic remarks. I have witnessed this numerous times and today it actually happened to me. I will never go to this restaurant again.
I've only ordered pizza here. The sausage pizza is very good, but I didn't like any of the other slices that I ordered. I've been here about five times. The buffalo chicken pizza wasn't good at all.
Best margaritas and authentic Mexican in NYC! Orlando is the best bartender I have ever come across and treats you like family.  The margaritas are to die for people.
Ordered pad Thai to go and it was very poor.  Dry, barely spicey, with rubbery mushrooms.
My friend and stopped in this place on a whim! It was great the food was excellent and the waiter was extremely attentive!

I'm really puzzled by all of the rave reviews.  Have people actually forgotten what real soul food is supposed to taste like?  I ordered the fried chicken with mac and cheese and potato salad.  My friend had the honey chicken and collards cooked with turkey :-( The potato salad was good and the fried chicken was acceptable but the mac and cheese was just about inedible.  I can't remember another time when I have actually sent a bowl of mac and cheese to the trash.  What a shame. We ordered sweet potato pie for dessert and I was surprised to see that instead of a slice, they presented a full mini pie.  Made me suspect that the pie was not made in-house (though I have no proof of this).  I'm also not accustomed to having my sweet potato pie served piping hot.  Go figure. On the positive side, the staff seemed friendly and did not rush you out of the door. Oh yeah - I almost forgot.....pass on the cornbread.  It's not worth the calories.

I went to Wafa's based on all the top notch reviews but was disappointed. The service is good, however, the food is mediocre at best.   The hummus I buy in the grocery store tastes better than the one they serve in this restaurant.  The baba ghanouj was OK, but the barley based appetizer was not good.   Most importantly the lamb they use for the shish kebab is poor quality - the meat is tough and some pieces were inedible.  Furthermore a good shish kebab should have other vegetables besides a little onion on it. All in all I would say I am still looking for a restaurant where I can get good middle eastern food.

The atmosphere is bright and airy. The staff is friendly. The music is laid back Reggae. The food is delicious! This restaurant caters to Vegan and non-vegan diets. Finally... A restaurant I can go to with my friends that knows how to feed us all and well! Bravo!

Great great great food! Everything is freshly made including the pita bread. Take note, aside from the pita bread being fresh from the oven, it is also gluten free! All the staff are very hospitable and friendly including the owners. They know how to treat their customers right!  The ambience of the place is very warm, relaxing and entertaining with their display of antique and vintage collectible items. You're not only going to enjoy the food but will enjoy the place too. It's as if eating great food in an art museum. Where else can you have that? A real found treasure in the city of montclair. I highly recommend this to everybody!!!! Dont even hesitate of choosing this place if you are looking for a good place to eat in.

Been here twice so far... First time for lunch buffet and it was great. My favorite so far.. Everything was fresh and delicious... My second time I went for dinner and I had my favorite lamb chop and chicken kebab. Delicious.their garlic naan is out of this world.bbq and curries good too.wide verity of food.Overall, great restaurant with great food that is worth visiting.
Excellent food and atmosphere. My girlfriend and I are both new to Indian food, but the staff was friendly and helpful. We had a great experience and will be back.

I'm a pilot and fly into and out of Newark fairly regularly. I live close by in Livingston.  My copilot on one of my assignments told me about this restaurant that has the most incredible karaoke as well as great food, even though it's known as a pizzeria; it's close the airport in W. Orange called Starlite.  I came for a quick dinner but wound up staying 'till midnight with the KJ. I've done karaoke in all 4 corners of the world but have never seen anything like this; speakers and tvs all over the place and a little stage also. The guy said there were 40,000 songs to choose from.  I had a great time. The dinner was a special too; I had this delicious prep of swordfish with saffron rice and perfect vegetables.  It was so pretty I took a picture even though I'm an amateur photographer; it came out great.  Anyway, go! - Dine and sing!
The best american pancakes I have ever tried! So fluffy and crispy. This is a must place to visit! I went there two days in row.

The food is exceptional ... the prices not so much! I had one of the "specials" which was a very small bowl of white beans and 2 thin slices of a sausage in a very good sauce. $13 was I thought about double what it should have been. My wife had a caprese salad again far overpriced at $15. The place is small, the service good, the food great but how they get away with the pricing is a bit of a mystery to me!

Hartford is a tough place to try and manage a decent restaurant without getting uber expensive and pompous, I get that.  However, this place has some issues.  First off, the beers kind of aren't that great.  I'm a huge opponent to the whole "craft beer" movement but these beers are far from crafty.  A well crafted beer takes decades of fine tuning to perfect a full bodied, pleasant and comforting beer.  All the beers served are just some concoction of hops and barley loaded with who knows what that churns my stomach.  I get it, it's hip, it's cool, it's what the people want, but it's not what everyone wants.  Would it kill you to have some reputable, well established bottles?  Couple that white throne wizard potion they formulate with flimsy fries and saturated fats, let's just say it's not pleasant. While writing this I'm reading some of the other low rating reviewes and I have to say not getting extra napkins and a lemon in your water really makes you a sackless member of society.  If you want extra napkins and a lemon go home and ask your mom for some.  Find something with substance to judge. Back to my review, I've been in there a few times, I don't know why I keep going back.  Probably because I keep getting dragged there.  I've seen the ceiling leaking, not sure why.  The establishment is getting worn down, and I think it's just too big for the staff and management to handle.  The whole "it's got a little of everything," bar-restaurant-pool hall, I just don't see how that's a successful business model anymore. Food-mediocre.  Maybe I'm just getting old, but if you want to succeed, you have to maintain a solid menu with quality ingredients.   FYI, I drink Coors Light, it's really all I'm asking for.

LOVE this place.  Been here twice, and can't wait to go back.  Everything is sooo fresh!  In my twenty nine years of living, never have I tasted such amazing pancakes.  The guacamole is bursting with explicit flavor, and  the luxurious truffle eggs are a must.  Skip on the Bloody Mary- way too heavy and not the typical bloody mary recipe you're most likely accustomed to.  Opt for a Mimosa instead, well worth the value.   The portions are generous, the owner is pleasant and engaging, and of course - do get the French press.  I recommend the large press since the small only accounts for two cups. -Do make reservations, even for brunch, as the place is a big hit in Park Slope.

We were recently on a trip to Hartford and went to the Mill on the River for our second time.  We tried it a year ago and it was good, but it didn't make any special impression.  This time was exceptional - all the way around.  Truly exceptional!  And an overall wonderful dining experience.   To get to The Mill on the River is a bit of a drive, if you're staying in Hartford, or near the airport... but it's definitely worth it.  When we arrived, it was a beautiful September evening. The sound of the river rushing as you cross over the bridge is soothing and anticipating.  Once we entered, the hostess was smiling and inviting.  She seated us right away.  Our waiter was the best.  He introduced himself as "Arlo, as in Guthrie."  The comparison seemed off the mark, but what the hell, he was funny.  We asked for his opinion as to what was good and he said "you're at The Mill on the River; everything's good."  Was he right!  Everything we had was wonderful.  And everyone around us was in a similar state of dining ecstasy. Their specialty seems to be german-inspired basics and seafood.  We started by "splitting" a caesar salad.  Arlo brought what seemed to be full-sized salad for each of us.  We're from California so never expect much of a "fresh" salad on the east coast, but the Mill's Caesar was excellent and perfectly prepared. Next, my wife had the Pan Seared Chilean Sea Bass - on Arlo's recommendation.  She's finicky about her seafood and she's super health conscious.  She doesn't want greasy or fried.  She grilled Arlo a bit on whether the searing would seem fried at all or greasy.  He assured her that it would be perfect.  He was right.  She loved it, and she thoroughly enjoyed Arlo.  I had the Signature Fra Diavolo. OMG!  It was the best.  I thought I was in the Northend of Boston... it was that good! Be assured, you'll enjoy The Mill on the River.  Ask for Arlo (probably everybody does). He's a classic.  We usually tip 15 to 20%, but for Arlo, we made it 25%.   To the management at the Mill:  you have a good one in Arlo!  He is the best.  Thanks for a delightful experience.
Excellent service. Owner it's very customer oriented. Food it's great and they have good ambience. The perfect place to start a night out.

We're regulars there.. The atmosphere, the staff, the food .. all create a feel of being in southern Italy. The standard Italian dishes are amongst the best I've had (and lived in Italy for 5 years!)..The portions are large, the prices reasonable.  How can one not love that combination. And, too add one more star, all sorts of wine by the glass - we're red drinks and can get Chianti, Malbec,  Syrah, Montepluciano, Pinot Noir..excellent for a local restaurant!

I really liked this place. The restaurant was clean and smelled amazing, the food was ridiculous (fresh, authentic Italian) and the server that helped us was very attentive. The only thing that sucks is parking. It took us forever to find a spot....but it is Center City, so maybe I shouldn't be whining so much about this. Will be coming back the next time I am in Philly.....
I ll make it really simple......This place is AMAZING!!!!!!  I would have posted pictures of the actual meal, couldn't stop eating long enough to take pictures. =0)

It was suggested by a friend and I loved this place so much. i would definitely gonna try this place  out again and again. My first experience was quite good enough to decide about the place. I liked the food and the service is quite great to visit this place again. The atmosphere is awesome with the quite relaxing and calm surroundings will definitely make you fan of this place. I would definitely try this place out again. I had chicken taco which was awesome. The service is worth to experience, you should also have to go to experience this place. You will love this place.

As a Chef I have & will eat just about anything but one could also argue that Im a picky eater. Im a "Flexetarian on and off vegan/vegetarian that will still eat meat depending on the circumstances. I've been meaning to try Mundo Vegan out and finally pulled my self off the line to place a pick-up order. I had the hummus,cheese platter,lasagna, bean stew,apple crisp and Ice-cream(to share with my sous chef). The vegan Ice cream is still on my mind and why Im writing this review worth the tip by it self. Im super excited that to have another vegan option  available in the area you get tire of eating off your own menu all the time.Looking forward to going back and actually sitting down for my meal.
Excellent restaurant week experience. Love the music and atmosphere!! oh and the FOOD

Daisiwa is poor man's sushi restaurant. That about sums it up. My partner and I used to frequent this place until we started seeing frozen tuna and salmon boxes in their trash. I read Carolyn's review about the owners driving to NYC to ensure freshness. This is a bold face lie. The miserable owner is unfortunately there EVERYDAY. He is often rude and is always smoking outside. If you're looking for sushi, go to Umai Umai. The price point is a bit higher but you're not going to be flirting with getting a food borne illness.

This place is truly a great find. The fried fish sandwich is incredible for brunch. They also have pancakes and other more traditional brunch items. What makes this place special is the decor. Truly picturesque and one of the more beautiful restaurants in Brooklyn
Had a wonderful dinner at La Sirene. The food was wonderful, the service fantastic and overall we had a great time. It was delicious!

Do yourself a favor and visit Marigold Kitchen in Philly for a wonderful dining experience.  The ambiance is cozy,  wait staff very friendly and professional, and the general manager makes sure you are comfortable and happy.  Every plate (14 small courses) was beautiful to look at and more importantly delicious; and by the end of the experience, very filling satisfying.  This is unlike most restaurants that you will visit.  It's very special and you won't regret it!
Meh. Soup dumplings were alright. A bit more fatty tasting than usual. (Which is what made it worse imo) The dumplings you can get in vancouver canada are definitely better.

The doughnuts were great. Samoa? Delicious! The food was good too! You can't beat the prices either. But the service? Awful. I would hardly call it service. Our waitress took our order (had to repeat a few things) and we never saw her again. My boyfriend even had to go up to the counter to get his drink refilled. This place would be a really great spot, they just have to get people in there that know how to wait tables.
Bland pulled pork and okay fish n' chips leaves you wanting something better.  I think the burgers are good from the other patrons' reactions, but our experience left a lot to be desired.
Great food! Very flavorful dishes. Only been there once but will go back.

This place started out great. Would come here as much as possible. My boyfriend and I would always order the roast chk dinner for delivery. They have gone downhill lately and it's a shame. The chk has gotten worse every time I have ordered it over the last few months until I just stopped. Tastes like they just throw it together and don't take the time to season or fully cook, anymore. There are a couple of new people working the front with bad, combative attitudes (young hipstery dude is the worst) and I have found that I just avoid the place all together. I wish this place would go back to the way it started. It was a breath of fresh air. And the food and service was top notch.
This place is a great neighborhood spot. The food is always so good and the staff are great - a phenomenal place!
This place is has good pizza love it. They clean and have good costumer service. I love there chicken cutlet.
awesome ramen
Great value. We got 2 meze and 1 entree for 2people, made us full enough for $30 total. Even adding desert (+$6) was great idea.
My friend and I always come here when we need a good meal knowing anything will be delicious. The waitstaff is always great and I've had most of what's on the menu and everything is amazing!

Yes, great charming place with a cool local vibe. But not a breakfast/brunch place. Menu was pretty much limited to eggs (hilarious how they had separate entries for sunny side up, scrambled, soft scramble, hard scramble, etc). They did have pancake, egg, bacon, fried chicken sandwich. Egg looked it was the scraps from the grill and fried chicken were a few thin strips of chicken tenders. Bacon tasted old. But I'd come back for the beer and would try the pub fare.
Staff was very awesome and food was great! We are from Texas and the food tastes excellent!

This place is horribly ran. It took 15 minutes for them to acknowledge us, another twenty minutes for them to admit they forgot our order and another 20 to get it to us. They told me the computer wasn't working and that when it would they'd bring my change. Once they did they returned my change short and said the price was different. Then I realized it was because they gave me the wrong thing and would refuse to rectify it. Long story short. RUN in the other direction.
fill ur belly with the amazing chicken n lamb over rice combo... then hit the gym the next day!

This place can be 3 stars or 5 stars depending on a few things. #1 - It depends who makes your sandwich. The owner makes it with 1/3 less meat than the others. #2 - Depends on the line of customers. If you are 10th you will have a good long wait. The staff likes to kabits, sometimes too much. #3 - Get there early or your bread selection will be limited. #4 - There seems to be no set price on any sandwich. You can go there one day and it's $9.50 and the next day $11? I'm also not a big fan of the bread being handled by the customers. All that being said the do make a fine sandwich.

I've known the owner of this business for years and I am writing this review not to just give a 5 star review but because the food is actually delicious, Nir knows how to decorate a dish and make it look like a masterpiece, his style of cooking originates from the Middle East and as a native I can swear that his cooking is as close as you can get to an authentic main course meal. Yes I must admit the service and wait staff can use a little work, but considering how busy they get it's understandable why the service is a little slow. My suggestion is to come in during the slower times to enjoy a quiet and delicious meal.

One of the best, if not The Best pizza places in Vermont. Their focus on local and fresh products is in line with the way of life in Vermont. The local cheeses they use on their pizzas are amazing including maple cheddar, goat cheese, caraway-cumin gouda and local mozzarella.

Very disappointed. I spent over $100 for breakfast this morning. Besides the waiter being too preoccupied with hugging the other staff and flirting with the customers at the bar, 2 dishes of eggs were sour, the granola was salty, poached eggs were so full of vinegar they could have passed for pickled And the ketchup tasted like chemicals.   The French toast was soggy and undercooked and the bacon was burnt,black. I am a repeat customer, bringing in 3 New potentials and they were all unsatisfied. I couldn't find enough words to apologize to my friends. Not coming back.

Searched on Yelp for somewhere low-key within walking distance from our hotel & MP had the fewest bad reviews. So we decided to eat there. Sunday night around 7:30 & there was only 1 other table of 4. Bartender/server was very polite & we got our drinks quickly. White sangria packed a punch & while they were out of the IPA my SO wanted the suggested substitue seemed to do the job. Appy of the bruchetta - 6 pieces, 2 of each, with good quantity of toppings. The mushroom was our favorite, the carmelized onion good but the cream cheese was somewhat overpowering. We ordered the steak sandwich & clubhouse to share. Fries were average. Sandwiches were tasty, the steak could have used something to give it some punch like a horseradish mayo. Both had good amounts of fillings & ingredients tasted fresh. SO wanted dessert so he chose the Tollhouse pie. Sort of more like a pecan pie but with walnuts. Ihad a bite, seemed ok, but not my thing. I was eyeing the brownie with the cheesecake filling - the other table had that & it looked good. Overall, MP did the job & wasn't disappointing. Looking forward to some stellar meals however as our week in NY gets fully underway tomorrow.
Manager was extra helpful and friendly. Food was delicious. Place was nice and clean.

The meal I had here was outstanding! I came here with my family for dinner and there wasn't a thing we ate that was less than amazing. We started dinner off with the fried calamari with ginger and cinnamon dipping sauce. I must say I had reservations about the sauce but boy was I wrong - even my father who is super picky loved it! I shared the butternut squash and crab meat risotto which was very rich and creamy. It was delicious to say the least - I recommend it to everyone! I also had the veal Milanese which was tender and the salad was the perfect pairing. Other members of my party got the linguini with seafood and lemon shrimp. I tried everything since I couldn't resist. Absolutely phenomenal. Can't wait to go again and it's byob!!

It's all about the soup dumplings!!! The key is to work down from the top instead of from the sides. Their spicy shrimp was really good as well. Crispy, tangy and delicious. Ugh but my friend had to sit next to the trashcan and she was too sweet to ask to be moved or let me switch spots with her but that was definitely a turn off. Sorry Rach.

A great breakfast sandwich to go is so hard to find in Montclair. I'm a native New Yorker and miss the ability to grab a sausage, egg, and cheese from places that don't expect you to stay.  I have had several menu items from Mac Attack so I was already a fan. Then I found out they do breakfast 7 days/week.  Finally satisfied my desire to try one this morning. Loved it!  They can work a little faster but this isn't NYC after all so I'm spoiled. But the sandwich was delicious!  Hit the spot and let me do what I do best, move on to the next thing.  A great breakfast sandwich to go has finally arrived in Montclair.
I eat here once a week. I dont need to say much more
Incredibly delicious burgers and great beer. Went for a quick dinner with my friend Geoff and it was a great success.

The oysters were amazing!! Asked them to pick for me and it turned out to be that I actually asked the owner!! He recommended some yummy goodness. Ordered a dozen and then ordered 6 more, they threw in a wild oyster the size of a hand! Delish! The cherry on top --- a free slice of whiskey cake!!!!!!!!   Happy girl! This place is awesome, very laid back and relaxing. Go glad I yelped this place!

I've had better cheese steaks. The beef is not seasoned so it lacks flavor. Even a little salt and pepper would liven it up. The restaurant is a dive situated for quick in and out service. Picnic tables are available for dining in curb side. The atmosphere is family owned and operated. With so many other cheese steak joints, it will be a while before I try this one again.

It was my first time trying Bolivian Llama Party in Brooklyn. Pulled pork chola sandwich was amazing!!!! These guys definitely know what their doing. Also try the Maracuya-lemonade soda.. Delicious and refreshing!

I love this place because it's very reasonably priced considering the amount of food served! If you have time to wait an hour or two for a seat, then I suggest you do so because it's worth the wait. I just don't have the time.

A new amazing ,healthy,reasonably priced restaurant. The atmosphere is calming, it's beautiful and tastefully decorated. The staff are sweet as pie. On to the food... Seasoned with love, just enough and the Caribbean influence on the food items make these healthy dishes quite tasty! The stuffed avocado paired with a paradise smoothie is an amazing combo. The hummus is to die for. All around the food is absolutely amazing! A perfect place for vegans and non vegans alike.

Great experience every time I go. I am a teacher in the neighborhood and Gaia is always welcoming and has fresh specials every day. The panini sandwiches are spectacular! I rate it the best deal in the LES area.
Very nice setting and very good italian food. I ordered a veal dish but I think the move would have been risotto or pasta.

Based on the many reviews here, I traveled to 79th street from Flushing to try this place.  It's in the space long occupied by Arunee Thai.   Yes, the remodel is modern and attractive, with comfortable faux barcelona chairs, and lots of mirrors. Our waitress, I believe an owner or manager, was pleasantly attentive and ultimately apologetic.  And yes, it is inexpensive for lunch at $8.50. The cook who earned all the five star reviews was either having a bad day or had just left town.    It was one of the most disappointing Thai meals I've ever had. Why so bad? The curry puff was not yet defrosted; I sent it back and it was replaced with an identical, but colder version. When eventually warm, it was tasty. The next dish, essentially Singapore Mai Fun, had the wrong meat in it; not a big deal, but it was oddly insipid, as if several ingredients were missing. The Pad See Yew, a favorite standard, had a nasty, off after taste which was traceable to the mistreated shrimp; and it too was otherwise flavorless and boring.  Pad Ka Prow with ground chicken was edible, but was far too sweet, as was the Pad Thai, which was drowned in sugar and tamarind syrup.  I ordered dishes that are hard to screw up, but they were. I suspect the cook was hired from a Chinese fast food place ...although I heard the owner speaking in the kitchen in Thai. I'm very reluctant to send dishes back, but had to do so here three times.  Thai food can and should be delicious, even if not spicy or "authentic."

Been here several times and the coffee is consistently terrible and burnt tasting.  Stumptown really needs to discipline these guys.  Otherwise, free WiFi and good seating in the wasteland of midtown are tisserie's only redeeming qualities, which add +1 star to what is 1-star coffee.

This place was a yelp suggestion and boy was it a great one!!!  First of all, the place is RIGHT around the corner from my house and secondly the food is amazing!!! I got the chicken and waffles and although it was a fried split chicken breast and not the traditional southern fried wings didn't make any difference at all. The chicken was seasoned to perfection, the perfect amount of spicy and tangy. And who can really mess up on a waffle!  All in all the food was absolutely amazing and I will be returning again and again and again!

Outstanding! The food is so perfect that it is worth the extra time in the kitchen. Our waitress was very nice and it seemed like the maître d very much cared about our visit.  I had the steak and eggs and my guest had the French toast. Both were presented beautifully and tasted wonderful. I highly recommend Gold Standard.  Be prepared to wait 30 minutes at least for your delicious order.

Let me preface this by saying that I have spent years working in the service industry and always treat those that are still in it with utmost respect, out of a keen understanding of the challenges of the job and the lack of rewards. However, this was atrocious behavior from the waitstaff. Waiter forgot cutlery, didn't refill or fill our water, gave us snark, cocktails came late, nothing tasted particularly good, portions were small. Honestly, you're all getting mugged if you think its a good deal here. This would be a standard exceptionally bad review, except for one detail. We clearly instructed her to run our cards for the different amounts as there were 3 of us who had racked up quite different amounts on the bill. She splits it evenly, and then I say to my friend, "not one thing has been right". The plumpy waitress overhears, then takes a picture of us without our permission, and says that we are banned. Taking pictures of patrons without their permission is simply unacceptable.

I was there last night with a group of friends. The first thing I noticed was the rustic looking and "woodsy"atmosphere. It has a very cool vibe and setting. After looking at the a la carte menu (which by the way, looked excellent) we decided on trying the tasting menu. Tonight's feature was the "Pork" feast. Everything was on point and delicious. My only suggestion is NOT to add the anchovies to the kale and bacon salad. Otherwise, all plates were delicious and plentiful. I must also mention the pork belly and gnocchi plates. Thumbs up on those 2 plates. Now for the not favorable part. If this is a tasting menu for a party of 5, why are you bringing all the plates out at once?! As good as the meal was, I felt rushed. I would have much preferred each plate to be brought out. When I'm eating such a meal, I love to savor and enjoy; really take my time. Unfortunately, this dining experience felt like all the food was being forced down my throat. Too fast. Too fast. Slow down! And then onto the service. Sorry guys but the service was unacceptable. No one came to check on us. No one asked us if we needed anything. I recall, we had to flag down our waitress several times. I actually thought the servers did a much better job. They constantly kept coming over, refilling our waters, and keeping the table neat and clean. If it were up to me, the entire tip should have gone to the servers. I realize it was a Saturday night and Saturday nights are probably the busiest time. However, service should have been better. Don't know if I would go back. Wonder how brunch is?

I liked this place a lot! I had never had ethiopian before this and it was interesting and delicious. I didn't  get to see the coffee ceremony they do but I did have the coffee and it is really good and really strong. At the time I went they didn't serve any drinks or beers, not sure if they do now but I would have liked to have had wine or something. Other then that the atmosphere was lovely!

This was by far one of the WORST costumer service experiences I ever had in my life. I don't care where a business is located, there should still be a level of hospitality. THERE WAS ZERO HERE! I have never ordered from here before, there was no signage that explained which way the line was going or the ordering process. There was just a crowd of people waiting at the counter when my 5 year old daughter and I arrived. After asking several people standing toward the back if they had ordered already, we made our way to the front where we waited in the crowd for 10 minutes never being acknowledged until the man behind the counter asked the gentleman standing next to me what he wanted. He then turned to me and said "Did you stand in that line down there?" I replied, "What line? There's just a crowd of people." He says, "Oh yeah well, you gotta stand in line." It took EVERYTHING in me not to flip because he saw me standing there the entire time with my daughter who now was growing restless from waiting so long. I wasn't going to wait in that line because I had already waited too long and asked him why he hadn't said anything when he saw me standing there the entire time? " He ignored me and waited on the next costumer. Of course I wasn't going to patronize them at this point so I took my child, crying "But, I'm hungry" and left. Bottom line is there's a way to treat people and that was not it! There's a certain level of organization that your business should have and that wasn't it! I don't care how good your product is. I work too damn hard for my money to be giving it to somebody who treats me like this. You NEVER know if your next costumer could make or break you. Treating the wrong costumer inappropriately could ruin your entire business... IJS.

Wait staff is super friendly. Ate brunch, herb omelette and my daughter had poached eggs over creamed spinach and puff pastry. It was all perfect, the buttered brioche toast and jam, the fluffy omelette filled with fresh herbs and creme fraiche and the side salad of frisée, shaved fennel and radish was pure Sunday happiness.

My wife and I had reservations at another restaurant around the corner but canceled them after reading all of the horrible reviews it was getting here on Yelp.  On a whim, we decided to give JJ Bootleggers a try.  We were not disappointed.  The moonshine drinks were very good.  Nice selection of beer as well.   The food was great.  We had the tater tots and cheesesteak spring rolls for appetizers.  Both were excellent.  I enjoyed the Lightnin' Burger and my wife thought the shrimp tacos were delicious.  We would definitely recommend stopping in for a few drinks and a meal.
I will go so far as to say these are the best wings in Connecticut. I've been going to Roma's for years and the service and food is always consistently good.

Thank you Matt & Marie for OUTSTANDING FOOD and SERVICE. We are exciting to have your business in ourarea. The food is fresh and always delivered on time. Your staff's desire to meet the customers needs is very refreshing. We look forward to our next lunch with you. Renee

Awesome but hard to get to from Manhattan unless you take ferry-then super easy. Pizza was amazing and the brookies were yummy. Will definitely return. We walked over Brooklyn bridge, not realizing there are barricades quite a way down that prevent you from getting to Dumbo area. No big deal, will just take ferry or subway next time. Worth it.

Can i have some kangaroo with my cabbage please?? Ordered the kangaroo and mahi tacos.. Bland, need more seasoning, and they put way too much cabbage over the meat. Drinks tasted weird. Quite disappointed overall but happy i got to try their crostinis.. The free bread was the best part.

This was only my second time visiting this place. I had the half bbq, fries and green salad. The sauce on the chicken was good and the salad could have used some cheese and onions. I did ask for the onions and was giving them so that was fine. My Aunt had the salmon and she enjoyed it. The lemonade was sweet. I will come back next time I visit.

I am not from Philadelphia but I'm always on the hunt for a great coffee place that always serves extra. I'm always looking for somewhere that does more than coffee and this place really does it right! All of their food is fresh from the breakfast two lunches. Everyone is very friendly and kind. Indoor and outdoor seating and dogs are welcome outside. I will definitely be back here!!

I had a wonderful time here. It's some of the best food I've had in awhile. I am so so so happy I came across this place. It's got an adorable vibe, delicious food, and fun decor! I had a great time with my friend and I am recommending this place to everyone I know!!

What a wonderful experience.  My wife and I were treated like celebrities by the staff.  The food was nothing short of amazing.  the steak was done just right.  the appetizers were amazing and I recommend you try them all. I live in philly and I would drive out here every weekend. Very impressed

Was in Philly this past weekend for the Black Keys concert and came here for brunch. I had the Oh My Omelet with goat cheese and sauteed mushrooms. It was eh okay, not great, but i;m a sucker for anything with goat cheese and its pretty hard to mess up a omelet. I think $10 for an omelet that only gives you two choices if highly over priced. My boyfriend had the waffles and liked them but thought they were a little on the burnt side. He liked how they had a strong banana tastes. Service was a little on the slow side and our server was a little inattentive but it wasn't terrible. If i lived here I probably wouldn't make it a habit of coming.

Theresa's Place  was great. I went here with a friend for lunch and they served us promptly. The waiter was a cool down to earth guy that was friendly and made everything flow well. The environment was very homely and laid back which made me enjoy the meal even more. I definitely would recommend this place to a friend or family member.

I have never been anywhere with the same level of service! The food was great, atmosphere was awesome, but nothing was better than the service. We went for our 7 year anniversary, and the kitchen was very backed up, so they offered desert on them, sweet deal! Then when the check came, everything was taken care of other than our app and drinks. Had they not done this, it would have been tough for me to recommend, due to a 2 hour and 15 minute dinner, but they made up for it and some!!! Thanks again!!
Delicious noodle and cottage cheese plate. Simple but filling. The stuffed cabbage is just like mother made. Hosts are very hospitable
Until coming here, I had never tried Japanese desserts. Now I'm kind of obsessed. Damn you cha an.

We had an absolutlely amazing special event christening dinner yesterday afternoon. Every single detail was perfect! The food was outstanding! Such a great menu! The staff  was wonderful and could not do enough! We will be back and recommend to all!

Myself, husband, and kids visited Rincon last Friday evening after a long time (approx. 15 yrs) anyways, the place looked the same.  First off, the soup was really, really  good, the bread was ok.  we order baked clams and a snail appe, out of this world, I ordered the paella for me and son, as we both loved it, and it always is a lot, and we end up taking it home, sorry, but not good, non of the seafood was fresh, the rice was soggy, it had a horrible smell, that throw off the whole meal. my husband ordered the broil whole red snapper, he was pretty satisfied, he enjoyed it, then my daughter ordered the garlic chicken, it was not what she expected, she said it tasted like fish.  the red sangria was  excellent, not watered down, plenty of wine, did not order desert. would not visit again, as we always enjoyed Iberia in Newark.

We used to love this place, and order take out about once a week.  But, lately the food hasn't been great.  The guacamole tasted very strange, the rice wasn't good and too much of it was used in the burrito and the chicken has been very salty for the last three orders.  It's too bad, because our order is always ready quickly and the food was always great before.
Great neighbourhood bar where you immediately feel like a local. Definitely worth a visit if you are in the area although be careful - you may not want to leave!
Yum. yum. yum. This is my favorite spot for brunch in the Slope. They even have seating outside for those nice summer days! They tacos are excellent and by far my favorite.
Had dinner here Sat 9/20.  Great meal!  Fabulous service.  Waking distance from Hilton Manhattan East. Delicious offerings eclectic combinations of flavors.  Highly recommend!!
Awesome food. Decor a little strange. Good place to eat with friends on a casual Sunday.

We liked eating here. The noise level is not too high, the staff is well  trained and the menu is varied. You can eat cheaply or more extravagantly with lots of options. We had the soup specials and they were delicious. The Cobb Salad was huge with lots of shrimp. This is close to the theaters and the staff were eager to tell us all about what there was to do in the neighborhood. We would eat there again.

I've been wanting to go to this place for over a year, and live in the neighborhood, but every time I walked by they were closed.  Apparently they fixed their weird hours, so I was excited to finally eat lunch there on a weekday. For lunch options the food is overpriced, and the selection is very minimal.  For health reasons I can't eat spicy food and after inquiring about the hot level of the wings I was told (and heard him repeat later to another customer) that they weren't spicy at all and that "a kid could eat them".  He was very wrong.  I even ordered a side salad thinking "well that can't be spicy", but it totally was.  I get that it's a Caribbean place, so yes most things would be spicy, but come on I really only went there to accommodate friends who like spicy things.  Have other options on the menu! Overall maybe I'd go back at night for a drink or happy hour, otherwise I'd skip this place.
Stopped in not expecting to stay long. Stayed longer than we thought!! What a great time! Thanks Erin and Richie!

So I decided to try something new tonight, and though their were alot of mixed reviews. The food was GREAT! I had a chicken and lamb kabob with rice, salad, bread, and a choice of sauce. I was surprised it was given a bad review because the food was excellent, the service was so friendly and the place has a great feeling to it. I will come again and again! you must check it out,

It's not easy finding a restaurant accommodating to gluten free diet but this certainly is and delicious at that. With a wide assortment of risotto and tasty sides and salads I rate my experience here well. The service wasn't up to par just givin the time I was there I would expect more attention my appetizer nearly sat on my table over 5 minutes when finished before being removed. But overall a great meal. Not the best risotto but certainly close.
Amazing, every single time. Go with a group and try everything. Cool place and better food.
Delicious! They gave me white rice instead of brown rice that i ordered, it was even on the receipt but it wasn't a big deal, still a really good lunch!

This is most definitely my go to spot with clients.  The food is amazing (Red Velvet Pancakes with cream cheese frosting center, creme brûlée French toast, egg white omelets just to name a few) and the service is professional, friendly and efficient.  Ask for Brittny! She is my favorite!!
Pho doesn't take 30 minutes. The food was very ok: spring rolls and pho. But the service was slow and indifferent, with the overwhelmed manager as the exception.

My family had a dinner here last week and overall, we enjoyed our foods and the staffs were really generous and smiled all the time! Our server discribed each dishes and an appetizer she recommended was very good! I also like the mango salad with soft shell crab on top and the pad thai. Hope they could've give us the bigger table for four adults plus 2-year old baby...the square table was way too small so had to squeeze each other.

To Bernie E. from Ft. Lee New Jersey. I have to comment on your post. If the fact that the restaurant did not have Lamb Shank and you drove a half hour and it ruined your evening it does not say much about you or your party of 4. It ruined your night? PLEASE get a life. As for me, I go to Risotto House all the time and I have never had a bad experience with the staff or the food. Everything has always been perfect. I tell everyone I know to dine there.  One other thing, WHY should the restaurant pick up the tab for your coffee and dessert. Why do you feel they owe you that gesture.  I've dealt with customers like you always looking for a reason to get something for nothing.

Wow!  Keep it down the kids are scared. Very hip place, but forgets where it is. Drinks took 20 min Food took 45 min and was kinda worth the wait, but don't ask me to keep it down 4 times when the bar is 10x louder than the dining room. Good fare, slow service and nervous nelly ownership. Loosen up please!
Soul Food Heaven. Don't mind the wait...greens and yams are scrumptious. Tender braised beef short ribs are my favorite and order the Sunrise.

They have the most fantastic sloppy joe sandwiches! I ordered some for my father's birthday party and they were packaged perfectly and delicious. They were such a hit at the party, and so easy for me as well. Thank you Lakeside!
Great place. Friendly staff. The lemonade smoothie was delicious as was the sweet potato/pea soup, corn hummus and the salad.
The pizza is great, especially the clam pizza, although if you are a huge crust fan then you may be disappointed.
Phenomenal tacos. Some of the best I've ever had. As authentic as it gets!
Food was amazing and well presented. You would think you were eating at a 5 star restaurant. I will definitely be going back.
I had lunch for the 1st time here & the food was delicious! Customer service is great . . very attentive & friendly. I will definitely be ordering from here more often.
Great food. The oxtail pappardelle was wonderful! The homemade pasta was incredible. We also had the black linguine with shellfish. Equally as good. Excellent restaurant, comfortable atmosphere!

So good!  I live down the street and whenever I'm off I come in and it's a little bit of heaven.  There's nothing else like it around.  Nutella with strawberries and granola.  So Flippin good.  And their savory crepes are just as good!

Sort of korean fast food in nyc. If you looking for a quick bite to eat and tired of usual choices i would suggest to check them out. They get really busy and sometimes its hard to find a place to sit but just give it a few minutes and most likely you'll find a spot. Im not very fond of their manager (at least i think he is the manager) because he is rude. But it doesnt stop me from coming here.
Great food!! I love the vibe and the food portions are just enough. Be sure to try their desserts! Yumm

Stumbled in here on the way to an open mic with a few friends. Everyone loved the food! (Even the pickiest of my friends who hates everything we choose, was happy and smiling!! That was quite an accomplishment in my eyes!!) Please try the octopus appetizer and any of the cocktails!! Cannot wait to go back! Staff was very friendly and attentive!

I am half Indian and have traveled to india a dozen times.  Taj E India is the best Indian food I have had outside of india.  I asked them to make it "Indian style" and not watered down and it was amazing.  What a find in the upper valley.  Take-out only.
The meatballs were very good. Service was OK. I got the brown butter ravioli and it was way too oily/buttery. Overpowered the whole dish.

Food was creative and tasted quite good.  I visited during their opening week so there were still some tweaks needed in terms of their process. Digging their decor and layout, lends itself to lots of conversation.
Best tofu soup place ever. Like the appetizers especially the fired fish. Tofu soup is a must order each time.
Thin & crispy crust pizza from their wood oven had great toppings. Bartender had some refreshing mixes.

It was my last evening in NYC so we decided go to olea and enjoy some good wine and delicious food before going to the BAM. It was great like always. The tapas taste quite Spanish and the service is really friendly. Definitely get the meatballs if you go there!

My new favorite Indian restaurant in the area  Every dish I had was very flavorful.  You can taste the fresh spices such as curry and ginger.  Their entrees are somewhat more expensive than other places, but the freshness and quality of their dishes is worth it!  Even the Sunday buffet is excellent.

When my wife and I went here, we both ordered tea. I should have inspected my cup more carefully, because after a couple minutes of drinking the tea, I noticed that there were smudges of red lipstick on the outside of the rim. Gross. Really? The waiter didn't even seem to care. The sushi itself was nothing special.

As good as it gets. Best Mexican food in Philly. We have been here 3 times and it does not disappoint. Delicious, inventive and easy on the budget. If you have been to Mexico City think "Valentina". Top notch Mexican cuisine in the heart of Italian  Market. Great drinks too. Try the tamarind margarita. Best  Chilaquiles in the city. Excellent menu full of new and interesting dishes. Excellent service also reminiscent of Mexico City. A real find.
A little bit expensive.

THE CHEF SHOULD BE GIVEN A NOBEL PRIZE. genius! the best steak i've ever had in my life, the best pasta i've ever had in my life, the calamari is a unique blend of cherry tomatos and bananas... whaaaaat? i over eat every time i come here. i eat here almost every day. best food i've ever had.

I LOVE THIS PLACE! The food is amazing and what is best about this place is the staff, they are accommodating, wonderful people that are very attentive and understand customer service. The atmosphere is warm, inviting and welcoming!!! this is always my place to go for a business lunch/dinner.  And now they've added breakfast! what a treat! Try the Branzino, the spreads, Cod fritters, grilled octopus (well done), Greek salad, OMG the home made soup...seafood...amazing!, Greek yogurt...I've had these all.  There were a couple of items that were on the menu when they first open that are no longer, and wished they wouldn't of taken them off...but other then that...Delicious!!!!
5 stars for the spumoni! It's well worth the trip out there just for that!

What a lovely place! I've only been there once so far, but I can't wait to be back. It's so beautiful and cozy. The coffee was good and I had a chocolate cookie which was fresh (at 5pm!) and delicious. The stuff was also very friendly and polite. I only wish they were open until 6:30pm, that's when my class at FIT starts and I like to get a coffee right before.
Great cheesesteak! Cook really knows her stuff! Fresh ingredients and efficient process! Will come back again! FYI! It's a cash only place.

Outstanding sushi. Loved the white tuna sushi, sunflower roll and the Mountain Roll. Attentive wait staff. They even gave us 4 pieces of a chef special roll to try - on the house. All of the fish was extremely fresh.

Good food and drink, but if you're not metal or covered head to toe in tattoos, expect to be treated like second class patrons and scowled at by the staff. Table service is better than it used to be, but generally bartenders can't be bothered to interrupt their conversation to pour you a beer (not counting the bartender on Sunday afternoon, she's great).
