Food is overpriced ($8 for an "egg benedict," not eggs, egg), but tasty. Definite plus is the collection of dictator portraits, and random tchotchkies all over the place.

I would like to give this place at least 4 stars because I really enjoyed the drinks, but unfortunately I cant.  While the bartender was very nice, my  husband was served in a dirty glass with a lipstick rim. I thought that was completely unacceptable, not to mention unsanitary. No wonder they have a B grade.

I really enjoyed my buckwheat crepe. I got The Johnny Crepe. Yum!!! The service was good, but it is an order at the counter being to you place. So not sure how you can mess that up. I was very happy after going here.

This place is incredible.  It consistently has delicious food, the menu is constantly evolving, and the service is wonderful.   Try everything, but definitely don't forget to try the brussel sprouts, lavender goat cheese, bacon wrapped dates, lamb tajine and short ribs!!!

The service was excellent. I have been here a few times, the first time I loved the food and each time there after the food has become significantly less impressive which is a shock for a Garces restaurant. The wine list is wonderful though.
pork buns ftw.

This place is amazing. As soon as you walk in, the atmosphere and staff are so welcoming and friendly.  The people, food, and atmosphere feel so authentic. When asking the chef for a recommendation, he told us he couldn't recommend anything because everything is SO good. Boy, was he right! The flavors are so rich and multi-dimensional. My fav is the Rigatoni with prosciutto. Perfect amount, perfect flavors. And the house wine is even amaze-balls. I'm telling you, if you want simple affordable ($11-$15) authentic italian food with a welcoming atmosphere...this is your spot.
Awesome beer, great food, and good prices.  I love come here!
I stopped in for a quick lunch after searching yelp for a Cuban sandwich. I was very pleased to find a great classic Cuban sandwich. Must return to explore the rest of the menu

Very creative name for the area. We love the outdoor  seating that about does it for the good.   The food is far below the standard anyone should expect from a neighborhood bar. The interior is dark and uninviting.  Our server seemed to have other things on her mind.   I will not be returning.
Fresh food, terrific service and nicely presented Mediterranean dishes.  What more could you ask for?  As the crowds will attest, this is a new area favorite!

Ok, the sushi is good, great for the price you pay. The service can be on and off because I think there is a major language barrier problem, however, I give it 5 stars for 1 reason. If you ever have a problem, the manager will always take care of it if you ask for her. She is very nice and genuine. Also, if you go there regularly she makes sure to let you know she remembers you and sometimes will give you a free appetizer because your a good customer. All restaurants in new haven are on and off with good/bad service, especially during busy times. But this has consistently good food, good prices, and good management.

Horrible customer service, don't go there! I have been frequenting this place for half a year only because it's close by so I can grab some food after work when I don't have time to cook. Today I order a dish which is noted not spicy on the menu, but i believe they put in the most spicy pepper there ( the green thin one).  My tears bust out since I cannot handle spicy.  The waitress said this is the way they prepare dish.  I asked for a replacement and they said since the food is touched they will not either replace or refund it because "if the food is not touched, they can still sell the dish to other customers"!!!  This is the most disgusting I eve heard in restaurant that they even try to resell food that's returned by customer. For your own hygiene Please don't go this restaurant.  Their waitress even come over to my desk scolding me for eating the food.  She glanced at my plate and judged how I eat my food, and raised her voice at me in front of all my customers.  When I asked for manager she keeps yelling "I am the manager".  I don't know where thats true or not, but don't think I will go to a place that treat their long term customer like a piece of dirt.  UNbelievable!

I had a stop-over in New York last weekend and a friend recommended Bijan's - I fell in love with the rustic, modern and cozy decor! The food was great and the staff very accommodating - I wish they had a place like this near me in London!

Don't bother with a reservation, your best bet is to go on a slow weeknight and sit at the bar. The table service is horrific. We had a 7:30 reservation and were informed by our waitress at 8:45 that a large party also had a reservation and we had to move to accommodate them. When we asked where we could go, the waitress told us we could shift to the bar... Where there was no seats. We ended up leaving with full margaritas on the table and going somewhere else. While their spicy passion fruit margaritas are original and delicious, it isn't worth the horrible service. With margaritas at $10-12 each, you deserve to take your time drinking them, not be rushed by a staff that can't manage their reservation system.
Was excited to try.  Place was packed.  Only one server.  Didn't get waited in for 20 mins so I left.  Will try again another time when more servers on because food looked great

This has become a regular haunt for my girlfriend and myself after moving to Astoria! Wonderful staff, good variety of food, and the kangaroo burger is truly a guilty pleasure (can't help feel terrible for eating them but they're absolutely delicious).
The artichoke slice is banging. The pizza is so good, I know it is a heart attack waiting to happen but it's worth it

I went here with friends based on the yelp reviews and found it met the high expectations.  The staff was awesome and nice. My girlfriend got a high five on the way in.  The food was really good and has a good beer and cocktail selection.  The vibe inside was really nice. It is chill and pleasant without being stuffy.

Beautiful environment. Top notch service. Love how the waiter poured wine. Everyone at the table enjoyed their meals with the exception of my chicken scapriella. It was flavorful. But the chicken itself was a little chewy and gamey.
Great food, great service.  Would definitely recommend a visit to this little gem.

So yes they are know for the most amazing burgers around and the beer selection is also great but have you tried the pumpkin cheesecake?  All of the desserts are great but this one is a step above the rest!!
JOHN'S ROAST PORK is the best roast pork sandwich in Philly. Go There. Order 2. Eat one in the car. Dont bite your own finger while eating it...like I did. Go now.

The food was amazing, the service was excellent and the atmosphere was just unforgettable. No matter what you order on the menu you will be happy, the apps were amazing, tried a few different ones, but the Mac and cheese and tostadas were two of my favorites. Check it out, great spot.

I have honestly not been here in a good year. I am pleased to announce that NOTHING has changed. This place just screams little Italy. I recently went to the San Genaro festival they have up on canal and honestly il trianglo shoots any of those little "family owned" restaurants out the water. I know this is my third time reviewing this place (should not be allowed lol) but I just wanted to update anyone whose still contemplating on coming here. Of course I didn't call and reserve a table for my mother and I because I didn't know how packed it would be. We got in and as soon as we got there the owner politely asked us if we had a reservation. We replied no, and he nicely told us that we should have lol. I say nicely because he was not rude at all, BUT there are people out there that get offended for stupid things like that. I sat down and apologized (I'm not a sucker, but neither am I rude). We took a while ordering because the menu has A LOT of good things on it. I just noticed that my mother and I ordered the SAME exact thing we did the last we were here. Not intentionally of course we are just earthy people that don't like change I guess lol. But anyway, she ordered the meat ravioli and I had the pollo a le penne. Both fantastic, both gone in minutes. Oh! We did get the appetizer that was on the special. I totally forgot the name but it was a studded crab meat zhuchinni. Super great I will post a picture! For desert we had the chocolate pie WHICH I DEMOLISHED! So good OMG Anyway, this is the update of the update lol nothing has changed! The only thing that has changed is the line of ppl they have to say no to because they didn't make reservations. ALSO there is a dress code! I saw a couple get a huge no at the door for coming in with beach shorts and a pack of bounty lol..
Great addition to the neighborhood! Good food, friendly staff, and an excellent wine list.
I had some good times at this place. Very nice people and an excellent cuisine. Will be back!
By far my favorite pizza in Brooklyn. I've always gotten delivery, never been to the actual restaurant by delivery is always prompt and friendly. Best Pizza in nyc if you ask me.

I will give this pizzeria two stars for getting the right oven, but not much else from there.  Their "Ah Pizz"  should be called "Ehh Pizz."   It was simply a mess with a bunch of cherry tomatoes atop a decent sauce--no point in doing something so redundant.  They also claim that this pizza has mozzarella di bufala, which it simply does not--or at least the non-Italian guy making the pizza had no clue and used low grade mozzarella cheese.  Probably one of the worst pizzas I've tasted from a true wood burning oven.  All for $16.  What a shame.  There's no love for making pizza here--just a business looking to take whatever they can get from "fesse e cuntenti" clients who don't know any better.  By the way, I love pizza, have my own wood burning oven and have tried pizza from just about all the pizzerias claiming to have good pizza in the tri-state area.  I will pay $30 for a great pizza, so money is not a factor--if the pizza is great, then it's worth just about whatever the owner wants to charge--period.  What you get here is no love for the craft, misleading ingredients and high-priced blah pizza a legna.

They serve good portions of food that fills you up. I like the ambiance and the wait staff are friendly. The food tastes fresh and the turn over is pretty fast. I see people coming in here regularly. That usually means the chefs know what they are doing. I love the salsa and chips they give you before the meals. It complements the meals.

Hi.Let me tell that, 1-What a charming tapas restaurant this is? 2-What about food? 3-What was the Service,staff duty and other things? 4-What I was eat there? 1=Oh this restaurant is one of the best restaurant in NY.I have to only get one thing,let it be the fried goat cheese with levander infused honey.It taste  exactly as delicious as it sounds. 2=The food was so tasty and organic.They use pure ingredients in fried goat cheese with levander.AWESOME food. 3=The service was so good and quick.The staff was so co-operative and done there duty with honesty and responsibility.Atmosphere was relaxing. 4=I was eat there Fried goat cheese with levander. Every thing was AMAZING.
This is my favoriteeeee place! Their food is just out of this world. My favorites are the Octopus, the Mussels and the Branzino.

We have been here twice, the first time we had wonderful drinks and snacks and the guacamole is really very good indeed. We returned with family who travelled from Spain, we had a great start with the usual Mexican snacks and some well made cocktails however the entree confused us all... We had a variety of entrees however all seemed to have used Chocolate as part of the dish... The dishes were not good and really were too rich and heavy and lacking in the finesse I would have expected from this place. Needless to stay we didn't stay for desert because we seemed to have already had it.

The dinner pre-fixe is an amazing deal. All of the starters were standouts - green tomato pies, pretzel rolls, and bluefish pate were fantastic. We ordered the lamb and striped bass as mains - lamb was great, bass was a bit bland. Definitely redeemed with dessert though, as well as with the chocolates the chef brings out at the end of the meal. All in all a really great experience with exceptional service.

I'm just going to put this out there for everyone. This is literally my favorite pizza place in the city. I highly suggest it in the strongest possible terms. Delivery is always on time and it's always hot and fresh.

You can't go wrong with anything on the menu, all exceptional and delicious. Service is equally superb and attentive, not a discouraging word to say about this place, except that they're not open for breakfast or lunch...
Only had the drinks so far but they were incredible! Try el chilango and the smoky room. Incredibly nice and welcoming staff.
Terakawa ramen is a nice little restaurant, could be a hangout spot just chill and eat. I ordered the pork bun and chicken cutlet curry. They were both delicious!
Flatbread is a great spot that epitomizes the Burlington culture. The pizza is delicious and original.

Went to NIXS with a friend and we sat at the bar lounge area. How hard is it to get an IPA or a lager? The waitress in the lounge knew nothing about the beers on draft when I asked her and didn't even bother asking the bartenders at the bar. She brought over some beers to sample because I asked her if I could sample an IPA/draft. None of the beers I sampled were IPA's or what my friend asked for, oh well couldn't order what we wanted. Seeing that it was a struggle, I just got anything from the drink list and my friend got a pumpkin beer with no cinnamon rim because again the waitress didn't ask. After the first round of drinks and dessert the waitress came up to the table and said if she could cash us out because she wanted to get a drink at the bar...how unprofessional is that. However, the dessert was awesome and I have to be back before 10pm for main food menu.

Usually thoroughly enjoy this place however tonight I had the pleasure of meeting a rude manager. Not more than 10minutes after we paid our bill $200 (group of 4) was she clearing the table and giving verbal suggestions that we leave because she needed the table. I have waited plenty of times for an hour or more to be seated never did I think that customers were being rudely pushed out the door. The free round of drinks at the bar did nothing to undo the rudeness. You should treat your customers a little better than this.
Great Service happy hour is the best, 1/2 price drinks plenty of parking not a huge selection of food, but the pizzas are great!
Excellent food, small, relaxed and cosy atmosphere. Asparagus poached eggs are amazing!

Went last night with friends from overseas. Impeccable family style restaurant made a great impression at reasonable prices right in Times Square. Highly recommend and will definitely be coming again.
Food was great ! Even though the wait and service was fair! Food made up for it all . Highly recommending this place !!! Wow !!
Worth the trip! Had a slice of Chocolate Swirl Cheesecake. The cake was extremely rich yet deliciously light and very flavorful. Loved every bite!!!! Will be a fan for life!

If you like breakfast...you have to try this place!! I recently moved out of New Haven, but the year I was there Bella's was the place to go for breakfast! The chicken and waffle special is fantastic! They also have a corn dog style special which is sausage and pancakes!! Can't go wrong with the egg selections either! Cute and quaint little diner style cafe that is the place to be for breakfast on the weekends!
They have a very good shish kebab and Greta lentil soup.   They are located right next to the mall and ha e delicious food

The food here was pretty good, but it was slightly lacking compared to other places in the area. Service was fast, but our waitress was a little impatient and unfriendly. Overall, the food was good for the price, but you can find better sushi in nearby restaurants for a slightly higher price.

Amazing food. Traditional italian dishes done simply right. From the lasagna bolognese to the pizzas...everything is perfect!!! Staff is wonderful and caters to your every need. Cant wait to come again!

in early September of this year (2014) I was visiting New Haven and decided to have dinner at Oaxaca Kitchen.  The food was good and the service was decent.  The reason I give it two stars is because the food was over prized.  I have visited many states and been to my share of Mexican restaurants.  We have many in the San Francisco Bay Area.  I never spent $70 for two entrees, a side of dip, and two margaritas.  I would NOT recommend this restaurant to a friend.
Great gyros ! We had a celebration here. All was delicious !!!
All was great We sat down in the porch I have salmon raw appetizer and gnocchi and my hubby  bisteca Service was great

Absolutely delicious tapas, they deserve their high rating! Had beautiful weather on the patio, they were dog friendly, had attentive staff and food came out quickly. Will definitely come back next time we're in the area.

Held og lykke med at finde stedet :-) Det er inde bag en rød dør, der minder om et lille bitte skur malet med grafitti. De laver lækre pizzaer, og det er et vældigt populært sted blandt de lokale. Prøv det - også selvom du er på ferie "kun" på Manhatten

One of my favorite spots in the city. They always have a great beer selection on tap and are decently priced for CC. Food wise, everything I've ordered has always been delicious. They're roast pork is some of the best in the city.  The atmosphere is great with a "cheers" type of feeling as I always run into a lot of regulars. The staff is great and friendly as well. I'll be a customer as long they stay open.
Not only was the food amazing, but the service was superb. Especially the hostess - who was lovely and went out of her way to help make sure that we had a wonderful evening.
Went here for the first time and found the pizza to be very tasty. I would have expected this place to have more reviews. My husband and I will definitely order again for our pizza night.
Awesome chicken empanadas!!!

Wow. I went to yelp and "your next review awaits" was Pat's. I hadn't been here in quite some time, but just happened  have an early lunch there last week.  Pat's has thousands  of reviews. So will mine make a profound difference? Doubt it! But I feel it must be pointed  out  that that these are NOT direct reviews of Pat's that state a  standard restaurant criteria. Example: food, drinks, service, price, atmosphere, etc, The unique, and likely unfair, characteristics of these reviews is that they have a division/competition between out-of-towners/tourists and Philadelphia residents. Additionally, another large portion pits Pat's directly against Geno's! Neither of these situations seems fair or appropriate when giving an honest and concise opinion of a single establishment. So on to a proper review. I had a cheesesteak wit, applied my personal preference of ample condiments, and a soda. Total cost: approx:$12. Not unreasonable for a totally filling and delicious lunch!
Really tasty  hamburger. Myself and my wife where presently surprised by the food and service, very friendly atmosphere!  This for the Princeton NJ location.
The food is so disappointing, service is not bad though and the drinks are pretty good. I don't think I will go again.

This place is pretty on point I have tried to break room fries , the break room burger and the mint lemonade . Everything has honestly been amazing everytime. I love the egg is the burger makes it 10 times more messy but so more delicious at the same time . I like how the fries have a lot going in but it just meshes so well. Only con is small space

We had avocado salad, kalbi, harami, beef tongue, premium sirloin, sukiyaki bibimbap, and green tea mille crepes. The menu was a bit limited compared to the ones in Tokyo, but everything was delicious. My best favorite is harami for sure. I see some people gave low ratings because the service was slow. We also needed to wait a little bit as we didn't make a reservation, but otherwise, the service seemed perfectly fine to me. Our server was very very friendly and made us feel welcomed. I would definitely come back :)

Terrific ambiance, friendly and welcoming service, and all the drinks and appetizers we had at our table of 6 were excellent. We especially liked the empanadas and lobster taquitos, but everything was very enjoyable. We'll be back!

My wife and I tried this restaurant for the first time recently. It had been recommended by the SOPAC will-call person. The food was very good. We shared a caesar salad so we asked for an extra plate. By the time the waiter brought it out, we were finished eating the salad. The main course came out which were the scallops and risotto which was very good and a pasta with vodka sauce and salmon which was also very good. The reason for only two stars is due to the service. It was terrible. We sat and waited for over 5 minutes before our waiter showed up. We decided to place our dinner order immediately as we were not sure when he would come back. Dinner arrived okay, but then at the end of dinner, the waiter disappeared again. We had to ask for him. We gave him the credit card to pay, but when he returned, he decided to go to another table to take their order instead of dropping off the check and charge slip. We had to go get it from after we realized he was holding a conversation with the customer. We recommend the food, but the service is terrible.

Probably one of the best french restaurant that ive ever eaten at so far and its in an unexpected city like bloomfield! I was even fortunate enough to meet the chef and he was such a genuine and passionate individual. the ambiance was comfortable and the staff were very friendly. Its safe to say that ill be coming back soon

The bagel shop has been making their bagels smaller and smaller . They are very expensive for the size and quality of the bagel . They are very clean but I remember coming here as a kid and getting that bagel you were craving .

While the food was quite good, the owner and two young men servers were poorly and sloppily dressed and uncaring and unsocial and unhelpful re the menu to two first-time visitors.  It took a long time to get our food but we were pleased that it did not seem to be waiting for us and was cooked to order.  If they'd sharpen up their people and their ambience and have a more social presence this could be a good restaurant. Right now it's like a big open barn with no pizzaz or charm.  They need some warmth and feeling of hospitality and customer service. The current people on board do not seem capable of this.
Offers breakfast sandwiches quickly when you're on the go. My favorite place to get breakfast before work. It's a mix of corner store and sandwich shop. Iced coffee is pretty good too!

Really good tacos, but on the expensive side.  Not worth going out of your way for, however, if you're planning a visit to (the crowded and overly-commercial) Chelsea Market, then drop a tenner and enjoy.

Very good place! The atmosphere is classy and the food amazing! The vegetarian options are creative and delicious. I also loved how they gave you a muffin for your breakfast the next day. To top it off the cocktails are very tasty.

Food was warm the booths were extremely small and close together. The food was overpriced and the eggs were burnt. I will DEFINITELY not go back the hype about gluten free and organic breakfast is not worth the price tag or atmosphere.
Super tasty Vietnamese food. We had the pork with rice and a tasty fresh sauce with a bunch of vegetables. Good portions, good value for money!
Great place to experince different cultural foods.

Food was pretty good, and staff is very friendly, but there are couple things wrong: 1. If you are gonna charge an extra $7 on top of the $7 base price Caesar salad, you would expect more than 3 shrimp. 2. Calamari could have used a little more spice 3. Although it was a large delivery, it was a little botched.
I just moved into the area, and this guy helped me out so much! Gave me recommendations on everything! They're so friendly and helpful here. The food was good for a deli, very fresh.

Very disappointed with Papa's. I had heard that it compared to Delorenzo's so we decided to give it a try. The hostess was extremely rude, but we kept going. Pizza was ok, definitely no where near as good or as fresh as Delorenzo's. I actually think it tasted like any old standard pizza place. We also had to ask for clean dishes since ours were filthy when they came out to us. Since then, we know friends of ours (that were 'regulars' there)  got into a bit of an issue with the same hostess and a man who was in the kitchen running the place. Not surprised.  Overall review:  rude staff + mediocre food = won't ever be back. Delorenzo's wins our vote hands down. Fresh ingredients, much friendlier staff, cleaner place, and a much better pie! Another great place in the area you won't be disappointed in is Palermo's on 206 in Bordentown. They are great with their customers and their pie is awesome!! Highly recommend them as well : )

This place is a gem. Everything we ordered was absolutely delicious. The burger, Kale salad and Market Salad were all so good and fresh. Love supporting a place that supports local. The atmosphere here was great a well. We arrived just as brunch had ended so they were transitioning to lunch and the dining room was getting prepped for dinner. We sat at the bar to eat and I ordered the Hint of Fall, which was a delightful cocktail. Everything has been considered here, from the napkins and coasters to the bathrooms which have the most lovely mirrors and lamps and I loved the pedals to operate the water at the sink! I will surely come back here again to try the chocolate cake with pepper frosting! Thanks for a wonderful lunch, Agricola!
The best vietnamese ever! My husband and I had classic pho, my son had fried spring rolls. They were absolutely fantastic!

They really did an excellent job overall. Where can you have a beautiful Italian meal for 45.00 out the door tax and tip with 1 wine. I had the veal my mom had manicotti including soup and ceaser salad. Nice service. No issues whatsoever.     On a Thursday.  Could be crowded so  you may wait no reservation policy..  friendly family restaurant in a nice area.    4 stars..  ps. They will make you whatever you want.....

The waitstaff are always attentive to patrons needs and very informed which helped us in deciding on the meal. We chose to share a kale salad together to start and for the main course I chose the Colorado lamb while my wife chose the Amish chicken. The dishes were tasteful and beautifully arranged. In between each course the chef would send  out small samples of new tastes that would complement our meal. A very lovely evening was had here.

An honor to review one of my hometown favorites! Grew up eating paella marinera here. Just the smell is so nostalgic! The sweetest most friendly staff, lovely ambiance, and the BEST bread and paella. Delicious flavor on the rice and the tender seafood. Also loved the spicy and regular olive oil selection. Didn't have room to get postre, but dessert menu looked very exciting.

The happy hour food is awesome. Can't get empanadas like that for the price. The mojitos were refreshing. They have a huge selection of rum. The atmosphere changes from the front being bright and airy and the back being traditionally cuban with a beautiful romantic ambience.

Dined here Saturday night with a group of 7 and was not impressed. The first floor had an ok vibe and was fairly crowded however we had to go up to the second floor to dine. We walked upstairs and it was empty. We had to sit in a room separated from the bar area that was closed off with a glass wall. We were the only ones here and at one point our waitress closed the doors to the dining room - truly was an inviting atmosphere, NOT. Food was typical, sub par bar food and the beer selection was limited upstairs. We quickly ate and left for another bar. Was way too expensive for the crappy food, service and environment. Oh, and the curry fries are simply French fries with a side sauce of curry to dip in and they charge you about $10 extra. Nuts.
The best margaritas and guacamole in the city.  Perfect if you can get a spot outside.  Seriously, order the margaritas by the pitcher! Totally worth it.

Some of the menu is quite good, but as a review of their omakase, my experience was very sore. A friend and I went in hoping for a creative and delicious evening. What we ended up with was standard fair. The chef prepared our entire omakase at the same time and then brought it to us, although we were sitting in front of him at the sushi bar. The arrangement was your basic nigiri lineup. In fact, the chef even asked us if he should add toro. I mean, I confirmed that we were doing an omakase before we started, but it looked like he just prepared something akin to "sushi platter number 1" and tossed it at us. And although the chef had other (albeit at most two) fishes available as specials, they were not presented. Moreover, we wouldn't ask for them,  since what we did receive was...off. The fish was cold (not body temperature) and awkwardly cut (size), the rice was overly firm, and honestly, the experience as a whole was disappointing and lacking. Especially when we saw the bill at the end. What did we pay for? Certainly not the guided tour through beautifully prepared fish we were expecting...
I love this place - either eat in or order from seamless once per week. The delivery can be a bit hit and miss (twice the sushi hasn't been fresh) but overall it's definitely worth a visit.

I loved this place! I went here with my boyfriend on a whim, and had one of the best dates I've ever had with him! We were greeted by an extremely nice host, and were seated at a table near the kitchen. It's an open kitchen, so you can watch everything the chef's are cooking. It was great! I also noticed these really nice booths for larger groups, that looked like they were tucked in their own little nook. It was very intimate and cozy. I will consider this for the future. Our server was fantastic! He suggested a great red bottle of wine to go with the spices in the food (which by the way, when I say spices I mean the flavors. The food is only as spicy as you want it to be). For an appetizer, we got the samosa chat which was so good! It was served with greek yogurt and roasted cashew, which was the cherry on top. Next, we got the Diver Scallops, which were the best I've ever had! They just melted right in your mouth. Those are a must have! Another great dish we tried was the Shrimp Tandoori, which came with a few different sauces to dip with. Also amazing! We tried a few other things as well, but I don't remember the names. I have pictures of most things we ate. I gotta say though, everything we had was unbelievable. I CANNOT wait to go back!

My girlfriend and some friends and I went to Sake Bar Hagi because word on the street is that it is authentic Japanese food. My girlfriend is Japanese (Osaka) and I have been there twice. I can say from my experience at this restaurant that it is not authentic. It just feels acceptable at the end because it's actually pretty cheap. That is probrably the best thing about Sake Bar Hagi. Okonomiyaki and Takoyaki are street foods from Osaka, which I have eaten there. My girlfriend and I both agreed that they made the okonomiyaki all wrong and the takoyaki seemed like it was frozen. Okonomiyaki is suppose to have cabbage in it! Also, the ramen was quite strange! Strange white cream coloring and too salty! The yakitori was under seasoned and the meat quality was poor. It was quite disappointing after all the buzz about the authentic street food. Good choice of saki and great pitchers of Japanese beer.

I was visiting Hartford, Ct. from the San Francisco Bay Area and one of the locals suggested I try this Sorella.  The staff was friendly and the food and wine were good.  Nick the bartender can carry a pretty good conversation.  Friendly type of guy.  I would recommend this restaurant and dine her again if I was ever back in the area.

I absolutely love Dalessandro's. The steaks are amazing! Even if it looks like it is crowded from the outside of the shop, still go in, because their ordering line is set up a certain way in the small shop. The line goes really quickly and you will be at the front in no time. They make your food very quickly, so you can be in and out within 15 minutes if you order to go. Also, if you want to go the extra mile, order a piece of their cheesecake: it is outstanding! There's absolutely nothing bad I can say about this spot: one of the best in Philly!

I discovered this gem a year after having moved to Astoria. It's BYOB and the food is AMAZE! I ordered the ceviche but my husband did not shy away from the carbs. Besides the food, the quaint tchotchke-filled decor and friendly servers are reason enough to keep coming back.

When I first moved to Fishtown I frequented Lloyd a lot and took my friends who visited me there for their mac and cheese. I went this weekend and the mac and cheese was STONE COLD. Until this time Lloyd had been a 5 star establishment in my book. But this visit I found the deviled eggs very dry and the mac and cheese even after it was warmed up overwhelmingly salty. The visit was really a 1 star rating but given my other positive experiences there I bumped it up to 3 stars. The reason I felt I should leave a review is because I now seriously question whether they just microwave their food. I only ordered two side dishes and the bill came to $16. That would be fine with me if I didn't leave feeling like I was given a microwave ready meal.

Wonderful, cozy restaurant with great food.  The service was ok, a bit slow at times, but our appetizers and dinners more than made up for it.  The fries are great and they have vegetarian options and will even omit the fish sauce.  The owner and chef was on iron chef!  Try her cooking classes if you have the chance.
Try the edamame dumplings, I swear it changes lives! Also, they have a very generous pour on their martinis!

I come in here a lot--usually brunch time--and I generally don't write reviews on places I frequent regularly (not sure why, actually; just don't), but wanted to write a comment since I've read a lot of mixed reviews on the "vibe." There are a lot of great brunch spots to go to in Philadelphia. They usually have larger crowds (to see and be seen) and a very energetic, bright, upbeat atmosphere. Personally, I love those types of places. So I can understand why some people may be put off by the vibe at Kennett; because it is a little bit darker, quieter, cozier. However, I love this place just as much as any other great brunch spot, just for different reasons. I like Kennett for a calmer atmosphere and a low-key hangout. Particularly when I'm hungover and just want a quieter, easier experience. The food is consistently good, the bartenders are always accommodating and pleasant. And they'll talk to you as much as you want (or leave you alone if you prefer). Hopefully, this will paint a better picture of what to expect when you're here. It's a great place (underrated in my opinion), especially if you like to sit at a bar to have brunch--but they have outside seating too. Also, side note: if you're a diva about your eggs then you definitely need to eat here. They get their eggs from a local farmer and they are FRESH FRESH FRESH. And Kennett always cooks and prepares them consistently well. You'll never want to eat stupid grocery store eggs again. :)

I just don't get it.  I know tons of people who love the square slices here.  I finally tried it and it's pretty terrible imho...  a piece of bread with a little bland tomato sauce.. bleh. I'll take DiFara or any good thin crust any day..
friendly cashier.  i would come back.   ordered the pie with kale (forgot the name) and it was pleasantly huge! freshly baked!  awesome crust!  a little too salty due to the cheese.

After reading the reviews for this restaurant we decided to try out the food and see just how true the service is.  The reviews are right on. The food is amazing and prices make it even more appealing.  The service is exactly as it was reviewed.  We had a server who abruptly snatched our menus from us just to hand them to the diners in the booth besides us.  We all got a good laugh about that and were expecting something like this from what we read.  Overall, I enjoyed the time spent there, ate well and am looking forward to our next visit.
Didn't expect much from this place...but the food we had was delicious, the wine excellent (a recommendation from an excellent server). Dinner was low-key, scrumptious, with familial, helpful staff.

Linda's sells chewing tobacco to underage high school students. Ask any Pequannock high school student.  I have.  It's a dangerous and disgusting habit.  My child's friends have told me they go there and purchase with no ID required.
Really wonderful! Good prices, lots of amazing choices. A bit cramped if you're dining in, but get over it! Staff friendly and welcoming.

This place is fantastic! The paninis are so far beyond what I thought a panini could be. Absolutely delicious. We also got a great cheese plate and wonderful Austrian wine. The service was attentive and helpful. Highly recommended!

Food was ok; although the waitress was very friendly, it took FOREVER  to get our food.  Bathrooms are not really clean and didn't have soap that day, so servers didn't get to really wash their hands before touching the food.

This nicely attired place offers a fairly priced selection of food and drink. The choice between draft and bottled beer is extensive enough to satisfy most beer lovers. The various plates, while being attractively named, were somewhat flat in presentation and taste. Service was somewhat lacking when It came to refilling water glasses and following up on drinking and menu selections.

Sadly I came back on a Tuesday for their happy hour. Although the food was good, the service was awful. They wouldn't accommodate a large party and the hostess was rude. With so many places and choices in New York City they did very little to help out. Hence we went across the street where they were more than happy to accommodate. Will never come back back here for their happy hour.
Steak and cheese is incredible

Came here on a Sunday for the traditional Ichiju Sansai set meal breakfast.  We arrived around 10:30am and there was no wait at all.     We totally enjoyed the heartwarming meals prepared by the passionate cooking team.  They patiently explained their menu of the day, where the seafood were sourced, how the fish will be prepared, and all the hardly resistible add-on options.   We ended up getting black snapper and bluefin collar with the sashimi appetizer and Onsen eggs topped with uni.  The black snapper was light and delectable while the bluefin collar was rich and luscious.  Nothing can beat genuinely prepared food served by passionate good folks.   Would love to come back here again for ramen on a weekday when I am back to NY again. Note:  The storefront sign is "fish" in kanji in a bowl.

I was in NYC for business and decided to give this place a try based on Yelp reviews. I asked the server to recommend 2 apps and he picked: Chicken Tikka and Taash Kabab (lamb). Both were very good! I also had their special cocktail (evening in pippali) and an order of Nan. With tax and tip all this came to $44....the food was tasty (spicy but Not burn your lips hot) and the servers were very friendly. If you are looking for good Indian food on the lower East Side, this is a great spot to try.

One of the best restaurants in the area, I always try their specials which change daily and are made fresh, The chicken pot pie is to die for and they always have prime rib on the weekends. Their prices are great and the place is very cozy. The staff is friendly and attentive and remembers you the next time you go. The owners have done a great job with the renovations, it is immaculate!
Great food! With a trendy vibe! It's trendy and the service was great. I've eaten in a few of Bobby restaurant over the years and have never been disappointed.

I visited this restaurant last weekend with a group of friends. The food was OK, pretty generic and Americanized, but not bad. Also, our waitress was polite and helpful, though service was a bit slow. That being said, it was really overpriced for the quality. At the end of the meal a friend of mine had a Localvore Deal for the restaurant. The owner refused to honor it as she did not have a printed copy, even though she had the barcode and all numbers needed on her phone. In all fairness, the deal did say they must present a printed copy, but the owner's handling of this situation, with attitude and total dismissal of the fact that the point of the deal is to attract new customers, left a bad taste in my mouth at the end of the meal. Nothing about this place was worth the price and quite frankly I don't want to spend my money to support someone so unmotivated by customer service.
Nice food feels like home...I loved butter chicken and dal makhani.The owner is also very friendly...I recommend this restaurant to everyone...

Spectacular!!! You can not go wrong by dining at Lithos. The owner Chris and Mike are warm and wonderful and always welcoming to their guests. The food is beyond fresh. Fish shipped in daily! I hate feta cheese however this is the ONlY place that I LIVE for the feta! I eat it alone it is so melt in Your mouth good. I recommend the grilled eggplant with feta it is delicious. Actually everything I've eaten here has been terrific!
one of the best in philly...especially for late night runs
Decent enough but inconsistent delivery. Have gotten our complete order only once out of at least 7 attempts.

Okay, have to start by saying I love BBQ more then I love pools and paid days off and trust me there are not a lot of things on earth that eclipse pools and pdo's. Hometown is a great mix of fun and food. It was my first time so I wanted to try everything but everything is served by weight so had to be smart I tried the essentials: Order of sriracha hot wings, these things must be glazed in crack because I still think about camping out front for these delicious treats 1/4pd pulled pork, very juicy and full with flavor Half rack pork ribs, Mmmmm well seasoned good size and my girls favorite 1/4 brisket next I go I'm gonna bring Italian bread and stuff this in there with some grilled onions The pork belly tacos are delicious the taste is unique the seasoning is A+ Mac n cheese awwwesome very cheesy and hearty the pasta holds up to the cheese and they almost feel like they melt in your mouth u almost forget to chew The whisky sour pickles compliment the meats perfectly The collard greens are good considering that it has never been my favorite food I didn't leave any so must be good Finally the corn bread was great not dry or overdone but moist and tasty I loved it and my lady and I thing have a few pieces left over which is y I'm not bitching about the cost it wasn't cheap eating here but the food was delicious so can't blame them because they obviously take pride in what they put out so I'll blame it the govt and bankers for killing the dollar To top it off and this is the reason for the 5* rating in the 40 mins I was there the owner whose from brooklyn came over and check to see if we were enjoying our meals he sat a chatted for a sec and moved on this is something that I've only experienced out of state not in NYC. I loved the fact that the workers eat the food also that usually gives u confidence that they are not dirty and they weren't in a rush to run home which is why I got to meat the butcher who preps the meats for cooking he had been there 12 he's and took some time to have a drink at the bar where he and I had a relaxed convo

The gnocchi was good but the service was really disappointing. Perhaps it was because our table was squeezed tightly between two others, but our server barely spoke with us. We didn't hear about any specials--the first contact with our server was, "Ready to order?" It was frustrating when a couple were seated next to us to watch them hear about the specials--they sounded good! I had been excited about eating here, but we won't be back--there are so many little neighborhood BYOs that there's no need to repeat this experience.

Cheesesteak was pretty good, albeit this is quite a touristy place and I'm sure there are plenty of better places in town, maybe without the hype but good or even better. Went for one here followed by another at Pat's. I preferred Geno's bread, but was more a fan of Pat's steak which was filleted and just less dry, with more onions. And the dried red pepper gave it that oomph!!

My favorite saying at this place is "Spaten, Spaetzle, and a Prezel".... I love this place and the people who run it are amazing.  They have Karaoke Night, German Holidays, and the amazing Ridgewood Market happens here too This place is always fun and really does Gott Cheer !!

I'd never planned to go here intentionally, was just walking around my area in search of meat and ended up settling because I always forget that there aren't any damn restaurants this side of McGuinness. I've now eaten here four or five times, and save the last two, each time the menu was substantially different, which I can only assume had to do with chef-turnover or the wavering intentions of the owners (I tried coaxing more information out of the server I had last time, but the sneaky little minx was playing hard to get). But it seems they've finally settled on what they want their establishment to be. The restaurant is small with maybe five or six tables large enough for two people and a couple of larger tables in the windows, with some bar seating to boot. The space is predominantly bright woods and white, pressed tin, which is mostly calming, yet with a slight twinge of horror vacui. Only two chalkboards adorn the walls, which serve to notify you of their rotating draft/wine list and any specials they're currently serving (as a note on those chalkboards: whoever is in charge of writing on those things, I hate you for your beautiful handwriting). They've got a good number of plants, perhaps to allude to their exotic roots in place of hanging cheesy pictures of Indonesia. All in all, I enjoy the minimalist space, but if I had one real critique, it would be to lower the lights a few feet to match the intimacy of their table layout. Not an interior designer, but just sayin'. They have a pretty good selection of draft/bottled beer and cider (how rare!), and a modestly sized wine list as well. Everything I had paired well with the food. I'm surprised they don't have any liquor though, I feel a curated cocktail menu would do very well here. And now on to the food! For those unfamiliar with Indonesian fare, it's loaded with coconut, ginger, turmeric, lemongrass, kaffir lime (yes!), and some sort of medusa-root-thing called galangal. Oh, and lots of chili and spice. Come to think of it, it's a seemingly healthy cuisine. Their menu consists mostly of small plates, with a handful of larger dishes; the food is clearly meant to be shared. Most of the dishes I've had were somewhat spicy, but not in overbearing fashion, and the plating was always enticing and the portions fair (this isn't some cheap Chinese restaurant where $3 gets you a bucket of "fried rice"). All the flavors were well balanced and each dish had something unique to offer the palate. Their deviled eggs and spring rolls are so addicting I've ordered them nearly every time I've been in. Their mussels, served in a spicy coconut milk broth with something called cakwe (breadstick thing?), are truly fantastic, and their chicken wings are some of the best I've ever had. As for some of the larger dishes, the market fish curry (I've had it with both pollock and hake) and the beef rendang are both delicious and I can't recommend them enough. For sweets, they have some modified classics like coconut creme brûlée and lemongrass panna cotta. The servers have always been kind and attentive, and possess adequate knowledge of the menus, no complaints there. Altogether, Selamat Pagi is a humble little restaurant serving some fantastic Indonesian-inspired food. Definitely worth a try!
Horrible experience. Understaffed and bartender yelled at us after waiting fifteen mins for the bill. Do not recommend it
It's a nice place to sit down and eat. The staff is friendly. The chicken pot pie is so good and there's a lot of other comfort foods on the menu that I'm looking forward to trying

Very nice experience!!! Excellent food(timballo warm octopus salad,gnocchi and pizza served with their homemade spicy oil...A MUST) service attentive and a very pleasant atmosphere. Nice outdoor seating as well.,Missing the Italian classic apperitifs and digestifs(Campari grappa limoncello amaro etc)Maybe in the future.
Simple , greatly sourced items, Italian as close to home as I can get stateside. Really nice dinner. Great Italian wine list.
Great sauerkraut, potato and cheese pierogies, stuffed cabbage, and kielbasa. Good prices, too.
Have the BLT. You know you want to, and you are thinking 'boring... I should order something Exciting'. Stop. Order the BLT. Best meal I've had in the village.
Very good food, reasonable prices, the ambiance of a french bistro.
Il Panino.  Great sandwiches and service.  Hot or cold hero's. Specialty salads.  In the Calandra Mall on 46 east.

My girlfriend and I went to a concert over the summer at Newark Symphony Hall. We wanted a quick bite to eat before the show. A few blocks west of the theatre was Soul Food Chess House. The establishment was not fancy, its set up more for take-out orders more than dining in.  The owner took our orders, he was very friendly and helpful to answer any question we had about the menu items as well as portion sizes. We both ordered fried tilapia sandwiches on whole wheat bread. My friend and I decided to dine in b/c no food was allowed inside the theatre. Once seated, the owner introduced us to his wife, she told us she did all the cooking. The sandwiches were prepared in a timely manner; the fish was served crispy golden brown, nicely seasoned (not salty) and piping hot. The owner insisted we sample some of their side dishes as well. They then served us both nice size  samples of collard greens, candied yams, mac & cheese and potato salad. Everything was delicious and portions were worth the money! In my opinion quality supersedes quantity but at Soul Food Chess House you receive both. I will definitely patronize this establishment again. The only reason I didn't give 5 stars was due to the high traffic area of the location.

For starters, the menu is jacked in the sense that it doesn't tell you what comes on each burger. All you get to choose are the sizes, which are basically small, medium, and large. You then have to ask them what comes on it, so you can tell them what to take off. This makes for a very cumbersome conversation when ordering. My friend and I had to repeat our burger orders to the cashier three times before she felt like she had it down, and then a fourth time to the woman working the grill. And these were not complicated whatsoever. When our orders were finally complete, they got my friend's burger wrong and they forgot our drinks. We also had to go back and ask for condiments,we had already asked them to include. It would be so much simpler to start the burgers plain and allow the customers to build onto it, rather than starting with everything and working backwards, I'm just saying. Now, when it comes to the food, I'm split. The fries were actually quite good. However, the cheeseburger I had was really overcooked, dry and chewy. I had to smother it in ketchup just to keep it from getting stuck in my throat. I am shocked that a place billing itself as a destination for nothing but cheeseburgers could in fact, make such a poor tasting burger. Somebody needs to teach the cooks to go for a medium rare to solid medium rather than cooking the patties to more than well done.
Delicious sandwiches with a New Orleans and Southern touch! I tried the Fried Chicket Biscuit sandwich and the Veggie Muffaletta--both scrumptious! Nice guys behind the counter, too.

I've been to just about very Smith location and can't think of a single time that I've been disappointed with food or service.  Always very solid on both fronts.  Noise level is the only thing I would point to but I have never seen it as overly problematic.  This is my standard go-to for lunch and dinner with friends.

Probably the worst Chinese food I've ever had. Food arrived an hour later, cold and tasted horrible. Egg rolls were undercooked and the rest of the food was too salty and stale tasting. What a waste of money.. Most of the food ended up in the garbage so did there menu. Won't be needing that!

Really delicious! We just arrived Ravenous for a good meal after a long, cross country flight. Mercato byob is a charming, open air restaurant, and the waitress did warn us its tap water iin the chilled bottles. The chicken marsala my partner ordered was cooked to tenderness in a delicious sauce, however, it was served lukewarm. The pasta Special with  Lobster Mushrooms I ordered was truly wonderful and exquisitely seasoned, but after travelling all day I wanted more than eight (count them, eight) strips of pasta. Still hungry, I had to ask for more bread. We were not asked if everything was ok, we had to flag down a server, and my ice tea was not refilled. Not great service for $20+ per plate.

I had been craving authentic Falafel for about a month, I have eaten these regional foods state side, the Mediterranean and the Middle East. I saw the pics read the reviews and then a close friend who lives a Kosher life gave it 4.5 stars (his mom is a 6) so I was in the neighbor hood and remembered the name. I am glad I stopped in. the place is clean, the fragrance of spices and falafel being prepared in the back was a flash back. the staff friendly and the owners suggestion was a hit, ordered as authentic as I remembered and brought it home for my fiancee and I. craving filled, We will return.......Great job folks I wish you a hundred years of prosperity.

Vegetarians are not welcome here. Unless you're ready to take a walk on wild side. This place is for the meat lover. A few bites of what this well crafted menu offers will surely satisfy the carnivorous monster within. The Dinosaur Bar-B-Que features some of the best cuts of meat. There isn't a part of the cow they don't make use of. . They find the perfect blend of American BBQ !!!! Come hungry, leave full and satisfied.
Absolutely love the pizza here! , reminds me of the good old days, the prices are moderate and the selection are vast, definitely is the place to get a slice if you are around there.

Fried Chicken and the popovers drizzled with salt and honey they give you to start are to die for. Great to sit outside or in one of the window tables Incredible brunch Good wine list, nice beers on tap... Cant say enough good things.

Don't know who Sharon W. Is, but she wasn't at the same Piccolo Angolo as me. I've been eating here for years and the food and service are top notch. Sure, it's a little small and sometimes noisy, but that's where you find the best food in New York. I live on the Upper West Side and often go down to Hudson and Jane because that's where the best Italian food in all of New York City can be found!!! The portions are huge and should be shared  (hence the higher prices) and Maria and Peter are outstanding hosts. They take reservations (online and on the phone) and always honor them. I'll be going back next week!

Stopped in with a random hankering for tequila and tortillas. I had two margaritas and the pollo azteca.  Both were awesome, chicken was absolutely perfectly cooked. The service was perfect and I'm considering sleeping on a pillow of their warm tortillas and swimming in a sea of their verde. The guacamole was simple which I appreciate more than anything.  Simple and delicious. Fresh and bright.
Nice people , tasty food , cozy restaurant Sashimi was perfect. Just go (dont mind haters how can you give 1 start for this resturant i dont understant you hater) just go and see it your self
the best elote available in Philly

I loved this place! At first, I was somewhat overwhelmed with all of the different food vendors. I did not know where to start! Once I got passed that initial shock, I realized I was pretty much in food heaven. I ended up trying Dinic's Roast Pork and Beef, Dutch eating place, and the Beiler's (donuts). I was not disappointed at all. I plan on coming back and trying new places once I visit again
Chicken is amazing. From out of town. Saw all the reviews and had to go. Joe was great very welcoming and the food was amazing.

my favorite neighborhood restaurant for 10 years running.  just make sure you arrive at a slightly off time, otherwise the wait can be insanely long.   i've never had a bad time here or a bad meal.  my kids are addicted to the gnocchi.  their cookbook is great, too. i cook from it all the time.

Talk about bland cuisine. I ordered the lamb shank and it was tiny, rubbery and tasteless. The shank was served on a meager portion of "red skin mashed potatoes" (they were really from a box) and a can of Bush's baked beans, which weren't even heated up). It was disgusting. Oh yeah and it cost $22 dollars.

I haven't actually been into the restaurant but my boyfriend and I ordered dinner through Seamless. I got the Shaved Brussels Sprout Salad with Chicken on top and he got the Pollo al Limone. Both dishes were really tasty and best of all the delivery was so quick!
The crab rangoons are very good and the portions are huge but the pork fried rice is so bland with no flavor and the chicken with cashews is not good either, also lacking flavor. Too bad
Veggie bomb all the way!! Reasonably priced, delicious, quick service, "healthy" - so happy to live in the same neighborhood as Modern!
One of my favorite spots downtown. Great atmosphere, amazing food and attentive service. Definitely worth a try.

If only it didn't get so loud this would be a five star place for me. Starting out with the great raw bar - I'm a sucker for oysters and they have not only a good variety of both east and west coast oysters they always seem to be fresh. The entrees are excellent as well with nice pairings of fresh vegetables. I'm particularly fond of the way they do scallops but I've never been disappointed with any of their fish or seafood dishes. I must admit that I have not had much in the way of meat here but that is not what I come here for. It is also a BYO which is a big plus for me. Now if they could just find a way to make it a bit quieter.....
My husband and I celebrated our 2nd anniversary here. the garden is extremely romantic. The staff is excellent. We highly recommend the cheese plate.
I love that place!
The food is phenomenal; well crafted, balanced, and nuanced. I am in love. ... The service, however,  is typical Williamsburg.

It is strange people have given such great reviews but not rated so well. I have been here a few times during my business visits to Hartford. I absolutely love the place. The ambience is decent compared to the rest of the joints around. The food is great. I love Thai Basil fried rice and Tom Yam. They are the best I have eaten in a long time. The service is friendly. I have not tried the bar though!

The food is very good. Italians (like actually from Italy with the accent and the cooking skills) are here making the food. Servers are friendly. It's cash only. Organic eggs, good bread, grass-fed meat. Only drawback is the bathroom situation, but it's understandable.

I've been here a few times and I have tried both their sweet and savory crepes. Service is quick and the cashiers are very friendly! I have tried the strawberry banana Nutella, grilled chicken with honey mustard, and buffalo chicken style crepes there. The least I can say about this location is that they are VERY GENEROUS with their ingredients. The crepes are filled with flavor, and the first bite is all inclusive of the ingredients that compose the crepe.  There is plenty of everything: vegetables, proteins, sauce, fruits, you name it! (Depending on the crepe you order of course) Everything is prepared right in front of you via an open kitchen, from the technique they use to disperse the crepe batter to garnishing. It is bestowed onto awaiting customers as soon as the item is ready. The crepe is hot and crispy and the ingredients are cooked perfectly.  My personal preference is for the savory crepes, only because I don't have much of a sweet tooth. I like to eat the end first (pointed part) to accommodate the avalanche of sauce these crepes appear with.  The filling is dispersed well as each bite contains a little bit of something. Very balanced. All in all, I have not had a single bad food experience for the multiple times I have been here. Definitely recommend to university city dwellers!

This was a great dinner.  I am not from around here, but Scott was my server and he had great beer recommendations and knew the entire menu for great suggestions.  I highly recommend anyone check it out as I had an amazing swordfish dinner over mashed potatoes and a great crafted specialty draft beer:)

From California so we come across a lot of Korean BBQ joints. Looked this place up to set up our itinerary for our trip to NY and was so excited to see that there was a Korean spot next to the Empire State Building! Very clean and a large beautiful space to sit down and enjoy your meal! Food was perfect! I finished my tofu soup which I never usually do and the meat was just right and rich in flavor! I ordered the L1 lunch special BBQ ribs which I highly recommend! Enjoyed my lunch so much I decided to write a review once we finished and I hardly every write reviews so this is a definite must after some sightseeing!

Had a good time out with friends. The food was good, typically bar fare offerings. We tried the nachos, eggplant sticks, and poutine for apps. Poutine and nachos were really good! Eggplant sticks were avg. For dinner three of us had burgers, one had steak. Everything was great! Burgers come with two patties. Alone complaint is that draft beer could've been a little colder. Tried the Box 63 ale and it was good. What surprised me was someone had ordered a beer at the bar and changed their, so one of the managers walked around looking to see who was due for a drink. Well that person was me and he gave me a free beer. Most places would just pour it down the drain. Def will be going back!
Great service and innovative meals.  Fairly small portions and a bit pricey.

The waitresses were not helpful in explaining the menu. We had some fatal communication errors and she brought out a dish with peanuts despite me telling her that I am allergic, and asking if there wasn't anything nut related. Glad that my date tried the food before I did or else I may have had a serious problem on my hands. The ambiance is great though, very traditional feel about the place. I know it's weird to compliment the bathroom, but it was actually really cool with some appliances that seemed to have come straight from japan! I think this place is as others have mentioned, exceptional. I may have had a bad experience due to the server, but this is something that the restaurant must be very cautious of, in order to avoid allergic reactions. I would hate for this issue to repeat it self again.

This place was so nice! The food was great and so was the service. The only downside is we had to wait a bit even with having a reservation. That atmosphere they set was very intriguing especially with the movies projected onto the brick walls. Would definitely go back again!
Read the review by our local Long Island City residents! longislandcityqueenstv.b…

What a little gem!  Found this place while driving up to my mother-law's house from Virginia.  She lives in Poughkeepsie so we still had a little ways to go when we decided to see what was near by that we hadn't had before. OMG!!  The food was delicious....much more than we could eat at one serving, the prices were reasonable, they were pretty busy and the food came out quickly.  Oh, and did I mention they were friendly too?  Definitely will be looking to stop there again on a future trip!
I been to many Thai  restaurants!!! By far this is my FAVORITE! Excellent food, good prices, and great service! #1 pad Thai in New Jersey.
Best meal I have had since I moved to Long Island city.  Food was delicious and delivery was quick.

Very good place to hangout, they play nice music too. However,  when I got there with my gf, I had to wait 19 minutes  approximately for the bartender to come ask us what we need, but she would ask other people she knew, hug them, a customer waiting is more important than all those things, we almost left, but we really liked the place. She would not smile,  not friendly at all, very rude. But the vibe is excellent there. Sorry 3 stars only for the poor service.

Yum! Yum! Yum! I had never explored the world of kati rolls until my boyfriend took me here to try an "Indian burrito." I love the achari paneer roll, it's my favorite. It has this amazing spicy tang and is a must try! Spice end is a great option for something quick and delicious or/take-out. Oh and definitely try Limca, it's a  citrus Indian soft drink. I'm not much of a soda drinker but it's definitely a nice refreshing treat.
I have to make excuses to myself to not come here so often. While the menu selction is small, everything is delicious. No more trips to NYC to get my Ramen fix!
The food was AMAZING and VERY affordable.... The service was awesome too!! I highly recommend!!
Delish pie after touring NYC. Great service and food from the first pizzeria. We really enjoyed the experience

Han is a pioneer Sichuan food restaurateur in the Phila area! This is evidenced thru this meteoric rise in the greater Phila area, and now in NYC's east village. Every item on the menu is meticulously prepared and served with the right amount of spice and flavour! He often hosts a tasting dinner for a set price, where a patron can sample all his top dishes. Top notch items include - Dan Dan Noodles, Cumin Chicken, Wonton in Chili Oil and the ever spicy Dry Fry style! If you chance upon Han Chiang, the eponymous owner, do engage him in a conversation - mighty interesting chap!
This is simply the best. If you don't like it, disrespect yourself.
Great place. Loved their food. I had fantastic service and the prices were very reasonable.

I always wanted to stop in this restaurant for months.  I finally went today with my husband and son. My son and  I ordered the shrimp Pad Thai and my husband ordered the Seafood platter/stew (forgot the name); for dessert- the fried banana with ice cream, which was also very delicious. The service was great, the waitress kept checking on us to ensure we were comfortable.  The decor is impressive, and the restaurant is larger than what it appears outside. I'm so glad I found  good place to eat authentic Thai food,  and it's close to home !
This place - food wise - is extremely mediocre. It's not worth the money they charge.
Fantastic place. The taste is great and price is very reasonable. It's definitely one of the best Korean restaurants in town.
The dim sum here is right up there with NYC Chinatown.
Food was horrible when I went. The pancakes weren't even good.
We just had take out pizza but it was absolutely delish! I would most definitely go back!

Wow, This Place Is Hopping! What a great place; fantastic food, great atmosphere and décor, full of energy, and amazing drinks. Knowing that they just opened, I expected some rough spots, but found none. I had the buttermilk fried chicken sandwich and it was out of this world. Flavors were spot on and the roll was the best I have ever had. The fried artichokes were ridiculous, and I could have eaten 3 plates of the bacon wrapped jalapenos. Saw the two reviews below and couldn't have been more surprised because that is not the experience I had at all. Everyone in my party loved their food and had a great time. Seemed like everyone else in the place was as well; line out the door and the bar area packed!

The Blue Cat is consistently good. The steak is the best in Burlington and the wine is moderately priced. The atmosphere is very quaint, great for a romantic night out or a nice family dinner (not with young kids). I would highly recommend.

10/4/14   Sadly,  they have changed the recipe for their "thin crust"  gluten free pizza and it's extremely disappointing  --- not thin crust at all.  I hope they'll go back to their previous recipe because this isn't at all  what they used to make.   Its heavy and no longer has the crispness that made it the best gluten free pizza in New York.

The best kebabs I've ever had my friend Kobi brought me here on a cold dark night he was nervous about all the baklava but I told him don't be nervous about all the baklava you don't have to eat any if you don't want but he said but I love baklava. We ended up getting the kebabs they were delicious I would recommend the lamb the fish was good as well. My friend Kobi ultimately ended up getting the baklava. he loves sweets.

I have been a regular of Benjamin's Steakhouse, Sea Fire's sister, since 2009. In July of this year I stopped in with friends for drinks and desserts one night and then for a birthday sinner in September. The restaurant itself is beautifully decorated, classy, quiet but NOT STUFFY. From the front door to your wait staff you are put at ease and made to fell very welcome. I will admit, I am not a seafood person at all. However, Sea Fire has a Rib Eye Steak that was amazing. It came out very hot & very juicy with a little char on it. The Chef was able to and kind enough to make a side of potatoes for me like they have at Benjamin's but not on the menu at Sea Fire. I highly recommend you ask if they would do the same for you as that is a great side for the Rib Eye and they are cooked to perfection. The desserts are all made in house and if you don't get the cheesecake with the graham cracker crust you are missing out for sure. As fantastic as the food is at Sea Fire, the only thing that can top it is their staff. If you look up the word Prenominal you will see words like, remarkable, exceptional, incredible, unbelievable and extraordinary. With that I can safely say their staff is Phenomenal! From the greeting at the front door, to the bussers, it appears that each employee is a part owner. They take great care of each guest. Too often I see at restaurants where staff members will pass your table without even looking at you. I was at another place in NY during the same weekend and my server appeared to have gotten lost or something so I had to ask two other people for refills and each said they would try to find my server to take care of that. At Sea Fire, without being intrusive, it doesn't matter what their position is, they are there to help you. I must single out Besar, the bar back who was very helpful and professional. You can tell, even as a bar back, the management has trained him very well and instilled in him "treat the customer well." The Sea Fire Grill is a MUST while you are in New York and you have a taste for an amazing Rib Eye or Sea Food. To me, their made in house cheesecake is worth the trip alone. Thanks to Victor, Besar, Lena and the entire staff at Sea Fire for a great experience and we will see you again very soon.
Great food and nice staff.  Very attentive.  All fresh ingredients and nice sized portions.  Would definitely go again

I took my partner there for his birthday and we LOVED the entire experience. They were so packed we had to wait about 10 minutes past our reservation but it was fine. We split the risotto as an appetizer and I had the spicy corn soup as my entree. Everything was phenomenal and our waitress was very attentive and nice. He had a very nice birthday and we will definitely return to the Writing Room again. 2 entrees, an app and a bottle of red for $118 so it was a bit pricey but it was completely worth it.
The food was good and I enjoyed the watermelon mojitos.  There's nothing spectacular about the establishment. It has decent food and good customer service.

The food was average, and the service is awful. Do not come to this place for their "unlimited" brunch drink special. The time limited is not advertised anywhere whatsoever on the menu, so it is basically either a) arbitrarily defined by your very slow server or b) 90 minutes (I guess) assuming that it is the customer's responsibility to look it up on Yelp. There are way better truly unlimited brunch places in NYC with at least 2 hours of bottomless drinks. This place is a rip off.

They are our Chinese go to! Fresh, flavorful, perfectly seasoned. Deliveries are super fast with awesome, courteous drivers grinning ear to ear, handing the food over proudly. Non greasy, awesomeness. Wish they would offer Groupons or menu coupons.

This place wasn't too bad. We had several things from the menu, none of which can I remember except for the fried green tomatoes that were excellent. The rest of the food was okay. I am not a huge fan of tapas. I prefer to order my plate of food instead of 5 tiny plates and share!

I had such a great time here.  The service was top-notch!  We were treated like celebrities.   There were at least 6 people waiting on us, all with character and charisma.   The bartender made personalized drinks.  The wine selection was great- mmm... Sancerre!  The chef kept surprising us with little treats, starting with the most delicious soup in an espresso cup.  The presentation was creative and artistic.  The night time view of Hartford- exciting! From starters to finish- perfection!
Good place for Mexican food. Everything was really fresh, the guacamole is a must it was really good. Accommodating for vegetarians. Place is really clean.
I have been going here for seventeen years ,always great food and great srevice , staff is number one. This is my favorite place.
Highly Over rated...

Today we saw this place at the magic hat octoberfest and decided to try it tonight as lines were long everywhere else. Food was amazing. Big props to KATELYNN at the register. She was so nice and helpful as I think I was a pain in the butt. Will hopefully go back again.
I had eggs at this location. My meal was very good. The wait service was not the best which is why I didn't give it 4 stars. The food is good though.

Pat's is only good when you're drunk at 2am and the bars closing. The steaks are average at best and the only really good item on the menu is the fries wit cheese. The staff are usually miserable with less than stellar attitudes. This place is only for tourists and not where real Philadelphians prefer to grab a cheesesteak. Good luck tourists!!
Super fast to-go, great food, good prices. Hard to beat that! Open 24 hrs is awesome, too!

Been coming here for a while now- one of my favorite restaurants in Brooklyn. Food is consistently delicious, and service is friendly and efficient. I've never had a bad plate here, and the lamb meatballs and margarita cubes alone are worth a visit!
Best calamari pasta hands down. We sat at the bar and bartender Jacob was so friendly & recommend other places in the city to visit. Great experience, I'll be back soon!
They consider their crepe presentation as an art! Very cute asian style crepe located near little Italy and Chinatown. Green tea ice cream with sweet red bean is a must!!

I usually am only inspired to leave a review when a place is off the charts amazing OR just absolutely had a horrible experience usually more with the service than anything else. This was neither but felt compelled to review as SO MANY PEOPLE rave about the sandwiches. The lines were huge people were excited to order. After reading the reviews and seeing all this I was REALLY excited for our meal. We ordered the pork with sharp provolone an brocolli rabe and a brisket with sharp prov and sweet peppers. The service was great. Atmosphere great. The sandwiches. Decidedly not great. Just really far from great. Bread was fantastic but all else was just really underwhelming. I'd felt like I wasted a meal. So my review is that. Wanted to love it. Didn't.

Great service but the food wasn't as great as I thought. I was expecting some good greasy indulgent gastropub delights! But they were all dry, bland, and well....boring. We got the Brussels sprouts, loaded waffle fries, pastrami dog, and an Italian sausage.

So my sister and I got a large Margherita pie, and the pizza was just okay. Nothing phenomenal. I particularly had an issue with the sauce - it could use a little more flavor. No doubt that the food tasted fresh and the crust was thin and crispy, but I guess I was expecting a lot more. I'd prefer the Prince St. Pizza over this.

Exceptionally nice staff. Amazing food. The brunch was delicious. BBQ ribs and cheese grits. Holy crap. The pizzas are great too, as are the desserts (get the dessert empanadas - flavor explosion). Price is very reasonable as well given the quality of the food, the excellent service and beautiful setting. They even gave us a little chicken shaped timer with our French press coffee. How can you lose? Great work AWOL, we shall be returning.

The chicken kabob platter is really great here, and reasonably priced.  But don't order delivery from here.  My roommates and I have ordered from here many times and a lot of times they forget to include part of the order.  This time I called to let them know part of the order was missing.  They said they'd send the missing part and I waited half an hour, without a delivery person showing up.  I called the restaurant again and the manager argued with me and said I was lying, when clearly, part of the order, which I had already paid for, was not included. I finally got the rest of the order after waiting 45 minutes after my first call.  The food here is great, so I wish I could give a great review, so go in person- don't bother with delivery- it's not worth the hassle.

This is my fourth time at this place and the service/food has always been the same. Spectacular! The servers are always very friendly and helpful. The ambience is so down to earth and homey! The huevos rancheros is the way to go for the Sunday breakfast menu!!! The corned beef hash is amazing too and so is the Italian omelette! This is my fav breakfast spot! Waayyyyy better than Ihop or Denny's!

Soul Good!!! Collard greens, cornbread, mac & cheese, fried chicken, just amazing!!! I understand why this place has been around for 10 plus years! Great food, good service, and causal atmosphere. Wait, and the music!  The music made the experience just a little more comforting and enjoyable!
