This is Vietnamese food for people who aren't Vietnamese/like authentic Viet food.  I tried Banh Mi, Pho, and Cha Gio.   The Cha Gio (fried spring roll) didn't even come with fish sauce.  It came with a tangy soy sauce.  The lettuce, which you usually wrap the roll with looked like decoration on the plate, not like usable lettuce. The bread on the sandwich was extremely hard but not in the good way.  I don't know where they get their bread, but it's not great.  The meat tasted like it was freshly made, but it was missing a ton of flavors.  There were no onions, no peppers, and the buttery mayo that usually goes on banh mi was missing. The pho was all right. Everything was quite pricey, most likely due to location.  $8 for pho. $8 for banh mi. Also, Saigon Shack is CASH ONLY.
I love this restaurant literally am always going here and referring ppl to this spot. I absolutely love their food just hate the fact that its just cash only.

I was excited to have Dimitri back after Table 8 closed.  The menu and service was really lovely tonight.  We shared the dates appetizer and had hanger steak entree which was perfect and Black and white sesame crusted tuna..also perferct.  The fudge brownie flight to share really topped it off!             Welcome to Upper Montclair..we will be back many times!

My boyfriend and I head here semi-frequently when we're in the mood for a few beers and some awesome snacks (shishito peppers and wings are to die for!!) but tonight's experience really set itself apart from the usual good food and good service. Our server was Bryan and he was awesome, he was extremely polite and professional from beginning to end. He had great recommendations when a few things we wanted weren't available ( totally understandable for a sunday night) and was great about checking in on us and making sure we had what we needed. He even went out of his way to catch us on our way out to let us know about a discount we could use for our next visit. I have never once been disappointed in the food or service here but tonight was definitely above and beyond.

Omg! The food is ROCKING up in here.... Let's just say it's seasoned well... If you have high cholesterol or diabetes ... You shouldn't be eating this good anyway... I had the whiting,cabbage, and yams...My honey had turkey chops,collards,and Mac n Cheese...this is a diamond in the rough... Don't judge a book by its cover......we will be returning....
Went here with my roommates last week and had some of the best tacos in NYC by far! Serving sizes were huge and the staff was very friendly. Glad we stumbled on this place!

In short I recommend it, a very fine place.   In more details, one can enjoy a variety of excellent organic healthy food prepared in front of you on the grill.  While you wait there are many kinds of shakes that you may try and they are fleshly made in front of you.   After a delicious meal, you must their coffee it is outstanding.  At the end one can just walk over the adjacent place and relax smoking a hookah.  :-) What an enjoyable evening.

DiNics is Da Sh*t !!!!! I saw this place in Reading Terminal and knew I would like it before I even tasted the food. My thought was "HOW IN THE WORLD DID I GROW UP IN PHILADELPHIA AND NOT KNOW ABOUT THIS PLACE!" Shame on me! So I was in town, going on a food tour and heard about it. Went there the next day and took it all in. Cooked meats with a line of people ready to order. The prices were very reasonable and what folks eating at the counter looked great. There was a wait for things that was greatly alleviated by the server who took our orders before we got to the register. By the time I paid, my pork & broccoli rabe sandwich was ready. It was delicious ! I should have had it wilh BBQ sauce but that was OK. It was that good! I'm a fan! I'll be back for sure ! If you read this, you need to go too !

Incredibly overpriced food poisoning. That's really all I can say! Our group of four was unimpressed with each of our four mains and three starters - especially for the price. We should've known when there were so few people around on a Saturday night. And I've been violently ill since!
The DJ on Friday nights rocks the house!  The crowd is mixed and casual trendy.  The drinks are inexpensive and the vibe is chill mode.  Good times!

Cheese Grill (which is the new official name) is the perfect addition to the Lower East Side neighbourhood. Between the delicious food, great selection of local beers and wines, excellent prices, and (the best) staff, this new establishment deserves far more than 5 stars. I highly recommend the Crispy Goat sandwich. If you have a sweet tooth, the brioche with banana and mascarpone cheese is simply heavenly. You couldn't ask for a more attentive and friendly staff (shout out to Mike!), who are also very knowledgeable about wines. They truly make you feel very welcome and the ambiance has that community/homey feel. It also has a chill vibe (almost reminds me of some cool places in Santa Monica, CA), and on top of it they have a great music playlist! I live in the LES area and I know Cheese Grill is going to be my new watering hole. I'm craving the Crispy Goat right about now!
Hands down favorite place in Philly. Had the Ouovo Pizza, Gnocci, Beet salad and Bronzino. Food=10.. Drinks=10 Service =10. Go here. It won't disappoint.
Great for private events. The garden is very beautiful, the food is delicious and the people are nice and helpful. The menu is a good balance of French and American food.

I seem to be the only reviewer who didn't think this place was out of sight. I went when it first opened (and took out the fried shrimp and crab roll) and my husband went the other night and took out (fish tacos and shrimp quesadilla) - but both times I was disappointed. Plus, I had an upset stomach after both meals. Sorry - I'm not returning after these two strikes outs.

I was so glad to see a cheese tray when I sat down as I figured when in Vermont I should have some cheese/dairy!  it was delicious and hit the spot.  I also got the meatballs which I didnt even finish, not appetizing at all.  I had a glass of wine as I dont really enjoy beer and wish i had room for pizza as it looked delicious from what I saw other ppl eating.  Service was okay, i asked to move to the bar when some seats opened (was at a bar table) and was denied (3 loud guys near me) but that's no big deal other than I would have stayed and had another glass of wine or dessert if I felt more welcome.

Love this place. My fiancée lives right next to it and we always stop in for a drink and dessert. Their sandwiches are delish and we recently tried their brunch which blew us away! We've only ever had amazing times at this place and love the vibe here. Ask them for their picklebacks!! Nothing hits you quite like a shot of Jameson and a chaser of pickled beet juice.
great customer service & fresh seafood. appropriate portion sizes. loved: soft shell crab, lobster roll and oysters. don't leave without having a slice of their key lime pie!

Worth the wait! We had reservations for 8pm on a Monday night for my birthday and the table we were waiting for had lingering ladies. The manager/host assured us we would be well taken care of. And that we were! Service was outstanding and attentive, food was prompt and exquisite, and I will absolutely be back! Thank you to the entire staff who made my birthday extra special.
Food was great but not as amazing as we expected. We like the skirt steak a lot. The staffs are very friendly and restaurant atmosphere is great.

Big fan of this place and would come back again and again and again.  Sure the pickles are amazing, but there is so much more.  I would highly recommend the biscuits with an assortment of jellies and butter for an appetizer, as well as the turkey leg dinner with mashed potatoes and cranberry sauce for an entree.  Simply heavenly.  Get the bread pudding for dessert, then go to the gym the next day so you don't feel bad. Jacob runs a great place that I would recommend anyone going to.
We ate breakfast -- pancakes and sausages.  Delious! !!!! Service is a little slow but atmosphere and food make up for it.

We choose this restaurant because it was given 4 stars on this app. The food was disappointing. The beet salad had to be sent back because it had no beets. The shrimps were chewy. The coffee was bitter. The service was friendly but that's the only good thing I can say.

Why of course I had to check out this place when I'm in NYC. After all, 6000ish review... We ordered: - Hirata Chicken Wings = crispy with glazed pepper sauce. Typical. - Hirata Buns = I'm all about pork buns. Yummio! Get it. - Akamaru Modern = well-balanced broth, too bad I'm not fond of the thin noodles. - Shiromaru Hakata Classic = simple classic bowl of ramen. Delicious broth that is not overly salty. Great ambiance, great service, and great comfort food. I hope you give this place a try. Cheers!

I'm so glad I looked on Yelp and found the Breakroom when we were exploring NYC. We all had Tacos - and these were amazing. The steak was tender, and the pico de gallo was just right. These guys have go to be some of the friendliest in the city.  Truly enjoyed the quick meal.

Came here for a friends birthday on Saturday. The drinks and beers here are phenomenal to say the least. I had then cucumber basil gin drink which was amazing, I could drink those like water! The one down side is the place is kinda small so if you have a large group it's hard to coordinate but this is a great place for small groups. Will definitely be back!

OMG!!!! I love Ruby's! This place is tiny and have only several tables.I brought my friends to here, and I never fail to satisfy my friends. You will have to wait on lunch or dinner time, but this place is so worth to wait. Get the Bronte burger or shrimp pasta.
Better than Cullen. Fresh salmon and roasted veg made a perfect $10 lunch. I will be back.

The food and the service are excellent. But what you can't get many places is the ambience of their outdoor garden. It's at a prominent Passyunk corner, but not noisy and you don't feel like passersby are leaning over your shoulder. It's shady in the evening and on a summer night it's heaven.

I was recently visiting NY from DC when I asked a friend of mine who is a bit of foodie which restaurant he would recommend.  My requirements included great, honest food with a twist and he recommended The Gorbals.  Needless to say, he knows his food!  My friends and I were NOT disappointed.  The food was amazing, the staff was attentive, friendly, and very helpful.  The menu is highly creative (one might even say irreverent, which I loved) but the execution is nothing more than genius! Although everything was great (and we had a lot of dishes),our table's favorites were the Falafel-crusted sweet breads and the lamb ribs with crunchy raspberries but don't stop there.  You MUST try the sticky toffee pudding.  I'm not a big fan of bread pudding but this one will delight every sense of your palate (sweet, salty and spicy).  Good luck in guessing where the spice is coming from.  Highly recommended!

Blvd Bistro what a nice restaurant. Went on a Sunday for brunch. The place is small and intimate. Met some of the staff who came over to day hello and welcome us to the establishment.  Ordered the Shrimp and Grits. Never have I had such creamy grits. The shrimp was cooked just right. Their famous biscuits were good but loved the butter to put on them. Definitely will be back to try dinner!
I came here for restaurant week with a friend and we both loved everything. I still have dreams about the tiramisu. Will definitely come back.

Great Expectations by Charles Dickens's ....well no.... actually by me ...had great expectations about this upscale Mediterranean restaurant which was disappointing. The first thing understaffed, not that friendly except for a girl called gayathri i guess ( she was very sweet) so obviously due to low staff waiting time is more. The quality of the food was not any great then a normal $ Mediterranean restaurant actually they are better and for that cost their portion size is way ..way ...did i mention way too less. will not go there again

I have been coming to this diner since I was a kid! The great food along with the staff is what I keep coming back for, the owner Jorge is a treat in itself and he can cook up a storm!! On most days during lunch he'll give u a taste of whatever he's cooking while you wait for your order off of their extensive menu! Some of my favorites are hands down the beef brisket with mash potatoes, tuna melts and the vodka penne with chicken which is to die for! Try one of their Greek dessert specialties to top off your meal and you too will be coming here for years to come!
Favorite neighborhood coffee shop... have to try the apricot/almond scones!!

My Sushi experience is limited to only California and this place in New York. By far this is the best I've had in terms of quality and flavor of the fish.  I ordered the Sushi and Sashimi combination to get a range of the fish and it's flavors.  My girlfriend asked for the chef's recommendations with a budget in mind. We were not disappointed.  Presentation was excellent.  The detail and quality of all ingredients used were second to none for me.  From the soy sauce to the wasabi. All very subtle and did not overpower the taste of the fish. Our server was very accommodating. My mind was blown.   My standouts from the experience in which all selections were amazing: -Fresh Eel Sushi -Toro Sushi -Scallop Sashimi -Blue Fin Tuna Sashimi Now I can't wait to take the next step and go to Japan.  If Japan is not in your future, try this place.  Definitely make a reservation!

Am only sorry I had not tried the Palace sooner!!!  Walked in for the first time today, and was treated to the tasting tour - which only made me want to order EVERYTHING they gave me to sample!!! Before you even walk thru the door, the smells great you from 50 feet away, enticing you, and assuring you that you are in for a delicious experience.   I wound up going with the Fiesta Chopped Chicken special - a party in your mouth!! Full of flavour, spicy (but not overwhelming), a generous portion (took home half of it for my husband to sample!).  Slightly pricey for lunch, but worth every penny, especially considering the amount of food. Too many good choices on the menu to know what I will try next - but I look forward to my next visit....perhaps lunch tomorrow???

Thought the food was pretty good. Not as good as I expected from reading reviews. I opted not to take my leftovers. I really thought the coffee could have been better. The service was not that great, I felt like we had to flag someone down when we needed something. I went 7/31, it was nice out but dark inside. I was really hoping to like this place. I would go again to see if my experience was an exception. Hey, Im an optimist!

Yummmyyyy.  I dropped by here for a dinner with my boyfriend on a Saturday night.  We sat down, ordered steamed dumplings for an app, and ordered two udon bowls- one with shrimp tempura and fried chicken, the other with beef and egg.  First off, we were a bit worried from the reviews that said service was slow.  However, this was DEFINITELY not the case.  The food came out in less than 10 minutes after ordering.  We probably got our udon bowls immediately after we finished eating the appetizer, which was definitely less than 5 minutes after receiving it.  Secondly, the food we got was just what we were hoping for.  The steamed dumplings took us by surprise because we imagined getting gyoza, but obviously we didn't order that.  No problem there though because these were delicious and the wasabi it came with was a great addition.  Our two udon bowls were different but delicious in their own ways.  I like that the beef was actually shredded because it added tons of flavor to the broth and became almost like a soupy stew.  The tempura/chicken udon bowl was also really good, especially because of the friend chicken taste.  I was definitely iffy about that when we ordered, but after trying it, I was a fan.  I'll be back here for sure!

WOW I'm so glad that I finally decided to give this place a try!!! it's been right beside my school this whole time and I have never even went in! Now I'm pretty sure i will be going there very often! This place is adorable! especially with the wood wall decors! both very industrial and rustics! it's very clean and the staffs are very helpful and nice! I actually ordered the salmon, but for some reason, the cashier thought i was getting the Kruveet. I was sad at first when i found out there were no protein in it. BUT I aint even mad..... because IT WAS SO GOOD! SO TASTY!PACKED WITH FLAVORS! I ordered it with quinoa, and it was topped with hummus and tahini spreads. THE FOOD COMPLETELY BLOWED MY MIND BY HOW TASTY IT WAS
My favorite restaurant in Philadelphia.  Food is delicious, staff are super friendly, and prices affordable.  Make sure to check out this place more than once.
Extremely cool atmosphere and the best pad Thai I've ever eaten. The spring rolls were amazing as well. I recommend you get the pad Thai medium heat and then get hot sauce on the side.

Great place in Brooklyn when your craving Ramen! Pork bone Ramen broth is great and don't forget to ask for the garlic chili oil which gives it that extra kick, the Kale salad is great also.  I recommend this place!!

Yeah, despite its small size, the ambience of this restaurant is just right.  You certainly need to make your reservations well in advance, though. It was fun to try a number of items off the menu and they were all heaven-sent.
excellence! food here makes me wanna comeback! yeah service can be better but I don't go there for service I just leave a bad tip.
Thanks for the feedback Marco. I hope I can enjoy a spritz with my pizza soon. Good luck with the upgrade.

I've only been to Peony Pavillion once...was excited to go as I love asian food.  Decent menu.  But I was completely shocked to have ordered soba noodles and got egg noodle instead.  When I questioned this the waitress insisted it was soba...I was with a group of people and didn't want to send anything back...but it was so disappointing.
Great french onion soup! Recommend this place for a quick bite. Cute for couples and comfortable atmosphere to enjoy alone.
We had dinner at the Hourglass Tavern again on Sept. 24th. A late dinner after a show , everything was perfect as usual !!!!!  Great food and great service !!!!! You will not be disappointed !!!

If you don't like this place, I don't like you. Everything is tasty. They use lots of garlic. The waiters dress formal and are consummate professionals. They use white linen. There is free parking across the street. They are generous with a pour of the Spanish Rioja. They make the flan in house. I can't imagine being in Newark, and not visiting Spanish tavern.
Love this restaurant . Cold appetizer plate is outstanding. I also love the Iskender kebab, delicious ! I'll be visiting this establishment very often.

This place is as good as everyone says it is!! I was craving indian for lunch so decided to drop by and give it a go. They have a good lunch indian buffet but I wanted something specific so ordered off the menu. The paneer tikka masala and onion kulcha was delicious and they even brought me water while I was waiting even though I had takeout. The sauce was one of the best I've had with the right coconut to be sweet. Yumm. Good atmosphere and service. Food was a little pricey otherwise this place would have been five stars! I will definitely be going back there for lunch again soon. I had enough food for leftovers the next day too.
Aside from the long waiting time and crowded front door, food is excellent. OK servers (most of the time), and incredible food.

This place only takes cash.  It's set up funny, because it mostly looks like a coffee shop from the outside.  Do not come with more than 4 people if you're going in at a busy time, for the other customers' and the restaurants' sake.  The food is really good and although it's a very open restaurant, conversations can still be private.

From the outside this place looked a lot more expensive than it actually was. It was very affordable, fair portions, fantastic sourdough bread served before the meal, and our waiter was just wonderful. Between 2 people we ordered a caesar salad with chicken, a margarita pita (an appetizer) and truffle fries. We split everything and it was satisfying, yet not too heavy. Our bill came out to about $30, $15 per person. So affordable, so delicious, and really great service. This place is definitely one of the best in my book.

My fiancé and I were staying in Quechee, VT. On a Saturday night we were looking for a nice restaurant to go to and after reading all of the positive reviews of Elixir we decided to check it out.   Parking was an issue because of a very popular fashion show happening next door, which the owner of Elixir told us about.  As soon as we walked in he welcomed us.  The restaurant itself is very unassuming, but once you try the food you regret not knowing about this place sooner!   The food was AMAZING! We ordered the large mussel appetizer with its delicious sauce.  For our entrees my fiancé got the scallops and I got the filet mignon.  They were both so delicious!  The scallops were the most amazing thing I've ever had!!  For desert we had creme brûlée, which was very good.  We only wish they had fresh fruit to serve with it.  Other than that everything was amazing! The food and drinks are also very reasonable priced.  I highly recommend this place. Funny thing was that when we first walked in I overheard 2 different tables mention how delicious their dinner was and whenever the owner walked by, they would thank him for it.  For me this was a good sign as I was initially worried whether we made the right choice for dinner.  If we are ever in the area again we will definitely be going back!

I especially like the meze platter , and I got the lamb shish kebab with shepherd salad. Kebab was ok but salad was so bad.they should do daily, and try to do look better. Baklava has a too much syrup. Service was ok.

Small, cosy and nice garden, but roof is closed compeletly. Perfect for breakfast and quick lunch, very delicious, french-europe style kitchen. We had Croque Madame and Gratin, both were excellent. Be aware cash only
My son and I have been eating here since he could eat a kids burger on his own (well almost). The food's great and plentiful. Always take home leftovers.  The staff is pleasant and friendly.
Great food and concept, but always lacking in the good stuff. I don't mind paying $10 for stir fry, but not when there's two pieces of chicken and one tomato.

Amazing bang for your buck. Food is fresher and way less greasy than other Halal Stands. The line is always long but it's so worth the wait. Love these guys they are fast and considerate despite how fast they handle orders and your food they make sure you have everything you need. They are always super busy.
Honestly... only good when you're drunk. Wouldn't go out of my way to get it though

I can't stop raving about this butcher to all of my friends! Actually, I've told everyone I know about it. This is a whole animal, organic, humanely raised, locally sourced butcher and it is halal. Plus, the place is spotless. Not only that, the prices are so good. I love food and the butchers there share my passion for it. They are so helpful and nice! Go there!
great tasting food, and I love the grape leaves! the hummus is great too, and the service is friendly. A nice place to bring a date.

It was just OK. The bulgogi was a bit sweet and had no charred bits and no garlic. I am kinda glad because although I love garlic all this food was Americanized and had no garlic. The blaring rap and disco music was a sure giveaway that they were trying to cater to Americans but I am not coming back.
Love this place. Everything is amazing.

I've been here about 10 times since February. Impressive place! Great atmosphere, great beer, and... Usually great food but the quality had declined over the past few months. Overcooked brisket and ribs, subpar bacon. Hopefully they can turn this back around.

NOT JUST ANOTHER SANDWICH PLACE! House made bread, delicious combinations. I had the Red Onion sandwich and husband had the Reuben. Both were delicious-you can taste the freshness of the ingredients from the first bite. The staff was helpful and welcoming. We'll be back! (And well both order the red union sandwich-something about the combination of red onions and Granny Smith apples.....had me at the fist bite!)
The food here is good but not the price, I'd eat elsewhere where real Mexican cook your food.
Yummy Pizzas, best in town, specially tomato basil with crispy crust. Though, they need to work in their customer service skills...

Great atmosphere and all, but the portions are a bit too small and a bit over-rated. I think it's a place you should go to if you haven't gone before, but it's not really a place to go to regularly...

Good, fast and friendly.  It's pan-Asian (Japanese, Thai, Chinese) but the staff is mostly Chinese, so it's not quite up to the highest standards of true Thai and Japanese places. But for a tasty, quick bite, it's hard to beat.

"Soul Food" at its best - made to order, unlike many other "Soul Food" spots where the food sits under heat lamps and our nostalgic memories of dinner at grandma's clouds our true assessment. This place is the real deal without all the hoopla (and sticker-shock) of some other Harlem eateries!
For the price I paid the sushi was not that good. It's more of a lounge place than an actual restaurant. It may have been better if the food tasted better. I probably wont be going there any more.
Ok

Best Kale Salad Ever! I've lost over 100 lbs over the past year primarily by eating a lot of salad, so when I say that Vital serves the BEST kale salad, I know what I'm talking about! The chef cuts the kale into thin strips and adds a touch of cumin to the dressing. Delicious! And, the chicken was just right! I even enjoyed the water, which is served with a slice of cucumber and lemon.  The food was so good, I just had to tell the chef! The staff is friendly and the service was great. I'm looking forward to going there again.

Favorite sushi place of all time. Been here numerous times. A little pricy but well worth the splurge. I highly recommend their tuna "sandwich, " spicy girl roll, fantasy roll, caterpillar roll, and yummy special roll. Although everything I have  had here has been outstanding. Favorite place by far!!

I really like what this place has become. There's a perfect balance between neighborhood/irish pub and craft haven. Jesse, the owner/GM has been putting a great deal of thought into his draft beer selections. There's always a variety of styles, flavors and brands. Whether you're looking for sweet, sour, hop or malt bombs, you'll find something here. I regularly see the draft tech in cleaning lines which tells you just how committed Poor Henry's has become to the cause. The burgers are a staple for me, but I can also confidently recommend the sliced steak, crab cakes, and chicken pot pie. The garlic sauteed broccoli is bangarang. Stop in on a Sunday night for bottle share. All the servers are friendly, whether you're in for the first time or 100th. They try hard to make you feel welcomed and move you in and out quickly at lunch time. Worth a visit.  I hear there's tap takeover in the works.  Better check the calendar.

My first time trying this legendary place and all I can say is it was well worth the stop in Clifton!! It exceeded every expectation and I can't wait to go back next time I am in NJ. The flavor of the ripper was so unique and nothing like a New York Dog and the deep frying gives it almost a slight donut taste along with the perfect snap and juiciness. The house relish was the biggest surprise, a great topping and I need to figure out how to make it myself!

Delicious! Beer selection was superb, food was delicious-so tasty and fresh! Our server was friendly and helpful.  Price is right, and the food leaves nothing to be desired. Atmosphere is casual and cozy, and rumor has it this place used to be a McDonald's! This is Vermont!

The Jolly Goat was a tiny little hole in the wall coffee shop - literally. It was super small, but had a lot of character. I ordered a cortado that was delicious and the barista was charming and we had a great conversation! My friend ordered an affogato - a scoop of ice cream with an espresso shot on top - and she loved it as well. Overall we had a great experience with both the product and the service, and I will definitely return!

The food is above average and the staff is great. To me, service is very important. I used them to cater a small party and everyone was happy. Since it was my first time catering they took a moment to help me out and get the right amount of food for the group size. I'm always glad to go back and would recommend it to anyone that lives in the area.
Charming cafe in the midst of a residential street of brownstones. Ate brunch here which was a nice fusion of typical western european brunch and Greek food. Pouched eggs were spot on!

Grew up on Hoagie Haven, if you live in the area, you can't not love it. I always get the veggie. It is super loaded with all the cheeses, they never skimp on the veggies. Just the right amount of o&v. I have had some of the other sandwiches and they are great too but this is my favorite! Whenever I am back in the jerz, I find my way back to HH!
This is by far my favorite Indian restaurant in the city. I've been here so many times and it's always delicious. The idli and dosa combo is my personal favorite!

I had the pleasure of dinning here with some clients last Sunday. Being from Atlanta, I received this recommendation from a friend of my family and WOW!  The service was beyond exceptional, thank you Emmy! Our clients were still raving about the food and service the next day. I've given a few 5 star ratings on yelp, but I think I need to go back and lower them now that I've had this dinning experience. To the entire staff at Trattoria, THANK YOU!

Great Soul Food and a great price! Went one night because it was near our hotel. The staff was exceptional despite it being close to closing time. I went back the next day to try their breakfast and was not let down. They had a great selection of the usual dishes and a couple of uniques items. I had the savory spinach pancakes with ricotta cheese which was really tasty. The only thing I would like to see improved are their operating hours, as they close pretty early. (7:00pm)

I seriously miss this place!  Huge selection of Bahn mi I've ever seen.  When I was in New York for a few months, not a week goes by that I don't order from here.  I order via Seamless and never had any issues even in the middle of winter.
I have been eating here once a week, and I always order the yellow curry chicken and pad Thai. Both are fresh and delicious. If I could, I would eat here every day.

Loved our falafel sandwich for lunch and sat outside the shop. The staff were a bit rushed and short with customers but the good food made up for it! I liked the traditional falafels but apparently the Harissa spicy ones where good too! A nice casual place for a cheap meal

Juan and I definitely enjoyed the shrimp buns. They are amazing with the dip. We also tried stuffed shiitake mushrooms which were also delicious. We ordered Mezame Ramen and Ani Ramen. Both were delicious! Til next time. :)

Not what you expect from an italian place as concerns the decoration and especially not like an italian cafe bistro.....but but but the food is amazing period.100% authentic handmade fresh italian food.The bread is awesome the pasta is hitting the spot.there is no particular service cause you order at the counter and the owner has the right amount of italian "craziness" everything is so cute and authentic congrats.

I came here on August 1, 2014, for my 24th birthday. It was my second time eating here, since I had came here for my previous birthday. Isabella's is not only my favorite restaurant but Isabella is also my name! My second time here was much better than my first. Although my first time here also went well, this time was just better. I had a wonderful experience! Our waitress for the night was Amanda P. and she was the best waitress. She was nice, very easy going & very patient. She served me and my party free champagne for my birthday. For dessert I orderd the chocolate bag, and Amanda placed a candle on it and sang happy birthday! I wish more waitresses were like her. A waiter named Jake was also very nice and he even gave me a free Isabella's hat for my birthday! My boyfriend and friends also enjoyed the service here. There's just a very nice vibe to this place. The atmosphere is great and the restaurant is set up so nicely. I had a wonderful birthday dinner at Isabella's and I will definitely be coming back here next year for my 25th! A big thank you again to Amanda P. & Jake for a wonderful birthday experience at Isabella's!
Great food, friendly service. Wide selection of beers. Burgers are on point with a side salad at $12 can't really beat that.

Really bad bagel with cream cheese and lox. 1. The bagel (that was supposed to be everything had a ton more poppy seeds than it did everything) looked nothing like the Manhattan bagels I'm used to. 2. Very little cream cheese 3. The lox was...dry and shriveled up. I don't think it was very fresh. Smoothies are good but overpriced. I'd pass on the coffee. Salads are good.

Stumbled in after once again getting blown off by Simon Pearce. Adam was very accommodating and the place oozes with charm. Menu is simple and good with the drinks very appealing, but we had a long drive after, so maybe next time. Definitely worth stopping in and enjoying good hospitality.

This was the second time I have been to Max Fish and will go every time I am in Connecticut.  I had the Scallops over polenta and little neck clams from the raw bar.  The scallops had a perfect pan sear and was cooked perfect. The Alois Lageder Pinot Grigio that was chosen by my waitress was a perfect pairing. wonderful!
I got the #17, it was AMAZING. The sesame seed bread took the sandwich to a whole new level. 5/5.
Very disappointed for the amount of food you get for the money you pay. Nice atmosphere but I don't feel the quality warrants the price. I had a Seabass dinner the cost me 28 bucks and left hungry
The food here is very unique and the portions are very adorable.  Must try their selections of desserts!
The cheese and wine selection here is fantastic. The camembert was so delicious, my mouth waters as I write this review. Quaint ambiance. Foie gras was not so good and slightly runny.

I work right down the street from La Villa and it's usually the lunch spot of choice for me and my co-workers, when we go out (or order in).  The Tradizionale pizza--a square pie with fresh garlic, oil, and sausage -- has to be the best pizza I have ever tasted, and I know I'm not the only one that thinks this way.  Even their plain slices are far above nearly every other pizzeria I've tried.   Their crusts are crispy and not too doughy, and that Tradizionale pie sausage (which is not the sausage you get if you order sausage on a regular round pizza) tastes like it was sauteed in the garlic and olive oil and is generally heavenly.   If you are eating in around lunch time, it is worth noting that this place can get packed (for good reason) and service may run a little slow.  Usually that's fine for me and my group, as we're not trying to rush back to work, but it's a better experience if you have the time to sit and enjoy yourself.  This place is owned and run by some really nice people, also.
Delivious restauraunt. The only thing i personally didnt like was the lamb hamburger, it was seasoned with too much black sauce. But apart from that it was great. I loved the kafta and the babaganush

The good: excellent cocktails and service, and the food is very good. Delicious, actually. The bad, and this is a dealbreaker: portions are TINY and the drinks are expensive for the size. I'm all for crafted cocktails, but at $15 in a tiny glass is ridiculous. This place will not be open long with portions and drinks this tiny. Unfortunate, but true. 1/9 edit: they are closed.
Simply the best Italian in Astoria. The owner is a nice guy who spends his nights looking after his guests. When you'll go make sure you try the porcini Risotto!
Great food and atmosphere! I typically have the pollo cubano and sangria. There's usually a long wait so try to arrive early.

Went back with my family; my wife had not been there before.  I usually go here with my son when we go to Red Bulls games. Tonight, we all went and had an early dinner before the game.  Two had shrimp with garlic sauce and 2 has steak.  All if us thought it was great.  The food is delicious and fresh and prepared in a healthy way,  portions are good (you will not leave hungry), the sides are excellent and there are so many to choose from and the price is right.  The service is very good; the people who run the place and work here are nice people and do their best to accommodate.   I rarely go to Newark and now that the Red Bulls season is coming to an end, I'm going to have to find some time to get here.  I normally take the train and it's a quick walk from the station but I Wish it was easier to park in which case I would come here more.often.

Previously, the owner hung up on another coworker who I recommemded to this establishment because she called complaining about hair found in her food. I called back because I witnessed the hair and I was embarassed. I immediately thought about that Friday. Both of us did not hear him ask me if I wanted to order but that's ok. As for taking to yelp,  I generally don't but I was very offended by his attitude. I generally only take to social media with positive feedback. However he was not sincere at all. Since he maintains that he asked why didn't he ask again so both orders could be done around the same time. Instead he was doing other things instead of helping a paying, long time customer. In the past if a pastry was stale,  an order wasn't ready for pick up on time or a dish was not seasoned well I never complained or wrote a review. It was the inference that my friend and I were lying that persuaded me. Then on top of that her sandwich was soggy. Bummed!  You lost my whole office especially after this unnecessary rebuttal. Humility is always a better practice especially when dealing with the public.
The fluffiest french toast I've ever had! La Colombe Coffee is good. Service is fantastic. Wait times for seating on the weekend can get a little long but it was worth the wait.

Very cute mom and pop restaurant. They gave us a few small free dishes and soup with what we ordered. Food was fresh and portions pretty large portions. The deep friend chicken wings and The bubble tea were especially awesome. I had a mango bubble tea and I'm pretty sure there was real mango in it! Eating my yummy left overs as I type. Will be coming back to try more food!

This place is tiny! And packed! Don't expect fries, fancy condiments or a large menu. They do burgers and cheeseburgers. And that is a-okay because they do them well! Expect a wait and know what you want. Your patience will be rewarded (while you wait, enjoy a Foxon Soda)!
Ordered the sashimi, age tofu and soba, they were absolutely delicious.  Especially the sashimi which were thicker sliced and the age tofu was nice and warm.
Just left there. Had a wonderful lunch. Love the menu. Waitstaff were very nice. Enjoyed the experience very much. We will be back again and again.

I had high expectations for this restaurant based other's experiences.  In particular,  my companion had wonderful past experiences here so I was excited. However, my experience was a disappointing.  The quality of the was food okay as it did not taste any different than dishes at other Chinese restaurants at which I have dined. Thus, other than family style seating that works well for the restaurant, nothing set it apart as great. The quality of the service can improve; while taking our order the waiter began a conversation with a co-worker, which I thought was rude.  In general the wait-staff seemed disinterested in the customers. Whether it is a cultural dynamic that I do not comprehend or not, the adage of when in Rome has value for any business. Later in the evening I went to the bathroom preceded by an employee.  The person was in the bathroom for quite a while and I did not hear water running for hand-washing prior to exit. This is just my experience and I certainly do not wish to dissuade anyone from trying as it may be a wonderful for you.
Everything they make is delicious.

I had planned a girls night out dinner at Sushi Lounge a few months ago. In total, it was about 13 ladies. Our reservations were for 7pm. We arrived in 3 different groups. The first group was already there before my group arrived at 7:02. The final group arrived a few minutes after us. First off, even though more than half the total group was there, they wouldn't seat us. Secondly, when they did seat us, they sat us at a table people were sitting at already. They asked the 2 couples, who were only having drinks to move down to the end of the table. They expected a group of 13 people who were having dinner to share a table with 4 other people who were only using it to have a place to set their drinks. When I tried speaking to the manager to explain to him that we were a large group who were intending on eating dinner and I didn't think there would be enough room for us to share the table, he told me to be patient and they would be leaving shortly. By the time our food came, the 2 couples were still there. I had to find the manager AGAIN just to have a comfortable dinner. One would think serving a group of 13 people would be good business. I expected better customer service from this place. I had heard such good reviews and was extremely disappointed with my first visit that I would never go back. Sushi Lounge in Hoboken, on the other hand, was a different story :-) I thoroughly enjoyed my experience at that location.
What an amazing culinary experience!!! I LOVED it!!! So many Exotic dishes ! Definitely order the rabbit and heart. Will come here very often

Three times i have called the national office about cleanliness.  Weirdly, each time I call a different manager is working at the restaurant.  The tables are dirty, the floor has food on it.  The product is okay, but just okay.  There are a couple of authentic Mexican restaurants in the area.  Chipotle is just fast food, and not very good.  The lines are long, they sometimes run out of ingredients, and it's dirty, like unhealthy dirty.
Love it! Authentic and amazing!
Really great food but too loud and not that cozy/comfy.
I have eaten in and taken out. I had the kale salad and the Montclair crepe. Both delicious. Cannot wait to try brunch!  I also love the cozy, ambience. I have a new fav.

Ok, it's been well established in prior reviews that the food is good. Eaten here twice now so I know that. The scale really bothers me. Food here is not cheap, but this nickel-dime mentality with the scale is going too far. Allow me to illustrate the process: 1.zero the scale 2. Put tray on scale 3. Zero scale 4. Put bread on scale 5. Zero the scale. 6. Put the meat on the bread 7. Give to you. I don't have a huge problem with the prices, but don't stick it in my face. The guy measuring the meat looked like Walter White measuring out meth after a cook. If you need to measure out portions, use something else other than a scale right in front of you.
