This is really rather awful excuse for Asian or Asian fusion food, fast or not.  The entrees are packed with sugar, and the chicken was inedible.  The appetizers were cold and (actually) slimy).  Skip it.  The reality is it is really hard to get decent Asian food in the Princeton area.

Wait time to get a table was about 10 minutes for breakfast.  The coffee was good, but they never came around to refill our coffee or anyone else's. the wait staff was slow and once we got our food they didn't come back to check on us for refills. I would say the food is average at best. I got the Belgium waffles with strawberries and bananas. The waffle was good- but some of the strawberries still had the tops on them.  My hubby had the corn beef and hash with egg whites which describes as horrible. Probably would not go back.

What a disappointment! Food was just OK, somewhat  overpriced. Primary reason for the low rating is the length of time for food to be served. Took about 35 minutes after our order was placed. Server was attentive but seemed accustomed to the slow food service. After telling our server we were concerned about time and were unsure about dessert, he recommend a couple of desserts that he said would be quick. Fifteen minutes passed and still no dessert.  We finally told him to cancel the dessert and to bring the check. Then had to wait for the check. Won't be going back.

Best Chinese Comfort food you can get on a cold day or a night where you just feel like crap. Any beef noodle soup would do! Well, for me, anyway. They have coconut curry dumplings!! These were fantastic as hell. It's a rare find and great combination ingredient for dumplings.

We had the best night. Live music, the owners brought over a basket of toys for the kids, the food was great. Perfect atmosphere. They also won the mac&cheese competition. We have 7 kids. It can be hard to find a table sometimes but they cleared a place for us right away.

Went here a couple of times on a recent trip to CT. It's kind of an American style bar and grill.   Has some good outside seating.  One time, I ate inside and the other time I ate out. In both visits--one with a group of three, and one with a large group, the servers were friendly, attentive and patient with questions about the menu. And, the food came out pretty quickly, so that was nice. It was a bit loud in here both times--between the tvs, the people talking, and the street noise (the patio is right off of a major road).   On on trip, we had kids' mac and cheese and  some "dirt" kid dessert, nachos (just hum on the nachos) and tacos (thumbs up on the tacos). I also had a burger here with fries, pretty good, not greasy.  One of the pizzas (I forget which one) got a thumbs up from our group.  The group was able to find something that worked for a range of diets/tastes because of the extensive menu there.  Nothing too daring on the menu, it's simple American fare, but the sheer number of options here (versus other national "American food" chains") gets a higher ranking in my book.
The food here is delicious. I definitely recommend it to anyone in this area. This is definitely not the last time I will be eating here.
Lower than my expectation :(
I love this place! The food is delicious and the place is small and cozy. I could never pass up a great plate of bistec and arroz blanco with great service
Really good food.. I'm coming to eat here again.... Love the food..... Reminds me India!!!!!!!
This place has the best pizza in Belleville. Period. Their large sandwiches are crazy too. A full cheesesteak easily feeds two people. Perfect place to fight off the munchies
Food was good and reasonably priced. Entire staff was on their cell phones the entire time I was there. Not very professional, but nice spot overall.
Excellent red sauce joint...1st time you visit get the meatballs!
Delicious food, great environment. Really authentic Greek seafood. Lamb chops and ribeye steak are delicious as well!

Maybe just because I was told it is a best Shaurma in the city my expectations were very high. I can say I did not like meat of this Shaurma but for sure during the night when you are out and hungry it is a great place to take a fast snack

We went to this little restaurant before heading to a broadway show and the staff were really friendly and happy to help! They ensured the food was brought out swiftly in order for us to get to our show on time. The menu had excellent vegan options (try the curry, the chickpea burger, the beets and the roasted sweet potatoes) but also the salmon cakes were delicious! The roasted cauliflower and the zucchini stuffed with quinoa lacked some serious flavor which was unfortunate. But give the juices a go! If you want to have a delicious, healthy meal with some options for vegans this is the place to go. The setting was nice - make sure you get the table facing onto the street for people watching.

Went for brunch with my husband. We were in Philly for a weekend get away. Based on the reviews, I practically ran here. There was a street fair happening and the restaurant was setting up their booth. When we came up to the door, there was no one to meet you. A frazzled manager(possibly) came a few mins later. He showed us to an indoor table and before he sat us down, told us that it would be very slow service due to them being busy and setting up for the street fair. Is that my problem?  No.  We reluctantly sat anyway. Our table was wobbly and the manager? acknowledged this, said it needed to be fixed but never fixed it. We waited a good half hour for the food. I had the stuffed French toast which was ok, nothing to write home about. My husband had the Eggs Nola which he said were very good. Our waitress hustled the whole time and was very good. Overall, the place was just ok in my opinion. And, for out of towers, completely uninviting.

Best pizza in Burlington in my opinion. Really nice not too crispy thin crust big slices. Reasonably priced for how much pizza you get. Toppings are all really good quality ingredients, not just plain old whatever. Highly recommend Panacea next time you're craving pizza.

Solid place for a quick Chinese meal although their xlb pales in comparison with so many better offerings around the city. The food in general was well prepared and didn't taste too salty or full of msg. Overall semi decent for a quick lunch.

thank you to yelp for this find! it was packed- and no wonder - it was delicious. i don't remember what i got but the menu said it was one of the signature dishes - some kind of fish based soup. very unique - but yum!

I always order from here when I'm not working and we even order a lot from the police department. This place is the best. Hands down number one. I don't know why they have any negative reviews. They truly are great.

We were in Pennsylvania for a wedding, so took advantage of the opportunity to sightsee a bit. We wanted breakfast at a local spot, and Cousin's did not disappoint! The server (might have been the owner) was kind and helpful. The restaurant was not busy, and she took excellent care of us. The menu was amazing! I had Salted Caramel French Toast...wow! My wife at pancakes and loved them. We also had bacon and eggs, which tasted just like home cooking...I mean real, fried bacon and eggs cooked in the bacon grease. I'm back home in Texas and still want to return to Cousin's Grubhouse for breakfast! The server did tell us that they are very busy on weekends due to brunch, and that service can be slow because the kitchen is small. We were there on a Thursday morning and had great, quick service. Can't wait to return!

Locale in centro a Philadelphia, non propriamente messicano, ma comunque molto gradevole. Forse un po' cacofonico. Una birra, un margherita e un appetizer in due (porzione enorme), davvero buono. Ottima opzione. Consigliato!
Comfort food! Soup dumpling are the soul food for me. Cheap and great quality. Can't pass this up, ever.
Creative menu.  Good service.  Long wait.
It was the perfect meal for a great day. I loved everything about it. The spaghetti was perfect
Best. Cha Gio (pork and shrimp fried spring rolls). Ever.  Also the Che Dau - a must have at the end of your meal.  Love x3 this place.

The best!! After last nights debacle with The juice Bar on sixth avenue I was scared to go to another 'healthy' spot. But this is off the hook! Amazing chicken soup with quinoa, delicious seed muffins, rockin atmosphere, reasonable prices. If I lived in NYC I'd be here a few times a week! Amazing!

We have eaten here on a previous trip to NYC and enjoyed the food and service (4 stars). On this trip, we tried to go twice. Once on Thursday at 10:45 and once on Monday at 9am. On Thursday, they were between breakfast and lunch service and were only serving drinks. On Monday (Columbus Day) they were not open for breakfast and were not going to be opening until 10:30 for brunch. Sigh. We ended up at Chelsea market both days. You might make sure they are open and serving when you want to go.

Great ambience, great service, great food. All around greatness across the board, highly recommend. Tried the pad kee mau but naturally taxed every plate at the table... Everything was awesome, my tummy is content.

The Olive Oil was amazing. Service excellent and fast. Bread good. Salad was excellent. Our main course was the special, the artichokes, asparagus, tomato in a wine sauce was good. Restaurant was loud and crowded.
The Caliente margarita was excellent! The most unusual nachos ever- the house pickled jalapeños were sweet! But so good and I am so full.

Wonderfully delicious banh mi! This Vietnamese sandwich is so tasty that we devoured the sandwiches in less than 5 minutes! The store closes at 7, we walked in at 6:56 and the owner still took our order. The pork was marinated so well that it paired perfectly with the crunchy vegetables. They even toast the buns for you! Oh and all of this for less than $5!!! Must try!

AWOL (All Walks of Life) cater's too all diets and needs. Perfect for dinner or a late night snack (open till 12 on weekends). Without a doubt, the service is impeccable and the food is spectacular. John, the head chef, has created a unique menu with interesting flavor combinations and a circus of mouth-watering specials. Additionally,every cocktail has  their own wow factor, and better yet, they have a considerable selection of wines and beers. The interior creates a calming and intimate environment of pastels and suppressed illumination. I will definitely come back here again!

Went here on a date Friday & it was just meh.  There was nothing really great about the place except the patio was pretty cute.  We shared a Canadian bacon & brie crostini which was pretty good, but I was expecting it to be open faced and it was 4 full sized sandwiches.   Then I had a lamb pizza which was really good but, who wants pizza on a date. The wine selection was pretty slim & my Malbec was pretty light. Probably not venturing back here.

Service was great, and the food was good. Only drawback is that there are pretty limited options for vegetarians and the kitchen is not very amenable to making substitutions. I recommend the special mojito.
Great for what it is--a diner-like breakfast and lunch place. I got the check in deal and it was phenomenal!

Food was amazing but the portions are slightly smaller than what I was expecting but filling nevertheless. I usually order bluepoints but the waiter quickly referred me to a list of different kinds of oysters that she considered to be better and I was not disappointed. Love the intimate atmosphere of this restaurant.
Muy buena la comida, pedimos 3 platos y todos súper ricos, recomiendo la quinoa veggie burger.
Great food and good service. Best veggie burger ive tried in my life and im not even a vegetarian. Steak sandwich was also delicious and the smashed platane with shrimp was aldo good

I stop at Rahway Grill whenever I am in the neighborhood and need a snack. The current price for two hot dogs and a drink is $4.95 (I've been eating here since the same special was $2.00). You can get your dogs with sauerkraut, cooked onions, or both. You get to add the mustard or ketchup. No seating  you get to stand and eat as you watch Rahway City go by out the windows. Nothing fancy, but a NJ classic!

I had very high hopes for this place when it first opened: The pot stickers and soup dumplings were delicious, and other food tasted authentic, was interesting, and had the wok hay you look for. I thought I would be having many happy meals there. But lately the food has been inconsistent. The Ma Po Tofu is different every time we order it. Today it was especially garlicky. The chili chicken which was mouth watering the first couple of times I had it was too greasy today. A noodle soup my wife had enjoyed before left her cold. We're probably not going to be going back much.

I wanted to like this place so much. In the end I liked pretty much nothing about it. The ambiance was confusing. It was not intimate, too brightly lit, and playing a music and a movie that seemed confused with their food. The food. I liked nothing about the food. Autumn Wraps--a nice concept, but nothing stuck out in their flavor. We had to add a lot of hot sauce. The Chicken Wings--they felt almost rubbery to me. They needed to be crispier, or saucier. The sauce was thin and the skin left a lot to be desired. The Cabbage/Mustard Greens. These felt overly oiled. I could tell they had been cooked haphazardly in a wok and tasted just of vinegar. The tofu on top was so fried that it became almost empty inside. The Pork Belly. The meat on this dish was so overcooked I was shocked my companion could stand it. I had one piece, with fat an inch thick and that was enough for me. I was also stunned that there was not actually pho on the menu. The sake was fine. Best part of the meal. It also felt so expensive for where it is--this dodgy corner in Bushwick. I will not be going back.
Great food and service! One of my favorite spots in Glastonbury.

My daughter came in from LA and we happened on this place. Everything we ordered was so tasty! The baked clams the soup the prosciutto the chicken it was not only glorious to smell but to feast your eyes on and to devour. We will be back soon.
I've been here so many times. Love this place. It is one of the best restaurants in NYC right now. Highly recommend it and make sure to make a reservation!
They messws my food up one too many times but its clean i can say that n they also have a great big fush tank in the back sitting area which i guess can b claiming to some

Service was good. The young ladies that serve are super nice. The food was good. Now the negatives - the amounts of food are small. And what really sucks is if you're a coffee drinker get ready to pay for the second cup. No refills! First time I've eaten in a breakfast place that makes you pay for refills? It's a shame, because I really like the place.
Friendly casual and very authentic thai. Young peppercorn is really good. Quick lunch service.

This place is amazing! I visit AGO in LA often DeNiro also owns it. You can not go wrong with anything here. I had the special spaghetti noodles, browned butter and shaved truffles! It was fabulous! We started out with the warm ricotta and ended with nectarine and buttermilk gelato Highly recommend this place
Love the square pizza!
Everything is really good, great service . A joy to have portuguese treat near home !!

Went in on Sunday not knowing that their brunch menu only had 6 items.  It was very difficult to accommodate our one guests who is gluten-free AND vegan, although they tried. She ended up getting some vegetable concoction made up by the kitchen--there wasn't even a salad option in the 6 menu items.  Among the rest of us, we had mussels frittes (small mussels, small portion), the brunch burger (meat and bread smothered in maple syrup), chicken confit hash (no chicken, small crock of potatoes), and a side of sliced strawberries for the baby.  Food was not impressive, and for $80 for brunch with no cocktails, I'm not willing to find out what C&P has is store for dinner.

Stopped here for lunch one afternoon, I was pleasantly surprised. Appealing and fairly vast lunch menu selections at reasonable prices for the quality of food. I had the penne a la vodka with chicken which was very good. The chicken was a bit overcooked and tough but the pasta was well done and the sauce was light and creamy. Really nice ambience when you sit near the window facing the main street. Service was extremely and unreasonably slow given the restaurant was not busy, Basically felt like we were seated and just left there on our own, and this accounts for much of the lower rating here. Much room for improvement with the staff. Appeared the two managers were walking around basically doing nothing when glasses were empty on tables. Don't understand this. Otherwise enjoyable

We have just dined at Frere de Lys, what a wonderful experience in NY and a great find for UES. We are visiting from Australia. The meals were excellent my husband had the salmon and I the chicken, beautiful flavours, what a delightful restaurant, the decor is simple but beautiful so enhances the AMBIENCE, the personalities of these two young men running this restaurant make it a memorable dining experience.

This is the best Ethiopian food I have ever had.  The food is healthy, fresh and simply delicious.  The kale and avocado salad, pumpkin dish,  lentil dish and mushroom dish were spectacular.  Unlike other Ethiopian restaurants I have been to, the food tasted homemade and fresh. The quality of the food and ingredients is superb.  The  portions are really generous and the prices are really reasonable.  If it was nearer to my apartment, I would go at least once a week.

Wow just wow! From the signature cocktails to the hummus... Must try the thyme salad, lamb & Brussel sprouts! Wine selection is beautiful! Our server is the absolute best I have had in a long time! Ask for April she will recommend everything that you need! Feeling blessed to have discovered such an incredible restaurant~*~
Nearly perfect!
Good coffee! We took a little break from walking around. 100times better than Starbucks!

Th food is great here, I love the burger and grilled cheese. The owner, Chris, is very nice and always smiling. The place looks great, I feel so comfortable sitting and eating there. The restaurant stands out, finally a trendy place to eat in my neighborhood.

Came here for a quick bite after work, I ordered a burger and fries. My burger was okay, the fries were no so great half of them were burn. Service was not so great! The waiter was no where to be found even if the seating was nearly empty.

It's amazing. My favorite mexican place in NYC. I hate to say this, but I'm from LA and have a picky palette -- it's still no LA joint but it's amazing in its own way. Order anything. It's all spectacular. But I always go with chips and guac and a cheese quesadilla. If u order in, get the nachos (the portion size is bigger in the restaurant than to go). They've screwed up my delivery order once but I don't even care!!!

The food wasn't bad, but it also wasn't the best food I have ever had. I'm giving it two stars because it was insanely over priced. Although food in Brooklyn is expensive a lot of the time, I felt like this meal was especially outrageous. It cost me 17.00 for a muffin, a small sandwich, and a small orange juice.
The waitress was really stupid. She kept telling that we gave the wrong tip. But the truth is she forgot we had the bill spilt and she didn't double the tip. The beef tongue was pretty good though.
Been here twice - exceptional service and food both times.  Had their homemade yogurt for breakfast once and enjoying a grilled chicken on brioche right now.  WONDERFUL!
Some of the best good I've ever ate. Had the bah mi burger kale and nosh fries. So happy with my meal I had to write a review so others can experience this amazing food.
I love this place!!! The crawfish and drinks are great. I also love the atmosphere here. The staffs are super friendly and helpful. There are alway a long waiting line but it move pretty fast.

One of my favorite places in the city. So many options..where do I start? Prices are competitive too. I just wish the lines weren't as long. It's a bit much to wait 20 minutes for a sandwich in the middle of a day..but the food is fantastic. Definitely a fan.

Came in the try a Kangaroo burger because who wouldn't!? Service is good. Quick and friendly. Even the owner came out to greet us and check up on us. The drinks during happy hour are cheap, delicious, and STRONG. The koala burger was only average. Kangaroo meat is dry (I'm assuming) and the burger was a mess. The beet was too juicy and it fell apart in my hands. The don't cook it past medium rare because it's super lean and would definitely crumble but I'm not a fan of anything above medium rare. It is a bit pricey but you're paying more for the experience and opportunity to try kangaroo meat. Would definitely come back for the experience but wouldn't order a kangaroo burger or anything kangaroo.

I have eaten at a lot of great restaurants in Philly this year and I can say without a doubt that the meal I had at High Street was the best yet. We went with the chef's menu and everything was so carefully thought out and executed that I just couldn't wait to see what came next. The service was thoughtful and unassuming and the ambiance relaxed. The food did all if the talking. Usually I look to more exotic cuisines for exciting meals but there was nothing boring about what was served. The flavors and ingredient combinations were the work of a truly gifted chef. I can't wait to go again!

Sam is the best. Food is not only amazing but they all work so hard for you to leave with a smile. Thank you guys for also letting me have the mot perfect party for my daughter.. I will never forget how you put me at ease. I am greatful for your patience and how you worked so hard to make sure all went well.

This was the perfect choice for a romantic dinner out! Made a reso for two at 8 and were promptly seated. The room was still full of diners and the ambiance was very warm. The service was impeccable my dinner partner and I both joked it was too good. We felt as if we were being treated as royalty. We were promptly brought menus and waters as well as a complimentary flat bread and bread rolls. The dinner prices were beyond reasonable, considering we were right on the park and in NYC. My entree was 26 and it was a seafood medley. It was supposed to be served over pasta but being gluten free I asked for it over spinach. They do have gluten free pasta but it was more than enough without. My date got the seared tuna. The wine was a bit pricey but the bottle was delicious. I loved every part of it--especially the complimentary after dinner orange liqueur. Thank you again!!
We love this place, Everyone is friendly, attentive and courteous. We were in town for 4 nights and ate there two of them. that says it all.
Decent breakfast restaurant. I have tried their omelets and pancakes. Great service!!

I have been coming to this spot for years and must say that it will always hold a special place in my heart. The atmosphere of a dark pub with an open floor and candles around the area make it feel so comfy. Perfect spot to get cozy and enjoy some excellent wings and beers. The pub fare is above normal and the staff is tentative. Friendly folks. Sports on the tv and solid music choice, a must go to spot to grab some tall ones with the boys.

The food is great, but the delivery is really slow on a weeknight. I tried to call to track my order after the 30 minutes (quoted time) and the girl on the phone tells me my order went out, but she never asked for my name (called from my work cell which does not show my name). It ended up coming in 50 minutes. Bottom line: Best for pick up or eat in, not delivery!

Went to this place to see what the fuss was about.  There was a roach on my food and the waiter was rude and made it difficult to return the dish.  Waiter posted my receipt on the Internet - I wish I could give 0 stars but not possible.

This is one of the best lunch places in Lower Manhattan.  The food is all consciously, lovingly made with integrity.  Plus, it's delicious.  It has excellent options for carnivores and herbivores alike--even for the gluten free and other restricted dieters.  The price may be a tad higher than what folks are used to for lunch, but the servings are pretty generous.  Whenever I get the lunch special (2 colds + 1 hot), I leave with a little left over for my afternoon snack. I lovingly refer to this place as "the cafeteria."  You go through somewhat of a cafeteria line, and the servers put your food on plates and then a red tray that is reminiscent of grade school.  There are no "entrees" here--everything is a "side."  Some are cold.  Some are hot.  There are a plethora of vegetarian and even vegan options for both the "cold" and "hot" sides.  There is also an option to get your food over a bed of greens--adding even more nutrition!  I often get the lentils over a bed of arugula.  Their lentils are divine.  Sometimes, I get the kale salad with chia seeds.  For Fall, they have a butternut squash polenta wedge.  All absolutely delicious.  I have also had the quinoa with peppers and avocado.  My only wish is that they added a little more avocado and other chunky vegetables to that side. But, miraculously, the hot sides are even better than the cold ones.  Many are stews--which come over either veggie mash, quinoa, or brown rice.  The veggie mash is a delicious concoction of your favorite root vegetables.  The veggie mash is definitely a comfort food and reminds me of Thanksgiving.  I often get it topped with the Korean beef--which is so delicious I have to limit myself from ordering it every time I go.  Another delicious hot side is the chicken tomatillo stew, which I often get over brown rice. The  ambience is also great.  Incredibly casual, but they somehow play the best music.  Not too loud, but loud enough so that if you are dining solo, you can appreciate it. This is seriously the best lunch place in all of Lower Manhattan--you are getting healthy food that is lovingly made.  I couldn't ask for anything more.

Wow! Absolutely NO WAIT to get our sandwiches  I'm amazed, given the amazing Yelp reviews.  and to think that I was annoyed at my husband for not calling in the order ahead of time.  Sorry, honey! P.S.  The take-out option is great, in the event that for some reason you are too incapacitated to dine in.

We sat down at 7:40, got our food at 9:40. Granted, a lot of it was not their fault.  They had a health inspector come in that day.  All I have to say is that I hope it was a surprise visit. If they knew he was coming, they should have closed down the restaurant for the evening.  They said they were unable to cook any food while the inspector was there. Hence the 2 hour ridiculous wait. The thing is that.. If I ignored the fact that we waited so long to be served, then I would give this place 5 stars for their food.  The servers themselves were very kind at explaining the situation.  But something is up with management.  I did half expect to get some sort of compensation for waiting that long.. Like free dessert?  Or an appetizer on the house?  Nothing was offered to further please this obviously disgruntled customer.  We ate our food quick and paid the bill. Thanks.  I guess.

Here we go with the big cheese steak debate. I did take the Philly cheese steak challenge and I have picked my favorite out of the bunch. For me Pat's was just OK compared to some of the others. The meat just seemed bland and a little on the dry side to me compared to others. You won't be dissappointed with a "Whiz Wit" but there are betters. However I did think their frie's were better then thier neighbors.

This place is hopelessly overpriced and does not offer the quality you would expect for that kind of money. You can get the same exact quality of sushi, if not better, at all you can eat bars in the area (where unlimited Sushi costs as much as one roll here). As far as the non-Sushi food items are concerned, I was not impressed, my husband ordered the cowboy steak and it was chewy and not seasoned well. Their 'CRAB CAKES' are made from IMITATION CRAB MEAT but priced like a real crab cake ($30!!!!) - I am so glad I asked before I ordered. I ended up getting the 'crispy' duck, which was mostly fatty on the outside and dry on the inside. The rice on the side was overcooked. The atmosphere is strange, with red lighting, it is kind of dingy and has the strangest mix of styles. It seems like it is attempting to be Asian with lots of Asian artwork and red and black walls but then they put a huge wall mural of Michelangelo's Creation of Adam in the middle of the room. Oh, and it seems to be seat yourself because there was no hostess to be seen anywhere. The drinks are too sweet and the bartender appeared to be drunk. He consistently tried to pressure our table into ordering shots, etc. And when we did would always drink one too. It seemed like he just didn't want to drink alone. We went to this restaurant on a Groupon deal which includes a 20% tip. While the service was not bad, if it had been up to me, I would not have left that much. I don't think we'll be back anytime soon.

The plain pizza and the Italian sausage parmesan is great. We also love the chicken wings. The owner is a nice guy. They also deliver and you can order online as well. We visit this place at least once a week.

They claim to have started the original "Fat Cat" in 1986 in New Brunswick. Being a Rutgers Alumni I had to test that claim and try the classic Fat Darrell.  It was pretty good, portion size appears to be larger than the grease trucks around RU.  Mr. G behind the counter is very friendly and welcoming.  I will be going back for sure.

Went there once to use a Groupon coupon. The food was not very tasty, the service was not friendly and it was unnecessarily crowded. The prices are very high for the quality, taste and experience. Wouldn't go there again despite the fact that it is very close to our home.

I highly recommend the dessert called rice ball in sweet wine!! It may looked like soup or porridge, but it was more thick and sticky.  There were lots of tiny sticky rice balls that had white or light yellow color in it, and within a small portion of rice wine, it was an visual and taste enjoyment. I was falling in love with the dessert,and I could feel the sweetness remained and melted in my mouth slower and slower. It really made my day!!!

Hmmm many things I could say about this joint... My friends and I were looking for a new spot in the city to try for brunch, so we decided on Jones due to its down-home menu and Stephen Starr-studded proprietorship. We walked in and were immediately taken by the restaurant's 50s style decor, despite the fact that an absent-minded mother allowed her children to aimlessly weave in, out and into me and my group of friends (not the fault of Jones but perhaps the first sign of danger within the restaurant). We were seated on the upper deck of the restaurant, which seemed to me like a cozy and private elevated area (loved the shag carpet), but later proved to be the land of forgotten patrons. Our waitress took the drink order promptly, and I was quite impressed with the customizable Bloody Mary menu. Anxiously awaiting the arrival of said beverages, my friends and I waited and waited on an order of drinks, which seemed par for the course in regards to the rest of the meal. Our waitress, though kind, was complicit in the slow service on which Jones appears to operate. I'm all for a leisurely brunch, but let's pick up the pace. As for the food, it was simply eh, which is incredibly disappointing when the banana maple walnut pancakes are advertised as though you'll never taste anything better. I would love to try Jones again for another meal, in part because I'm enthralled with the fact that it looks like a set of Mad Men, but I think I'd rather stick with diner food, which is a no doubt safer (and cheaper) bet. Oh and their coffee is FOUR dollars. Even Starbucks ain't that pretentious.

The falafel sandwich was tasty . The service was slow,very slow. place wasn't clean and  it was very noisy . But again the Falafel was very tasty. if it wasn't for all the other things i would give it 4.5 rating .

Ah, when the french classic comes to the U.S. it doesn't disappoint.  Always a treat of perfection at this place.  Salted Caramel is the best.  Stay a moment to people watch and enjoy the ultra feminine pastel decor.

Simply the best Pizza place @ neighborhood  of the square area. Nice quite warm welcoming place. Price is little high but it's okey to pay for their test & quality. I used to eat their lot, but since last couple years they Shorten their hours. Used to open early 11:00am on Thur & Fri. But not now. They should open early to cover lunch customer.

I love their speciality rolls! Cute little place, I wish it was a little bigger, but I guess the small size is a part of it's charm. I have and will continue to recommend this place to all of my friends.

One of my favorite restaurants in Philly. Calamari Salad & Tuna Pizza are so good! I've never left unhappy. They made our night special for my boyfriend & I on our anniversary, they lit a sparkler on our dessert.

I have been there for breakfast and was so impressed I went back the next day for lunch!  Both times I was greeted by a friendly hostess who seated us promptly.  The waitstaff was friendly and we didn't wait too long for our meal.  I liked the retro décor.  As a vegan I always get excited when I have a choice of vegan items on the menu!  There were three vegan choices for breakfast.  Recommended by a friend, I chose the vegan buckwheat pancakes with blueberries.  They were pretty good...large and VERY filling...I could barely get through 2!  The pineapple juice was fresh.  The next day when I went for lunch, for which there are more vegan options (than breafast).  I ordered the Garbanzowhich (a chickpea salad sandwich)...yum!  I would recommend this diner and will definitely be coming back!
Absolutely fantastic! Great burger and BBQ sauce, beers were outstanding. Serves and atmosphere was primo. Our server was very good and we were highly pleased with our experience.

Ordered delivery. I got the drunken noodles with Chicken and Indian pancakes. Both were good the pancakes were my favorite with the curry dipping sauce. The noodles were a little caked together I'm assuming for to the fact it was put in a container but it had lots of chicken and just enough spice. The pancakes came quartered and had a good curry dipping sauce. I got my order delivered within 30 min.

We are fans of Bobby Flay and were quite exicted to try the restaurant.  Unfortunately, this place misses on multiple levels: food, service, and value. We ordered lamb and it came out cold and overly sweet.  We also had the potato, the Gato Spreads, and some other dishes.  They were all average and below the quality one would expect at the prices charged.   We were extremely disappointed in the service.   We had to strain several times to get the attention of our waiter.  Dishes were forgotten.  Others were brought out in a haphazard manner.  As mentioned, the lamb was served cold.  Our waiter had a who cares attitude. The only thing this restaurant has going for it is the Bobby Flay name.  Otherwise, it is an absolute disappointment.

***SMALL*** This place is petite so do NOT bring a large group here without discussions and planning with the restaurant. Our group of 6 had a fantastic meal here - mostly because we knew to bring cash, knew the place was small (and made reservations well ahead of time), brought our own wine and water, and were ready to make the trek across the street to use a deli's bathroom. The food was fantastic, and the layout of the restaurant makes it possible to watch the chef at work - but keep in mind that this place is idiosyncratic.
Steak frite is amazing. And def get the crume brulee for desert!!!! It's a real French brûlée :). Bon appetite!

When one wants a gyro sandwich go the platter is also great. You will be stuff but your inner greedy will say continue to eat. I have being going here for the pass 3 or 4 years. One Saturday the family and I were in Denville I became hungry ask the family do they have a taste for Greek food. The family replied yes sounds good we need to find a spot close which I said no problem then drove us to Greek Town.
I'm with the other reviewers here.  This place is amazing!  Definitely yes to the mole sauce and the guacamole. The service was spectacular - so friendly.  Don't pass this place up!
I love this place the food is awesome I recommend it 100% plus you get more food for your buck..

In town for work this week and I ended up going twice. Fresh fish and a good deal in the all you can eat. Be prepared and come hungry. Rolls are big and delicious. I will definitely come back if I'm in the area again.

Great place to relax after a busy day.  They have some of the best cocktails I have tried.  I love the espresso and cucumber one.  The service is always friendly and the food is always phenomenal.  Prices are also extremely reasonable for this kinda atmosphere.
This place freaking rocks. Allagash Maine beer was superb. Please bring back wings on the appetizer menu.
Amazing food and service. The lentil sambusas are a must!  Gorgeous place and ambiance. Looks like i'm going to become a regular here.
The food was great, the garden seating was quaint but the service was absolutely horrible. The servers were aloof and took around 10 minutes just to serve us our coffee.

Sometimes you want to go Where everybody knows your name, And they're always glad you came; You want to be where you can see, Our troubles are all the same; You want to be where everybody knows your name.

Wonderful dining experience and fantastic food. We had the cheese platter, the guac, and I had the short rib dish for dinner.  All of it was incredible. The cheese platter seemed expensive until it comes out and your realize just how much they give you. It filled us up! I would definitely recommend it. Our waiter was attentive, engaging, and very helpful. The manager made great drink recommendations. I have been here twice now, once for brunch and once for dinner, and I would go again in a heartbeat.

Oh my gosh!!!! Mister hotpot was the greatest dinner I ever had. They have tons of selection and the soup selection was great! Best of all, their waiter was so nice to me. He help us when we needed. Oh yeah. His name is Jeffery. I love this place!!!
Hostess was kind of rude but server good! We got a flight and pulled pork sandwich and steak. Quick service kept drinks filled and the atmosphere was great!
Best Casino Mojitoes ever and.best fresh made guacamole.  Also everything else excellent! !!
The best "tacos al pastor" I've trying!! great place, great food. You also need to trying the "Intrincadas" amazing delicious

This has been my absolute favorite Italian restaurant I  had the pleasure to dine in!  Believe me, I have dined in many !  Love the small town personal atmosphere and service is excellent!  My always favorite is clams in white wine sauce, homemade manicotti with the best tomato sauce, and for dessert, their apple pie!  It sometimes is a challenge getting there due to the traffic, but well worth the effort!  Only request I still keep asking for, is Please, Please rehang that beautiful oil painting you always had over our favorite booth! First thing you see when you walk in the door! Sunflowers, blue sky! Gorgeous and so authentic/heart warming!
Joe's is always a pleasure!  I feel as though the portions have gone down in size however this is the best place to get good seafood in the area.  The staff is amazing and they make joe's a fun time!

We drove to this place for dinner from North of White Mountains for some 80 miles. For the fall season the restaurant was quite busy. Dal makhani was average, chilli paneer was a little sweet and not what chilli paneer you would think of. Naan's were good.

This place is fantastic. I came here the other night with a friend, we both had the tuscan chicken, it was delightful! We also shared the mushroom cigars and the tuna tartar to start. They were both outstanding. Cant wait to come back! Its BYOB!
Great food, great service, and such a cute location! Definitely a great place to go for breakfast.

I usually hated eating falafel but coming here it just changed my perspective. I bought the platter and the smoothie. Let's start with the platter, it comes with hummus, salad,pita bread, several different flavors of falafel and something's else. The hummus and falafel are darn GOOD and this are the stuff that makes there falafel sandwhich the best. The smoothie was alright not that good. Spent over $20 at this place but well worth. This my top place to get falafel from now on.

In this lovely little Chelsea restaurant I had one of the best if not the best sandwich I have ever had.  Go and order the credo pork sandwich, marinated, braised pork butt with aiole  and chimicurri sauce, and crunchy diced potatoes!
Good place to go for great beer. I have had some of the appetizers and they were good. This is a great place to go to relax in the city.

Family style ONLY. Very bright. Awkwardly bright. They don't give you menus. There is one big menu on the wall (like at Burger King) and you order from that. Baked clams tasted like any other so nothing amazing here. Wait staff is attentive. They do not stray from the family style rule at all though. They are very precise about what the menu says and they will not change anything for you.

one of my favorite bars! sometimes a lil too crowded but the staff members are great, and they take the time to get to know you, and they make you feel comfortable right from the moment you step in. Great food, great drinks, and great atmosphere!

Superb food! I strongly recommend the bacalhau com natas, by far some of the best I've ever had! The sangria is like no other and the atmosphere is relaxed and inviting! My mother had the octopus which is another house specialty and it too was delicious! Five stars all the way around...
If we will eat here you never pity about it! It cost only 6$... You can take 1 portion for 2 people!

Very impressed. I had a few hours to kill near the Trenton airport. Tried this place and dined solo in the formal dining part. Service was polite and prompt. They were just as courteous to a single gal as to a large party. I ordered a Veal dish served over gnocchi- amazing! The gnocchi are homemade and soft. The sauce had such good flavor. The veal was ok but the rest of the dish was so good I'd consider flying back to Trenton for it. It's. BYOB and there is conveniently a liquor store in the same complex.

Love this place!! The food is awesome and the ladies always smile and ask if we like the food or nay. So sweet! Every time I go to Korean town, I always go to bcd... I had miss Korea once, wasn't as good as bcd hahaha
It's all good. Busy but well worth the wait. I was not as crazy about the breadsticks as everyone else but food is good and a nice wine selection.
Fantastic vegan food! Highly recommend the vegan cheesesteak, avocado spring rolls and soy golden nuggets.

My wife and I are here right now after a long flight form San Diego.  I am very whole foods plant based. Finding this reastaurant is awesome!  One of absolute best vegan / veggie reastaurant anywhere!!!!!!!!!!!!  What more can I say?  The owner is friendly, the staff is great.  I am happy!

This is the restaurant in the area that I always recommend to people. Tagliatelle with boar ragu is my go to dish with the house red wine. The goat cheese crostini is another favorite. This place is consistently solid. Dinner for 2 at the bar is always a pleasure.

Food was delicious.  Staff was wonderful.  Bartender, Nich, couldn't have been better!

Food is good service totally sucked, had to ask for drink refills apps brought out with entree and no silverware had to ask for it.  I had coupon for half price meal the waitress took off 4.00 and said she hadn't seen the coupon.  The owner came over and fixed the mistake after I complained.  As we were leaving the owner approached a table of 4 and asked if they were done they needed the table.  How rude and inappropriate!  Don't waste your time they just lost 6 customers.

I stopped in for dinner a few nights ago and WHAT HAPPENED SUSHI LOUNGE?!?!?  The sushi I remember from last year - was NOT the sushi I had this time around.  The risotto was cold by the time it got to the table which was a HUGE reason why I wanted to come back here. The Hoboken roll - tasted very fishy and that's it.  The Hoboken roll I remember was flavorful and was so good I ordered another serving of it.  This time around, I could barely finish it.   I'm not sure if they have a different sushi chef or if management has changed but, it was very disappointing to say the least.  For the price you pay here, sushi needs to be on point not bleh.

I'm not sure why I continue to go in there when I'm in the city for doctor appointments. The food is good but the guy making coffee is so obnoxiously Rude. I'll give it to you if your having a bad day but every time I go in there. Bad mojo!

We stopped at the Lone Star Grill in Sweetwater, Texas on our way home to Austin. Not much to look at inside or out but I had the best steak fingers ever there. They cut their own and have a great batter. Also had their house dressing which was terrific. Friendly staff. Worth a stop!

Oh the meatballs!  Jimmy , the nicest, most helpful waiter in the world says they are the signature dish.  I always rate an Italian restaurant by its sauce and this sauce is great. The  meatballs were just the best, lots of sauce and  cheese.   The level of excellence can be found in every dish.  I had the best prosciutto of my life at Campagna..  The staff is so helpful and attentive.  The ambience is friendly.  I visit often.
Great place for something different. Sandwiches taste Great.!
Wonderful breakfast and brunch spot.  Awesome espresso bar and long tables for reading the paper at breakfast.  The pepper and pecorino eggs are so great at breakfast!
So good we came back again 3 days later. Awesome, authentic Italian food. The polo di vitello alla piccata is great!!
Nailed it: still talking about every course, days later.  We will be back.
My favorite Thai place in NYC! Great Ambience (loud, trendy, dark). MUST HAVE: chicken pad Thai and curry puffs.

This is a Japanese restaurant specializing in Ramen. I went here on a cold rainy day hoping to warm up with some yummy  ramen. This place is just off 9th and is convenient for an after work meal. The dining room is small and crowded. The decor is a nice traditional Japanese style, sparely decorated with tapestries and signs and lots of wood. The staff here I would describe as curt to the point of rudeness. The waitress doubles as a host and she has very little patience. She tried to seat a couple in front of me despite the fact that I was first because I was still waiting for my companion to arrive. Is there no respect for ones place in the line anymore? When I sat down I was unpleasantly surprised to be sitting on what looked like a cast off part of a bookshelf. This was I guess a very modern stool that was seriously uncomfortable. I consider myself to be fairly slim but had trouble fitting on such a narrow stool. The appetizer I had was a great potato thing on a skewer covered in ponzu sauce, yum. The main course options here are lackluster to terrible. Everything on the menu is basically pork so if you have any dietary limitations or health concerns stay clear. I would like to rename this restaurant Pork Soup just so that everyone is aware that that's all they offer. If your vegetarian or Jewish do not go to this restaurant you will go home hungry.

Take out is really good.  Way better than our dine-in experience.  There are 2 separate menus.  The Chubster Sandwiches are awesome and the pizza is thin crust.  The only thing keeping this from a 5 star review is the fact that our delivery guy was half an hour late.
Very unique take on korean/mexican food. Try the veggie kimchi bowl! My boyfriend loved the chicken tacos.

I gave this place a try because I saw that they had a quinoa veggie burger + the ability to customize your burger. Although the reviews looked pretty bad, I actually liked BurgerFi.  Some of the staff members were a bit standoffish, but others were reasonably friendly. Personally, I'd prefer it if they did the ordering like The Counter (another custom burger chain) where you fill out a short card to list what you want. It's just easier than trying to tell someone what you want over the noise of a busy restaurant, and it seems to result in fewer errors. The veggie burger was delicious. Even if I didn't have a preference for vegetarian dishes where available, I would still be inclined to order the veggie burger over a traditional meat burger. It was just very, very good. Some veggie burgers are really soft and they smush out of the sides of the bun when you bite down, but that wasn't the case with this one. It had a slight crunch at the edges, and the middle was soft. I WOULD recommend getting at least one condiment or topping that adds some moisture, though. I could see how it might be a little dry without mayo, tomatoes, etc. I also liked that the burger wasn't enormous. There was an option to do a double or triple burger, but the single was the perfect size for a normal person who eats healthy portions. The fries with parmesan and herbs were also fantastic - highly recommended.   One more thing - if you want to get their food delivered, I noticed there's at least one local service that will deliver their food for a $20 minimum. Just Google "BurgerFi Philadelphia delivery" if you're curious (not going to promote a specific delivery service here).

I'll be honest, the quesadilla was amazing. However, it was amazing if all I could stomach was something that fit in the palm of my hand. The guacamole was served with a great selection of flavorful chips, but the guac itself had little to no flavor. Chipotle has a more tasty guacamole than this. We had to ask for hot sauce to add flavor.
Very tasty diner, I got an egg white omelette with sweet potatoes and roasted broccoli and I was very pleased!! So nice to have gluten free, vegan options at such a quaint location!
Not bad. This location gets lot of seniors for the early bird. But the burgers were good. Not the best, but not the worst.

I had read about Marigold many, many times before, and finally decided to try it for our fifth anniversary. I wanted something unique to surprise my husband, and Marigold did not disappoint. From the second we walked in, you could tell that service was a key focus for this establishment. They recalled the specifics of my peanut allergy , as well as the fact that it was our anniversary, details I had provided when making our reservation. I can not even put into words how amazing the food was. This is a meal I will never forget. Each course was impeccable, and so incredibly creative. Standards like pork and beans and eggs benedict took on a new, reimagined, and delicious light. To top it off, the staff did everything they could to facilitate an amazing experience. There is absolutely no doubt that I will be recommending Marigold in the future. Thank you for making our fifth wedding anniversary so memorable!
Our waiter, the bartender, the owner, the chef = absolutely amazing. Best experience. Best food. Best night. Crazy laughs.
Have been here three times so far and I like every dish we got. The food comes fast and it's authentic Chinese food. They don't take card if the bill is under 20.

nice south philly place if your looking for quiet this is not the place, they have a jukebox you can play songs off. beers are hopping beers, some with big ACH count. the Brisket is ridiculous, it is amazing and you dont even need to cut it it it just pulls apart the pork is also great, it melts in your mouth, potato salad , corn bread is awesome, dessert pecan pit, i had root beer float. for the 4 of us it was 150.00, a bit pricey but worth every penny if you are in the mood for some really good Barbeque. i would come back again in a heart beat
Nice place with all sorts of spices and cheap. Make sure that you take cash. If it is less than $10.00, they will charge you a .30 cents service charge. RIDICULOUS!

We arrived at about 3 pm on Saturday.  The wait to get in was about 45 minutes.  Being from Hawaii we know Ramen, and we have tried Momofuko several times.  The consensus was that Totto Ramen had better ramen than either in Hawaii or at Momofuko.  However, the steamed buns were better at Momofuko.  The atmosphere was better here, more relaxed and less noisy.  One strange thing was the kitchen sing had the tap open and water running the entire time we sat at the bar, and it seemed terribly wasteful of water.  The meal was excellent.
Decent food. Cash only.
Overrated! Good but doesn't deserve 4.5 stars. Food is too simple, atmosphere is nice yet too crowded.
Killer!!!  Get the Goats neck and the smoked mussles!!! Had a great meal and it's a really cool atmosphere.

It's solid Italian food, but probably over priced. Place is a bit touristy, but for this neighborhood it's some of the best Italian. I say come for lunch it's quieter and cheaper and the food is the same.
Good food friendly staff and very beautifully clean Restaurant I try tomyum Kung and chicken pad Thai it was delicious It's busy place every one should try it
This place has great energy and excellent German beer. I was just in Munich and this reminds me of the beer gardens there. Food is good.

Best burgers ever, staff is always so nice and i never have a bad time. I always get the manly burger and truffle fries- you HAVE to get the truffle fries! Got the apple pie for desert. Would have been better if it was warm but it was still so good! Best!

We ordered chicken kaboob (came with salad) and chicken curry (came with rice) Here is my eval: Salad: 8/10 Kaboob: 9/10 Curry: 7/10 Bread: 10/10 Value/$: 10/10 Service:10/10 I loved the place I would come back again

A great new spot in Astoria for real Italian + a friendly atmosphere.  My husband + I try new places often and if we return, it's a great sign.  We've been back 4 times since they opened and each time the food, wine + service were great!  They even accommodated a 7 person party with ease and only a small wait at the bar - where a friendly bartender offered me a few tastes of red so I could decide on a favorite. The risotto (the flavors rotate) has been amazing on two occasions.  It's by far the largest portion of an entree available.  A friend did find the ravioli entree portion to be on the smaller side but that doesn't bother me at good restaurants since it's a good match when ordering both appetizers + dessert as well.   Speaking of which, Vite has made me a believer in Tiramisu - which I have never enjoyed before tasting their version!  Order it. My favorite from the start were the small glass tumblers used for wine.  It's a sweet touch and realistic one since the venue + tables are cozy.   The striped cloth napkins got me too, which all ties into an authentic Italian restaurant + a class act addition to Astoria.  Thank goodness for Vite!

New place since late summer early fall 2014. I've ordered cheesesteak, burrito paisano, burrito mariachi, taco salad, chicken cutlet wrap, 2 XL pepperoni, 1 large bacon sausage &broccoli pizza. Everything was great. Grinders are as good or better tasting than Joey garlics. The Place is clean. I live around the corner and have been to all the restaurants that existed here. Aside from Ella's which was here in 2011, this is the best. The pizza passes my kids test & I love the grinders and Mexican food. Please give this place a try. It's pretty good.

Always pleased when it comes to this place. The food is great love the pad Thai & steamed dumplings. The wait staff is very attentive & the prices are even better. They have a luncheon special daily that is worth the price.

Great for fried-food lovers.   What I tried: Combo deal flounder, 2 shrimps, fries. Plus fried broccoli with cheese separately. Tasty/good/fresh.  Fries average. Did not usually notice the place when walking past it until I found out about it online. Easy to miss. People nice. I like the food. Would come again.

I went on a Sunday afternoon and it was pretty empty, couldn't understand why once I had the food. The decor is beautiful and modern and they even have spaces set aside for small parties. We ordered from the reasonably priced lunch menu and I had the Kafta platter and it was a perfect portion. The food tasted fresh and delicious. The dinner menu is much more pricey and higher end foods, will have to come back to try that.

One the best tacos I've ever had.  The carne asado taco were really tasty and was actually a good size.  The same went for the pollo asado.  Having coca cola from Mexico in a glass bottle was a huge plus.
The food was good, but not amazing. The service was excellent, though, and the Byob policy makes it an easy, chill dinner. Try it if you like ethnic!
Amazing food, really fresh and healthy. Great selection of vegetarian stuff like black bean & sweet potato burger-like-things. And delicious veggies! Plus, great service. This place wins.
Very nice place.
A vegan cafe and cocktail lounge with a wonderful ambiance and super tasty dishes. The sunchoke soup, chick pea fries and the potato croquettes are simply fabulous!
Amazing, cheap Indian. Love it, and order from here all the time.

This is a throw back restaurant in an old Italian American neighborhood. This owner operator trattoria is a real jem in the heart of corona. Mario our host was outstanding. His recommendations of house made soppersata and pickled eggplant were excellent choice for an antipasto. Only the red pepper stuffed with risotto bolegenese was even better. For entree the veal a la grappa served with broccoli rabe was tender savory and slightly sweet with a hint of fresh table grapes. The pasta special was also outstanding. The pasta dough was cut with guitar strings to create a spaghetti not to be missed. It was topped with a variety of fresh mushrooms and finished with roasted tomatoes and shaved black truffles. The house made red wine was a perfect pairing for this old school Italian feast. Complimentary biscotti and a lemon chello on the rocks was a perfect ending to this authentic queens restaurant. I can't wait to return. Thanks Nicolette for showing us this fine dining destination in the heart of corona.

great service!  salad was great, baby squid delicious, 2 of the 3 grilled sardines were wonderful, the recommended wine was fantastic and the shrimp perfectly cooked!  We'll be going back and also to their new location in Westbrook!
The Oyster shooters alone are worth five stars. Best sushi in Philadelphia.

Ambience? Check. Young, fashionable clientele? Check. Service? Decent. Food? Ehh... If this was the only restaurant left in the world, I would not starve. However, I found the food to be very heavily seasoned, masking the flavors of the ingredients. At similar price points for swanky tapas bars, there are better options out there (e.g. Alta).

The straight dope...The food was good , The desert was great.   We came in at 9pm and was told it would be 10 -15 minutes to eat, finally was able to start eating at 10 pm. Its not the servers... they were fine, just very understaffed. We asked for bread just to help us through the wait and they decided to charge us for it. They should have let us have it for free just for waiting an hour.   Other than that the ambiance and and atmosphere is incredible. Very Williamsburg , Very Brooklyn.
The ramen is tasty and the wait staff is courteous.  Sadly, the portion-size is for babies.
The food is decent - service is quick - some acquired tastes.
Had gone here for dinner. Had fish tikka tandoori, which was ok. Also had biryani which wad pretty good, recommend the biryani.

Eh, I wanted to love this place.  Major disappointment. Things started well:  It was my pick for a special date. We had a reservation, and were seated on time at a romantic, great table for 2 at the back of the restaurant.  Love the warm vibe of the open kitchen and wood tables. Great lighting.   Looked at the menu, and was drawn immediately to several things on the menu.   Food:  I ordered a fig salad.  Waitress tells us after the fact, oh, sorry we are out of figs, we are substituting something else. I ordered duck.  Waitress returns to the table after we place the order and says halfhearted oh, sorry we just sold the last duck.  When your menu has about 5 entrees on it, wouldn't you make sure not to run out of your signature at prime time on a Friday!? The apps we got were fine, small portions not particularly interesting flavors.  The steak was excellent, but kitchen didn't honor medium rare request.  Fluke was fine. Service:  Waitress wasn't very attentive (see issues above) except to rush us to order or get more drinks. Slow to bring wine.  Not welcoming, basic too cool attitude. Evening then took a terrible turn when they squeezed a table for six in next to us - carrying a 2 top over my husbands head.  Their party included several drunk mid twenties girls who proceeded to yell/raise the decibel level in the restaurant by multiples.  It was so bad the date at the table on the other side of us chose to finish their bottle of wine at the bar rather than stay at the table. Bottom line:  go elsewhere.  Other options with better food and service in the west village.
Los Angeles type Mexican spot. Great tacos, solid margaritas, and an authentic ambiance.
One of my favorite spots in bushwick. The flatbread and crispy cauliflower are amazing.
Love this place. Great pasta , burgers , sandwiches and cheesesteaks
Had the Roast Beef on baguette. The baguette was a little too hard but still delicious. Also had a cup of Yucatan Chicken soup which was out of this world.

This is a great date spot. The food is delicious and the portions are large. We usually split an appetizer, order two different entrees, and never have room for dessert although I wish we had. We always go for the special appetizers. We had the lobster cocktail app once and the zucchini flowers another time.  The squash flowers were oozing with cheese and flavor. My girlfriend always orders the chicken parm. The sauce is delicious and The cheese is melted perfectly. I've had a variety of dishes, usually fish or pasta. All were outstanding. The complimentary champagne at the end, hits the spot.

We had our rehearsal dinner here October 17 2014. Half the wedding party lives in NY and the other half from central jersey so I pucked a place in the middle. I found this restaurant through yelp and so happy I did. The food was fantastic and so was the staff. Thank you so much, everyone had such a great time. I will definitely be coning back to eat. Great food!!!!
Great Service ! It was super quiet on a Friday night . Food was great great great . Love Cracker Barrel !!

The food is delicious as i heard and the menu is very unique. Everything is made fresh with quality ingredients. Its perfect place for breakfast or lunch for great price.   I had to try Memo burger, Its AMAZING!!!! Its perfect amount of house ground beef patty w caramelized onion, fontina cheese on brioche roll...And the fresh cut fries are very delicious as well.. The coffee is Excellent and they make it  the way you like..It look like they fresh ground beans too.. The service is great with very friendly staffs, The  space is small but its very cozy and cute. I will definitely be back to try everything on the menu!! I Love the place and the food .

There are many good things about this place, but equally as many turn offs. Although the place sounds like a small local breakfast place, the interior makes you feel as if you are in a small crowded food court. The lunch items looked pretty good ( I myself did not try any) however the breakfast was OK...nothing more. If you are looking for a good local breakfast place with tasty food that will keep you coming back, I suggest you keep looking, nothing outstandingly good here.
Great selection on menu, clean and very helpful wait staff. Grace is excellent and very knowledgeable. Salmon is Devine but the shredded Brussels sprouts are out of this world. Highly Recommended

Groupon was a great deal. Servers are great. Food is above average. The place is never packed for some reason, even being right in center city. I would recommend, but do expect a more casual than formal setting

I would say this is the one place I've been to that had a good chicken pad thai with an extra kick of freshness to it. I also had the Chinese watercress salad that was extremely delicious. I loved the thai iced tea, it was super sweet. And the curry with chicken was also great. I was a bit upset with the customer service though. After waiting 20 minutes for my change, the waitress asks if I was waiting for changed.

We were invited for this restaurant by friends who described themselves as very picky and were really excited going to this restaurant. When we entered to the main sitting area this place was packed and very noisy almost like entering a bar. The food and the wine were very good but miniature quantities. I understand that you want to be exclusive but to give a soup size less than a cup? This all could be fine except for the high price for the food and we stayed hungry. Even this I could forgive but not that night that followed both my husband and me had a problem all night and had to run to the bathroom so I do not get more descriptive. I know that everyone is saying that this is a great restaurant but unfortunately this has been our experience. I am wondering if anyone else had the same.

i came, i saw, i conquered(with cheese) lol...place is small but the flavor is big!!! only way they do wat they do is if the second u walk into that door ur magically transported to philly. thats the only way ur gettn this in brooklyn. the man is a genius, a scientest, and a chef. thats the only explanation. pass by.. you wont b disappointed.
I'm in love with Thai food and I would say this is my go to spot when I'm in park slope! I always get the chicken pad thai and a thai iced tea and my night is set! Love this place!!!

Amazing, amazing, amazing! My 1st time in NY, googled best restaurants in the area and Rubirosa was on every list! Loved how quaint it was...i wanted to try something authentic and simple so that I can taste their sauce, because it's all in the sauce! Well, their sauce was orgasmic! I told them they should bottle it! Had the rice balls and they were cooked to perfection. Their banana split was a perfect ending to a great meal!! Can't rave enough about this place. Got back to Miami craving that meal all over again! Great service as well btw!!!

A bit hesitant given the location but the restaurant itself has a nice family vibe. Big portions but the overall quality of the food was just ok. It wasn't bad and I will definitely return again and try other dishes but there was just something missing. It's always busy on the weekends so they must be doing something right.

A must try when in NYC.  We went for the lunch tasting and it was so good!  I would fly to New York just to go to this restaurant again. The lunch tasting came with 5 courses, all very delicious.  The added bread cart with its fancy breads (e.g. pistachio saffron) was a nice touch. The restaurant was beautiful.  Walking in you are greeted with a wall of fresh apples from floor to ceiling, a nice sweet smell. Trust me and try it.

This was the worst dinner experience I have ever had.  Our waiter would constantly ignore my friends and I as he was busy with other tables.   The food took a very long time to come out and it was only so-so.   They failed to split our check correctly and charged me more than they should have.  I will not be returning.
Love this place!  Bartenders so cute and soooo funny!!! Great music.....and way better than that bitch on Jay Street!!
Lots of food for a great price!  I wish they have this in the Bay Area...
Best kept secret, really good Thai food in a beautiful neighborhood I recommend the fried calamari and pad see yu =]

I wanted to love this place but just didn't. I liked the location, view was nice and the restaurant itself was nice.  There were 4 of us and we were excitied for the experience.  And then it started to fall apart.  The bartender was pretentious and almost mean in her delivery.  Same for the waiter who was frustrated to have to deal with a vegan patron.  The food portions were small which would be ok with if they were filling but mine was not. I got the scallops- they were delicious, but there were only 4.  The bottom line was that everything was just good and nothing blew us away like we were hoping.  Then the bill came:   Drinks at the bar, wine & drinks at the table, 2 apps 4 entrees 2 coffees & 2 desserts came out to be $500.  Granted, most of our money was spent in alcohol but we walked away feeling it was so not worth it.

Came here with my boyfriend on a Friday night not realizing they don't actually have a lot of seating compared to how big the place is. The hostess was super sweet and let us sit down even though we didn't have reservations and they were going to be packed in an hour. We ordered the Mac n cheese, salmon, watermelon/goat cheese salad, and lemon Parmesan cauliflower. Everything on the menu sounded fun and vibrant, but we were very disappointed. Everything was bland. Except the salmon, it tasted like they seasoned it. The ratio of watermelon and goat cheese compared to arugula in the salad was completely off. Couldn't taste lemon or Parmesan on the cauliflower. The Mac n cheese was decent. Had to call the waiter over for bread. For the price, I wouldn't go back. But it was nice for a date night :)

Tried it out of curiosity and I was hooked. The Loffa changed my life with the amount of food you could fit into it and not feel like you just eat all of it. The decor is a cool place to sit, relax, and enjoy.
I'm not normally one for seafood but their Captain's Cakes are amazing!! It's been a while since I've been but will be in very soon for some more great food and drinks!!

The sandwich was good but nothing to rave about. I was not a fan of the bread. Too tough for me but I could tell it was fresh. When it's hard to bite through you just make a mess. And what sandwich place in Philly doesn't have a cheesesteak on the menu?

Couple things: 1.) this place is legitimately overhyped on yelp. 2.) the service is slow 3.) the Benedict Jane which was recommended was not that great. Best part of the dish were the potatoes. 4.) blood Mary was actually pretty good. 5.) this place got two stars because there was an eggshell in my dish, in my first bite, and that just ultimately ruined the remainder of my experience, my friend had a crab shell or crawfish she'll in her first bite so that destroyed hers as well, my cousin like her baked egg dish  no weird errors there.  I mean it's fine, the food was fine, but when you get excited and take that first bite and get an egg shell and try to look for a paper napkin to spit it out in in front of everyone and get awkward suck it up, try to swallow the egg shell, then you can't because the texture is like sand and it's too finely ground at that point, you're just stuck with crap in your mouth etc. meh I don't want to go back. Enjoy.
great place to get food, browse around, talk to people
Best breakfast we've had in New York. Tasted just as spectacular as it looked! Would return to New York just for this Breakfast!

I die and go to brunch heaven every Sunday I have been there! Food is amazing. Presentation is spot on! They may make slight variations to the brunch menu and it never disappoints. And please, order a mimosa!

I just ordered delivery from this place for the first time tonight. They forgot half the order, so I had to give them a jingle to let them know. Not only did they bring me the rest of the order, but 15 minutes later they brought over two sides as a token of apology. As I opened the bag, an apology note as well. I'm from the world of "mistakes happen," so I wasn't upset about the missing food, more just confused. But, this service really impressed me. Really smart recovery and an appreciation for the customer that you just don't encounter much anymore. I will order again -- and, did I mention the food was also delicious?!!!

AMAZING FOOD!!! I am in the area frequently and always dining-in however tonight I took a whirl at delivery- I highly suggest Friedman's! I got the turkey burger which is handmade (packed with spices and flavor), Rosemary fries- delish, and the brussels which were to die for! If you're in the neighborhood stop by- it's a must!!!!

Great service. Great food. Nice drink selection. Would have been 5 stars had the only other party sitting in the back room NOT been seated at the table next to us! Can't understand the seating etiquette when the rest of the back room was wide open (and there were still tables open when we left). We heard them talking about having to wear sandles due to a toe infection. I'll be back but will insist on being moved if that happens again!

My friend recommended we dine at this restaurant. I checked out the menu online and it looked great. I was shocked when I walked in to find a modern diner. It definitely was not what I was expecting! Maybe I'm too old and/or expected something a little more sophisticated. The service was great and the food was pretty good. The best dish was the grilled octopus. The crispy brussels sprouts were good, but too greasy and friend for me. The steak frites was another good dish as the meat was perfectly cooked and the fries were delicious. Probably a good bet for those in their 20's or 30's; anyone older might be better off dining elsewhere.

If you want to find a Chinese restaurant in University City, SangKee may be a good choice. The food here may not be absolutely great but totally acceptable. Its location, service and ambiance may promote you to have the Chinese style meal.   Location: SangKee has a special location, at the first floor of the Sheraton Hotel. This location may give itself a chance to have more customers. Nevertheless, unlike most of the restaurants in the hotel, this restaurant has relatively more delicious food with a passable prices. Service: The workers of this restaurant are totally friendly and helpful. Several workers in the restaurant can speak Chinese. When I first communicated with them in Chinese, I just feel I'm back to my hometown. When I had meals in this restaurant, I also saw 20% to 30% non-Chinese customers. Waiters could also communicate with them in fluent English. They could also give accurate descriptions of the food and some constructive suggestions to customers. SangKee's service may attract more customers to the restaurant. However, their service is not completely perfect, because, sometimes, customers need to wait for their seats while the restaurant is crowded. Food: One customer claimed on Yelp that "Sang Kee Noodle House provides passable Chinese food -- it's generally okay, but not great" (C.Sen). I think although the "Chinese food" here is not absolutely traditional Chinese style, it is much better than the food I have tried in some other Chinese restaurants in Philadelphia. One of the dishes I want to recommend in SangKee is the "Spicy Stir-fry Pot". This one is extremely attractive to those people who are keen on Chinese spicy food. Since I'm from Sichuan Province, I have a high requirement for spicy food. This dish almost meets my requirement. It holds different spicy contents, like shrimp, pork, cabbage, tofu which make it not only spicy but also full of various flavor. Its taste is similar to our hometown's chili pot "Taiwanese Beef Noodle Soup" is also tasty. One bowl of noodles hold about 30% to 40% beef meat over noodle. This would make the dish so attractive to those carnivorous customers, like me. The taste of the soup is also very delicious. Despite trying this specific noodle, people can also try noodle with chicken, pork, shrimp or seafood. However, one thing the restaurant need improve is to add diverse flavor of soup in different kinds of noodle. This can make multiple styles noodles taste differently. The taste of all the dishes in SangKee is similar to Hong Kong style taste. This may be attractive to those people from Hong Kong or Guangzhou province. Most of the restaurants in the hotel always sell dishes with high price and small quantity of meat. Unlike them, you should try SangKee because holding enough meat is the common characteristic of all the dishes here. For all the dishes, there are three main special types. They are "SangKee Favorites", like Beijing Roast Duck, Crispy Garlic Fried Chicken, Steamed Fresh Stripe Bass, "Asia Rice Bowl", like Bulgogi Rice, Hot Pepper Beef Rice Bowl and "Big Bowl Noodle Soup" which I mentioned previously. Different desserts, drinks are also available. One thing great is that I can even enjoy the Chinese traditional hot tea. Ambiance: There are both outside and inside seats for customers. The chairs and desks are brown and the light inside room makes customers feel comfortable to enjoy their meal. There is no music inside the restaurant, but the atmosphere still let customers feel comfortable. There is a bar-like table near the door of the restaurant. Customers who prefer to have meal with themselves often seat at these tables. There are different tables with sizes for 2 to 10 people in the restaurant, too. One thing I think SangKee should improve is to offer more chairs for customers in the waiting room.
I would definitly go back! i enjoyed the food and drink.  I stronly recommend this place!

SOOOO happy this place opened. Great staff, great food and great atmosphere. What a wonderful addition to our neighborhood! Congrats on nailing it! Cant wait for their breakfast and lunch to be extended to dinner!!!!!

While visiting my bf in NYC, she insisted that we have pizza at this place. She talked it up for days and I was concerned that I'd be disappointed because of all the hype leading up to the meal. As stated in all the other reviews, the place is a hole in the wall. Rather dumpy to be honest. But the pie did not disappoint. It was delicious. Fresh, fresh, fresh ingredients. Hand made dough. Hand grated fresh mozzarella and parmesan. Chunky tomato sauce and topped with fresh cut basil. The master behind the pizza, Dom, made every pizza himself from start to finish. Do yourself a favor and check this place out if you're ever in Brooklyn. I'd highly recommend topping the pizza with the fresh red peppers (not the dried flakes, but red pepper soaked in olive oil). Cons- be prepared to wait. Also, it's pricey- an original cheese pizza is $32.00.
The Brunch and Burger in this place is very good.  I definitely Recommend
Traditional Japanese tea and snacks with a modern twist. I love everything on the menu. The teas are must-try: the roasted rice tea was the best I've ever had:3
