I'm so glad I found this place on Yelp! It's soooo delicious and definitely one of my favorite restaurants. Put it this way, I went with my boyfriend on Thursday and we were back on Saturday. I'm in love with their paradise shrimp and shrimp spring rolls. I highly recommend The King and I, great food and excellent service.

Quick delivery. That's the only positive I have for this place. Ordered udon noodles with beef. The noodles were extra rubbery feeling and just tasted over cooked. I'm by no means a Japanese cuisine expert but I can definitely advise to stay away from that part of the menu. Then again this is really a Chinese restaurant so maybe I ordered wrong? However my wife's Chinese seafood dish was equally as bad. The steamed dumplings were extremely bland. The spring rolls were good and the chicken corn soup was also bland.
Great place for local take out or pick up. Probably would not dine in as it's an older  dated room. Driver is very friendly and fast! Have been happy with the quality of the pizzas.
I thought after waiting over 30 minutes for my food, it would taste magical...yeah..not so much. It wasn't bad, but it wasn't amazing. It was average and definitely not worth the wait.

What can i say? This place is one of the best places in bay ridge hands down and I have lived here all my life. The beer selection is amazing, the food is great. My personal favorite is the Johnny Cash hotdog. In the winter and summer this place is packed on the weekends and it should be. I live around the corner from Lockyard and I am a frequent patron. I hope this stays around for a LONG time!

Great food and idea, not so great on execution and management I love that a place like this exists, and the food is pretty great, if not cheap. The staff are rude and the place is super disorganized during the lunch rush -- lines everywhere and no one knows where to go. Additionally, no one is a managing the seating so you have people camped out for ages with laptops taking up tables. If they tightened up a few things and made some improvements to the staff it could be a five star place.
Attentive service. Food came out quickly. Large portions, enough for 2 meals. Loved the chicken satay. It was tender and full of flavor.
Love, love, love this place!  The happy hour sangria special, guacamole and ambiance are at the top of my list.  Each time that I've been was always a delish time.
Great vegan place where the food is good and the people are friendly. Try their mighty mang!
Ok this place is getting 5 stars because Mike the bartender was the best!  Fun and engaging.  Thanks Mike!
The sea bass melted in your mouth! Down to earth lounge with great drinks. The mac n cheese was wonderful as well. Friends had the English muffin hamburger and they were well satisfied!
Busy, interesting. A little fake.

On a business trip in June we searched Yelp for places to eat.   We chose this spot on a Friday night.  It was empty when we walked in.  Being from California we are not used to the BYOB idea so we didn't have anything to drink but water;(  The waitress kindly told us that we were welcome to go the liquor store down the street and bring back something, we thought that was nice. This place looked promising in the pictures but the food was not good.  We had empanadas, arepas, chicken soup and a beef dish with fried bananas and black beans.  The chicken soup lacked any flavor as did the rest of our food.   We took a taxi from Old Town where we were staying and were glad that it was easy to flag a taxi to take us home.  This place was NOT worth the cab fare.

One star loss for the rude service and two more for the "eh" food. The broth only tasted good with the two slices of pork that we were given. When those were gone so was all the flavor and then the broth was mostly just water. Watched as the chef grabbed pre-packaged noodles from a cardboard box and throw it in some water which turned out to be extremely chewy. The menu doesn't explain what's in the food. Waitress kept plopping water into the cups and spilling it all over. The bill came to 24 and the tip section read 2 dollars. We paid the 26. As we were leaving she comes up to us and tells us we haven't given her a tip. States the two dollars were tax and as my bf pulls out his wallet she requests a $4 tip which may be a reasonable tip for someone who wasn't spilling water everywhere and forgetting the sides we asked for. Tried to eat ramen somewhere that wasn't Totto Ramen. Went in expecting Totto Ramen quality and we were of course let down. Our bad...
Love living around the corner from here,  never have had a roll I didnt like.  I take all my visitors here for brunch, gotta love the lobster bloody.
Shhhhhhhhhhh, do not tell anyone how good this place is, there is no room to fit a single other person on a Saturday or Sunday morning.

I came in here with ridiculously high expectations and I gotta tell you, it didn't measure up.  Yes, the food is definitely good but not knock your socks off good. I ate the Chicken Parmesan and the missus had the Lasagna.  We also had a mozzarella/prosciutto appetizer which was just average.  All of the reviews about the unnecessarily long specials menu are accurate.  Our waiter was talking for at least 10 minutes.  Just put them in the menu and call it a day.  I would compare this Italian Restaurant to Parkside in Corona Queens.  Parkside used to be amazing but has gone downhill a bit and is now just average.  If you want really really really AMAZING Italian food you gotta go to Don Peppe's in Ozone Park.  Not to mention, you're surrounded by mobster looking like individuals that kiss each other out of respect.  So, with that being said, bring your appetite, keep your mouth shut and you'll have a wonderful experience.  Also, bring CASH.  They don't accept credit cards.  Hope this helps.

If Ur in the mood for great pizza, Modern Apizza is the place to be.  The Food is excellent in every sense of the word Excellent.  Just be sure u have the time to spare, and that's a good thing, because the food is so good, more than likely u'll be standing out the door waiting to get in, however, once seated and its all said and done, I get cha u'll be back !!

My boyfriend and I come here every weekend for our breakfast and we wouldnt have it any other way!!!! The chef caters to our liking.  The menu is unique yet traditional.  Everything is prepared fresh with great service and the staff makes us feel like family! love it!!!

Came here at 9am on a Saturday morning, boo yea beat the traffic and fell in love with these never-frozen dumplings. I got the pork and cabbage dumplings, fried and steamed. I liked the fried one a little bit more than the steamed but I'd recommend to anyone trying both. Their Soy Bean Milk is AMAZING! Never really had soy bean milk but for some reason this milk was bringing me back some warm and fuzzy feelings of happiness. Even though it was 9am, we had to wait 2 minutes to get seating so expect to eat the milk + dumplings outside...

This restaurant is delicious! We got here a little early (630) and there were several open tables. I was glad to see because we had not made a reservation. By 730 the place was packed with people. The food is amazing. I ordered the filet mignon and my boyfriend ordered the chicken which were both extremely delicious. I would definitely recommend this restaurant.
One of the best places to eat sushi, especially for the price! The lunch specials are such a great deal.

Had to go after reading all reviews and the chicken biscuit sandwich exceeded all expectations. However I know personal taste but didn't think same about the shrimp po boy. Bottom line it is a must trip to get chicken biscuit

Gorgeous inside, and lots of high hopes and anticipation for this place, but the food is...not so great. And expensive. We've tried it twice, and the second time was a $400-ish celebration meal with family. It was depressing to shell out that kind of cash for such an average meal - we certainly turn out better entrees at home. I don't think this kind of menu/pricing bodes well for the future of Ricalton's. It's a bummer, but unless I hear of a big sea-change with the menu and pricing, I probably won't be back. The owner knows what he is doing with burgers at his other place, but the food here just isn't making sense. If it were delicious, or even reliably good, a la Huntley Tavern, I'd happily come back and recommend to others.

I have try many sushi places in the city and this is by far the best one! great sushi, good price, nice and friendly service! perfect for date night, hangout or just to take home! TRY THE HAKO & ROLLING FIRE ROLLS you won't be disappointed!

This review is just for the weeknight manager, who handles my complaints with both professionalism, manners and a smile. It's easy to handle a happy customer, so I always appreciate those who can handle me.

3 of us ate at 'chapter one' last evening..  what a great find..  staff was helpful..  service was good.. whether appetizer or entree blend of ingredients was perfect without being overpowering..  sound level was acceptable..  i will definitely be a repeat patron..  i wish them great success..restaurant was not full but by 9 p.m. the bar was hopping with hungry individuals..
Love the green hummus and the kabobs are seasoned very well. The lady here is very nice and friendly.

Found this restaurant through a Groupon. We were pleasantly surprised at how good this place was! We ordered the Samosas and something called Chicken 65 as appetizers. They were both delicious! We got the curry lamb and the lamb Madras as entrees. Also fabulous! I honestly thought the lamb could have been a little more tender but the sauce definitely made up for it. The garlic naan and mango lassi were also great. We'll absolutely be coming back here in the near future.

Totally enjoyed the brunch menu. Shrimp & grits were fantastic, came with sauteed kale and some sausage too. I cleaned my plate. Also had a fantastic bourbon cocktail, very strong. very good.  My brunch-mate had a huge waffle with fresh fruit and a cider. Not on the menu but he wasn't in the mood for the fried chicken with waffle so they just charged him for a side of waffles. aka, great service as well.  We sat at the bar, near the open doors and enjoyed people watching as well. A great spot!
First time tried the Turkish food,it was good.the coffee thing,soup...impressive!!! even the service is a bit slow the time we went,but good to try tho.
I've only had the brunch menu... But that's where they sold me!
Best burgers ever. If you don't happen to live in new York,  and like burgers.  Make this your ny tour lunch break!
Delicious sandwiches, Great flavor. Family friendly. Very good service. Ambiance is conductive for eating and conversation
Great place to eat the spicy tomato soup was great and I normally don't eat tomatoes and the grilled cheese With bacon was great would eat here again

I really wanted to like this place but I found it to be just mediocre. The portion sizes were good and the decor was nice. The place was very crowded, especially for a weekday night and I felt that they were not adequately staffed. I'm not sure if they were just having a bad day, but all the dishes were very salty.

I was skeptical about Marigold Kitchen's re-opening under junior chefs. But, wow, what I discovered...it got better! These talented young culinary artists are in the groove! Come enjoy the beginning of an excellent new era. Five stars hands down.

This place is very classy with a coat check from the moment you enter and friendly wait staff. The bartender made the most wonderful Espresso Martini (my signature drink). I enjoyed the entire experience with a very tasty charred Beef with perfectly melted cheese atop.  The ambiance is old school with brick walls
Unbelievable food- especially the Mediterranean Platter. Best breakfast/lunch place in Philly by far. Really guys, its that good!!!

Great restaurant with awesome food & very polite & friendly servers. Had the monk fish for lunch & I definitely would recommend it to my friends! Their wine list was a great selection & I would definitely recommend the Pinot blanc with the monk fish.yummmmmyyy!!
Very Pleasant staff!    I love to the spicy tuna roll! I had the sushi and sashimi combo special Fresh , and prepared well     Stop in and check them out!
The best!
Great service and friendly staff. Breakfast was quick, hot and really good. Nice selection of food on the menu. Nice warm and cozy place to enjoy a pastry, food, coffee or a tea.

I love the place. First time I took a bite of that burger I was in love. Seriously amazing hands down. The burger just over flows with flavor. I ordered the break room burger i put  their homemade hot sauce on it, and I ordered the breakroom fries. My review would be higher if I loved the fries but the potato tots was not necessary and it needed more cheese, would be better with a creamy sauce added maybe ranch or blue cheese, anyways. I love the staff they seem happy to be there it's as if they understand what's great about the business and genuinely enjoy what they do. Only been here twice was good each time. My boy friend is a huge fan of the drinks. I recommend anyone to go here!

This was by far the best meal that both my husband and I have ever had!!!  As soon as you walked in you were greeted with the fresh smell of apples from their floor to ceiling wall of apples. The service was exceptional and they provided us with excellent recommendations for both our meals and for the wine pairing.  We were served an amuse-bouche with every single course of our meal.  The Procini Flan was the best appetizer I have ever had. My husband ordered the chocolate souffle for dessert (which he confirmed tasted amazing) and with that they brought us a pineapple/coconut amuse-bouche, a complimentary grilled peach & sorbet dessert, PLUS a tray of a dozen housemade chocolates.  And finally on our way out the door, after we had eaten the best food ever to our hearts content, they sent us home with a take-away lemon tea cake. The overall experience was absolutely exceptional.  It is a must try in NYC.
I have no idea where they get there meat, had a stake and it tasted perfect. Best I had ever had, a bit pricy so I don't go often, but the meal is outstanding.

i freakin' love this place! food is always delicious, staff is courteous, and on point. pork slap ale is always on hand as well, a perfect accompaniment to the light, filling, superb cuisine at this fine establishment! !!

One of the best burgers i had.  The truffle burger was amazing. The only downfall is that the place is tiny and it gets packed so the service is so so. But this is a burger joint not a 5 star resturant. If you do not like the burgers here something is wrong with you.

We have been here twice and tried most of the items on the menu. The culinary adventure began with the friendly and cozy ambiance. Our dishes came out at the same time so we could share our plates. Beef Rendang was cooked to the perfect velvety texture, meat was coated with perfect amount of sauce, subtle yet complex flavors continued to develop with each bite. Definitely recommend this dish. Our other favorites were the fish curry, egg plant (from the small plates), chicken wings, papaya salad (has a hint of coconut flavor to it), chicken wings (not what you would expect so make sure you try these). The nasi goreng (fried rice) was very tasty and came with satifying portion. Each bite consisted intense but not overpowering shrimp flavor. This dish came with crunchy shrimp crackers and fresh cucumber to balance all the flavors. We wish we had room for dessert, next time. We liked the food here a lot. Perfect little place to catch up in the middle of the week with friends (what we did), or just sit at the bar area with the book you always wanted to read but never got to (what I will do next time). p.s. Great coffee!

One of the bestest cocktail bars in the world! Make sure to try the Ready Fire Aim. It's delicious. Can be hard to get in. I suggest reserving a table and eating although you miss the fireworks at the bar.
fabulous food, gorgeous design of the space and views looking at the boat basin.

Very good Indian food.  Went on a week night and had a couple of the Kerala dishes.   Good spice and flavor.   Ambiance was nice.   We've been to numerous Indian restaurants and this place is good even out.   Food is not the best we've ever had, but we left full and satisfied.

Did they invent a portal door to transport you to Greece on 1st avenue? Nope. It's just Taverna Kyclades. My favorite (and now the only) Greek restaurant in New york. Oh and yeah, complimentary dessert.

Good soul food no frills excellent.  They specialize in waffle combinations with awesome names of prominent African Americans.  I had HUGE smothered turkey legs with two sides. I could eat here every night.

Going in I thought hey! They fixed up this place let's give it a try. It was seriously the worst money I ever spend. Firstly, everything was over priced. I was like ok at first maybe it's like a little more money for better food. When I get my food the portions were so tiny. I mean everything I ordered was miniature. I was still like ok that's fine. Maybe it's a little taste of heaven. Nope onez bit in I almost spit it out. Disgusting! Horrible. The chicken was very rubbery. The soups were just unexplainably uneattable. And everything else we order was just gross. I literally did not touch anything. I wouldn't even serve food like this to my enemies. I walked out very unsatisfied and hungry because I couldn't eat this trash. Avoid like the plague. This is not a good addition to the neighborhood. I'm disappointed.

Ok so it looks good and roti was nice and soft and moist.. I selected the boneless chicken seasoning was ok a bit salty thou. But I don't cook with salt so I maybe a bit sensitive to salt. There was a good amount of chicken potato curry balance. Cost was about right for the size $8.49 you could split one and not feel bad about it. Over all I would give it a three out of five stars. I'm not shouting from the roof tops but it was good enough to go back and try something else.

Enjoyable experience, ordered omakase at bar along with choice platter that I don't remember the name of and dessert. You might still be hungry when you walk out but the point is to enjoy the flavors, textures, environment and interaction with the chefs. Omakase isn't priced because it's based on how many pieces you order (sushi master makes you whatever he feels like making or you can tell him what you like/dislike and he'll create the pieces accordingly), but ordering 10 pieces should put you in the $70-90 range. If you want a seat at the sushi bar, (recommended) Know exactly when you want to book before calling and have alternative times/days ready in case your preference is booked (highly likely if it's on a Thursday or Friday night) I had their green tea ice cream mochi dessert, which was probably the best mochi I've had because the sweetness, chewiness, and green-tea flavoring were balanced. My favorite pieces: sea urchin, King salmon, eel Worth a try? Obviously Take the menu home as a souvenir if you're into that kinda stuff
The struggle is real trying to find good pho in NY. Still trying to find my go to place. Take me back to California.
The best falafel around. I love the pickles.

One of the best new restaurants in the city. Solid drinks, delicious food and a great overall atmosphere. Went here with a big group and they were incredibly accommodating. Wings were awesome and Fish Tacos were on point. Get to know the owner/chef if you can. Really cool guy and looks like Brett Farve. Will definitely be back soon.

Was so excited for this from reading some reviews. Got food delivered, took a while but wasn't worried as I thought they're a popular place so wud be busy. Ordered chips n guacamole, pollo burrito, mexi sausage tacos, steak tacos and pollo tacos. Some of the blandest food I've ever had, dry and no spice or flavour. The only saving grace was the mexi sausage taco, which was good I must say. The guacamole was overly bulked out with onion and tomato. The burrito was just plain bad. Good chips though.

The best Thai food I've had since moving down to NYC about 6 months ago. There curries are rich and perfectly spiced, the atmosphere is fantastic with an option for outdoor seating, and the prices are very affordable, I'd take this place of any Thai spot in manhattan.

I had the sea bass.  I don't think that I have ever eaten sea bass before. But, I was in NY and wanted to eat things that I normally don't eat.  I was glad I did because the sea bass was good.  It was like eating a juicy steak but better better.  We had a nice table outside but all the tables were too close together and it would have helped if our waiter spoke better English or at least smiled once in awhile.

I've heard a lot about SOCO for quite so time now and I finally had the SOCO experience, the staff was kind and courteous, the service was on time and the food was good. On a scale of 1-10 I'd give'em a 9 and I would also recommend them to people I know as a very nice place to sit down and have a bite to eat. Thanks Sam you really made my wife and I feel welcomed.

Horrible experience. Went there for lunch (take out) I ordered their calamari app and the person who took my order over the phone put in for the calamari dinner. Well when I arrived to pick up my food - I noticed that they were charging me $5 more than what I asked for on the menu. So of course I informed this that my order was incorrect and instead of trying to remedy their error, they went to the back and began taking my food out; which I actually didn't mind much being that they just opened recently and probably needed to save themselves money. Well when I finally returned to work to enjoy my food. I was highly disappointed, I don't know if they were upset with me for having them correct my order but the calamari was just awful - rubbery and plain...the sauce they provided had absolutely no taste and it came with a salad that included one piece of lettuce and a whole onion sliced and placed on top of the lettuce. The dressing that they provided was plain as well. I've had MUCH better Peruvian food before - save yourself a wasted trip, trust me! The place looks nice but unfortunately we can't eat the decor!
Charge for deliveries  chicken look fishee no good food charge to much for what is this place. To much bread in General Tsos chicken no good at all
Chicken parm slice was awesome and so was the sicilian. Found this place on yelp while driving home from NY to MD and pulled off. Glad we did and would stop again if in the area.
Love this place, the cavatelli is awesome. The service is just as good as the food.....i keep coming back and it keeps getting better.

The best creative drinks anyone can find in NYC. The food is delicious and fun,  keeping the interest of how possible did the chef create such a dish.  I love the food,  drinks and for the price, it is a must go.

This is one of the best slice spots in the city.  The fresh mozzarella and the prince street square are both addictive.  Also one of the best spots to grab a bite late night after leaving one of the many bars in the area.
Go for Meatball Monday: you get an appetizer, entree & dessert all in meatball style, with a glass of wine for $31.   Absolutely incredible.

Great lunch spot! The portions here are HUGE!!! The food is also very delicious. The staff was friendly and the wait was not bad considering we can at lunch hour on a Saturday. Everything was exceptional and I would recommend this to anyone looking for a great bit to eat in Times Square.

I've been here twice in the past year and enjoyed the food and service both times. They have a turkey burger which says for limited time only (but it's been on the menu for awhile) that is delicious. It comes with mayo and sliced onions. I tell them to hold the mayo and grill the onions and the end result is close to perfection. Whatever you order, please at least try the sweet potato fries. I dip them in ketchup (because they're fries, right) and magic happens. I don't believe I'm exaggerating at all. Also, servers are attentive and friendly. Stop in the next time you happen to be in the area.

I am new to NJ and have visited this restaurant twice. It is one of the most decent Indian restaurants with good ambience and great food. Yes it is a little pricey BUT it is one of the upscale restaurants. I loved their food and service. I will definitely go back with friends.
Still a good steak @ a great price service is really young but really try hard See you guys soon.
I loved the potato pancakes, and the Chinese watercress is very, very good. I cannot wait to go back for more!

Simple brunch story.  My friend and I went to brunch and brunch and brought mimosa ingredients. We were seating in the garden patio and after 10 minutes of no menus and no server we decided to open our champagne and orange juice and drink our mimosas. As soon as we did a tall male server came running out to yell at us( yes he yelled and all 10 people in the garden turned around). He informed us we were not allowed to open our own bottles or bring orange juice to mix it with. We told him we were sorry and now we knew for next time. The server then came out with menus 5 minutes later and offered to sell us orange juice. We told her we were ok because we already had some. She then tells us, " I thought someone came out and told you that you are NOT ALLOWED to drink your orange juice bc we offer it here." We told her we didn't know that we weren't allowed. She told us we had to place it under the table and order oj from her. We ordered a large oj to oblige her and to end the awkward chastising conversation. She went on to tell us that they " had to make money off the oj bc they don't sell alcohol." Hmm... I thought they made money off the FOOD and lack of expenses associated with a liquor license. By this point the tables on either side of us were talking about how rude the servers were and how ridiculous the situation was. Meanwhile a group of 8 young women walked in with Starbucks coffees and drank them at their table while ordering food. Ironic because wedge and fig sell coffee comparable to the price of oj that we were forced to buy. I wrote our experience on a comment card and the owner Kirk emailed me to apologize. Too bad it was too little too late. This place has horrible service, average food and inflated prices. Don't waste your time in old city there!

It was our second time here. The first time, we had the happy hour $1 oysters and beer special that takes place at the bar. The bar was full, so we sat at a table off to the side that still counted. It was a fine experience. Today we came in for the $13 burger and beer bar special and this time got a place at the end of the bar next to the open kitchen. Short summary of the experience: 1.  Ordered beers, dozen oysters, burgers. 2.  Beers come. (yay!)   3.  Burgers come. (me no oysters?) 4.  Girlfriend spots a teeming nesthole of baby roaches in the crack of the service bar at the kitchen (2 feet from the end of the bar where we were sitting). 5.  I quietly point it out to a manager. 6.  No further words exchanged with management... damage control. 7.  I asked for the check. Bartender: "Did you ever get your oysters?"  Me: "No, that's okay." No sympathy there either. Food: Beer: Delicious and wet (as expected) Burger: Average Fries: Very good Oysters: M.I.A. Roaches: Plentiful
This place is incredible and the staff is wonderful too (Big Mike will remember your name after first visit)! Great to see more places like this opening up around Bed-Stuy.

So delicious, but pretty small! Best for one or two people. WAIT: Put your name on the list hanging on the door. Went around 6pm with a party of three and waited about 15 min. The hostess was ON IT. When we left there were atleast three times as many people waiting as before. FOOD: Super satisfying! The broth was rich and yet not too heavy, noodles perfect, pork was flavorful and not fatty. As someone who likes spice, the spicy ramen had just the slightest kick. Would def try the really spicy one next time. AMBIANCE: Small and intimate with a few tables and bar seating.

First of all, if you get MJ as your waiter, ask for different server immediately. He was rude to my group and I from the start of our dining experience.  He yelled at me because I was taking the bottle of water to fill up my cup. He then proceeds to raise his voice at my lady friend because he did not think she was listening well enough during his presentation of the night's specials.  Later, he throws the check on the table and doesn't even thank us or acknowledge us for dining in.   However, I did notice that the interactions between the customers and other servers was positive and warm.  I wish we could have had the same experience.  The food was pretty good though.

This is a Japanese noodle chain, this being the NY variety. I went rather late at night and enjoyed a steaming hot bowl of pork ramen with egg. I can't really complain - the ramen was fine - and the atmosphere was reasonable. I guess I just had higher expectations having dined at the originals in Japan. Still, for ramen fans looking for a solid outing, this is a good spot. Be prepared to wait, though - it's generally extremely crowded.

We stumbled upon this place in our search for breakfast after our go-to place had too many people--and we were so happy we did! As New Jerseyans we take breakfast very seriously, and Our House did not disappoint. Extensive and interesting menu, so much so that we HAVE to come back before we go home. Coffee was spectacular, breakfast was on point, and the cocktail menu is unlike anything you've ever heard. Lots of vegetarian/vegan options too :-)

Currently a limited drink menu but my waitress was able to have the bartender make the drink i love!  so awesome of her and my tip reflected my appreciation!  it took a while (10+ mins) for my waitress to greet me when she delivered water and chips, but they had only been open a few days so I know there are some kinks to work out.  table was super wobbly (lack of attention to detail).  tacos were good.  I'll be going again soon for sure.  it's very close to my work so it has the potential to be a weekly $40 tradition, hope they work out the kinks and fix that table.

I sat at the counter and got very quick service. I ordered roast pork with broccoli rabe and provolone. It's a very juicy sandwich so stock up on napkins. It's overall pretty good. However if I'm comparing it to some others in the area it gets beaten out by John's Roast Pork and Tony Luke's. But if you're in Reading Terminal, it's not a bad option at all.

Listen to me and listen to me well. This place is the absolute best Italian food in the area. I work at Pugliese Kitchen & Bath and we order from this place at least once a week and they do not disappoint. Try it out for yourself. You will not be let down

Fabulous burger.  Shared the portobello  and the blue cheese burger with a friend.  Both were excellent.  Cooked to perfection and fresh yummy roll.  Had to try the French fries because people were raving about them.  Now I know why.  Hand cut fresh daily and the bacon jam blew me away.  I highly recommend that you try this place.  I will visit again  not only to enjoy the food but the comfortable atmosphere.

We stopped in for a quick breakfast and were very impressed not only with the selection but the food itself. Great bagels, great cream cheeses. Can't wait to go back for more. The staff was friendly and fast even though the line was out the door.

This is great place!  The portions of food are large enough to share. Very good food and staff! Very pretty inside. Came here for my brother's birthday. They were more than happy to put our cake in their refrigerator and bring it out at desert time.

The pizza is out of this world! The beer selection is beyond extensive. That said the service suffered in our second visit. The waitress had no personality. Our mild wing - our 5 year old loves wings but hates spice - were spicy buffalo and the waitress had the nerve to question whether that orange buffalo sauce was their red mild sauce. I'll go again because of the food but I'll expect to wait longer than I should have to and to not have a great server.
Always delicious and fast delivery! Never had an issue.. a bit pricey but you get what you pay for. Very happy to be a regular customer!
Their brunch is amazing and back garden is beautiful too. You do have to come early since there is always a wait on weekends.
Waited over an hour but the staff were really nice and the food was worth it. Really good Vietnamese food, fresh-tasting and flavorful.
I wish I lived closer to this place but probably wouldn't be a good thing! The besttttt southern food I've ever had. We always made a point to come here when we go into Williamsburg.

Totally worth all of the hype! Adorable atmosphere and we didn't have to wait too long (20 minutes at 10:30am on a Sunday morning). I highly recommend the sourdough pancakes...such a treat! Two notes: one, you can't bring outside coffee to your table, so be sure to finish it beforehand if you grab a cup while you wait; two, it's pretty pricey, so be prepared to drop about $30/person.

The brunch menu is very small, and the kitchen still has a hard time getting the food out even warm. Despite that, the food isn't really that good, and lacks seasoning. You might have to beg for salt and pepper. This place might be ok for dinner or something, but brunch wasn't worth it.

I come to this place with my best friend at least once a week. The food is AMAZING but every time, the service is so bad that we vow to never come back. Yet we find ourselves here every week because the food is so good. The hostess is so rude and literally yells at me even though she knows I'm a regular customer. The second you sit down she pushes you to order and rolls her eyes if you have a question. She asks customers to move tables mid meal and shoves the check in your face the second you take the last slurp of soup. She should be fired. Always packed but worth the wait. Be prepared for terrible service.

I've been to the Hillsborough diner a few times and each time the food is under cooked and not very good. We're talking about dishes like eggs, pancakes and burgers ... fare a diner should do well with if not excel at. The service itself is generally attentive and speedy. The poor rating is strictly on the lack of quality of the food.

Came here on a Thursday night. The restaurant was packed and there was a wait so we sat at the bar. Great ambiance--the place has an overall vibrant atmosphere and I really loved the decor.  The staff was very friendly and attentive. We tried the ceviche, the corn "off" the cob, and several tacos--al pastor de pollo, lengua, carnitas, and pescado. I wasn't a big fan of the Oaxacan rice and beans but everything else was very good. All of the tacos were tasty...small to perfectly fit in one hand but melt in your mouth delicious. We had the churros for dessert and they were a perfect end to a good meal. I would definitely return.

Was in town for a wedding and figured this would be a good snack before the wedding. It was a great decision. I went with the Chicago dog on an everything roll (made in house). I added hot peppers and spicy brown mustard. It was very good! The owner is friendly and outgoing. Another plus, on the weekends, they are open till 3!

Ippudo in Greenwhich stands out for its famous Ramen Noodles and traditional japanese cuisine. I tried their shishitos, Chicken and Pork Buns, service is good and you're always greeted with a loud welcome and since its always busy its worth the wait for what you spend to eat. The atmosphere is enjoyable, the traditional Japanese design is great. Chef Masashi delivers the quality you would want from  a Japanese restaurant. Overall i enjoyed it, it does get full so if waiting in line isn't your choice then move along, but its worth the wait. "Irasshaimase!" everyone
Came here for brunch a few weeks ago and the food is awesome & the service is great. HIGHLY recommend the steak & hash.
We completely enjoyed our meals, the oysters were delicious and the service delightful.

This was my first time at this restaurant as I live in NY and I have to say I wish we had one of these in my city. The decor was fun and I liked the tall tables. We had a party of four and it was a packed house. We were all comfortable. The wait staff was nice and helpful. Our food was flavorful and delicious. I had the veggie burger and fries. The frilled were also great. The prices were decent. I'd recommend this place. Can't wait to go back.

Our chef did not bring out enough rice and shrimp for the table at first. He needs to work on bringing a little more hype to the table. for example, waitors always try and let the guests catch food in their mouths which he did not do. salad and soup were excellent, very tasty. Add soy sauce to the soup-you wont regret it. fried rice and loein noodles-amazing, loved the flavor. shrimp was good, chicken was dry, was not a fan of the flavor. id definetely go back for the beginning courses. excited to try whats on the dinner menu here in the future!

I was very excited to go to dinner tonight.  Friends have said great things about this restaurant.   We get there,  2 people, and they seat is with a family with 3 kids.  Normally no issue, however they were gluten free.  So all the food had to be made with their soy sauce and nothing else.  We should have been given a choice.  The food was very bland.  No flavor. The chicken was ridiculously over cooked.  The service was ok,  didn't realize is be charged per seltzer either. We went be going back.

When we walked in we noticed every empty table was dirty. I find this unacceptable.  Plenty of staff and they weren't busy. There were a few people eating in. Ordered our food, the staff is friendly and you do get a lot of food.  We were forced to sit at a dirty table. I cleaned it the best I could myself. Even the chairs were gross. Got wings as an appetizer. Sauce was good, wings were over cooked and dry. My pulled pork sandwich was ok, I have had (much) better. I only ate 1/4 of my sandwich due to taste.  My husband got the brisket and he said it was good. The cornbread was served cold, which was disappointing. Honestly, Black Eyed Sally's is MUCH better. It's cleaner, better atmosphere, and the BBQ tastes so much better! UPDATE: the tables and chairs had crumbs. That has nothing to do with the finish of the table.
I want an Woorijip on my college campus so badly, it's not even funny. It's convenient and cheap, and the food is good. Perfect for a Korean food fix.

Their menu is more creative than most brunch places, though they have terrible service. They don't have soy milk and aren't apologetic about it. It's actually the first place I've come across in NYC that doesn't have any--sad when you can't enjoy a coffee with brunch.

Alright. Ive heard about this place from many people. Something i wished i knew before going in line is that there are multiple locations. This means that if one line spans a block, check out the other ones to see if those were shorter. Good thing was, they still served pretty quickly. They dont really give you time to think too much when you are up next. So note, you better know what youre getting so that you dont hold up the line! Haha Anyways, we got there about 8p. Line was about a third of the block. New york blocks are pretty long, so thats a pretty long line haha. At first i was about to leave, but hey, i wanted to try it! You see all these people on the side feasting on these huge circular containers. My bf and i got the combo and the chicken and rice. Everyone who talked about the white sauce is right. Its pretty good. To me it kinds tasted like ranch, but hey...i like ranch!! Haha pour it aaall over your order cuz you will keep wanting more (plus itll be a little dry without the sauce). Anyways, it wasnt the best thing i ever had in my life. Im giving it 4 stars for quick service, amazing price (6 dollars for a huuuuuuge dish), and size of dish. Could prob feed 2 people (or 1 extremely hungry person). Overall Service- Long line but goes by quicker than you would think Staff-Just want you to order and get the line moving Food-Just ok Price-awesome Portion-Huge
better than pats and always a fun time waiting in line with others who are getting ready to enjoy one of the best cheesesteaks in philly

Balzem was a new gem that I found! Food was very clean and loaded with flavor. The service was on point as the waiter was very attentive. The entire vibe of the restaurant was great- love a smaller restaurant with a warm inviting setting. This will definitely be added to my list of go to affordable yet delicious eats.

I met my 4 girlfriends there one Sunday afternoon. No one came over and even offered a beverage for at least 20 minutes. When I looked at any of the waitresses they all turned their heads as if they didn't already catch me eye! Finally, we ordered. Upon delivery of our meals, everyone's, your read that right, EVERYONE'S order was wrong, except mine. I was the only salad. They took all the plates back but when they came back again, still wrooonggg! Finally on the third try they got it right. In fairness the food was good but the service was crap!! They could not even get the change right when we paid the bill. I asked for singles but got large bills. When I said something, the women, apparently the owner was so snippy, I wanted the tip back. When everyone left and I was last out the door, all Miss Snippy could say was I'm sorry, so glad you told me. But she knew something had been going wrong all along. As courtesy, they should have at least made some kind of offer...but no...too bad. This was my first time and if it's managed this poorly, I doubt I would go again nor would I recommend.
This is the best Indian restaurant in New Haven. I've tried them all now, and it's better than the one in the old diner or that other one. Tandoori chicken might be the best I've ever had.

Love chop chop. Part of a new brand of restaurants in the neighborhood not gentrifying the place (looking at you Connecticut muffin) but adding to he personality of the place by providing quality food at reasonable prices. I come here all the time, personal favorite would have to be the Cajun BLT with fried catfish...mmmm....

food was tasty, drinks were excellent. Price not so much. I understand for drinks I am not going to fight a delicious margarita with fresh fruits for  $12 but if I am paying $14 for quesadilla or guacamole I should get enough for the price. The portions are small but the food is delish. Mexican food should not cost this much and if the price was lower I would be an avid fan. The waitstaff was nice the decor was also good.
Authentic and tasty but expensive. You can get macarons three times as large for the same price elsewhere...although not as good.

The "idea" of this place would seem so cool right? Outside patio and bar? a bar/ restaurant right in the heart of Caldwell? Well, in those beautiful spring and summer nights, you're lucky if you find the outside bar open at all! and if it is..it closes up by 8:00. Then you are forced to go inside and be accompanied by waiters sweeping the floors and moving table and chairs... you ask "are you closing up?" The bartender answers no we have to stay open til at least 11:00.. They either have the air conditioning blasting so you freeze and leave OR they have the lights on over the bar so bright, you feel like you're the star attraction in a Broadway show. They charge $14 per drink...They run out of the proper glass wear, and liquor line is never fully stocked.   The prices in this place are astronomical! A simple chicken dish is $27!! I can make it at home for $8 !! Bathroom... I have scene numerous times an employee NOT wash their hands after coming out! At the end of the night it makes you wonder.. Was all the above worth the price? Not for this couple

This place is amazing! Small, authentic Italian restaurant in Soho. Great for pasta lovers, they have a TON of pasta dishes, you won't be able to decide what to order. Some of the pastas are made fresh, in house! I had the fettucine molisane, it was amazing! We also had the pizza primizie, also very good. Prices are low and portions are big!
Amazing vegan experience. Ordered a delicious vegan Reuben with sweet potato fries. Could barely stop eating them!!!

Start your meal with a Dark and Slushie and its smooth sailing the rest of the evening!  All while I was drinking this I kept thinking WOW, this is so good!  Then the food came - Jerk Chicken, Plantains, Rice and Peas, Spicy Slaw - and I couldn't stop saying it out loud.  WOW, this is so good! If you are not a huge meat eater, 1 order of Jerk Chicken dish and 3 sides is plenty for 2 people. The servers recommended 1 protein per diner but the $3 sides are such large portions that half an order of chicken would have been plenty.   (We had chicken left over and asked for a container of jerk sauce to go with it). The service was AMAZING for such a small, casual neighborhood place, The food is delivered hot to your table in less time than in most take-out restaurants. What a great place! I wish I lived in New York!

Here we are waiting for a sandwich and salad. 25 minutes and counting. Place is virtually empty.  Service indifferent. Food is not as good as it looks and they run out early. Place is beautiful. Customers are friendly. Were all in this together.
Possibly the best espresso I've had NYC. Better than all the known favorites. Tiny place w lovely decor. Espresso made with time and love. Also nice that it's by all the flower shops. Keep it up!

It's a cute space, and the service was fast. The ham in the Eggs Benedict was soft and thick. The Hollandaise sauce wasn't too sweet, sour, nor heavy. The eggs were fluffy, but the potatoes were nothing special. So, should you try now? Yes.

What a perfect place to plan a birthday celebration! Mario, of course, was fantastic JUST like the yelp reviews said. He was very accommodating and helpful in planning the menu and timing of the SURPRISE party for my boyfriend. The food was amazing, but mostly the homemade spaghetti was a HUGE HIT! Everyone was raving about this hidden gem. I'm so glad for planning my boyfriends 29th birthday party here. 27 people came out (we pretty much had the whole place to ourselves) and it was the most fun and intimate dinner party ever!!!!

Love!  I take my sushi seriously.  Great sushi selection, very fresh.  We did omakase, but also had a few extras since we are greedy pigs. We tried all of the different cooked eel varieties, which were excellent. The atmosphere leaves a little bit to be desired, but it is mid-town after all.  The hostess is also kind of snooty.  But the food more than makes up for it.

Great Customer Service and Food This weekend I went to Nolita's for lunch and I chose to get the Rigatoni Carbonara because my waitress told me it was her favorite. She was right!! The food was delicious!!!  My waitress, Milly, was so sweet and pleasant. She helped me make the best choice! I strongly recommend this restaurant! The bar area looks like fun too. I will be going back to Nolita's with my friends. If you are looking for great food, a place with a great atmosphere and very helpful wait staff, then head to Nolita's  You won't be disappointed. If you don't know what to order then just ask Milly.
Delicious - perfect spot for breakfast/brunch for the Burlington tourist! Only downside was the wait, but it was worth it.

This place has some of the best margaritas in the city. Tasty tasty tasty! Try the nachos they are nice and crispy,smothered with toppings. Steak fajitas are my fave so if you see me there, thats what I will be eating. They have a good brunch too. Bloody mary is a must at brunch.

Expensive and really not worth the cost. Why? My wife ordered the lamb chops and they barely made it into the plural. Two tiny chops, one half fat, four bites of food and 35 bucks later feeling kind of cheated. If you are a regular they pay attention I guess. Me- I had to ask for everything. No anticipation. Won't return and I guess I really don't understand what the fuss is about.  Oh, the cost... Dinnerr for two 300 buck

This is my favorite restaurant of all time.  The prices are great, but you always have to remember, it's BYOB and cash only.  This is just my opinion, but I think the Bistro East location is better than the Ovest West location.  The menus and the chefs are different. The restaurant is small, you will be sitting very close to the table next to you, but hey, maybe you can strike up a nice conversation.  When weather permits, there is outside seating.   I strongly recommend the Grigliata Di Calamari (grilled calamri) appetizer, and the homemade Gnocchi al Filetto di Pomodoro.  My personal favorites.

Great addition to the neighborhood.  The menu was perfect for everyone in my party as there were items from scallops and mussels to pasta and pork chops to choose from.  The wine menu had a variety of half bottles which is a perfect option for those that don't want to invest in full bottles. The ambiance was trendy but the space in between tables was very tight.

The chicken and waffles are to die for!!!!! I loved the service as well. My waiter, Lawrence was very attentive, polite and such a cool guy. He was also a cutie. This is now my favorite spot!! I give this place 2 thumbs up!
very very good!  i had the lamb kabob, morrocan cigars, and fried cauliflower.  all of it was delish.  good portions, and good prices.

Wow, what a disappointment.  An evening of decidedly mediocre food and unresponsive, unfriendly service.  The wine list is good - and not overpriced, but the overall experience was well below what we all expected. They did all the little stuff poorly.  When two of us were discussing wine, the waitress said, "I'll come back after you've decided."  Not a single opinion voiced, a recommendation made.   I always thought picking out wine was supposed to be fun, not the drive through at McDonalds.  We sat for more than 20 minutes before bread was served, and that happened only after a request.  Water glasses were empty throughout most of the meal. Oh, and they did the big stuff poorly as well.  With only two non-gluten entrees, I went with a filet of beef.  Despite a request for "medium rare toward rare" it was well done and dry.  The appetizer portion of scallops were cold and hard - apparently cooked to serve with the appetizers and held until the entrees were served.  Oh, and a $37 filet of beef should have some vegetables - more than a single ping-pong ball sized potato. Salads were good - kale caesar was dressed well and served with toasted pumpkin seeds - and the ice cream (ordered with sour cherries) was excellent.  But the waitress grabbed the creme brulee when it was half eaten and was clearly in a hurry to get us out the door. After all the hype - well, even without high expectations - this was not very good.  I'll stick to Elixir or Carpenter & Main - MUCH better food, vastly better service and much lower cost.
Blown away by this pizza. Cannot say enough good things! The salad was perfect as well. Definitely coming here every time I'm in Burlington.

The best customer service I have ever experienced. The food is amazing and affordable. Bartenders are awesome and the drinks are of all/any variety. Very continental and a true representation of NYC. You'' meet a lot of interesting people. Definitely go and try everything!

I come here for lunch every so often.  Then I had one bad visit - not sure what was going on that day, but it was much worse than previous visits. I let some time go by and then went back - and it seemed back at its usual standard.  Pan chan (small free dishes that they give you at the beginning of the mean) was back to good quality and generous amounts.
Great service nice location.  Great spot before a show at the TLA or just going to when hanging out on south street.

This was our 2nd time at Da Legna and once again everything was "beyond expectations".Our waiter was hard to understand and clearly more interested in a larger party and left my cousin without her wine and boyfriend without the IPA he ordered but the host/server who kindly introduced himself as "Joseph" recovered for him nicely and was a pleasant addition to the wonderful atmosphere.He had so many interesting anecdotes about the restaurant and helped us steer through the interesting selections on the menu.My sister was quick to ask the pronunciation and translation and he told her how the g was silent like in the word "gnocchi" and how the name meant "from wood".He totally wowed us with a suggestion for a "pistachio pizza" that we would have never tried and we all agreed was one of the best topping combinations we had ever tasted.He took the ball and ran with it and made our experience a "tasty one"!! We'll definently be back and hopefully will have Joseph to help us in our food endeavors!!!
Great neighborhood spot. Friendly service and consistently yummy food.

Last night was my second time at this restaurant. The first time I had an amazing scallop special that came with a side of risotto. It was fabulous! Fyi...I hate rice and still ate every bite of risotto. The scallops were perfectly cooked. Yum! Last night we got regular menu items. My boyfriend got the Betty Burger and it looked to die for. I was craving salad so I got the Turkey Ruben with a garden salad side. I thought they won me over with the scallops, but the ranch dressing was amazing!!! I don't think I will ever crave a salad again without thinking it should be from Smokin' Betty's! Tip...go there with an empty stomach if you want the burger. It is huge and it is yummy!

My wife and I went on the opening weekend and they have already nailed it!  The food was consistent hot and fresh.  The drinks were unique.  The owner was accessible and monitoring the scene.  The open kitchen will invite Vegan oohs and ahs.  I have not had a potato skins in 5 years and was pleased to find not only potato skins but great potato skins.  Ordered a second round  when our friend arrived.  Good location.
Good experience and a quiet establishment, a good place for a nice burger time!

A perfect bar. Not swamped, delicious snacks. Really dug the fried Jambalaya balls and the bahn mi po boy. The bartenders were gentlemen of an ilk not seen since the feudal days of chivalrous knights.

Went there today for a late lunch and everything I had was superb. I had the chorizo burger and split an arugula salad and parmesean truffle fries. My BF had the short ribs sandwich. It was all so delicious. we will definitely return.

Pretty decent bar with lots of people. It's nice and close to penn station so you can just have a drink before going home. Plus they always have the latest games on so it get pretty loud and rowdy here. I come here about once a week or so.

Good: Food was good. Bad: Portions are VERY VERYYY small. We walked in,  seated, and my girlfriend and I stared at each other awkwardly for about 3 minutes because  the waiter did not bring us menus.  Waiters walked passed us three times before I had to ask for it (it was not that busy), should have been common sense to give us menus after we're seated. For Appetizers we got the diver Caught scallops, which were 3 very small, quarter sized scallops for $15, tasted good though. My girlfriend had the "Coconut Curry Laksa" which tasted okay but it was $19 dollars for something that you can get for like $7 in a thai restaurant.  It was just a small bowl of 5 strands of actual noodles with mostly beansprouts (cheap ingredient) with only two pieces of shrimp and curry base.  We're asian and we eat in chinatown a lot and we very well knew this bowl of noodles is not worth 19 dollars.  We could've gotten a larger bowl of the same thing for 7 dollars in a regular thai restaurant. I got the australian lamb, which was very tasty, well seasoned, not fatty.  But it was $29 for 2 SMALL pieces of rack of lamb, with a small salad that I wasn't really a fan of.  Each piece I finished in one bite so I finished it in like 30 seconds probably.  $29 dollars for two bites of meat and a not so great small salad.  It's a joke to even call this a main course. Bill came out to around 100 dollars including tip after taxes and a cocktail.  Feel ripped off. Its a bad feeling leaving hungry after spending  a hundred dollars.  I should mention we're both skinny people that usually get full easily.  That's how small the portions were.

So basically I think the place just opened up. They have great salad and I ordered the shrimp. It was really good. They take their time and cook it. I drank sorrel. I love sorrel lol. It was actually good. Cool mellow place. They played Spanish music.

Small spot but got there late so they didn't have a few menu choices. BUT i was able to get the burger which was GOOD. They feature a different animal every week the waiter said so i will be going back. Service was ok we sat at the bar and even tho we were one of 2 groups in the place the food took a while. But we were given free whisky pickle back shots.
As I type my review I have a bellyful of half a turkey sub. I'm fantasizing about demolishing the other 1/2 but I'm too lazy to get up! One of the best sandwiches I've had.

What is there no to love about this place! Every time I order I try to get a new dish and 9.5/10 times I love every single dish! The portions are little small but worth every penny. My favorites are the Pad Thai and Hawaiian Chicken. My co-worker loves the wing dings and another loves the Spicy Noodles, Sesame Chicken and Chicken w. Ginger and Scallion(on the Lunch Special).

I absolutely looooooved this place! The food was excellent and the drinks were fabulous. I had the salmon. It was flaky, buttery, and fresh! The portions were nice. I had this drink special with 3 different kinds of saki...Delicious. In my Arnold Schwarzenegger voice, "I'LL BE BAHCK!"
Love this place! Excellent tikka masala. Love the food, ambiance, service, and prices are good.

This is my favorite Italian place in all of  northern NJ!!  I have been there several times and I was never disappointed.  The food is always consistent, real good fresh Italian.  The owner Pasquale is so friendly. You feel like your in Italy with the ambience and music of this place. Its BYOB and make a reservation as this place is always packed.

One of the best happy hours I have ever seen. Came here with about 6 people and spent at least 2 or 3 hours out back on the 'stoops' which was very reminiscent of all of our younger years drinking on a friend's real stoop -- very fun stuff. Really great service from a burly bearded man who didn't let our glasses stay empty for more than a minute. And just when I thought it couldn't get any better, they built a fire in the fire pit! It was so cozy and fun.  My friends ordered a bunch of appetizers. They seemed to really like the fried jalepeno poppers & spinach dip. I skipped the dip and had one popper that appropriately seared my tongue but it was quickly aided by a nice cold beer. I'll definitely come back and I hope they keep the backyard open in the colder months for many more fires.
BYOB (but be warned: there's a $10 corking fee after the 1st bottle) and the sushi is $3.50 at happy hour. For the win!
Amazingly delicious food..great service, and pleasant ambiance. Ceviche mixto  is my all time favorite  ... Love this place!

If I could give this restaurant zero stars, I would. The service was horrible and the food was at best, okay. I will never come back here! I made an 8pm reservation (they strongly recommend making a reservation) and when we get there the hostess says our table isn't ready and wouldn't be ready for another 30s mins to an hour. If you ask people to make reservations, the least you can do is call them if our reservation isn't ready. We sat at the bar and ordered drinks and food from a very unhappy and unhelpful bartender. We got a table thirty minutes later and I swore they forgot about us. We didn't get the complementary bread until 30 mins after sitting down. And that was after we got our appetizers. And our waiter didn't come by until we signaled him. That was after sitting for a while. The restaurant isn't that big and they had a decent amount of staff, so this was just unacceptable. Furthermore, our waiter didn't speak any English. I get that the iron bound is a predominantly Portuguese and Brazilian area. But those aren't your only customers. If you're going to run a business you should at least be able to communicate to your customers. We had to do an awkward point-and-signal with our rudimentary Spanish (apparently he spoke that but not English). When we FINALLY got our paella it was ok. I've had better and it definitely wasn't worth all the hassle. Finally when we got the bill, they included tip at 18% (after waiting a while with empty dishes still on our table). When I asked them to remove it because of crappy service they were upset. Tip is an addition to the bill based on service garnered. It's earned, not entitled. Our waiter proceeded to have the nastiest attitude when we explained our reasoning for removing and reducing his tip. Needless to say, we won't be back and zero stars for you Vivo Tapas

This is one of the best restaurants I've found for those with severe food allergies or gluten intolerance. They are extremely knowledgable and don't make you feel like a pain in the ___ for asking lots of questions about the ingredients and preparation. The gluten free bread is amazing, having tried tons of brands as well as baking my own and always ending up disappointed. The gluten free spinach ricotta ravioli is so good that my gluten eating dining partners liked it more than their own meal!
This restaurant is just great. The food is really good . I recomend for people to give it a try. You wont regret it...

I've been going to the Scuffer for years for half price burger night, best deal in town .  Not really sure how they make money doing it but , whatever works.  Anyways, I came here on a rainy Saturday night and was surprised by how busy they were.  My wife and I sat at the bar while waiting for a table.  The bartender did a decent job but he looked really busy.  He was quick to get us a round of drinks and I can appreciate that. Once we got our table the server  was fast and efficient.  I wanted to eat something other than a burger, so I went for the ribeye.  Great choice!  Cooked medium rare and the sauce was fantastic.  The sides were nothing to go nuts over but they did the trick.  My wife was happy with her salmon as well. When in Burlington for a nice night out that won't break the bank, I'll be at The Scuffer

I find this cafe very convenient and tasty while shopping at Westfarms. The service is good and rather quick and my favorite time to be there is when it is not too crowded. While they do vary their entrees from time to time, there is not a huge number of dishes available. That said the wine is quite reasonable. The ambiance quite relaxing and a nice touch to have this cafe in a such a fine store. Truly a family atmosphere.
Had dinner tonight. Awesome sushi, fresh and good portions. Chicken teriyaki was very good, chicken was tender and no fat!
Stopped by here for a chocolate bag and a couple of drinks during lunchtime - and it was FANTASTIC.  Sat outside, there were little heaters and the service was great. Highly recommend that dessert!

I went here with my roommates on a Friday night. We walked in around 830 with no reservations and we were surprised to be seated right away! We shared the guacamole, jerk chicken, and ceviche which was all very good. The drinks were also yummy, and refreshing! This would be a good spot to go on a date, it is load and kind of hot in the summer but intimate and the outdoor seating is a plus.
This is my go-to spot for my NYC trips. I dream about the bbq pork and the soy sauce chicken every night. The hot and sour soup is amazing, especially after a long trek thru the snow.

An excellent dining experience. Both owners were polite , welcomed us and were attentive through dinner. Now they serve this amazing aromatic bread warm with rosemary .... out of this world. Appetizers were amazing as well,do try the Keftedes with feta. As for the main course I had the best pork chops cooked to perfection. My husband had the porterhouse again excellent cooked. Too bad we live far as we would make this our favorite restaurant

My go-to eating joint in the town. Food is always fresh and they made to the order-the way you prefer to have. Love black pepper chicken and chicken with garlic sauce. Their lomein is must to have. And price ha..reasonably low for the quality to get.

My dish was very good..I had the chicken with biscuits & mixed veggies,wifey had the mac n cheese, she was'nt a big fan cuz it was like a dry crumbley cheese & she was hoping for a super cheesy mac n cheese.Service was ok I would go again
Place is amazing. The wings are an absolute must. Brisket is amazing and the Mac n cheese is a little different but oh so good

Great new addition to the hood! I went about a month ago with friends and we had a lovely experience.  Both managers were very nice and friendly as well as both of the bartenders.  I love the bar and the vibe of this place. They have an awesome selection of Tequilas.  I tried the Lobster Tacos which was superb, the Beef Empanadas which I thought were delicious, and the Salmon Tartare which was excellent as well.  I really am looking forward to trying their Skirt Steak! Yum!

This was the best italian food we have had in a long time. The interior is dated, but the family owned atmosphere and home cooked food was a hit. I had clams, white sauce and linguini. The clams were about an hour old! My wife has the most delicate veal that melted in her mouth. My girls had spag/meatballs. The sauce was delicious and the meatballs were a mix of pork beef and veal and very tender and flavorful. I might dive down just to go back

The thing I love about this place is the customer service. This is only my second time coming here but the waitress is always so friendly and very attentive. The food is made fresh so it sometimes takes a little longer to come out, but it's a nice quiet environment so I don't mind the time to relax. The only downside to this place is the food. It's not that the food is bad, I just haven't been wowed by anything I've ordered here yet.
Great place - staff is awesome, nice selection and make sure to try the deviled eggs!

Great location and food.  And thoroughly welcoming wait staff.  A recent visit prompted this review.  Have you ever ordered something and when it came to the table, it was not quite what you thought?  You misunderstood and now it's in front of you.  Yeah, its happened to everyone.  And I always feel a bit guilty making a fuss and sending it back. Last night the waiter noticed our faces with the unexpected order in front us.  We ordered that written all over our faces.  The waiter came over on his own initiative to make it right.  No guilt, just pure welcoming service. Keep it up contrada.

Absolutely love the guacamole at Jose Tejas.  My girlfriends and I try to make it out every Thursday night for happy hour after work.  Their margaritas are outstanding, and always seem to make us a bit more chatty, lol.  Great place to meet a group of people, and the servers are very nice.

This is the kind of place that you honestly consider breaking into at 5am to steal a slab of their brisket. Absolutely to die for. I have tried the entire menu (Pulled pork, brisket, ribs, sausage, wings, whole chicken) and have loved each and every moment of it. There can be a line outside nearly every night, but the 5 minute wait and very reasonable pricing is worth it. I can easily spend $25-30 here, but if you are tight on cash, you could be happy with a $9-13 dinner investment. Can't recommend enough for anyone after an authentic BBQ experience. The brisket is the best thing on the menu.
Great food, great beer.  Service was great.  Tried beer samplers, pizza was amazing. Save room for pumpkin dessert it was delicious.

Very good beers, excellent atmosphere.  Love everything about decor and general vibe of this place. Particularly enjoyed Fritzies Lager and the Belgrade crescent nitro. Staff was very beer knowledgable and friendly.  This ones sure to be a beer fan favorite.

I recently hosted a surprise birthday for my husband here and was treated so wonderfully. The owner Noemi set up a private room for us with flowers and candlelight, and followed through exactly as we discussed. The chef came out to personally introduce himself to my party and reassure one of my friends who has a deadly food allergy that our meals were carefully prepared without cross contamination. Great place, highly recommended for parties!

Omg if you have a problem with this place there must be something wrong with you!!  Excellent food, service and ambiance!!!  I've been here several times and each time blows me away more then the last!!  Try it for yourself..ps..those Brussel sprouts with bacon and candied walnuts A MUST!!!!  Thank you for always an amazing meal and experience!!!  :)

I ate here with an Italian friend who highly recommended it. While I liked the atmosphere and service, both of our pasta dishes were heavily salted, so much that the  flavors of other ingredients were neglible. I literally had a headache from the high sodium and wished I could have tasted more of the real flavors of the food.

I want to start out by saying this place was LOUD!!!! We walked in to the bar which is pretty much gauranteed to be most boisterous location in a restaurant...not the case here. We were seated in a room that had a large party and the decimal level tripled from when we first walked in, the rest of the night we were yelling across the table. The beer selection was the best part of the menu with several options on tap. We started with the beer cheese fondue appatizer which showed up fast and was exactly as described. I ordered the salmon salad which had a bit too much dressing but otherwise good. The service was average and didn't make up for the poor atmosphere.

BIJANS is the BEST!!! I love it here. First let me say the drinks are on POINT!! The food is divine and the environment is so welcoming. I go to bijans maybe like once a week, because the people are just so warm and welcoming. The bartenders are friendly and quick with making those delicious "give me more", "pom pom', and my favorite "the bijan" drinks! The food... OH MY GOODNESS, I LOVE THE PERSIAN CHICKEN WINGS!!! The yogurt and herbs is also an amazing dish, oh and the crack soup delicious! The desserts always have these freshly cut fruits (tirimusu)... IM IN LOVE! Lets just say the cooks know how to throw down in that kitchen.The owners Johan and Sepideh are amazingly wonderful people, that bend over backwards just make sure you feel welcome and comfortable. A typical visit to Bijans: Walk in and get greeted with a smile, from one of the many attractive people workng there. They will say hello and i will either sit at the bar or at one of the tables (usually the bar). I will get a glass of water and a menu, after at most 10 minutes I will get to place my order and within an a 15 minute time period (at most) I will recieve a nice meal, and my drinks that I've order. The waitresses never messed up my order and they were always energetic and affable. After I am done with my meal, I am able to enjoy little conversations with the bartenders. I will encourage anyone who likes good afforable drinks, delicious food, sociable people and an comfortable environment, this is the place to go.

The place seemed nice enough and the staff was friendly and attentive. Ordered 3 panckakes, i ate one that was under cooked.  The pancakes are so thick that they are not enjoyable. Eating one is like eating a small cake.  I ate one, gave one away (he didnt care for it either) and threw the other one away.  I have heard such nice things about Sabrina's so i will try it again, but i will never again order the pancakes.

My favorite breakfast place. I drive past about 6 other breakfast restaurants on my 10 mile drive from East Hartford, Just to get this food. Always look forward to the Steak Breakfast Burrito!!!!  So much flavor,  if they weren't so big I would get two.
The food is good, but the place is dated! They definitely some renovating! I felt like I was stuck in the 80's!

My favorite diner in the area. Food is solid- wait staff is generally attentive and friendly. The food is always fresh and the place is always clean. A classic NJ standard but an absolute standout among the other below average diners lining Rt 10.  My personal recommendation: The GYRO platter and pumpkin coffee !

Very disappointed about this good looking restaurant! I was wishing to try the eggs Benedict but supposedly they didn't have the sauce. Service was very poor, unfriendly, waitress forgot the straw, brought the check  without asking about dessert which I wanted, didn't offer refill and when requested, she forgot, a total disaster! THE alternate eggs I ordered weren't great either.

I visited in August but I'm bored at work thinking about biscuits so writing about really good biscuits gives me some sort of strange satisfaction. I came in a group of 6 for brunch on a Saturday and the wait to be seated was not bad at all even though this place was very busy.  Our waitress was nice, our service in general was fast and we were in a bit of a hurry so that was appreciated.  All of the food we got was done just perfect; it was delicious and the presentation was delightful (mmmmhhhhhhmmm). They do southern food better than most places I've been to down here in VA, although maybe since I'm in Northern VA it's not southern enough. On second thought, writing this review may have just made me a little dismayed that I'm not eating here right now.

Tourist Trap. Overpriced! Food is nothing to brag about. Burrata mozzarella margherita is just plain thin crust pizza with ricotta cheese on top ($25) & chicken Parmesan Pepperoni is chicken that was pounded down thin & heavily breaded with mozzarella on top ($28) Dessert: cannoli - they give two pieces it was good ($13). Beware of the minimum price per person to eat at this restaurant  $25 & sharing a plate $8. I would not come back to this tourist trap restaurant again. Waitstaff was slow as molasses!
Good bagels, but they only have a 4-slice toaster so it takes forever for a toasted bagel!! I usually have to call in my order for pick up!

WoW. Animals. Finally I made it to you the last day of living in EV. So perfectly simple combination of flavor.....perfect bread, crusty outside and chewy, stretchy inside, perfectly cooked meet VERY flavorful, simple but powerful seasonings. The beast with wonderful sweetness and highlighted by sour surprise from the pickle onion. Pulled pork was also perfect. Hands down another level better than any other sandwiches places around!! The reason I always miss out getting it every day is that it only open week days before I back from work. But I seriously think about taking day off just for a superb satisfying sandwiches feast visit to Animals.
This place was such a great surprise! All of the other reviews are on point. It's a nice little change of pace. The mole sauce is definitely the way to go!

Is it the first pizza in NY? Yes, Maybe even in America. Is the atmosphere great? Definitely. Is the pizza good? No. I love pizzas in every possible way, but this one was just another pizza, nothing special nor worth the wait and price...

I have to say, this place is pretty darn cute. I feel like the decor is Americanly authentic, meaning it's somewhat close to being full on Korean but still certainly has a touch of US American-ness to it. The food is pretty damn authentic too. It's certainly akin to how the food is served in Korea so I'm fairly impressed with that. However, the taste itself, it wasn't bad. But it wasn't mind-blowing either. It was good, decent. I'll definitely go back again, but it won't be on my list of "OMG YOU HAVE TO TRY THIS."

Surprisingly good. Had flautas chicken. And tacos beef. Some tomatillo salsa and a jarritos. I forget how much it was. I just kept throwing money at the girl (who spoke no English btw) becuz it was that good. I'll be back. Not too ghetto at all if ur scared of that type of thing. Wimp

Last minute decision to eat at Carmines times sq location and service was great from reservation to when we left.  Very efficient and friendly.  Place was packed for a Wednesday night but our server was very attentive.  Meal was good and so were  our cocktails. Fun for out of state visitors.
Try this place if you are looking for a BYOB with great Mexican food for a good price! Awesome food and a cool environment! It's a great dinner spot, but you have to go early because they close at 8!

While I can't comment on the dancing part, we went for the same reason all people go places now. A Groupon. And the paella we had was actually very good, extremely high quality ingredients and a whole lot of them. We had the seafood and they didn't skimp on anything. Just know, if you get seafood, there will be grit. That's oysters. Doesn't matter if you spend $5 or $500. Seafood paella works that way. The waitstaff, the food runner, the host everyone of them were the nicest people you can meet. Honestly, not nice like your aunt or uncle who send you $50 every year on your birthday, I mean nice like Jesus. They helped with every thing, smiled more than I have in my entire life and were happy to be there. While we were there we started planning our next visit. That's a good sign.

Food was awesome ! I wanted to hit this place up for a while and finally made with my best friend. I was so sad the food was good I got to full to try any dessert but will be returning to just have dressers next time for sure. I gave it a 4/5 not for the food and dessert but the seating. It's not to big of a location and we were close to the door so everytime someone came in you could feel the cold breeze creep inside. But the food and service was great !

So...I have to say I believe in second chances.  Home Sweet Harlem is a great local spot and the proprietor Donna is so sweet and kind. I love her ideas behind getting the community together and supporting local artists and chefs. Donna has been so generous to let a local group of mothers, myself included get together and have a weekly story time in her fabulous space. The first week I tried the Caesar salad with organic chicken and it was honestly delicious!  Each week now I have enjoyed a large portion of Caesar salad with their yummy homemade dressing and croutons. Home sweet harlem is a great place to book large parties and events I definitely recommend working with Donna and the Caesar salad!!
me and my GF hannah we think this place is F-word good!!!! enantio wine.. black sea-bass
