Amazing wings. I could eat them all day long!! Cute little spot and not intimidating. Causal local spot that is great for a beer and wings.

Had some what high expectations of this place and am disappointed. Coming from a person who likes trying various beers, the beer here actually isn't that good. I had the burley Irish ale and seemed flat. Tried a sample of the Vermont smoked potter and that wasn't really good ethier. Not to many beer selections!! As for food, had their speciality meatloaf, ehhhh its mediocre! Place has a weird smell too. Not impressed don't fall for the tourist trap!

I have eaten here a few times.  I'm always greeted immediately and warmly.  The atmosphere makes you relax and like you are in a totally separate world than the one you just exited off the street.  The service is always impeccable and the food as fresh and amazing as it gets.  I love the pita and spreads.  The calamari, horiatiki salad and the moussaka are to die for. OUTSTANDING.
Great wings and Mac and cheese, service was good draft list didn't seem to impress me but they had bells two hearted bottled so I was happy nice cool laid back environment

We went for my husband's 50th bday. It was a surprise for him. I picked this place because I needed something close to the airport as my son flew in that night.  What a gem! They were fantastic with my family that came from MA, NJ, VA.  The place is small but boy did they deliver with amazing food!  For apps we had eggplant parm so good, grilled calamari with a seasoned olive oil to dip (never had it grilled) really delicious, mussels also a big hit!   The lobster ravioli, and chicken parm were amazing.  I ordered the Ricotta Gnocchi in an asiago thyme sauce OMG was that the best gnocchi I ever had.  They melted in my mouth.  I made everyone taste it!  They let me bring a cake and its BYOB!!
A lively noodle bar, cozy and noisy. Each dish was a special revelation....tamales? Noodle soup? Washed down with cold beer...tasty and recommended highly.

I really wanted to like this place more than I actually did. Will give it a while to iron out the kinks and then try again. The most critical component should be the burger. And it was good but not great. Patty was thicker than Five Guys but not as large as Farmhouse, prob around 6 oz. All our parties' were slightly overdone, with zero red in it despite ordering medium doneness. Meat was moist but not especially tasty. Toppings were good, brioche bun was good but my wife's was cold to the touch. Prices were between $11-17 depending on toppings. Other Cons: - Slow service: we arrived at 11:45am with the place basically empty, but still waited about 20min for our food. - Uneven service: one burger was supposed to be plain, but had cheese on it; one dish of fries was cold Pros: - Good fries. We had a variety of orders, all were a good balance of crispy on the outside and soft on the inside. Be forewarned the truffle fries have spicy chili flakes. - Good draft beer list - Facility was sleek, open and clean - Staff was friendly It's right next to the movie theater, so I anticipate that Friday dinner and Saturday lunch & dinner it will be packed. I wanted to like it more, and I think we will go back and try again. But if you're going to make your burger the centerpiece of your restaurant, it better be a great burger. As of today, I'd still choose the Farmhouse burger any day.

The food is solid, the ambiance and service brings to mind Italian family dining at its best. The owners are very hands on and go out of their way to make their guests feel at home. We had a great time and will be back. Marco...We had a selection of meats and cheeses for an appetizer...I had the Manicotti...my fiance had the spaghetti...it was all very good. The service..your dog Coca...made the evening well worth the trip while we were in town. Thanks.
Looking for a city sushi bar... This was a surprisingly great find in a basement... Unique energy and great food and service! Casual

I'd probably give this place a 2 and 1/2 stars if I had the option.  So, I took my wife here this past Saturday night for her birthday, never having been here before.  I chose it because it got fairly good reviews, and because of its proximity to the Broadway show we were seeing that night, starting at 8 pm.  We had a 6 pm reservation, and we got there at 6:05, and were seated immediately.  We were given a very nice table, next to a faux garden.  We ordered a bottle of wine, and it came pretty quickly.  It was a pretty good Chardonnay.  We actually ordered our apps and main courses at the same time (approximately 6:20).  The apps took a little while, but not crazy long to come.  We got the tuna tar tar, which was delicious (kind of like ceviche, with guac), and the beet salad, which was...eh.  Needed seasoning, and the beets were undercooked.  Then, we wait.  And wait.  And wait.  6:45, 7 pm, 7:15 pm, and no main courses.  Granted, it was busy, being a Sat. night, but still, waiting over an hour, there's no excuse for that.  I ask the waitress what's going on, and she said, "oooh, they forgot to "fire" it" (meaning, they forgot to start making the main dishes).  My wife was convinced it was the waitress' fault - that she never hit the "fire" button as we were finishing our apps.  Anyway, a few mins later, we were given a free app (the cheapest one on the menu).  We were assured, at 7:20, that the main dishes would be out "soon".  7:30.  Still nothing.  I go to the hostess and ask to speak to a manager.  He comes over a few mins. later, and I say "Look, we have a show to go to that starts at 8 pm, and at this point, we would be scarfing down our food."  He didn't make any excuses, just said "they lost our ticket", and apologized, saying "This is not normally like us."  He asked what we wanted to do, and we decided to cancel the main dishes.  He said he would bring us another free app.  He also said he would make "adjustments" to the bill accordingly.  A couple of mins. later, we were served my wife's main dish, the Chilean sea bass.  We were assured we wouldn't get charged for it.  It was actually delicious - it's just a shame we had to share it, and a shame we had to eat so quickly.  When the bill came, we were charged for the bottle of wine and for one app., so we ended up getting the wine, 4 apps, and a main dish for $57 (including tax).  We got to the theatre right on time.  So, all in all, the ambiance was nice, the food was good, the staff was nice, but the service was AWFUL.  I may come here again, but only if I have no set schedule, and maybe not on a Sat. night.  Just be warned.............. leave yourself a LOT of time if you plan on eating here!
Saturday evening. Bar food plus cocktails and a friendly staff. One of the friendliest gay bars in the city.
This place has everything. And it's not just variety--you're talking high quality stuff for the old school and the nouveau foodie alike.
Went for a friend's birthday brunch. Service, food and pretty much everything was exceptional.

Over all this is a nice corner Cafe, with a Great menu!! Alot to choose from, The service was definitely great. Food comes out with in 5 Min from ordering. The server kept coming back to fill up my mug with coffee. And didn't even have to ask. That's definitely right on it. Everyone is so friendly. And feel welcomed when entering!! Would Definitely be coming back. Check out there Daily specials on the wall!!

So hey, get this -- this place serves out of this world, rich, hearty broth out of the side of the restaurant. Who would have thought of this? The crazy people at Hearth, that's who. I went and got the grass-fed broth and boy is it tasty. I think people are going to have to stop using the cliché "hot cocoa" and start getting this amazing broth to warm up when this frigid weather finally rolls through. My only gripe is that they close at 7:30pm and aren't open on Sundays, but I might be able to get past that
At one point I was coming here every Sunday for breakfast/brunch. I usually order fried chicken and eggs along with a side of bacon and lemonade. Best damn breakfast money can buy!
I ordered the buffalo tenders with their homemade slaw 2 thumbs up!  The fried chicken, flavor was on point and so tender.
Wow is all I can say.  Fantastic     We stayed at the Mark Hotel while in NY and was directed to this small place.  Every single bit was the best.
One of the best meals I have ever had. The cocktails were also excellent, as good or better than Aviary.

An amazing addition to my neighborhood - I can always expect to enjoy a well prepared, fresh, hearty meal at The Marshall.  The staff is consistently friendly and super welcoming.  Be sure to check out their weekend brunch as well!
Very friendly staff. Communication was strained. Nachos were very good but portion small. The rest was very good

It was just OK.  Stopped in for a late lunch only because we were in the area and looking.  Slightly dirty feeling to the entire place but I got over that.  I had a chicken panini which was very good.  Standard fare is sandwiches,  salads, wraps and bags of chips.  Not bad, just not really a great place. Think I'd try another place if I was in the area again.

Overpriced and unfriendly service -- avoid. Plainsboro has limited options and eating joints. The visitors to this place will be significantly reduced if there other decent options. The food is flat with a lingering sweet taste in every dish. The Thai flavors and spice are barely visible. The service is terrible. The wait staff is only interested in standing around or getting the customer out of the door. I ordered a red curry with rice and it was 16.50. It felt it was over-priced for the flavors and ingredients.  They also tacked on a mandatory 18% gratuity for that terrible service.
This place is amazing and delicious!  If you have room for desert you must try their Cannolis -- very tasty! I highly recommend Gelone Restaurant for Italian food.

Twice we asked to sit in the back where the ambiance was very different than the front with the bar and twice we were told different reasons - like there was a reservation coming (btw we had a reservation too). We were there 90 min. and there were still PLENTY of tables there. I spoke to the manager and she tried to apologize telling me yet a 3rd story of why they didn't seat us there (they didn't want to sweep in front of us..). My impression is that the hostess, help and manager are immature and don't know what true customer service is. Also, the plates are too small for the prices they are charging. We only liked 2/4 dishes. Pigs feet was tough and tasteless .

Great service- friendly, helpful, attentive. Butternut squash was monotonous. Chicken scarpa was tasty with sweet potato. Both were specials. Would recommend for the atmosphere but it felt a little touristy to my local companion. Good for an easy dinner.
Good place for friends reunion.
This is real Chinese food.  It's the only place I've found that can compete with New York's Chinatown.    The only downside is that service can be slow, but the food is worth the wait!
love this place!!! great food great vibe
FIVE STARS! Bread was amazing! We all had beef: My husband ordered the filet, I ordered the prime rib and my daughter ordered the sirloin. Excellent! Can't wait to return!

traditional korean food, lots of side dishes, most a little bit spicy. Then the main menu only has severl topic, hot pot, pancake, cold noodle and korean bbq. Not too bad, but also not too good, average.
Grandmas was really tasty, cheese pizza was eh..... A bit greasy, but that could be the California in me Service was typical

This review is solely based on service experience on 11/9/14 Dear Kafana Staff: I gotta preface this by saying that I'm from former Yugoslavia, used to eating cevapi, podvaljak, and everything else on your menu.  What I'm not used to "eating", at least in former Yugoslavia, is the holier-than-thou pompous attitude from staff, for no reason. You didn't represent us Yugoslavs well last night, and here is why: 1.  When someone orders cevapi - a dish generally served with lepinja bread and kajmak cheese (although not in your restaurant), let them know that you will charge them extra for the bread and the cheese.  Anything else is just bad business. 2.  You are selling more than just food (I hope), so do make eye contact when you put food in front of people - that's the least you can do if you can't crack a smile to go along with it 3.  When someone asks you for a to-go box for the food they couldn't finish, don't look so obviously annoyed and say that you will "do your best" to box it for them.  The food was paid for and it should not matter whether the customer eats it there or somewhere else. 4.  How you still get some many customers having a cash-only policy is a mystery.  However, coins are still considered cash, last I checked.  When a customer tries to leave you a tip by putting a few quarters in a mix, you shouldn't fret about it- money is money, period.  If your establishment doesn't accept coins, make that clear on your menu/website. 5. I won't be returning to Kafana with any more of my American or African friends - your loss. Sincerely, Sanja P.S.  Dear Americans, if you like good Balkan food and care about decent service, Astoria has a few good authentic restaurants worth checking out.

Went here about  a month ago.. The food is so tasty! We had a party of 8 and shared a lot of the appetizers. They had a home made pasta special that was the best dish I've ever had! Their artichokes and olives are out of this world too in the antipasti. I will definitely be back. Good drinks, good service. ;)
Great spot for food and  drinks or just hanging at the bar. The fried chicken is delish!! Definitely will return for the third time!

Warm, intimate authentic food served by husband and wife owners. Small menu allows the kitchen to really shine.  Impeccable service that obliges both causal groups and the many dates that the New York style dining room invites.  Must eat: Meatballs, Green Curry Fried Rice, Pad Kee Mao.

We.loved.it! Fantastic place...fantastic staff and better yet amazing food. The owner was there, the son and Diego was awesome. We loved him! The food is so good and Uncle Jimmy's meatballs melted in you mouth! It is a MUST do place. Seriously...so much to choose from...just choose this one! You will not be disapppointed!
By far my favorite place to get pizza in Philly. Cozy atmosphere, speedy service, and DELICIOUS pizza. Go for happy hour, go with a date, go with yourself- just go.

We went this evening for my mother's birthday and we were extremely happy. It was four of us and some picky eaters so after searching and almost giving up I came across this gem. The place is decorated really well, it's modern and open and still feels cozy. The food was fantastic. Extremely flavorful and spices and interesting. In fact my mom said it was the best baklava she has ever had and she has had plenty in her day. Finally we had the pleasure of meeting the owner Pierre who shared with us the inspiration of the restaurant, named after his mother. He spoke with us and it was clear that a lot of love and passion goes into the restaurant. Well done and thank you Pierre for making my mother Zahavas birthday.
A variety of ethnic foods, fruits, veg and gifts
So awesome to shop and eat there, words don't do it justice. Just go and experience it for yourself.
There's no place like it! It's an incredible way to get all of Philly's most iconic foods in one place! Great crowd of foodies!
Even without their groupon, this is a great value and quality restaurant, especially in NYC.
gppd food
Great brunch menu! This place is adorable and very reasonably priced. The entrees are unique and delicious.

I went to this restaurant on a Monday and the wait was not bad at all, about twenty minutes for a table for five. I heard the wait could be hours. When you walk in, there is an enclosed patio to the right and the main restaurant to the left. We ordered several dishes featured on their website and the food came out very fast. Service was great. I am sad to say I found the food mediocre. We ordered the Greek salad, calamari, and fried cheese which were exceptional. But then for main course we had the seafood platter which was very disappointing. Seafood was overcooked - lobster tail and shrimp were chewy. We also ordered the Greek sausage that were so burnt it really took away from tasting the sausage. With all that said, the meal ended with complimentary vanilla pudding dessert. The price was also very reasonable. Enjoy!

No food, just drinks, and they were food. Made with TLC. Tasty and delicious. Emily you the BOMB! The decor is very nice from the lighting to the seats to the seats, tables, and curtains. Nice little Cuban spot in Hells Kitchen if you looking to drink n eat for medium prices

Food was super tasty and we enjoyed the space. I would definitely go back for the migas and brisket.  I was a little peeved that there's no mention on the brunch menu - or from our server - that we could order a quarter pound of meat. Fine if they want to tell us they recommend half a pound of meat per person, but we didn't know until our check came that ordering less than 1/2 pound was a possibility. Also, $4 for a cup of regular coffee seems a little steep.

Great little restaurant....i go there often and it's always so good. Service is always good and attentive, no complain about it. Favorite dishes are buratta, grilled octopus salad and lamb chops. Try the rosso di montalcino, out of this world.

Can't figure out how this place got 3 bells. Nothing was as interesting as it sounded on the menu (one dish that supposedly included brussels sprouts had two brussels sprout leaves in it). The striped bass came out severely undercooked (to their credit, the manager apologized and comped our dessert). But that was the only dish that was served hot (after it was properly cooked) - everything else was tepid. The portion sizes were very small considering they are meant for sharing (small plates are tiny, medium plates are small, and large plates are also small). The apple cake dessert was excellent, but that was the only dish we could say that about.

Food was a plus but everything else was not.  Our server, I think his name was Nate, was terrible.  If you are gonna serve paying customers you need to at least pretend to put on a smiling face.  This guy not only made smart remarks back to us about our drinks taking 20 minutes claiming hes "not the bartender" but then proceeded to just simply not respond to requests, and finally knocked over a full drink on our table at the end of the meal.  Everyone has bad days but this guy seemed completely un interested in doing his job that night.  We appreciated that the manager comped our first round of drinks and the food was pretty good but our night wasnt as great as it could have been because of a disgruntled server.  After reading other reviews for this place it seems this is a common theme.  Lighten up!!!

I enjoy their food. I've had better, but I've also had far worse. The portions are fair, the food is tasty, and the price doesn't kill me. If you're in the neighborhood it's a good place to get some chinese. I always do take out. I can see the negative comments about the restaurant itself. It's definitely family owned, and they're not to worried about showmanship on the inside. I'll take off one star, but it doesn't really make a huge difference to me personally. Also, their Thai Iced Tea is really good.

This place is out of the way for most people in NYC.  The only nearby subway line is the G.  I never rode the G before coming here and I also never used the East River Ferry before.  The fact that they have so many different options and so many Vegan options makes it worth going out of your way.  I have not yet seen another similar place with a specific Vegan section.  Be open minded about the out of the way location and you will enjoy this place.  I'm a traditionalist, so I had to ask for the Regina, which was no longer on the menu.  If you are looking for something basic, then it's not worth going out of your way to go here.  Also, there is usually a wait and they are only open evenings.
great wraps,very tasty! took the Veggie one and was really great! nice place to grab a quick lunch!
Simple the freshest tastiest Thai food . Great staff. The place gets busy so be prepared to wait but it's well worth it.
Delicious.  The Pho Real is fo real!!

Fantastic burger joint! The flavor of the meat was excellent, and the bacon jam brought it all together. Most everything is made in house, and you can certainly taste the difference from the chains. Loved the hand-cut fries as well. They were crispy, and not over salted. If you want a real treat, try the bacon jam fries:)

I just love this place for breakfast. The staff are friendly and helpful, the food is awesome and the atmosphere is laid back and accommodating. I live in the Seattle area and travel to Philly a couple of times a year for business. I try my best to squeeze in a trip to Sam's Morning Glory for a breakfast sandwich with turkey bacon. So good!  The homemade ketchup is an added bonus.

Short and simple: This place is big and clean; customer service is as you order it. I had a burrito bowl, technically a salad bowl, and it was exactly as I wanted. It was also quite delicious and filling. The price is also reasonable. I recommend this place to individuals and groups. I also want to add that they cater.

I had my sons communion party in May 2014 and thanks to Steve it was perfect (and I tend to be a but demanding). He took the time to cover each detail of the venue start to the very end ( my guests were very impressed as were we). The food was great, the party room was perfectly decorated and Steve and the staff accommodated my every request. I can't thank you enough for creating this wonderful event for us! It's a beautiful place and the service was impeccable! We plan to book all our parties there from now on...:)
They have the best spicy seaweed salad here. I've ordered from other places and no one compares!

Food was very good, being from Ukraine I can say that I would recommend to anyone who wants to try authentic Ukraninan.  Borsch was very good, I tried it at Mari Vanna and that was not Ukraninan Borsch.  Kvas with honey was delish.  Service friendly, atmosphere perfect. My mom, aunt and daughter all enjoyed!!! Will definitely go back!!!

Well, our first trip to HB is nothing to write home about. I had the fish and sweet potato chips. The fish, while fresh was tasteless. Well cooked but not seasoned. Chips were 'eh'. My companion had classic fish and chips ... Fries were slightly raw. HB does not compare to the sister restaurant (Thai Basil).

You know the food is good at ABC Kitchen when it's your parents' favorite brunch spot AND your anniversary date spot... Food is flawless. Restaurant is simultaneously beautiful and relaxed (so you're acceptable in heels but your server is definitely in a flannel). Go-to orders include: DINNER -Raw sliced scallops with delicious crunchy vegetables (sometimes the fish differs to fluke, etc but the preparation with mignonette stays the same) -mushroom pizza with egg (so much more complex than you'd imagine) -all of the small vegetable plates BRUNCH -smoked salmon with horseradish, creme fraiche, and lemon -french toast with poached pears
After a couple more conversations on the phone, I finally got my refund for the extra charge... Sloppy, but at least they care about customer service

How is it possible that this restaurant  got an average noise level. When I was there and checked it with my iPhone app, it read higher than Grand Central station when 2 trains are coming in and pulling out together. I checked both, and this restaurant is louder.

I have passed this store so many times, and always crave Oxtail's. So I stopped in on my way to work. The food was awesome, just as I was hoping. Needless to say I hit this spot once a week. Good food and a good person.
My absolute favorite place in Philadelphia. All the Amish and Italian food are spectacular, and the produce prices are always great!
Amazing cocktails, beautiful atmosphere and great service. We didn't want to leave!!!

I went here around 5:30pm and asked for a table for 3. The lady told us it should be 40-45 minutes wait, but it ended up being 1.25 hrs! I ordered the nabeyaki udon. I advise you do not order this. The ratio of noodles and broth was off and the noodles were overcooked. The tempura was already fully soaked in the soup, which made me really sad. There were only a couple of pieces of tiny chicken in it and almost no veggies. Not even close to avg nabeyaki udon. I guess the place is not called Udon-ya afterall!

This is the only BBQ place that a frequent in NJ. The food is great and matched by the service. The owner is a great guy and very happy to speak with you. Not to mention he also makes the food. Thumbs up!
The Food Is Excellent, The Salmon Burger Is A Must Try. The Detox Is Not Only Good For You, But Taste Great. Love There Customer Service.  Thank You Vital.

I been working in Philly long time and I been looking for fast food Indian resturant and finally yesterday I found this little gem when one of my friend took me to this resturant . I ordered masala dosa with mango lassi it was just perfect combination and it was served with sambhar and chutney . Oh my god it was delicious . I also had samosa with chutney and indian tea which was amazing . I would love to go there again .
So overrated. I can't believe I waited 2 hours in the freezing cold for that. So not worth it.

I did a late night service call there and when I was done they gave me a plate of rigatoni and meatballs.  I got in my truck and started to eat. I started driving and placed the plate on the passenger seat. As I was driving I had to make a quick stop and the plate slid off the seat and fell to the ground.  I'm not embarrassed to say it but I still ate the dish. It was that delicious!!!

We went with a group last Friday night, the service was very slow. That said the food was very good when it arrived. The hostess was really friendly and accommodating. We like tequila and they have a nice selection. We will go again when we are in the neighborhood.

Great pernil asado (roast pork).  Great empanadas (tried a beef and a chicken).  I left off a star because the portion of beans was fairly small given 2 entrees purchased.  Next time I'll order an extra side of beans.  Ridiculously inexpensive as well.

I love the shrimp dumplings!  Soup dumplings are a little messier than I'd like but they taste great.  Make sure you have them read your order back to you, I've received the wrong items on more than one occasion.
The BEST falafel ever. I'm serious!
What a great place! As Ukrainian myself, I can assure you this is the best Ukrainian/russian food in the city. Beautiful decor and great service!

AMAZING food and service!!! This was our second time at the restaurant and we decided to take our friends they were blown away at this charm. Highly recommending and you can not beat a BYOB!!! They are always busy so it's a good idea to make reservations.
love this place!

Menu selection has a variety of appetizers and entrees. Cheese board had a wonderful selection of cheeses. Had the rabbit entree and was disappointed. Noodles were soft and tasted the sauce and noodles over the rabbit. If you enjoy rabbit, go to la peg
Love this place so much!!! The employees are so sweet and helpful. The front of house is clean and organized and the good is fresh and tasty. I stop by as often as I can!

I find myself coming here when I am desperate for thai food, especially since their lunch specials are only $8.00. Their lunch specials come with 2 spring rolls, a soup, an entree, and a few lackluster canned pineapple tidbits. For my soup I had the Tom Kha (chicken coconut), and I must say it was so bland. I love Tom kha, and was sadly disappointed in theirs. I ordered the drunken noodles, and they were better than the soup.
Service and food was excellent! Prices were also very reasonable. Atmosphere was excellent as a live, Cuban band played. Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant and plan on returning soon.
small intimate lovely place. great food & wine. very kind and knowledgable hotsts. recommend escargots, steak frites and onion soup which was not salty and perfect for a chilly day!
Check out my review on my food blog: bigfoodjournal.blogspot.…
Since they changed their head cook they became better than other Turkish restaurants in the city. If you don't want to spent a lot of money  ( PERA-Turkish Kitchen) same quality less price. Enjoy .

I placed an order on GrubHub at 7:00 p.m. and got a delivery estimate of 8:15-8:25. At 9:00 I gave them a call asking where my order was. They told me they'd call me back in a few minutes. When they didn't bother to call me back, I called them again. Apparently there was something wrong with their Grubhub setup and they never got the order. They told me they'd refund my money. I was pretty upset at this point, because now it was 9:00 and ordering from somewhere else wasn't even an option anymore. I hadn't eaten since breakfast, I had an early exam the next day, and it was getting harder and harder to focus on anything I was reading because I was so hungry. It was also a shame because I've been looking for a good Indian restaurant in the New Brunswick are for some time, and after this experience I was sure I wouldn't give this place another chance. But the way they handled the situation changed my mind. The next day the manager, Lenny, called me to apologize and make sure my money would be refunded. He also offered to fill the order, free of charge, at a time and date of my choosing. I chose that night (I was still REALLY craving Indian food). Food was all really good, too - we had Paneer Tikka Masala, Palak Paneer, garlic naan, and gulab jamun. Everything was delicious. I might be wary of online delivery (a phone call directly to the restaurant is probably safer), but I would eat here again. And I was impressed by how classy they were in fixing this.

Absolutely there is no, yes no Apizza better than Pepe's of New Haven! Thin crusted with a slightly charred edges and bottom from the Coal Fired Oven. No matter what your favorite combination is , it is the best. My favorites are Sausage & Onion, Sausage and Roasted Red Peppers and White Pie. The atmosphere brings you back to days of yore and where many famous folk stooped to experience the Nations' best and original Apizza. There are other Pepe's now in NY and CT glad to see they expanded and are carrying on the tradition of making outstanding Apizza.

Best pizza on Staten Island; has to be one of the best in NYC! Very tasty, with a perfect balance of tastiness in regards to the sauce and cheese! Even the appetizers and toppings are great! Don't forget, cash only, and no single slices.  Also, Ralph's Ices across the street when you're finished makes this a perfect summer treat!

I highly recommend take out or delivery. The service was awful! The waitress made it seem like an inconvenience to have anyone dine in. She yelled loudly at the other staff. Another customer walked in & she asked him if he'd like to move to a smaller table. He said no I'm okay & she told him he needed to move to smaller table. I just don't get how hard it is to be nice if you're going to work in this industry. I give 2 stars because the food came out fast & it was decent taste wise for the price.
THREE WORDS. BACON .... INFUSED .... POPCORN. Hell yes. This place is finger lickin' good. No longer need to consume anything with sodium for the next twenty years but totally worth it.

Nothing I can add that people haven't already mentioned. - Line moves fast - Put the mysterious white sauce on your food - 6 dollars for a container of food? Say wha - Sometimes they will sing for you - Food is awesome - Best late night snack

This was my second dinner at Mominette.  At the first, I just tried their burger frites, which was quite good, but not something to review for Yelp.  I returned with husband, daughter, and daughter's roomy the other night.  On the whole, the food was good, but the vegetable sides were all treated the same.  ("Would you like some kale with your garlic?")  The duck confit was a little bland.  The shrimp special appetizer in a light cream sauce with tomatoes was quite nice as were the mussels.  ("They were smallish, but they were good.")  The branzino special was good, but not exceptional, and the accompanying risotto was excellent.  My daughter's roommate pronounced the boeuf Bourguignon terrific.  The desserts -- creme brûlée, chocolate mousse, and flourless chocolate cake -- also were excellent. Service was cheerful but disappointing.  We were sitting at two wobbly tables.  The server fixed one but not the other.   No bread was brought to the table although our appetizers had sauces.  We were not asked if we would like another round of wine.  And, most perplexing was the veggie burger and frites.  My daughter had been here several times before and had enjoyed it.  This time, the burger was extremely heavy on the sun-dried tomatoes, rendering it almost inedible.  She forced down less than half and asked the server if they had changed the recipe.  He assured her that they had not and that was that.  He did not offer to get her something else.  Just dropped the subject.  Also, having learned that she had ordered and enjoyed it before (read: "regular customer"), he should have comped her.  He did not. The restaurant had a decent number of diners, but by no means were people beating down the doors to get in.  It's not great business to treat a regular customer in such a cavalier manner.  There are a lot of terrific new restaurants springing up in Bushwick, just clamoring to please new customers.  I don't think I'll be back to this one.

I love this place!!! So cheap & food is good !!! But don't go by weekend! Have to wait forever!!! We been waiting like more than 30 mins to get the table! And one thing not good is they gave tables to others after us..... Cry cry cry :( If no need to wait ! This place is good ! Cheap & Good foods

This was a huge disappointment. We live in the neighborhood and have passed by many times. When they first opened we were really rooting for them since they were new to the neighborhood. Over time they were busier and busier, tonight we decided to give them a try. The appetizers took about 20 minutes and when our shrimp skewers came out they were room temperature microscopic shrimp, and did not taste good. The entrees were just as unimpressive... My husband got the veggie fried rice and I got the egg  fried rice and both were inedible due to raw garlic. We literally left it untouched. My tofu and his short rib were so unimpressive we left our plates more then half full. I had a glass of wine he had a rum with juice which had no rum. When he asked for a bit more on the second round they said they could charge him for a double. I could go on and on but in short this was a meal I could have beat on a hot plate in my college dorm room. $120 down the drain.

Love, love, love the dessert here! Coffee éclairé is not just beautiful to look at, but so tasty and satisfying. If I have saved all those calories to spoil myself, this is what I'd go for. The paris cream pillow was a disappointment though. So stick to the éclairé and you won't go wrong. Love the quinoa salad and berries oatmeal. Yum! And of course, the chic, clean, bright interior, clever use of natural lights are brilliant. I can stay here all afternoon... that is until their wifi stops working. If you want free wifi, they don't have the most stable wifi here so be ware to check.
Awesome food and service ! Margie and Frank are great bartenders will definitely be back soon !

Excellent new addition to South Street--so glad to have a new option in the neighborhood for delicious, reasonably-priced food, with a family-run and very friendly vibe. Plus, the giggling, jokes, and innuendo while reading the menu is endless--if you're with the right people! We tried 3 of the 6 types of meatballs and 3 of the sauces" Chicken Pesto Spicy pork Marinara Turkey (special) Sage butter garlic (special) We also tried the Gnoochi Marinara, which was excellent--these folks were the original founders of Gnoochi, which used to be just off South St, too. Had Tiramisu for dessert, yum! Go there before it gets too busy!
Great food and wonderful owner/cook! The spanikopita was delicious and the baklava was heavenly. Thanks yelp for the perfect quick stop!

So maybe it's not in the greatest of areas, nor does it look all that great inside or outside.  What it does have going for it is that is it hands down the best thin-crust pizza in NJ.  The sauce has incredible flavors and the mouthfeel of the pie is simply perfect.

The happy hour here is awesome, and all day on Wednesday! The whole bar & bar menu is half off. Wine comes to $4 a glass, and the pizzas which are rather large are only $5. I also got the filet minion meatballs which were just okay, and the truffle fries. Great food, great prices, and great bartenders! Will have to try for dinner service soon.

In my opinion, this is the best restaurant in Montclair and is hands down the best value in town.  The ramen here is as good as the best Ramen in NYC, and everything the chef Julian prepares is first rate.  The service is impeccable.  This place has become my home away from home.  In a word-GO!
Delicious fresh juice, doesn't get any better! Very clean minimal look in the space, extremely inviting. Offers several varieties of green juices and fruit juices, and even nut milks.

Avoid PJ'S  Pancakes at all costs. The food here is over priced and the pancakes are lead hubcaps. Why, why, why do you have to PAY EXTRA for real maple syrup at a pancake house? Boycott this place for this reason if not for any other. For as much as you are paying for these pancakes, you should be able to gild them with as much real Vermont maple syrup as you want.

Great service, cozy interior. Maybe a tad bit small. However the food was pretty bad. Cheese with honey and bread were awesome, but you can't really spoil good cheese. It's the crusty octopus, which everyone here seems to like, was bad. Burned, over-marinated and too spicy. Not coming back.
Fresh and not heavy.

I just discovered this gem right around the corner from my apartment.  The ambiance is great but the food is even better.  The selection is plentiful and the portions are perfect.  There were plenty of specials in addition to the menu.  The wine list is nice as well.  The prices are very reasonable and the staff is extra friendly.  I went back a couple days later and brought my girlfriend.  This is going to be a go-to place for us.  So glad to have them in the neighborhood.

Great cheese steak if you are in that area.. better then that Gino's place across the street who only gives you a little cut of meat.  However over priced and really not worth the trip.. plenty of great cheese steak places in the city and surrounding area.
The lunch special is very filling and comes at a great size!

I check out the Chatni Indian Resturant yesterday for the lunch specials and I have to say there food is excellent. Made to order with option of how spicy you like it. I like it very spicy. Good sized lunch portions, great menu selection, excellent lunch prices. Check it out.
If you are a big fan of matcha and homemade style Japanese food, it is the right place for you! It is a lovely cozy restaurant. I highly recommend the Kato set, which includes basically everything.

I tried Koch sandwich artistry 14 years ago. Hands down they are the best in West Phila I live out of state now, but when I come to Philly , I must have a sandwich from Koch. The wait in line is worth it for a truly delicious sandwich..
The food was excellent! Had the Sardines and they were awesome, and the mushroom pizza was the best I have tasted! Great service and a cozy atmosphere.

So glad to have found this little hidden gem! I got the avocado sandwich with a side salad, and it was so delicious! The vinaigrette that came on the side was really good too.  I recommended this spot to a vegetarian friend and he loved it as well. I'm such a creature of habit that the couple of times that I've been there I've only tried the avocado sandwich, but I will surely venture into the rest of the menu options next time!

The BEST cheeseburger you will ever eat in your life. Don't even think about ordering anything else. And try to get a booth so you can carve your name along with all the other legendary people who have eaten there. The Yankee Doodle Tap Room is the epitome of the Ivy League and has a long, storied history. Take a peak upstairs at the common room of the historic Nassau Inn.
Very impressed!

Awesome drinks great food. Today I had the junkyard fry bread and harvest moon margarita.  It was my first time having fry bread it's almost like a Mexican pizza. Delicious! And the margarita is great for the season...apple and ginger yum

I don't always eat burritos, but when I do, It's Iztaccihuati. This place is fantastic! Authentic cuisine and even spanish soda all of it delicious. I ordered the burrito al pastor (marinated pork with a pineapple, mmmmmmm) and let me tell you, this was the best burrito I've ever had in my life! great wrapping and balance of ingredients with the perfect amount of spice (not too much! JUST RIGHT). Too cap it all off, the service was great right down to the speedy delivery. I will be returning.
My wife and I went for Mexican Independence Day meal which included 7meals paired with 7 drinks. All were fabulous and I would go back in a heartbeat.

Food is great and bar is personal, my favorite, great staff and fantastic management. will recommend to everyone. I stop by for a drink almost every night and there is a large staff of bartenders who all all very attentive, no matter which night you stop by.The Place To Be On Weekends!!!! all around a great place to go! A+++
Wonderful small vegan restaurant in the heart of montclair. Great food and friendly staff. I highly recommend Mundo Vegan.

I moved in the apartment above this place in June, and I honestly appreciate their business and highly recommend them. They are some of the nicest people I've met in Montclair so far and they have wonderful prices and of course, DELICIOUS pizza. My favorites are the Sicilian style and garlic knots. Everytime I visit, they greet me and talk to me not as only a customer, but as a person. The owners are really great guys. They have amazing times and never disappoint. Absolutely worth a visit!

I loved this coffee shop until I paid $10 for a cup of coffee and toast with avocado and "no wifi on the weekends". I understand the limited space problem but if you're not going to offer wifi, don't charge that much for a meal that's worth $5.

Went for lunch buffet. Wasn't bad but wasn't great. The buffet was small and the buffet wasn't refreshed as often as we would have liked. There were only about 12 options but the food was very good. Would recommend probably for dinner.

I will try this place again the next time I go into NYC. For now ugh. Wasn't busy as we arrived just before dinner. Server told us she's about to get off her shift. So I guess we should come back later or go to another place? We were the only table there party of 5. My nephew is an actor and suggested we all go here. I could have did better on a hibachi. Ok credit due where needed, burger was juicy, that's about it. Had to flag down the server involved with the bartender every time for a drink. This is not all about the server as it may seem but come on 2 people at the bar and 5 of us at a table looking to chow down and relax with drinks. Just wasn't good timing to go there I guess. Everyone deserves a second chance.
great vendors but gets a little crowded at times.  It is the city so what do you expect lol

authentic mexican. had the puerco in pipian and it was great! the green sauce was excellent! I also had a traditional salvadorian dish called "pupusa" de chicharron y queso and it was the best tasting pupusa that I've ever had! friendly staff!
Horrible pizza.  No taste.  Other reviews must be from friends and family.  San Vito and Pizza Masters are much better.
The pizza was good... I got the beast-master... Only problem was it wasn't worth 18.50 for a 10 inch thin crust pizza  that amounts to about 2 slices of a normal size pizza! Overpriced!!!

Worth the wait. Go early to avoid a long line (I'm talking 15-30min before it opens!) I've been to both branches, the newer one is bigger, good for bigger groups. If you go to the smaller branch with a party of more than 2, you risk being separated. I like their regular, Paitan ramen. I usually add an egg (and bamboo shoots and bean sprouts if I feel like splurging a bit more!). There was once, the soup was a little onion-y, but other than that I like the richness of it - bear in mind some people don't so it depends on your preferences! I like Ippudo too, but I feel their portions are smaller for the amount you pay. I'd go to either any day though!
The best Italian restaurant in NYC.  I love the black ink pasta, the best!!

Of all the times I've been here I've never reviewed this little gem. It's one of my favorite things about the Trenton Farmer's Market. The owners are some of the sweetest business owners I've ever dealt with and the food is out of this world. I've had BBQ down south in Tennessee and this rivals it! I'll continue to come here as long as it's open.

The husband and I decided to eat at Chips because we heard mixed reviews about the place and figured we would try it for ourselves. I had the "two eggies" with added birthday pancakes and he got the steak and eggs with home fries and bacon pancakes..yes..bacon pancakes! The food was okay but the portions for the price it was, was pretty sad. His steak looked like something from a frozen box at Walmart and the pancakes were nothing compared to the raves we heard about them. I would call them "doughy." Things that you would see automatically added to a meal at other restaurants ( bacon, eggs, toast, homefries, etc.) were an additional outrageous charge. Needless to say, our mediocre meal came to over $40.. Next time we are craving breakfast for dinner, we will go to the cracker barrel where quality meets quantity, and surely meets the price.
Best options for vegetarian sushi that I know of in Philadelphia. Service is always great. Love it!

The food is really delicious and I look forward to every time we have to go back there.  The only reason I can't give 5 stars is due to the service.  Takes a bit long for you to be served and this is even when it's slow.
Service is 110%! Must have the awesome garlic bread! The gnocchi was wonderful. Above all our server and the staff was awesome.

i went in for brunch... sat down at the bar then waitress looks at me and goes... "beverage?" with a condescending attitude the whole time I was there. I didnt do anything wrong, and she was friendly with others. Im assuming its probably because of my race and skin color. Not sure why a decent establishment would hire someone with an attitude like this. Overall awful rude service. Food is decent, just get takeout.

We found this place via web search while looking for a place to eat before touring the Empire State Building and figured it was a tourist trap. It wasn't. The food is WONDERFUL, the service is excellent, and prices aren't unreasonable at all. The decor and music are marvelous. Definitely the dining high point of our NYC vacation. Steaks were perfectly glazed and cooked, the clam chowder was not only delicious but obviously made fresh daily, and the bacon and cheese tater tots are evil in its purest form. We'll be back.

Great food. Great buffet. I would recommend not to go for Ala Carte as the ambience did not appeal to me. The waiters who are service oriented are giving attention to the fact whether the food was served or not but not to how it was served. Myself and my wife were having a conversation and suddenly there was a dosa on the table. There was no hello,hi and no personality. Needs a lot of improvement on that front. Not a classy restaurant at all. Stick to buffet for great food.

The frog leg  experience is amazing. My first time and I extremely recommend it. I loved the frog legs!!  The fried rice was  excellent. The service was prompt and very nice. The dumpling were good, but I was unable to taist what was inside of it. The sauce helped. It's a must for "first timers."  I will defiantly return.

The best Burger  for $7 you can find.   Best space in Bushwick between the magical garden the surrounds the perfect little nook of a bar.  It's great here and defines the phrase special find.   And not mention the coolest biggest sign I have ever seen.  Just follow the light!!!!

I give this place a 3 only because the chicken is good enough to go back for. The service is sometimes good but most times less than mediocre. I've seen people leave because it's taken so long to get their orders. Sometimes it seems more like a hangout spot for the employees than a place of business.

While it was more than a two hour wait, which we passed by walking to China Town for some tea, the fresh-squeezed orange juice and blueberry pancakes made it all worth it. Seriously the best breakfast we've EVER had. This will become a tradition for us to return to time and again whenever we are in New York.
Really great food. And the nicest people I've ever met in all of New York run this place.

I have been to branches of this same restaurant in Moscow and I have to say that even though the food was good there, it was even better in New York. The golubtsi, blini, and sausage were all amazing. So glad this restaurant is in New York.

Came in after a long cold day at storm king, the hostess and staff were super warm which was great cause i was frozen solid! It was a big group of us we sat up at the communal table by the bar, we all had different cocktails and they were all different and unique and very tasty everyone loved them. as for the food everything was on point nothing crazy just solid comfort couldn't ask for anything more. will definitely be back for more of those truffle fries and the katniss everdeen.

Absolutely disgusting. Ordered the roasted chicken with rice and string beans. I got overcooked/old rice, a slop of canned string beans with some tomato sauce and dried up chicken. Even after I specifically stated no tomato sauce, it left a lot to be desired. Never going back.

First off, I have to state that I'm not a vegetarian, and frankly I know very little about vegetarian cuisine. I do however, know a great dining experience when I have one. My wife and I dined at Revolution Kitchen for the first time last night and we enjoyed the experience. Nice atmosphere, attentive staff, good selection of regional brews - everything I like. We had the nachos and the miso sake glazed Brussels Sprouts to start (probably too much) and followed with the Revolution Tacos and Diablo Tacos. Everything was well presented and delicious. Our waitress was patient and answered our numerous questions about the dishes and their ingredients. The dessert was also great. In closing, don't think you have to be a vegetarian to enjoy Revolution Kitchen, it's a really good restaurant, period.

We arrived early for brunch and it's a good thing we did because by the time we ordered there was a line. The service was good a little slow but friendly. They ended up giving us a round of drinks for the delay. The Sugar Freak Brunch special and spicy fried chicken were great, while the sweet potato waffles were tasty but tough.  Overall, we would go back.

Had to wait to get seated, took 25 minutes. The restaurant was crowded, loud and crazy. Seating is family style with a lazy susan on the table. Food was pretty good. The highlights were the pork soup dumplings, the turnip buns, jellyfish and fried quail. Place only takes cash and prices are good.
Great brunch spot. Perfect for people watching on Metropolitan, spicy bloody marys, delicious egg po'boy, and the best playlist I've heard on a Sunday morning in a while.

Mundo is where I first realized how important the experience of dining is and I've yet to find a restaurant to top it in any way. I've been in love with Mundo since they opened in the early 2000's and made sure to have every birthday with them since. Even when I lived in Chicago, the first place I came home to was Mundo. Willie and Jon have created the most impressive and warm spot in NYC and not by chance -they are restaurant/people angels! Willie is the restaurant embodied- kind, generous and lively! Thank you for putting up with my family for all of these years :)   Now that they've expanded into what is a stunningly beautiful space, they've managed to maintain their signature sense of intimacy throughout both floors.  The lower floor is spacious, complete with a stage, and wonderful for large events. The main dining floor is a good size but sensual and with just the right lighting. Every detail comes together perfectly. Bring your dates, your parents, your friends, your bosses! If you live outside of Queens, this is worth the trip (and the many more you will make coming back). The food! Cheese rolls, red sonja, carrot dip and empanadas are my absolute go to orders. The dessert though. Their almond cake is as though someone figured out how to bake heaven. I dream of it! They also make a cheese and honey dessert that trips all of the senses at once. Their new cocktail list is inventive and delicious. I just had a sweet potato puree cocktail and a "sourbon" cocktail - both incredible. Neither were too "cocktail-y" - filed with sugar and cheap alcohol. They were smooth, balanced and just strong enough to go with dinner.   I'm so excited to have Mundo back. Please don't ever go again! xo

This review is addressed to Samantha Q, I'm sorry that you have that discomfort. But what is the point of you writing a bad review if at the end of it you're going to say the food was good. The last time I checked going to a restaurant was for the food not how big the space is. Every New Yorker knows that the best food comes from the smallest places. Thats why we all say we know this great hole in the wall restaurant. Also you have to understand that this is an authentic Italian restaurant. Which means loyalty comes first. Mario (the owner) is a great host and treats every loyal customer with respect and attention. That is why he doesn't have a manager running the place like every other restaurant in the city. You visited the place on a Saturday when 98% of Mario's LOYAL customers are attending. That is why you felt left out and needy. I have been going to il Triangolo since it first open, when I call to make a reservation Mario and his family always give me the highest attention because we know each other. Kind of like in the show cheers where everyone knows your name. Trust me when i tell you that if you become a loyal customer Mario will move mountains for you. thats how true Italians treat their family.

I came here for lunch and was quite disappointed for a few key reasons: 1. The sushi rice under the fish would fall apart in my hand upon lifting the sushi from the board (so I can't imagine what would happen if one were incorrectly using chopsticks instead). 2. Some of the fish didn't taste as fresh as I expected, and in fact one or two pieces had a slightly unpleasant taste. 3. The environment of the restaurant is just OK. 4. The waitress bringing tea would reach over my face as I was eating without even giving any warning. This made the price of the meal difficult to swallow. The one silver lining was the sushi chef was very friendly.
Very good prices, lots of menu choices.  Food is tasty. My favorites are the gyro and chicken dinners.
HANDS DOWN my favorite place in North Newark! Good food, nice staff, and close to home.
Went here today for the first time. Charming place,service was great, food was delicious. Definitely will he going back. Maybe today. Great addition to the neighborhood.
Its overpriced and not worth for vegetarians but the service and the ambience is good.

Lovely Indian eatery. The customer service was very good with the waitstaff taking time to educate my guest and I on the dishes. The food portions were quite hefty which was good for me because I didn't have to worry about lunch the following day. Not the best, not the worst so I'm open to trying this place again.

I am in Love! Yes it  is pricey but the food is so good!  I did the make your own, with the help of a very nice lady who worked there, and since it was my first time selectd a awsome combination of chicken and shrimp, along with red onion, fried shallots, green pepper, with a rice noodle base and the mild garlic sauce. The food was AMAZING!

While our pasta and salmon dishes were tasty, the service was egregious. The waitstaff was uninvested in our dining experience (no check-ins or true service). When we ordered dessert and coffee, the very mediocre coffee (tasted like instant crystals) was delivered, then we waited over 15 minutes for our cannoli to be delivered. Ultimately, because our waiter wasn't paying attention, we had to get up from our table to inquire about it. He swore it was supposed to be on its way -- then it never came. Ultimately, we asked for the check and the waiter told us he had never even put in the dessert order, which is why it hadn't come. No manager ever came over to apologize -- in fact, as we walked out the door, he was outside on his cell phone. Very disappointing for what seemed like a promising establishment. If you're considering eating at Tavola, I'd suggest getting take-out to avoid the service.

Very nice place, I came here with a bunch of friends and we were seated right away with no reservation. The food was absolutely amazing and the server was very funny. The decoration of the place was very lovely and it added an ambiance to our dinner. I will definitely come back!

I really wish they had a better selection for sandwiches. The menu is hard to read as well However, the staff are always very nice and helpful, and the prices are reasonable. It's no Bagel Market, but the bagels are definitely yummy and they do have a good selection of cream cheeses.

After a mixed first impression we gave it some time before returning to Lea and were very happy with our 2nd experience. We stopped in for brunch on a beautiful fall weekend and there was no wait. Our food was good, the portions generous and the coffee bottomless.

The pizza is absolutely amazing.  I came here with 4 people from Italy.  And these were some of the comments: "I've been in America for two years and I finally got a good pizza.  I forgot how good they are."  "Oh dio...this pizza is amazing...just like back home." "This is the best pizza I've had in America." Everyone thoroughly enjoyed their meal. We even ordered a sixth pizza because they were soooo good.

+ Service is top-notch. Wait staff is very friendly. + Bread is poor quality. Maybe it's just Italian bread I don't like, but the bread was quite pedestrian and tasted like it came off a store shelf. I'm glad they served it with olive oil and let me request balsamic. Olive oil was good. + Calamari was yummy - fairly large portion! + Chicken Amalfi was difficult to eat. I didn't expect that a "balsamic reduction sauce" meant that this thing would be DRENCHED in balsamic. I love my balsamic but each bite of this was an acerbic, gagging, mouthful with hints of ammonia. Really difficult to eat but I was a hungry person so I ate all of it. But I didn't enjoy it. + Dessert - they had an ice cream dessert crepe which looked really good but I didn't try it. So... I wouldn't say pasta is my favorite food, and I probably just made a misstep by choosing the Chicken Amalfi. But I probably wouldn't be going back to try their other things since everything was pretty expensive when it's literally just carbs.
not so good place

Small shop in the middle of nowhere! The menu is quite simple where you chose your broth then the type of noodles you would like. The ramen was good but I didn't quite get a kick out of it like I expected from the reviews. I would go back and definitely try their other flavors though. I got their shoyu ramen with extra thick noodles! Go with the recommended noodle choices too
YUMMIE!!!!!!!!!! I love to eat with my paws!

If people expect food to be like some cheesy chain-food menu - don't go here!!! If you want to eat something different and special - the hours are listed... I have yet to hear anything negative from people that know FOOD!!! Great place...

Three of us had a terrific meal Saturday night at Jewel of India in Hanover, NH. We had the full meal of appetizers, soup, naan and main dishes. The food is quite good and had gotten so much better in the past year; I wonder if they changed chefs? The place was crowded and we had to wait despite having a reservation but it was worth it. I plan to go back again and again.

I love Bubby's. Sure, it's over-priced for what it is. I can get a great burger at Whitman's for half the price. BUT, and I'm sure you know this, it's all about the pie. I crave that pie like it's nobody's business. I think a slice is 9 bucks. A whole pie is $65, and I would 100% buy one for Thanksgiving or something. It's totally worth it. Peanut butter pie. Pumpkin. Key lime. It's all effing unbelievable. And makes the trip to Tribecca (or the High Line loc) and the price tag completely worth it.

I went to celebrate my birthday with my closest friends and the experience was amazing. They treat you and your guest so well and to top it off the food is amazingly good. The view is incredible all around the restaurant. It's a must go place.

I tried Posto after reading the great reviews and left disappointed.  The plus of all this is that the pizza was good.  That was the only plus, however.  The service was sub-par.  After being seated and handed a menu by the host, I waited 20 minutes for a waitress to show up at my table.  To make matters worse, I watched her service two other parties who came in well after me before deciding to come over to my table.  Given that I had been sitting there for 20 minutes waiting for service, I already knew what I wanted and placed my order immediately: soup and a pizza.  After another 15 minutes, the waitress finally returned to tell me that they were out of the soup.  It's soup!  Nothing complex here.  It shouldn't take 15 minutes to serve a bowl of soup let alone  check to see that you actually have said soup.  At that point, I opted just to eat my pizza, which was tiny, and leave still hungry.  Needless to say, I didn't leave much of a tip, which is very atypical for me.

I went back to Bistro Mediterranean on 11/1/14. The customer service was much better this time! We didn't like our waiter very much (he was the older man who greeted and left me waiting last visit), but everyone else was very friendly. The place looks fancy but is not too expensive. My boyfriend LOVED his dinner. He got the Paella a la Valenciana and he was very content. I got the rib eye steak (Filete de ojo a la parrilla) but to my disappointment it was cooked extremely well done when I ordered it medium. This may not seem like a big deal but I have braces so my whole dinner was kind of ruined. The appetizers were very good though. I loved the cheese croquettes!!!! Now for the most impressive part of the evening was when the man in a white shirt, perhaps the manager, came to apologize about the steak. He was so kind and genuine. He brought out a free tres con leches for me to make up for the dinner. The gesture was nice, but his friendliness alone was very much appreciated! :)
This place is amazing. Them being cash-only was a little bit of a surprise but the mood in there is great with even greater food.
Good times.

Having biked all the way here from Carnegie Hill countless times, let me tell you it's worth it. Get an order of their fried dumplings or their steamed buns if they haven't run out and a pecking duck sesame pancake. Try to disregard Prosperity's appearance. What it lacks in charm it makes up for in flavour.
Now that Yogev is bartending here he leaves all his money in his pockets and forgets about it and I find it when I do the laundry.

After reading al the "hit or miss " reviews, my wife and I were a bit skeptical about what to expect.  No worries----it turned out just fine.  The food was excellent (short ribs for both of us) and no problems with the  service. Our waitress Linda, was very good--a real character).  The sides were tasty.  The groupon was a great deal-  the beer and wine that came with the dinner were normal sizes.  Our check came to $4 plus tip.  Our 35 minute drive to try this place was well worth it.  A nice mix of patrons with a separate bar for those who want to watch the game.  Very nice atmosphere.   We would definitely go back.

Wow. What a disappointing, inconsistent place. I really thought we had found a new neighborhood spot that wasn't overrated, overpriced, and overrun with hipsters, but apparently that hope was as worthless as when I thought music could make a comeback after the shitestorm of knives in my ears that happened in the early 2000s. Tonight was our second time at Pig and Khao and it just didn't cut it for the price or the cuisine. The dish we went crazy over the first time (the green mango chicken salad) had zero spice to it which, for me, defeats the purpose of going to a Southeast Asian restaurant. And the pork belly with pumpkin puree special was just bad. Too sweet, not spicy, and poorly selected cuts.   My guy, who is ordinarily unforgiving of these types of flaws in certain cuisines, was not nearly as turned off as I and was willing to give another dish a chance, but before we had an opportunity to do so the smell of cleaning products poured over the restaurant. At first I thought that maybe the kitchen realized they were kind of blowing it tonight and attempted to spare all of us from tasting any more of what they were serving up, but the truth is that the bar, which is right at the front of the restaurant and in close proximity to plenty of tables, decided to wipe down every bottle of liquor with windex. In the middle of service. And when it was brought to his attention a big grin came across his face and he continued! I'm always surprised to see that kind of attitude from a position that doesn't rely on a salary, but tips from the people that you're disturbing. Maybe he hasn't been working in restaurants long enough to know that vodka should be used to clean down his bar, but, for me, attitude and inconsistent food are two strikes too big to keep me coming back.

Came here to try out our local diner for dinner, and it was alright. I had a burger that was a bit more rare than I had wanted, and quite greasy leaving me a bit ill. My fiance's meal was 'alright' too, nothing special, and certainly nothing compared to the other NJ diner's I have been to which is sad. Though the wait staff was friendly and pleasant, pretty sure I won't be stopping here again, there are better places to go within a mile radius of this place on route 1.
My go - to for takeout and lunch. Only con is the minimum delivery charge is $30-$40, a bit pricey for one persons lunch.

Went for lunch with a group of 7 of us and it took forever to get our food. We ended up being in the restaurant for over an hour. Not a place to go on your lunch break. Then to top it off I asked for the cheesesteak without mushrooms and half my sandwich was correct and the other half had mushrooms. How hard is it put the proper sandwich on the plate?
Fries and chicken wings are good! Nice place to have a drink with friends~ also had duck flatbread, good but not fantastic~ glass of wine relax us after study!
Come here for the burger!

I recently went to this place to get a burger one evening, and the service was extremely poor. One of the servers moved the condiments from my table after I picked up a bottle of ketchup to use on my food. For no reason at all..... She asked me with a rude tone of voice "Is there anything else you need?" I respond "I would like more burger sauce" My server gives me a blank stare and ignores my request. The food itself is pretty good I'll admit, but the service was terrible; I don't think I'll be going back there.

Recently went to JANE with a group of 11 and we all had a great time. The food was great, the atmosphere was fun and the staff were friendly and accommodating! I will definitely be back again in the near future.

Much better plate presentation than I was expecting for the type of food. I had the meatballs with mashed potatoes and veggies. Very tasty, spot on portions and the big ass glass of dark beer I had left me quite happy with my visit.

Went with a friend Saturday night and was pleasantly surprised. I had not heard many good things from other people I knew who went here, but after thinking about it their tastes are more trendy and high brow, so we decided to give it a try. The place is well lit so it isn't a restaurant for a romantic evening, but if you want to go causal with friends and feel comfortable talking at a normal level this place will suit your needs. The menu was diverse and the food was high quality. I had the fusili with lamb meatballs which was delicious, as well as filling as hell! The portions are also substantial, especially for the price. So if you want to avoid the crowds and attitude of Montclair's trendier establishments and want to patronize a smaller restaurant which has a personal touch I recommend you give Next Door a shot.

Just ate this awesome Boston cream donut, they slice the middle like a sandwich of the donut and put so much cream in the middle.. so fluffy and fresh.. The cream was great. I highly recommend it. I hope they make more savory donuts like  the show ,donut showdown. Overall Very Good Place and affordable.

This is the BEST BEST place to get middle eastern/ Mediterranean food. Every time I've gone here it's been 10/10 in terms of service, everyone is so nice and the place is always so clean. Being a vegetarian, I always order the falafel and it's always delicious!! Plus there are student discounts on your meal. Always great always delicious never get enough hummus and pita company !!

Superb service, absolutely delicious dinner!   We ordered the Buratta and Proscutto (delicious), the Veal Parmigana (outstanding!  we split it as it is a huge portion), the Seafood Risotto (done to perfection) and the Tiramisu for dessert (best I have ever had!) Greeted by very professional and personable host, a lovely  glass of Prosecco each, homeade cookies (being passed around), and excellent Limoncello....all complimentary.   Highly recommend this restaurant.  It is one of my fav's!

I've been here quite a few times now. Everything on the menu is fabulous. I especially enjoy the burger, fries and kale fried rice. I recommend making a reservation because they are strict with seating arrangements.

Pretty good, I looked at reviews ahead of time so knew what to order. I got the wild mushroom paella. I dont think there was a crumb left on my plate. I like how the place was big and airy, I felt as if I had actually stepped out of new york city for a couple hours.
Love the burritos and quinoa salads and wraps.  I'm there practically every week and never disappointed. Thanx for coming to Hillsborough.

The BEST TACOS IN ALL OF NYC! Bar bruno is delicious, I've been coming here for awhile and always leave smiling. It started with the tacos, but everything on the menu is mouth watering. Delicious seasonal ingredients, awesome drinks and wine, super service and all around GREAT vibe!

Prior to coming here, I read the reviews and liked that they were fast because our party of 4 wanted to catch a NYC Doc movie.  However, they were over the top with the speed of their service--I felt pressured to order something (waitress wanted to take our order as we sat down & came back soon after like 3 times) and the ordering process was so much pressure.  Paying was a rush too--as soon as I got my check and was gathering money to pay, they asked if it was all set.  It seemed like they were so set on seating people who were waiting, that they forgot to treat the existing customers with courtesy.  This is great if you only have 1/2 for lunch or something but for leisure dining, it is not advised to come here.  Being an southeast asian, I do not consider this place as an authentic Vietnamese restaurant.  The shrimp vermicelli (with fish sauce) was bland.  Shrimp was overly salty and did not have an authentic taste.  The appetizers were just alright.  To my surprise, it was extremely busy.  Maybe because there aren't too many competitors in the area...not sure why.  Or maybe other dishes are better, but the service was so unpleasant that I don't think I want to find out.
The food is excellent, the only Italian food in Princeton comparable to Italy. Wonderful service, a truly terrific restaurant.
Great casual restaurant, just don't come for dinner after 9pm, the security guards are out front around that time, and they might give you a hard time.

Absolutely horrible. I've had better Pierogis from a bar. If you enjoy clogging your arteries with a pound of butter, and paying to cook your own pierogis then this is the place for you. Lets start with we ordered for lunch and the woman tells me it'll be a 40 minute wait (I get there and no one is there). I had the broccoli and cheese and potatoe pierogi, there was no cheese and as mentioned before - DROWNING in butter. made me sick. everyone at my job threw theres away and we ordered something else. NEVER AGAIN

Cafe Cluny is your typical West village cafe, with a kitchen and staff probably up to par for brunch, but nothing more challenging than that. I went there for dinner at the invitation of a friend who lives in NYC. The dinner menu was quite boring, nothing inventive and I would argue it's more modern American than close to the boundaries of French cuisine. Ordered the Steak Frites medium rare and a cocktail, which did the job but didn't blow me away. For a restaurant charging $120 for 2 mains and 2 drinks, you'd expect a *little* more fireworks. I also don't get how the servers expect you to hang your winter coat "anywhere around the room where there's a hook". Maybe it's a New York thing but I would've expected assistance for a place attempting to be chi chi.

Oh man. Good stuff. Buffet lunch pick and choose what you want for $6.49 per pound. Plenty of desserts that are extra. I mixed and matched a full plate of rice, lamb and potato, salad, veggies and it came out to $8. Not a bad deal at all. All the food tasted great and fresh. Will be coming back often.
Best gluten free bakery in New England. :) I recommend the black bean brownie and lemon bars!! Simply amazing organic ingredients to make truly unique flavors!
Awesome sandwich's!!! We had  16- Lamoretti & 22- Z'Tuna.. Both were excellent, price, and portion was just right.  Would definitely  recommend!!!
Wonderful food. Great waiters. A gem in a neighborhood with mediocre, over priced restaurants.

I don't understand how this place doesn't have 5 stars. Its FANTASTIC! Everyone is super nice there...big portions, great price. To the people saying its EXPENSIVE, you're clearly cheap because this is the cheapest, high-quality breakfast I could ever get. The pancakes are awesome, light...fluffy, with a unique taste. Bacon is the best bacon around, thick cut and fresh...nice and crispy...(it has its day like I'm sure some of you do) but overall its great.
The food is average and the drinks are overpriced. It's a nice place with pretty employees but nothing special.

I have never had actual food here, only chocolate stuff. But it is definitely worth visiting. It smells great from the front door and the inside is nice. Kinda easy to overdo it though with the chocolate.

We decided to try this place out after work during happy hour (we were a big group from work) and the experience was just ok. I didnt like that when we asked for a Menu the waiter pointed to the chalk boards on the wall instead of just suggesting specials. The writing was so small we ended up not ordering anything. We decided to play some music on the juke box but the selections they had seem to be out dated and only local artist (maybe). We only stayed for one round of drinks and went up the street to another place which was a lot more friendlier. We won't be going back there again which is shame because our *huge office is located right around the corner on Spring Garden.

It's true...Nonna is really  making your dinner. I enjoyed a creamy white lasagna with asparagus and fresh lasagna noodles. Melt in your mouth goodness! Husband had veal wrapped in eggplant. We love our dinner.  If your visiting NYC, I would suggest making reservations here for an evening treat after a visit to the Statue of Liberty  or 911 memorial since you'll  be near the SI  Ferry.

I really like this place. The staff are friendly and the owners are very proud of what they've established there and it shows. The food beautiful. If there is one downside it's that the kitchen is not physically separated from the dining area so if a particularly smoky meal is being prepared it permeates into the restaurant. Highly recommend the pork and beef burgers.

I was at the airport early in the morning and wanted some breakfast food.  Ruby's wasn't bad at all... I wouldn't expect more from a diner in the airport.   I ordered the scrambled eggs, bacon, and toast (they don't offer to cook the eggs any other way).  My husband wanted to order the tuna melt, but they didn't offer the lunch menu at that hour so he ordered the cinnamon roll fench toast.   The food came out pretty quickly, and my dish was served with sausage instead of the bacon I ordered, but the waiter realized right before he put the plate down that there was a mistake.  He let me start on my meal and offered to bring out a plate of bacon.  My husband got to eat the sausages so no complaints, I didn't mind waiting for my bacon ;)  I tried the cinnamon roll french toast as well and it was a bit too sweet for me, but if you're into sweets for  breakfast, it won't be bad. The waiter was friendly, but he did make a few mistakes here and there... we asked for another fork because the one on the table was a bit dirty, but he accidentally brought out a knife so I didn't bother asking again, I just wiped the dirty fork off with some water.  We asked for hot sauce and he didn't bring that out either so we just went over to an empty table that had a bottle and brought it over. One thing I thought was odd was that they give you plastic utensils. Overall not a bad experience though!

Being that it was my first time in Dig Inn Kay Kay was very helpful in letting me know what your restaurant is all about. She really sold me on the sandwiches that I purchased 2. I will be returning most definitely.
By far the best tasting Malay food! Reminds me of Singapore.  Beef Rendang was my fav!
Good spot, good food, good service, good selection of beers. The only annoying thing was that they played Taylor Swift's album the entire time.
Meal was served super fast during busy hours. Staff is generally friendly but forgot a dish we ordered.
