I work a few miles away. I LOVE the #1 sandwich and many times order the soup. while in there, I browse the nick nacks...from ear candles to soaps to incense and trinkets. Great environment with tasty food that doesn't make you sluggish after eating it. Plus, the little "Dan's chocolates" they sell at the register are the perfect size for apres lunch :)  Keep it up!

We went when it opened a few years ago, and it was quite good: tasty food, nice atmosphere, just a solid dinner experience.  We went last weekend, and the place was filthy.  Just really unappetizing.  The chicken was fine, the fried green tomatoes were not, and the burger was inedible.  The place probably can return to its earlier glory, but it really needs a good cleaning and a lot of attention to the food.  We were disappointed.
Ocean prime made my boss's birthday the most memorable ever.  Wondering what took them so long to open for lunch.
The Memo burger is never a disappointment and is always cooked to perfection! Probably one of the best and affordable burgers in the area!

I am so disappointed! Everyone in my office has been raving about this place for its sandwiches, and in particular the bread. I took a chance and ordered pizza for our next staff meeting, and was very please. The Chicken Primavera pizza is a new office favorite. However, I made the HUGE MISTAKE of ordering the chili dog and hot dog for my own personal lunch. I usually LOVE Nathan's hot dogs, so I don't understand why they were SO SALTY!!! I had to throw it away! From now on I will stick with the safe bets that people recommend.
f

Best Bar in Bayonne, by far. Decent selection of craft beers as well as a full bar for us liquor fans. Haven't tried the bar pie yet, but the mac and cheese is REALLY good. Crowd is a nice variety, and the live music nights are always busy. Kudos for the atmosphere and being a nice place to hang out.

Food is great but service us horrific.  Called an order in at 6:00 requesting pickup at 7:00.  Dinner for one so not too difficult.  Arrived a bit early and fine that food wasn't ready.  However far from happy when I didn't get my food until 7:18.  Got home and the free dessert for aggravation was there but not my soup.  I called and asked that they use their restaurant can to drive the 1.2 miles and drop it off, was told that they don't deliver.  Told the that since it was not close to the first time their take out was wrong, they could keep my soup money and lose my business.  They did.

I agree with the other posts. This place is really awful. The night waitress was really rude, ruined the whole meal so can't even say anything good about the food. The waitress needs a lesson on health codes or a visit with the healh department. she took dirty glasses from one table by inserting her hand into the glasses then proceeded to the next table to fill water glasses. She was training another waitress so I hope she does not use the same unhealthy practices. Not a good experience.
By far one of my favorite places whenever I'm near St Marks. Hot or cold soba all day every day. Also try the Maguro-don - the tuna is super fresh

Excellent- the food, decor and wine list- I took friends there who own a vineyard in Positano, Italy and the were in love - Mediterranean food .. Delicious and the owner is really dynamic and creative!
Great ambiance, good service, great food.
Great burger great fries.  Get the break room everything.  A bit heavy but super delicious and satisfying.  Great service as well
Amazing service on the 3rd floor from Brooke!! Comp small bites on occasion. High ballers are a small twist on basic well drinks

Me and a friend just tried this place tonight and I'm glad I did. The food was great the atmosphere was great, The grill in the table experience was great. My only complaint would be that it can be a little challenging to get your waiter/waitress but overall it was a great experience.
Fantastic, but pricey

Great service and food! We were in town for a conference and looked up good places to have a drink and a relaxing dinner.  The cheese plate was great but I cannot say enough abt the gnocchi! It was outstanding. Recommend for sure.

Great place for breakfast/brunch but it is a DIFFERENT  feeling to have breakfast in what feels just like a nightclub. We went there for breakfast/brunch. Not  your typical breakfast place, whatever that means. Food is great. They have a full bar for breakfast too. YUM YUM  had a MAI THAI in the morning,
Went here during the time it was busy and i got a regular slice. When i received it, it was just warm.... i rather have my pizza hot, but maybe its just because it was busy but still...
I've eaten here a few times.  Some food is good, some is ok. Entree portions are small though.
Absolutely amazing place! I just moved to the area a few months ago and just found my new spot. Jamie's is very classy with great people.

Like the legs of a dribbling, smacked-up prostitute, the lore of this East Village Thai spot spreads far and wide, and draws people into the neighborhood by the droves. So by the time I managed to escape work for a lunchtime bite, I had already made up my mind: I was going to love this place -- if not indefinitely, then at least long time. Stepping into this average-sized eatery, you're immediately struck with the sight of an open kitchen in the entryway -- something I found so damn endearing, I literally smiled and practically giggled, but because I was wearing a $10 button-up shirt, didn't to preserve my lofty air of professionalism. It worked. Nobody spat on me. Despite the moderately busy atmosphere, we were met promptly for seating and led to a table that rocked like a hyper-agreeable schizophrenic, which we medicated ourselves with a square of napkin and no complaint. Moments later, our server arrived to take our drinks. Or rather, force us into our only options. She informed us no one could make a cocktail at this hour, but that she'd give it the good ol' college try. We couldn't bear watching her flunk that, though (much less have to stomach it) and instead ordered beers which arrived a quarter empty, at which point I realized I was a huge pessimist. Of our order of pad Thai with chicken, pad Thai with beef, and calamari, the chicken pad Thai and calamari quizzically made it out at the same time. The beef pad Thai came some ten minutes later. While the calamari was beautifully cooked, its sauce a spicy bouquet of curries, soy, and sodium, the pad Thais were oily little affairs which had all the flavor of wet white bread. But it looked nice. It didn't sate the appetite, but it also didn't ruin it. In fact, it didn't leave any sort of impression on the appetite at all. And after this experience, it's the last non-impression it'll ever make on it ever again.
I had the Mac& Cheese and Steak Burger. Very juicy and delicious!

if youre in connecticut and want some authentic mexican food 'el sarape' is your place. while in connecticut for work,  i stopped by for dinner and tried thier chicken burrito poblano made with homemade mole sauce. when i tell you instant fireworks on the first bite i'm not lying. try it out when in connecticut!!!
The best breakfast in Burlington. Hands down.

In the past three months I have lived in the Greater New York City Area there is no doubt this is the best restaurant I have been to in NYC. Be prepared for a long wait on a Friday night, but it will be worth it.

Awesome Bar! Don't think you are walking in one of those regular places where you see the same beers everytime you go! They are always changing the beer selection and you can always find awesome and crazy beers! Spirits selection is great. Nice bourbon selection specially. Bartenders are super friendly and helpful! Dont ever forget to try the truffled fries!

I just went to try this place this afternoon and all I have to say is I've had better. The service was great my waitress was very nice and she was very attentive but when it came to the food that's where it all boils down to. I had the Chip's Favorite Omelet which is Sausage, Apples, and Cheddar Cheese and I had it diner style. As I am not a frequent eater at diners I forgot what diner style actually was and maybe I should have gotten my omelet fluffy. The sausage kind of tasted like it was those Jimmy Dean frozen sausage patties cut up into an omelet. I am going to give this place one more chance to wow me in the future and I'll definitely get something different off the menu next time.
Tacos are amazing!! I highly recommend the fish tacos with breakroom fries accompanied by the Mint Lemonade.

What can I say about this little slice of France here in South Philly!!?? Just one word comes to mind..AWESOME!! The owners are the sweetest people, and the quaint atmosphere is both welcoming and relaxing!! This place will open your senses, and take you away to the Champs-Élysées!!

We recently held our wedding reception @ Brooklyn stoops and couldn't be happier with the service, space and food provided. Leading up to our wedding, my husband & I communicated all of our requirements to the owner Ocian, he was prompt with his responses and followed through with all our requests. Although I didn't manage to eat a lot that night, our guests said that the food was excellent (I can however say is that the drinks we're great). If you're looking for a space to have a party or event, I would absolutely recommend Brooklyn Stoops - Great place, awesome night!

The best pork kimchee stew ever!!! Chuck of juicy pork pieces that melt in your mouth. Perfectly seasoned and spiced, of course!! It is ideal over rice/udon noodles. Seems that everyone in the area knows about this Japanese take out joint. The best time to get there is by lunchtime. My pharmacy manager and I are totally hooked! The eel donbury was nicely glazed;although the fish eggs were way too fishy for my taste. I love the green tea cake roll. Simply delicious! The umi rolls, sushi, miso broth are really yummy. Highly recommend this place. Everything is made fresh, daily. The staff is really nice. At this place, you will find real umami flavor.

Came here for a lovely birthday dinner for my sister about a month ago, we had Billy and he was perfectly attentive and gave recommendations where we needed them. When you get a menu as extensive as ilili's, it can be a bit overwhelming but he took the time to make good recommendations for 5 girls to share and everything was delicious. He said the brussel sprouts were quite popular so we tried that and they definitely were delicious with a lovely walnut salad to start. The Phoenician fries and steak tartar were also quite delicious once you get over the fact that you're eating steak tartar. I've had the falafels, scallops in their restaurant week menu in the past and those were pretty good but nothing mindblowing. All the dishes here have been consistently on point. The ambiance is a fun hip spot, trendy without being obnoxious. Thanks billy for another memorable night at ilili.
Delicious and authentic Portuguese food. I always order the bitoque and am never disappointed. The salad is complimentary and perfectly seasoned. Sangria is worth ordering ;)

I went there once for my sisters surprise party last year and I had some of their vegetable samosas which were pretty good. I got a craving for some Indian food not too long ago and I was going to go there for lunch and I saw not one person in there employee or otherwise. I recently saw that they are open again. I have to make a point to stop there so I can make my full assessment.

Fare is a great place to go when you want an amazing cocktail and little something to eat and don't want to break the bank. They currently have a Manhattan on the menu that has bacon infused bourbon in it and it is safe to say I'm in love. All the entrees they offer are amazing. Not one flop of an item. I tend to sit at the bar and love watching the bar tenders skillfully and charmingly make cocktails while engaging all their customers. I know they have outdoor seating and a patio but I have never sat there. Fare is a great spot to begin a night out!
So delicious!! I love this. I think No1Pizza of NY. Price good too.

Amazing amazing amazing! Delicious delicious delicious! The best middle was term vegetarian friendly good in nyc! The food is to die for and have a ton of vegetarian options. The staff is friendly and quick! I highly recommend for a first date anniversary or special occasion.

We were in search for a hot breakfast and coffee.  While the mugs were large the coffee was just ok.  Eggs were cold and the tables were too close together.  We were seated in a high traffic area and the waiters must have bumped my chair more than 5 times.  No thanks...
Great food and great beer for a great price. Bierhalle Cheeseburger with the pommes frites is da bomb digg bomb.  Terry the bartender is mad cool.  Try this spot out and stop slacking!

This is my third time in trio and I love it. I love the food and the prices. It a great place to go with your friends or a date. Great that is byob. My only complain is the service. Is getting bad, the sever was not attentive to us. We had to keep on asking for him to show to our table because we needed water , desert, and the check.

I love soul food and ever since Soul Flavors in Downtown Jersey City shut down, I've been coming to this place. I've tried the sticky wings a few times and they're also delicious. The potato salad and mac and cheese are also good. The cobbler is also very good!

I'm shocked to see the four stars here. For anyone who's ever eaten in Belgium, there's a big difference in the food quality. The French onion soup was just a bowl of cream without onion or real taste. The dame Blanche ordered looked and tasted nothing like a real one. The chocolate sauce didn't have real chocolate and when we explained about what a real dame Blanche was about (as friendly as possible) the waitress replied: "Do I look like the cook? I'm not the cook!" It was a feedback, and I hope it will somehow come through. Food was really not good, esp. For that price (60 usd per person).
The food is delicious and fresh, the service is exceptional, and the food and drink options seem endless. I love the atmosphere, too. It's quiet, warm, and inviting. I'll be here a lot more often!

Cannot put into words how much I love Gaia Cafe The. pasta and the pizza are amazing and the ingredients taste so fresh. In terms of value for money, Gaia is unbeatable, nowhere in Manhattan comes close.
Sorry I posted a review intended for another spot.

I was in Philly to visit a friend who brought me here for breakfast. What a wonderful place. You knew right away that it was going to be good when the waiter met us at the door and greeted my friend with a hug. The huevos rancheros were terrific. We ordered cafe con leche and the waiter let us know that he was preparing it the way his mother did we he was growing up - coffee and not expresso. It was great.   Clearly a must when I am back in town. Remember to bring cash as they do not accept credit cards.

First off, there is Pork Roll on the menu, so there will always be a special place in my heart for Delilah's.  The owners are also extremely friendly dudes and the service and delivery is great.  Unfortunately, me and a buddy got some buffalo wings the other night that were just not good.  Only reason I'm writing the review is to give the guys some feedback.  If you're gunna do wings, do em right.  No frozen stuff.  No heavy breading - it always leads to soggy wings.  simple crispy wings with butter and franks...done Ok, rant over.  Never stop serving pork roll!  thanks guys

I love thai food and was so excited to find out this had opened up close to home. Both the tom kha and tom yum soups did not disappoint, the papaya salad and chicken satay were also very good. Chicken and cashew nuts and pad Thai for the main course I will be getting again. Can't wait to go back when mango and sticky rice are in season.  Only thing I was hoping was for the thicker noodles in the drunken noodle main course but the taste was still very nice.

I had seen great reviews on this place, but was worried about the wait time for brunch given its size. Was in the neighborhood and decided it was worth a try. Boy were my partner and I satisfied with their specials. I got the curry porchetta (a pork roast stuffed with shredded chicken) which was super moist and tasty. It came in burger form topped with mango katsu, roasted garlic mayo, and crunchy red cabbage. There was amazing balance of tangy, sweetness from the katsu with the savoriness of the curried protein. Enjoyed every bite and was yearning for more. My partner got a stack of coca cola pancakes. The pancakes were chewier but the coca cola kept it moist and was not overly sweet. To top off the tasty brunch, we got some complimentary tater tots with our Yelp check-in. Can't wait to stop by again for brunch in near future!

Definitely worth a visit if in manhattan for a few days. It was a little pricey, but that's kind of how New York goes. We got the bleu cheese potato chip app both times we went and my wife absolutely loved it.

We were so happy to find that there is a Penang in Princeton!  We just moved south from Bergen County, and always visit the Penang restaurant in Lodi, NJ.  The food is amazing!  I recommend the Roti Canai, it's basically this fluffy pancake  from heaven with a small bowl of a stew with chicken and peanuts and spiced goodness.  We used to share it, but we always fought over every morsel, so now we each order one!  The Beef Rendang is to die for!!!  I highly recommend this place!  Don't forget to BYOB :)

As business has brought us from the DC area into Philadelphia.. We've taken some down time to enjoy some of what Philly has to offer..we spotted Fare on our way to the haunted house at the eastern state Penitentiary... As the other bar/restaurants in the area seemed to be a little immature for our taste, Fare had everything we were looking for. The menu is not overwhelming, offering the right amount of appetizers and entrees. We met Courtney a Philadelphia native. She whipped us up a few house specialties including a Old Fashion made with home made bacon bourbon. We hit  the Pennatentary and decided to come back for another round!... We will be back in the city of brotherly love tomorrow and we will be entertaining our clients at Fare as it is an appropriate place for such an event. Great Place. Check it out!!!

This place has quite a history between the owner - Mr. Grimaldi, and his long lost pizzeria next door, ironically carrying  Grimaldi's name. With that said, the pizza is absolutely nothing extraordinary. It is certainly overpriced, and half pizza toppings are charged as full. Personally, Domino's new York style pizza tastes better to me, especially for the price.

One of my boyfriend's favorite restaurants and i see why..cool decor, friendly staff , and great food..the Mac Attack was heavenly...i ordered the meatloaf with mashed potatoes for my entree and the portion was more than generous...Cafeteria did not disappoint

Gottino is a wonderful blend of old world and new world nestled in the heart of Manhattan.  This is a great place to meet friends for happy hour or just for a catch over a glass of wine.  They have tons of options and the charcuterie is to die for.

Jacks Wife Freda is a really nice place for brunch especially on the weekends. I highly recommend this place for both locals and out of Towner's. The place has a very cozy feel and one of my favorite items is the Shakshuka Enjoy!

Passed by on a beautiful Sunday afternoon, took a chance and grabbed an available table in the back . Warm and cozy, great service all around and an awesome, cooked to perfection medium rare burger. Meh on the fries. But what will forever stand out in my memory will be the pickle....oh man, what a great pickle.

I have been here many times and every time has been amazing! The best pizza in NYC! Friendly staff, quick service, great taste in music, fresh and delicious pizza, BYOB and the warm ambiance make any dinner here amazing.
I went on a Friday night, it was a wait of 25-30 mins, but it was definitely worth the wait! I had fried chicken, mac & Cheese & mash potatoes it was delicious.
I get the ribs and Mac'n'cheese every time and it's DELICIOUS!!! People are ultra friendly and has a great atmosphere
It's a great spot for a guaranteed delicious beer and amazing food.
Had the fish and chips this time, wasn't bad, wasn't memorable at all. Service... Not memorable either, and that's a good thing in this case
Love the Mezza plater, special baby eggplant appetizer and the octopus. Great food, service was a bit slow yet attentive - hey they were so busy!

I was there last night, and I WILL be returning. Pumpkin soup- great. Pepito de Filete-Grilled hanger steak -slightly tough but, oh, s0 tasty! Frituras de Bacalao-Cod Fish Tempura- loved IT! Friends I was with had no complaints-all enjoyed their meals.
I haven't been there yet,but hear it's a good bet.
Great food , great vibe ! Make sure to SHAREEEEE plates are huge. Waiter was  overall experience great

nice place to have korean foods for a reasonable price. salad bar section is kinda expensive but all the other packed foods are cheap and the portion is enough. it is not a restaurant where you have your own table and read through the menu, it's more like a fancy deli store with korean foods. perfect for lunch time or if you want to have simple/fast (yet tasty) korean food
My go-to Thai restaurant, so good! The serving could be slow, depending on the day, since they only have a couple servers. But the food is worth the wait!

Craft Beer, Craft Beer, Craft Beer  The absolute best Craft Beer tap selection on Staten Island. they rotate 8 of there 12 taps constantly and are not scared to experiment and bring in cool creative beers that other bars simply dont know how to market and sell.. from mikkeller , eviltwin , alesmith, maine brewing, cigar city, westbrook, local option, to some of the better more commercial crafts like firestone, sixpoint, smuttynose, southern teir, left hand, stone and founders.....  to top it off then have brisket ribs and pulled pork fresh out the smoker daily and limited if your get there too late it will be sold out... angus burgers , fried chicken, chicken n waffles, mac n cheese, diablo shrimp and many more cool dishes... which for me is just a huge plus to the amazing Craft Beer selection.... great spot! p.s  - dont expect to find any bud coars or miller products there
very good sushi, great ambience. keep it up

Everything is amazing. I literally want to post a review every time I eat here.  Where do I start. Fried mac n cheese is an amazing treat. Want some real fries?  These guys will grab a potatoe, chop it up and throw it in the frier.  Jerk chicken is seasoned perfectly, get it on the thick dough bread with some home made Cole slaw which perfectly balances the spice. If you've never tried something. This is the place. I was never big on fish but the fried cod basket or the fish and chips have totally changed that for me!! The homemade Batter is amazing and the code simply melts in your mouth. Shrimp is off the chain... Fried grilled or steamed!! Like chicken wings??? Jerk or BBQ will both hit the spot! If you can't handle the jerk but still want them on the spicey side , try them HYBRID!!! you won't find it on the menu but you can order all the chicken hybrid to give you a sweet and spicey delight. Everything is made on premises, I'm talking about the spice mayo, tarter sauce, beer bated, Cole slaw, mac n cheese. Chicken and fish are bought DAILY. the only thing I've seen them not make is the ketchup!!! The owner who's the cook is there every single day, customer service is top notch. Their open late. Till 2am on Friday and Saturday. Dance hall music builds the atmosphere on top of the amazing smell you can smell from down the block.  This place literally feeds the neighborhood. Once you eat here once you will eat here whenever you don't feel like cooking. Everything is made to order so your food is specifically cooked just for you. There is only one drink available here. And it's their own home made limeaid! ! This stuff sells out every two days. So stock up!
Good Thai

We just found this restaurant. Cause we always around washington ave for get spanish food. On sunday this place already busy.we still have to wait.after we get our food.the food so delicious. We love this place.
Got the shawarma for $6, which was ample sized and had very tender and flavorful meat. Can't go wrong with it. Highly recommend it, definitely one of my new favorite middle eastern food spots
Drove across the city to try this place. Very well worth it. Best breakfast we've had in a while. Ordered the Spanish omelette eggs with toast. Toast was buttered and fresh. On point..
Amazing evening at Gila's! The food was amazing, I especially loved the Sabich which was so authentic. The atmosphere was fun and the service amazing, definitely come again!
Always excellent food at this great eatery in the Ironbound!

I really like the enchiladas here.  But half the time they mes up the order.  I even make it a point to ask if it comes with guac every time, and they STILL forget to put it in.  It's really frustrating. Get it together.  I like your food but your service is god awful.
We stumbled upon this place while looking for a casual place to eat with good food. Nish Nush was a perfect match! Good food, good prices. Lunch = Done. Success!

My wife and I took my parents here recently and we all enjoyed our meals immensely. The the prosciutto wrapped asparagus salad was probably the best salad I've event had. The staff was professional and friendly and the atmosphere was great. We'll definitely be going back.

Soooooo that roasted turkey wrap was bomb thank god I'm off today because I'm going back for that pumpkins thyme soup....they have very healthy and tasty food and not greasy of fried so glad to have them back now only if they could lower the prices LOLOL

This place was a cute find! I happened to be in the area and yelped dinner spots and this came up. The food was delicious! I had the prosciutto wrapped chicken with kale salad and cauliflower. I hate kale and somehow I loved the kale salad here. I give them 4 starts only because it took a while for the food to arrive. I will definitely try this place again.
Amazing brunch, dinner and drinks. It can get crowded and there's often a wait - but it's well worth it. I always leave happy.
They just re-opened. Thank the heavens!

The Steak Tartare is the best I've had here.  Unlike some places that give you massive amounts of food on your plate the portions here are nice and small.  Another must try is the Sheep's Milk Ricotta.  One of my favorite places in Tribecca.

2nd Story is a great addition to Old City.  The beers stack up to any of the more established Philadelphia area microbrews and the food and atmosphere make the overall experience that much more enjoyable. I recommend the Evolve IPA, but you can't really go wrong with any of their house beers.  The beer flights are a good value and nice option for trying the rotating taps.   Although I prefer to stick with the house beers, I was glad to see the menu included specialty cocktails, other micro-brews and familiar imports.  You can go with a crowd and feel confident that even the non beer drinkers will enjoy their experience. As far as the food, my wife and I both ordered the 2nd Story burger and we were both pleased.  We felt like the quality of the food matched the quality of the beers.

Great ambiance and service is great.  I did not like the food though.  It did not taste good to me and it was just extremely pricey.  Only thing I liked was the chicharon bulaklak which is great with beer.  Other than, I don't recommend the food.
cute place, good food and great drinks. The ribs are amazing!
REALLY delicious food.  Simple and consistent.  Delivery comes quickly!

Discovered this place one day while trying to find an ingredient for a recipe - couldn't find it at Trader Joe's or any other local markets, but found it here at KFG! This tends to happen a lot for me, as they have a lot of random things (like chili sauce) that you can't find elsewhere. Once I moved to the building next door, I began coming here regularly for things like salads, sandwiches, and even groceries. As far as groceries go, this place is great for picking up a few things for dinner/meals, etc. Some things are pricier than others, such as canned soups, etc., but other things are cheaper, for example, sliced pineapple. Their produce is usually very fresh and they have amazing rye bread that I pick up on a regular basis. I often come to pick up a few things to make big breakfasts - and they usually have everything I need. The one thing they don't have, as someone else mentioned in an earlier review, is uncooked meats like ground beef and chicken. If they had that, they'd get a solid 5 stars from me. Now onto the prepared foods. Definitely 5 stars in this department. The sandwiches are on this amazing french baguette, and the salads, as everyone else mentioned, are HUGE! I'll get a salad with chicken and it will last me for at least 2 or 3 meals. I'm a fan of the grilled chicken and avocado sandwich. The rotisserie chicken is also great! But get there early because they tend to sell out by 5 pm. Be prepared if you go in around lunchtime, however, because you WILL wait a little while. The food is definitely worth it, though! Last but not least, it is a neighborhood deli and it sure feels like it. It's small and the people who work there are always smiling and saying hello. Become a regular and they'll recognize you and say hi when you come in. It's always a great experience when I come in here. Definitely try it out!
Great Margaritas! Also great happy hour food - fish tacos & guacamole.
Exceptional services  Our service adviser ken Walter is phenomenal.

I made a stop here on my way to a concert and it didn't disappoint.  I had the Brasilian Mixto Wrap and it filled me up, I had to take half of it home with me.  The sitting is a little tight, but the employees were pleasant.  The Brigadeiro were so good, my daughter said they were better than mines.  Next time I'm in the area will definitely stop by.

Went on a Saturday so there was a bit of a wait but I thought it was worth it. I got the eggs Normandy, the yolk was orange, and the eggs tasted so fresh. Great coffee. Good price. Stayed so long that I even got dessert and a big pot of tea. Waiters were super nice as well.
Best breakfast that I have had in awhile. I would come back.

Empanadas are the bomb.   The Flank Steak is incredible.  The pasta, delicious. Not just pizza to eat.  Service is GREAT.  And the owner treats you like family. Would definitely go back.  5 STAR ALL THE WAY!

I'm not a resident of Staten Island, NY, but my sister is.  So when we come to visit her, she takes us to all her favorite spots.  Her newest obsession is her "Little Italian Market", where she gets most of her food.  And today, she took us there.  Such a happy day for us all.  You walk in and everyone greets you.  There is a nice little grocery section with an assortment of things from olive oil, artichokes, canned tomatoes, etc. etc.  There is also some fresh produce lingering.  Not the biggest selection, but a good selection.   We actually ordered our Thanksgiving turkey there.  It was ready to pick up when we walked in.  But here is what I truly loved.  They have a large selection of prepared foods, meats, cold cuts.... you name it.  The gentleman helping us was fantastic!  We got risotto balls, broccoli rabe, pancetta, and some sausages.  The risotto balls and broccoli are out of this world!!  The rest is for thanksgiving use (yum). Next to the prepared food section is the cheese and fish section.  The way to my heart is not only through food, but specifically cheese.  And when you offer me some samples, straight off a butchers knife, you might as well marry me.  That is exactly what they do here.  They give you samples of cheese, which is oh so tasty!   Maybe it is the ambiance, or the people, but I love this place, and trust me when I say, when I am in Staten Island, it will be my staple go to little market.
Got very sick from this place, bad stomach cramps. They also push dessert on you when you order your meal. Don't recommend.
Great service, gorgeous ambiance with colorful lights everywhere, good food and huge portions. Complimentary chips and salsa

We got take out.  The pizza crust is super thin, the cheese was delicious and the sausage is crumbled.  I could have eaten a whole pie by myself.  The wings were cooked to perfection and the wing sauce was delicious! Caesar dressing was just right, not fishy at all! Can't wait to go back and dine in!!

Nice place, food tasted great! A little too noisy but you get used to it. The atmosphere that is created in the restaurant is really cosy. Spent a great time with quality food! Nice place for a diner with friends or for a date. Had a great advice for the wine pairing
mamma miaaaa! great spot for Italian cuisine lovers!  Sooo fresh and delicious! Thank you Gaia! :)

Great spot for breakfast and lunch in Newark. 5 star quality food, recipe, and affordable prices! Staff are welcoming and passionate about their level of service. Philly Cheesesteak so good it should be renamed Uptown Cheesesteak!

I can deal with having to wait for a table, but having to put up with waiters and waitresses that care more about whether you are SHARING food, rather than giving you good service, is something that I cannot put up with.  I have eaten here on several occasions, and though the prices have crept up steadily, the service has headed in the opposite direction.  Its not necessary to tell the customer over and over again that sharing is not allowed.  Telling them once is enough.  Staff at this restaurant (ours was a lady named Chen) should spend less time harassing their customers, and worry more about other things - like getting a customers food order correct, and cooking a customers food properly.

Really cute place and very friendly, accommodating service. It's really nice when a restaurant allows an incomplete group to be seated on time, despite its late comers. Also, it was great that the waitress noticed we were all ordering a glass of prosecco and recommended bottles, instead of separate pouring, making it cheaper. Food was outstanding - we were a large group and sampled a lot of the dishes, all yummy!
Hands down best cocktails I've had in the city. The bearded alchemist has special powers, I tell you.
I think Heirloom serves up the best food in New Haven, however the service is inconsistent at best.  They should focus on hospitality and the details of service. The food deserves it.

Horrible experience. Our party (2 people) was waiting for 1h (after making a reservation and showing up at the right time) and other people came and sat down before us (with no reservation! I asked!!!) HOMOPHOBES. STAY AWAY.

Thumbs down. My mom and I decided to order some food from OBAO online. It took nearly an hour. My mom had to call the restaurant, and we waited about another half an hour. This also happened before. The food is okay. The Pho Bo tastes good, but last time when I ordered pork chops they were dry and hard to eat. I'm not coming back. I'd give a one but the food tastes good. The service is also rude. My mom called, before, when we were ordering food, my mother was saying how our food wasn't yet here after waiting 60 minutes. The person on the other end argued with my mother, saying he recieved ONLY 40 MINUTES AGO. We only live about a few avenues away. *I have eaten at the restaurant in person. But the food was still eh. And the food also took a bit to get to the table.
Delicious and fast lunch specials! One of the better choices in the area.
I loved Okonomi for dinner. Each dish had delicate and fresh flavors. The space and people working there are full of passion and comfort. This is a jewel.

We made a reservation for 3 people online through the yelp app. We were seated and about 5-10 minutes later were asked to get up because they needed that table (table for 4) for a larger party that was coming. We ended up waiting another 15 minutes before being seated again. The food was OK. Most of the staff was not that friendly. But I will say the drinks were good. If when they asked us to get up after seating us they offered us a free drink at the bar while we waited as an apology for the inconvenience, I would have had much more respect for the establishment and how they treat their patrons. The kicker--the large group we had to give up our table for arrived almost an hour later (as we were finishing eating), so there was no need to make us move after all.
The food is delicious I'm coming back again...
A true brew haus!  Excellent food and superb beer!  A must to-do while in Philadelphia!!

This place is amazingly great!!! Hands down the best octopus ever! Nice large portions, great bread and great feta cheese.  I have been to both locations and the East Village one is not as packed so your odds of finding a table are higher! This is my go to place for all good and fresh seafood.
One of the best meals in the city.  The oysters and mussels are epic.  Chef guy is a gem. Don't miss the desserts either.

Delicious scones and breads. The baguette is better than in most places in Paris. The soups sandwiches and panini are also very yummy. One of the best cappuccinos. The atmosphere is great, friendly service. The Hungarian rolls are a must to try. If you are in Burlington make sure you try this friendly cafe.

Amazing food !!! Great friendly service !!!Highly recommend the polenta with truflle oil and mushrooms, the calamari was delicious as well and the eggplant appetizer was to die for !!! Make sure to save room for their superb desserts -the carrot cake and Nutella tiramisu were fantastic-  and plenty of delicious Italian wine !!!

Great service and great food! Our group was accommodated after not having made reservations on a very busy Sunday afternoon. Wait staff were all very attentive and friendly, and we were served our food quickly. It was all delicious. Garlic cheesy bread is a must. All four of us finished every last bite of our meals! We were also given complimentary garlic bread and biscotti to take home which was a nice touch

The food is innovative and delicious! We ordered the chef's tasting menu and it was a lot of food for such a good price, they cater it based on food you tell them you like and dislike, during the meal they noticed we didn't really eat the duck dish (just personally don't like duck but looked good) and came out with an extra dish, on top of a great meal, the great drinks, very friendly staff and service made it a great experience, have been back 3 times since! MAKE SURE TO GET THE CARROTS!

Small room located in the Village ... best to book, otherwise you wait a bit '.. exceptional seafood and lobster sandwich with fries that are worth the trip. young and super nice ... seems to be at home with friends. good

It's pricey but a unique dining experience. EVERYTHING I tasted was delicious and fresh. The regulars are very friendly. The atmosphere is like visiting your favorite family member's home for an elegant but not pretentious dinner with the neighbors invited. Loved it!

Couldnt take a picture because i finnished so fast...i had a crepe with potatoes, bacon and french cheese.....yummyyyyyy! My friend had the shrimp crepe and she dint want to share :-) It was so good! And the service was the best! Very kind!!!!

Craft Beers done right! The variety of craft beers is  extensive... constantly changing.  An all star line up on tap and plenty of  choices in bottle... that beez.in the trap is delicious! Beyond the craft beers, you got chicken and waffles that are airy. Fluffy, crunchy.. and glazed with a sauce your gonna be licking up.. corn.dip,brisket and mac and cheese that can't be beat! Chill out vibe, and simply good stuff!
Friendly staff with a romantic ambiance. The lasagna was really delicious but note they do not serve bread like many Italian restaurants so for a big appetite be sure to order a side.

Their habenero sauce is addicting and their pulled pork is meaty. But their steak and chicken is sort of dry and their meat quantity is laughable. For the same price, it's better to go down the street to Chipotle.

I've really tried to have a good time here. Whether they are busy or not, the staff is too busy to serve (if they even remember you need to order food or drink), food takes forever, and drinks can be hit or miss. Pizza is great, but with all the good pizza nearby, is the bad service really worth it?
Best coffee in the city with great service. Went to Cafe Boca Ciega almost everyday during my 6-day stay in NYC Love that place!!

The food was great, especially the coconut dumplings which are a must. the only problem I had was the noises coming from the kitchen. The chef and his cooks seemed to be celebrating new years back there or something.
Amazing, creative food. Friendly service with extra little snacks. They have such a cool, unusual wine list too. They were very helpful with my party's dietary restrictions. Definitely going back!

Love this spot! Very Mad Men-esque. Yummy food: oysters, fancy tater tots and loved the roasted cauliflower. Cute bartender too. So far I've sat at the bar twice, but plan to make reservations for dinner soon.
Stopped over for happy hour wings with a few friends. I was really happy with the wings and the curly fries. $1.50 Coors Light pints was a plus. Atmosphere was family friendly. Will be back soon.

i just love it. i had #9 and they make it just how i envision a perfect crepe to be. they arrange stuffing inside carefully so it doesn't spill, which usually happens with crepe. would go again anytime.

Delicious food and friendly service. Sometimes feels a bit pricey but all in all really like the casual environment if you're meeting up with friends and family. Would recommend making a reservation in advance as this place can have a bit of a wait...

Way too expensive for Schezuan food, in other words: fancied up Chinese food. I strongly suggest other alternatives around the area: Cheng-Du 46 and 23 (well...I admit, there are further) Food and Flavor? They are "okay": nothing spectacular; sometimes blend (such as the curry dishes), and not spicy enough (such as the dishes that use schezuan peppercorns).
10 out of 10-- I'd rather eat this pizza for thanksgiving than turkey! Sorry Mom. Also, Lizzie, the owner, is the best!
Love it here.  Great burgers
I had a chung guk jang and it was pretty good. My friends loved their biji stews too.

So I found myself at this restaurant for lunch. I was amazed as I walked into the restaurant.  The view of the lake is 1st class. The lunch special was more than what I expected.  The portions were very large. Iwe had pleanty of food left over which we took home. Loved their table bread and calamari.  If you find yourself anywhere near this place, its definitely a must.

Our family of 5 ate here on Black Friday while getting a ride on the Staten Island ferry. It's very close walk and the diner is very relaxed. My son had the Belgian waffle, my wife and two girls had the chicken fingers and fries bs then I had the chili cheese burger on a muffin. All of it was good. We will try it again on our next visit.
Best place for small private parties. Good food, good service, BYOB, overall we had the best time ever.

Have always been more of a ramen guy but the pho here may have converted me - def my favorite place for pho by a long shot. Also had the pork chop over vermicelli which is one of my favorite dishes and it met my high expectations. Definitely my new favorite viet restaurant in nyc.
Very good food, this is authentic shanghai cuisine, I like the pumpkin with preserved egg yolk, steamed juice bun, will come back soon!
Thai mango salad with chicken and sticky rice for $10. Plus a trio of hot chili sauces! Cash only
The crunch burrito was very good! The soup special today was pumpkin miso. That was good as well. I loved that the calories were posted on the menu.
If you don't come here, you're doing yourself a huge disservice. Best food, service and grappa I've experienced...ever.

I've had my fair share of dining at nice restaurants, but Hakata Tonton made me so happy that I am finally writing my first review! I've tried a few hotpot places around the city, but this place is definitely my favorite. The restaurant is small and can't seat many people, so I recommend making a reservation beforehand to secure a spot. We started with the monkfish's liver and the foie gras inari sushi. The monkfish's liver was good, but didn't leave any lasting impression. But I absolutely LOVED the foie gras inari sushi to the point where my friend and I considered ordering another serving. Every single bite I took seriously felt like heaven in my mouth. The rice was seasoned well, and the tofu skin was thin and soft but still flavorful. And to top it off, the foie gras was seared nicely. Grilled pork tonsoku w/ scallion and ponzu sauce: the restaurant specializes in pig's feet, so you can only imagine how good this was. It was absolutely delicious with its gelatinous texture and its crispy, chewy skin. However, if you order the hakata tonton hotpot, I don't think a separate order of the grilled pork tonsoku is necessary. Hakata tonton hotpot: I absolutely loved it. I came with one friend, and we devoured everything, literally had nothing left in our bowl. We opted to mix in rice with the leftover broth and finished that too. I don't think I've ever eaten this much and felt this full in my life, and I eat a lot. But it was all worth it--truly all worth it. The service was attentive and good. We didn't have any problems with service as other reviews have complained about the slowness. I was so satisfied and content with my experience at this restaurant that I wanted to tip generously only to find out that the servers don't accept tip! I left with only paying 40$... ONLY 40$!!!!!!!!! I've definitely paid much more for meals that did not even match half the quality and taste of this restaurant. I already made my reservation to go back.

I was so upset every time I walked by and saw that the gate was closed. This became my favorite lunch break spot last year when they first opened. I passed by the restaurant today and I was greeted by the owners, I was so surprised when they recognized me and remembered my name! Awesome staff and great vibes, you'll be seeing me everyday!

Hands down favorite pizza place. I take my vegan and non vegan friends here. Nice atmosphere if u like dark and cozy. Good beer menu. Personal favorite is the ricotta de vegan. A little pricey but it's worth it in my opinion.
Great Brunch spot

In PHL for the weekend and yelped this place. The family w as not disappointed at all.  Young picky daughters and they were chow'in down.   Fried dumplings were awesome. We went with hand drawn noodle soups & they were awesome. I only Wish I lived next door so I could eat it once a week.
This is a hidden gem of the upper west side. A really great place with amazing staff. Couldn't recommend it more for a nice evening out.
The resturant is always busy. Small but overall a  nice spot. The hot chicken is amazing!!!!!!!! Also great for carry-out.

The one extra star because the beer was good, the vibe was very friendly, and the other food looked good. Essentially, I did the classic "what do you recommend?" She recommended the goulash, which I didn't see on the menu. Alright, it sounded good. Turns out it was the chewy parts of meat in a too salty stew-like substance with a side of mushiness. Wasn't too pleasant. Also the only time I saw the waiter was when I ordered and... When I asked another waiter for the check. Turns out the "goulash" was $29 whereas most of the things on the menu looked to be around $10-20. You win waiter. You got me to spend $40. Here's your tip

So after a few attempts to eat here, during peak breakfast/brunch hours, I finally made it inside....hip hip hooray!!!! Right? Nope, not much to celebrate about. I ordered challah french toast, potatoes, fried eggs & bacon. I think the French toast was over cooked bc it was dry & tasteless thank God for the cinnamon, powered sugar & syrup. If blindfolded I would have had no idea what it was that I was eating. The potatoes were ok as were the eggs, but the pork bacon was to die for!!!! The best bacon I've had in a very long time. Oh & the coffee taste like I smoked a cigarette & I'm a non smoker.... My date ordered the Foccacia Breakfast sandwich which she enjoyed & I must admit looked quite tasty. Maybe it's just me, or maybe the cook was having a bad day but overall I did not enjoy the food here BUT I'm willing to give it another try in the future. According to the other Yelp reviews the food here rocks & that was one of the many reasons I wanted to eat here

I don't know how anyone can give this place less than 5 stars. The time that they put into the ribs, brisket, and pulled pork is obvious and is de;vicious. The beer selection is excellent and constantly changing so you always have a variety. The bartender, Peter, was filled with info on all the beers and steered me towards all great beers. Overall ill defiantly be back...a lot. nice change from the norm excellent service, comfortable atmosphere, great food, great beer how can you go wrong

Love, love, love! Been coming here for years and the quality has never changed. Love their salsa, so tasty with the right amount of spice. I always get the chicken mission quesadillas,  and they are always full of flavor. Went their yestrrday, Friday night, I felt adventurous and tried the tacos, def like the hard shell better. Hubby had the chicken fajitas,  he liked them, and still have more for lunch! I always recommend as my fav mexican spot for the last 10 years!
It's small Nd gkod food.  I don't find it to be a good value.  Back patio is very nice.

I've been here twice, no problems the first time. The second time the waitress was horrible. She never came back to see if we needed anything, a refill and some butter or jam would have been nice but we were never asked. We sat waiting after we finished our meal for a bit until she finally came over to ask if we were ready for the check. Terrible service.

The food was fine. It was good, but not great. It was about equal or slightly above what you would get at a pizza place, basically. The portions were huge which was nice. I had fettuccine marinara, sausage, and pork bolognese. My wife had chicken parmesan. The restaurant was pretty nice, it's gigantic. But, the place was pretty empty on a Friday night. The staff was a little brusque, but overall pretty nice. Bottom line: We probably won't go back. We'll be trying out other restaurants in the area. But, if we were in South Orange, absolutely craving Italian, we'd probably pop in.
Korean tempeh tacos were good. I think I would have liked it more if I had eaten in, but I got my food to go since I was in a rush, so the presentation was underwhelming. Tasty, and slightly spicy.
Unique food and polite staff despite some very rude and impatient patrons.

The food leaves a lot to be desired, especially if you have had real arabic food before. They don't have real shawarma if that is what you are craving and the hummus is very thick. The lentil soup was passable. Overall I was disappointed. The service was just as weak. The restaurant wasn't even busy and it took a long time to get the attention of the waiter. Overall, i think this restaurant shouldn't set expectations that it is an arabic restaurant. If they would re-categorize it as Mediterranean-inspired, maybe then you would consider it as good since you don't expect to have real arabic noms.

First time visiting this place and as soon as I walked in I loved the ambiance. Cozy and warm. The service was great and food was delicious. I had pasta with marinara sauce and shrimps. For dessert I shared a delicious Nutella pizza with my family. This is quickly going to become a favorite for me. I can't wait to go again.
I was looking for a change and discovered this hidden gem by accident.  I had the Mexican connection pizza it was fantastic.  I will definitely be going back to try other items on their menu.

The food was great however the service was horrible. They forgot countless orders and then claimed the registers broke down so we had to walk to the bank to get cash to pay. If you plan on eating here, give yourself hours due to the service.
Love the different sauces ...and the frites!!! You can get sauces on the side (I prefer to get it layered and 2 different sauces) I always stop here when I'm in the area for a quick meal. :-) YUM!!!

When I got there, the line was out the door! Very good food, especially the pad Thai. The service is great and I will definitely come here again (for take out because the restaurant only has a few tables)
A good place to escape from all the noises in your life. They serve delicious cocktails.

This is a very small place and, when you have a small restaurant you need staff who are able to get patrons in and out quickly. This couldn't be further from the truth here. It took a good deal of time for the food to come out and was cold when it did. The food may have actually tasted good if it were hot but one might not ever know. It took even longer to get the check and was one of few breakfast spots that I've been to where I had to stay there an hour. Next time I go to Kens and there is a line outside then I will wait in it. No matter how long.
Good crowd. I had a margherita pizza here and it was one of the tastiest pizza in Philly.
Yes, it is delicious and bougie, but is it worth the hype over bisous ciao or macaron cafe?  Maybe not

There are many people talking about Juliana's Pizza that I had to check out this place. Wow, the pizzas are large. One slice was actually bigger than both my hands combined. Unfortunately, the serving size is the only thing commendable with their pizza. Yes, the pizza was good but it wasn't that great as well. I had something better than this before. This place might have large servings but food is pretty much average. So if you feel like treating yourself with Margherita pizza, try some place else. But if you just want to enjoy devouring large pizza servings, then you'd like it here.

I had the veggie burger it was good and I loved the red velvet milkshake .. Would I go back ?yeah in the summer time for a shake the place was freezing and the food was high. They don't sale turkey burgers so I was a bit disappointed , every body don't eat beef. The staff constantly when in and out the doors which made it even colder in there smh
I order the "Fish&chips" fish were very plain no flavor. I'm will not come back. The place is clean compare to other.
Very very great foodI ordered plenty food for the family service is no so good but it is after all great food
GREAT place to shop and eat at any time.
They got it all from breakfast to chinese to mexican or anything. Best market available to any food lovers, and great options. The cookies are too good, especially chocolate chip.

Came with a couple of friends and The parking is kind of nonexistent Massaman curry w/beef Bangkok tofu red curry w/chicken Large helpings Sticky rice with Thai custard is good but really heavy The bathrooms are also clean but really small

Loved the Greek salad, ordered a large one to share with the fam (4 ppl). We also ordered 3 different entrees: the salmon, grilled shrimp and grilled calamari with side orders of lemon potatoes and rice. Over all it was delicious. Two entrees would have been enough. I didn't really like the grilled calamari but I have always been more of a fried calamari fan. Oh and as a surprise a dessert! Will come again!

Every time I go to Montclair, Le Salbuen is a must.  It had a great atmosphere and the service has always been wonderful.  I never write reviews but felt this restaurant deserved doing a review.  Some standouts are the pork and bacon burger which is excellent, and the chicken and mushroom sandwich which always has you eating the entire sandwich even though you know if it too large to eat the whole thing.   I have also gone for breakfast/brunch and have had wonderful eggs - there is one with a scrambled egg and bacon on a Baggett, I don't know the name of it but it was excellent. I would return for that dish alone. Our server was attentive and had a great attitude.  He was managing a number of tables in a this small restaurant and everyone was served quickly and was he able to keep all the tables happy. I would recommend this restaurant for ladies doing lunch, or a romantic lunch/dinner, or actually for anyone.
Pizza is fantastic. Wait on a Sunday night was a little long but not unbearable. Atmosphere is funky, but it adds to the flavor. Worth the time and the trip.
Cozy place, deeeelicious food and really, really good service. The Fulton sammich was stupendous, the empanada fantasic and the coffee really good. Really great place.
Very good and friendly service, I was actually very impressed. Ambiance was a little cold but they have a decent menu and everything we ordered was very good and fresh! Prices are good as well.

While on my visit to the east coast from the west I tried plenty of places an this place was on the top of my list so First of alltheir bacon on a stick is very delicious and I'm not even a bacon lover but it's that good. The burger is also so delicious and the nachos are a great snack too. Must try this place their prices are also very reasonable for some scrumptious food.
Pretty good polenta and kale salad...not sure about the menu ..kind of sophisticated appetizer !
Food is always good and their service is fast.  Typically I just do take out as the strip mall isn't the nicest ambiance for a night out.

The food was amazing. And the customer service was just as great. My waiter/bartender jay was amazing. Made sure the good was out on time and was available when ever we needed him. Overall the best Portuguese spot I've been in !!!!
Best Indian Food in Manhattan! Plus the staff has great meal deals, and is really friendly

Went to Goodfellas Restaurant on Thanksgiving day. I ordered the thanksgiving dinner special with turkey and all the fixings for 34.00. I was disgusted when it came out. No gravy, spoonful of potatoes, dark meat, and the portion was very skimpy. I watched the news that night and saw the homeless people received more food and fixings at the homeless shelter for FREE.

I found craft house on yelp on a boring Sunday afternoon and I'm so glad that I stumbled upon it. I was pleasantly surprised at the amazing beer selection and food. My boyfriend and I are always on the hunt for great craft beer and delicious food, and fortunately we found both. This place is a hidden gem on Staten island and I would definitely recommend it to anyone. Thumbs up for the beer, food and friendly waiter. Highlights: -jalapeno shrimp appetizer -mac and cheese -ribs -evil twin molotov cocktail
Great service, friendly staff, and amazing food. 5 stars for this restaurant for sure.

I LOVE the crabmeat dumpling! But sadly that's the only high light. Other dishes are just ok. Or if you go to Joe in 5th ave, try the duck smt in the special menu. It's pretty delicious. Grab a bubble tea nearby if you have to wait in line. But share it or do not finish it cause you'll be too full for the food. Oh and Im also really impressed by an old waiter's table-setup skill in Joe Chinatown. A must see!

My wife and I had our baby shower there last week. Nikki was super helpful with planning.They have great options on their menu for parties at a good price and the space is awesome. The food and drink was well received and all of our guests had a great time. Would def recommend to anyone looking for a good BK spot to have an event. They also have a great brunch, dinner and bar so it's a good place to hang out with friends.
Dear lord that pastrami-style smoked salmon is incredible. Top notch oysters, great drinks, awesome staff. Will be back again soon.

This is the only broth place I have been to. The service was very quick and the broth, amazing. My boyfriend got the hearth broth which was very fresh and had a ginger taste to it. Definitely has health benefits. The broth was on the saltier side, but overall it was a great experience.

Went here again on Saturday with my best friend and we love this place!  I had the special which was salmon done beef wellington style.  The fish had a pastry shell around it like a beef wellington would, it was in the shape of a volcano with an egg at the top - looked like a work of art I swear I am so sorry I did not take a pic of it.  It was so delicious and my friend had the duck with barley  he loved it.  I usually eat like someone will take the food away but not that night I slowly ate and ate.  We also had the chickpea app to start which was another very tasty dish.  I even got the recipe from the chef I had a Manhattan which I have never had before it was so good.  You cannot beat the Bounty.  The place is awesome to look at and the food is top of the line.  The prices are reasonable.  The people who work here are so nice.
Beautiful place try the lobster mac&schemes...

I work in the area so it is always a plus to have a chipotle franchise locally. Food is always fresh and most of the employees are very friendly. The only thing that bother me is during the lunch rush there can be a line to the door and the people making the food will make the orders that are ordered via the internet or their app. It Is pretty annoying and I think the customer in front of you is more important than the customer that is due in overtime.

Despite an earlier scathing review of this place, our party of four decided to eat at Galli's. "It's Italian food!" we said. "How could anyone screw up pasta and paninis?" Let me tell you, we would have preferred to literally eat our words over the paninis we ordered. The ambience was nice, but very dark. There was one, meager bathroom in the front of the restaurant with a perpetual line, in spite the fact that there were only a few other patrons in the restaurant. Our waiter was pretentious, and so was the water (it came in a tall glass jug. Please!). When we ordered the mozzarella sticks, he corrected us. "Oh, you want the mozz chips?" Granted, they were called "mozz chips" on the menu, but jeez, it would have been more appropriate to call them mozzarella fried nuggets, possibly microwaved (they came out of the kitchen very quickly). Five of them, fairly small and oily, were presented to us. I'm not completely sure? but I think they were eleven dollars on the menu. Two dollars a nugget? TWO DOLLARS A NUGGET?! We also received bread with oil and vinegar to tide us over. The oil and vinegar was so unexciting that I took to dipping it in the marinara sauce that came the mozzarella sticks. It was necessary to dip the bread because it was inedibly dry by itself. After twenty two minutes our "paninis" arrived. Why the quotes, you ask? Correct me if Wikipedia and I are wrong, but paninis are grilled, yes? These were sandwiches. SANDWICHES, which were, according to legend, invented by the Earl of Sandwich in Great Britan. Two slabs of uncooked bread and cheese/vegetables/??? inside. Even Starbucks knows how to turn a sandwich into a panini. What's your excuse, Galli? Three members of our party got the Parma Panini, which I think was $14, with prosciutto, mozzarella, oregano, and lots and lots of oil. It was literally not impressive in that it was not grilled, like I described before. I ordered the Veggie Panini, with grilled vegetables. Funnily enough, the vegetables with amply and generously grilled to the point where they tasted, no matter what the vegetable, of oily zucchini. It also had mozzarella, which I don't have anything to say about. It was mozzarella. Nice. Could probably get it at Wegman's. Despite what I wrote above, the paninis were fine. Just fine, though, by no means good. I would never intentionally pay fourteen dollars for "fine" again though. The weird thing was, though, that what we expected to be the most underwhelming part of the meal turned out to be the best: the side salad. It was perfectly dressed, very easy to eat (you know how sometimes people look like gophers shoving oily lettuce into their mouth when they eat salad? none of that here). The waiter, with his aggressive italian accent, sold it with "the salad is with organic mesclun greens, cherry tomatoes, shredded carrots and lime cilantro dressing." It sounded like a high school cafeteria salad, but it turned out to be the highlight of our sad little meal. We did not stay for dessert.

My family and friends had our Thanksgiving meal here - yes reservations were necessary.  This was my first visit, and hopefully not my last.  The food was fantastic, the staff were attentive, helpful, and they had a great sense of humor.  This was also my first experience with many of the dishes (which at one point seemed endless), and the rabbit.  I've never eaten rabbit before, and no it didn't taste like chicken.  This was a wonderful experience, and I shall return!
Yummy

I've been to The Fine Grind a handful of times and it's a typically good experience: cozy ambience, good espresso drinks, and an overall great small business vibe. I went on Small Business Saturday, however, and it was super disappointing. The place was packed as expected, but noise levels with the live music were almost unbearably loud and our server was extremely inattentive. I usually try to exercise patience in these cases, but our table of four was visited maybe 3 times during our stay, and food (soup and sandwiches) took nearly an hour to arrive. Our waitress forgot about us at several points and we had to go up to ask for our to-go boxes, and again for our check (with a 20ish minute wait time between the two). It was busy, but it's not a big place, so I'm really unhappy with that time frame. The food was okay in general with flashes of goodness; ordered an Italian cheese sandwich which was unremarkable, but the pesto pasta was delicious. Cream of chicken and rice soup was off and had a weird texture. The drinks were perfectly tasty, but the noisiness and being constantly forgotten by our server really put me off during this visit. It's Small Business Saturday; you should have done better.
Delicious food! Love the octopus salad! Def recommend this place. Prob warrants $$$ instead of $$, though.

Loooooove there lobster rolls. My fav is the warm and buttery style, I forget the name. But this place is def the best I've had. I had my order to go so I didn't check out the dinning area next door but that's ok I'll def be back soon.

I ordered takeout and had it delivered to a bar so that was a really nice feature.  I had the baked mac & cheese which was big enough to have leftovers for lunch the next day.  Also got to try some of the spicy fries - delicious! I would have given 4 stars but I'm knocking one off due to a menu issue.  The menu online lists a grilled cheese sandwich but when we called, there was no grilled cheese...not sure how they could be out of that.

A rare but well anticipated stop for burgers in NYC. Delicious and decadent (always have the truffle burger/fries) and amazing ambiance. The service is standard, slightly aloof. Pricey for a burger destination but the quality is definitely there. Always enjoy my visits to Umami!
Good Vegan options, and the wings tossed in bbq sauce are so so good.  I'm happiest here at late night happy hour and brunch time.  I've really come around on Cedar Point in the past two years.

Woooooow  thats all.... And this is from someone that hates cream sauce stuff  but wow  sooo good . At first its like no way u can taste good. Way too much dough. Way too..... ::bites::...... HOLY WTF!!! Its goooood  mmmmmmm

I held a private event in the back room and the staff was extremely accommodating.  The space was perfect, music was spot on, the food was great and the drinks were flowing.  There was a delay with some drinks but with a large group that is to be expected - especially with heavy drinkers on a busy Saturday night.  I would highly recommend this venue for a private event in the future.
This place is great. Happy hour starts at 10PM. Great martinis. Plenty of hot women hanging  out. Good small plate menu for late night munchies!

Gato is the cat's meow! If you like great food, great service and dim lit/cool NYC ambiance, Gato is the place for you!   Our waiter Mo was the man! He walked us through the food and wine menu with confidence that is rare nowadays! What we ate: Starter: Roasted Octopus Mains: Charred Beef, Kale and wild mushroom risotto Dessert: walnut brown butter cake All dishes we ordered were great both in presentation and taste but not huge portion wise. Side note: The bartender made me perhaps the best dirty martini I have ever had! This is truly a restaurant for those who enjoy great food - lived up to the hype!

I love their pizza here they're really big and they're delicious this is so delicious that you want even imagine it is really really big like seriously and the cheese is awesome I think they put a little bit too much tomato sauce but it's alright Little expensive that's why I'm getting it four stars but overall it's a nice place you can bring children and family overall really nice food and called in the pizza just really delicious
Excellent beer, good vibes, friend people and great food!

Tried this place for the first time 2 months ago.  I did feel that the food and service were sub-standard, given their prices.  Never in my wildest dreams did I imagine that any restaurant would provide bad food and service on purpose.  Normally, I would give an establishment the benefit of the doubt, but in this case, there are just way too many allegations, including those of mine.  As Gordon Ramsay says in Hells Kitchen, "Shut it Down!!"
The food was great and the service was awesome. I strongly recommend this restaurant.

Came in here looking for coffee this morning. I got this (it was delicious) in addition to super friendly service and free wifi. In fact, I came back later on the same day to try their apple salad and it was DELICIOUS. This whole experience was such a lovely surprise to cheer up this rainy day!!
Don't judge from outdoor appearance this is the best pizza around. Wonderful options, gluten free and wheat crusts. The honey pot and the sausage and Gorgonzola yum yum.
This place is good and you can feed 4 people for $40. Many variations of pho soup and bubble tea. I enjoy this quaint local eatery on a very cold day.

Awesome hotdogs. Highly recommended. As previously reviewed by others - it's nothing fancy inside - but it doesn't need to be. The food speaks for itself. Cheap prices. I will definitely become a regular here.

What's better on a chilly night than some wonderful selections of Sandwiches,salami, and wine?We were in the shop selecting cheese for a party when we decided to grab something at the cheese bar. Although they had no tables available they asked if we wanted to sit at the large farm table in the front which was reserved. Could we leave within the hour? No problem, we weren't going to linger anyway. We enjoyed the cheese, but the spreads while good were not our favorite. We will go back for sampler again and probably let them choose our cheese.We were asked a few questions about our tastes then brought out a scrumptious platter.

Dude! This place is sooo bomb. .. bacon on a stick is priceless. Everyone here was really passionate about cooking the food, you can see it in their face and happy attitudes that they are into it! And it shows in the food. Make sure you give it a try if your in the area. Don't get confused though about the location. It's actually in the back of "The Wood's bar" so just go through the bar to the back garden and you will find it.
Great chicken and super cheap for so much food. Love how fast it is too. Miso soup tasted a bit strange tho
We went to Spiegel for a Sunday Brunch, food and service were good.
Stopped in here for some coffee looking to try something new. We got flavored lattes and they were not good. We ended up taking two sips and throwing them in the trash and walking over to Starbucks.

What can I add that's already been written about this place? Probably nothing more than to reiterate how delicious the food is and what an experience it is to eat there. It's best to go during an off time, which sometime works out (usually no problem during lunch hours) and sometimes not so much. Last time we went we showed up 25 min before it closes and luckily we were persistent enough to hang out and voila we managed to get seated. The pork buns are amazingly flavorful and a must have. While the ramen is great and I really enjoy it, is it the best? Probably not, but overall the entire Ippudo experience makes a visit worth while.

The gold standard for gluten free baking. I'll leave it at that. Everything is delicious. They really should post a schedule of when they plan on baking things since they won't hold things for you without a deposit. But everything here is delicious and they are super considerate about allergen friendly. Everything is really allergen friendly and they'll pull up ingredient lists upon requests.
Delicious and service was efficient and attentive! My only regret was not getting another to go. ................. Note: Seating is limited and no patron bathrooms.
Good food, half priced sushi. Service is okay. Would recommend this place for their sushi!
Every time I go to Philadelphia I make sure and stop here. They have the best cheesesteak! Try it with Swiss instead of Wizz!
Absolutely delicious. The chicken tacos are a MUST. Everybody here is always nice and the service is pretty legitimate. Can't say that they don't do a great job here.

It's the place to see and be seen in Downtown Hartford.  Great place for a meeting, lunch with a friend, or some time alone to read or work.  A booster seat would be a welcome addition as many young parents visit the library with their toddlers.  Don't worry, the space can accomdate toddlers and adults in a meeting without conflict.

I went here with my girlfriends for dinner and we had a great time. The place is definitely on the smaller side so make sure to make a reservation, but the ceilings are high so it doesn't feel like it and the food was great everything we orders down to the guacamole was delicious.

Can't say enough good things about this place. The owner is always in the kitchen and is so friendly and accommodating. Offered me samples of the soup and chili while I waited for my grilled tenders, which took all of 5 minutes.  Never had a bad dish here. If you haven't tried it, you are definitely missing out. Check out the daily specials!!
Got the classic New England Lobster Roll, the lobster roll was smaller than expected for $17. However it was still really good.

Absolutely love this place Food and drink are amazing & food is fresh every time. And service is just exceptional!! I defiantly recommend to anyone for drinks & fine dining. This is one of our favorite places for drinks, lunch or breakfast, we haven't signed bad experience. This is where other bad restaurant should sent their staff to observe as to how a service-oriented establishment should run a business!

Went at midnight on Thanksgiving Eve for matzoh ball soup with my wife -- their one non-Southern concession to the neighborhood. It was remarkably delicious, with plenty of chicken meat and big savory balls that were the perfect consistency. The pickles were great and kept in the fridge for hangovers for days to come. The drinks were excellent. I hope Jacob's Pickles will expand to LA!

About the food: I had the orecchiette and shared sides with the table. The pasta was small but it tasted good. Plus with the sides/appetizers that we shared, we were filled enough to have room for dessert. Some of my friends had the steak, which was pretty good too and was served with a good serving of potatoes. The broccoli side was a little bitter for some reason but the potato side (pretty filling) and mushroom appetizer (small but savory) were really good. About the experience: My friends and I had dinner at L'Artusi to celebrate Thanksgiving and our friend's 21st birthday. We made reservations a couple weeks in advance and everything was fine. Once we got there, however, we noticed that we were not treated with the same respect by the hosts as other customers. I'm not saying that they were outwardly rude but we didn't feel welcomed. They probably looked down on us because we looked too young to eat at such a restaurant. There had only a few customers already inside and those who were enthusiastically greeted before us were offered to have their jackets and coats hung in the closet and were seated either upstairs or by the side booths. When it was our turn, there was no closet offer and we were shown to a table under the stairs that lead to the second floor. The table stuck out of place being the only round table among the side tables and the bar and it felt like we were being showcased as a bunch of young girls that didn't seem to fit in. Our server was nice though and gave us suggestions for meals and drinks. We also asked her if we could put our coats into the closet since we were in a tight corner (about 30 degrees and rain that night) and she offered to bring our coats for us and returned with our tags to take back our coats later. After dinner, we went back to the hosts to ask for our coats and neither of them smiled at us and looked as if they were indifferent to our presence. It's not like we were immature or loud or obnoxious. We didn't even take too long to eat dinner. Our only "mistake" was that we were young. My opinion may seem unreasonable considering we would have stuck out either way but the treatment we received as customers seemed unfair. Nevertheless, we enjoyed our night with each other. May return after a few years, once we become the doctors/pharmacists/therapists/dentists that we plan to be.
Pretty darn good!

As a pizza enthusiast, I've tasted my fair share of delicious pizzas. Therefore prior to coming to Difara's, I had a slew of questions running through my head: - Is the two hour wait REALLY that worth it? - How good can it be compared to other places I've been to? - Does the 80 year old man literally make all the pies himself? What a fool I was to have all these doubts. What a true privilege and honor it was to personally witness Dom (the owner) in action. Each and every pie that went into the oven was made by him. Difara's uses buffalo mozzarella, fancy magical olive oil poured from a copper pitcher, and fresh basil to sprinkle on top of every pie. My husband and I ordered one regular pepperoni slice and one square veggie slice as a pre-game meal before dinner. We waited two hours for them and scarfed them down in 15 minutes. Would we go back again? Absolutely. However, I will do things a bit differently if and when I go back: 1. Go with a group of friends and order a pie or two. Ordering a slice or a pie takes the same amount of time to make. Might as well get more pizza for it. 2. ITS BYOB PEOPLE, B. Y. O. B. I didn't know that until an hour into our wait.
