The wait would have gone by much faster with a few Zima's in my belly. 3. Skip the regular triangle slice. Square pepperoni slice all the way!
Decent cheesesteak. It was seriously huge though. I wasn't expected a roll that big. I ate it anyway...and fries.

Straight up Italian place. Headed to the airport and found this place. It was definitely awesome. Everyone was drinking their own bottles of wine they brought in during lunch. Just like Italy. The owner was seating everyone and finding ways to set up more tables. And the food was great. The bread was so good!
Clean, fast, friendly, healthy and hearty. Great food for a cold night. Good for a casual date night as long as the strong aromas of the food don't offend your date.

FOOD - THE BOMBDIGGITY SERVICE - SUPERFRAGALISTIC they give you so much food. the drinks are STRONGGGG lol too strong for my liking. It's a great environment. It's filled with other diners, but just right. GET THE SPRING ROLLS!!!!? I recommended you get the pineapple rice. However, that's a meal itself. I also usually add mango chicken / lemon grass chicken.
Drinks are good, unfortunately food is not. But it's a bar...and greasy food might be ok after 3+ drinks. Nice atmosphere and the ATM did not work

It's too bad that they are rarely open when they say they are because their food is good. They just have either bad workers or managers. They say they open at 9am all week but I have called many times on the weekend at 10, 11am, and even 12 and no answer. They also claim to deliver but when you actually get someone in the phone, they say we don't deliver today. Do they just decide on a day to day basis if they are delivering or not? Lastly, they are rude on the phone.
Just ok sushi. It is on the cheaper side and never the freshest. Again... Just ok.

The store had many different sandwiches to choose from.  The nice cashier recommended I try the BBQ pork sandwich. The sandwich was amazing.  The outside was crispy and the inside was flavorful.  You have the choice to make it spicy.
The best shopping for all genres and venues and deletable eats and drinks
I am very happy when I come here their service is amazing and I love coming here for brunch. Overall very pleased with the service
The falafel here was as delicious as promised by other Yelp reviews. It's a tiny little place with nice service. And a hot sauce that will burn you straight into your soul. YUM.
Great service, wonderful staff, fantastic food (the traditional Lobster Roll is my favorite).

Came here on vacation, johnny was super nice and we were seated right away - even though it's a small place. Ordered coffee, eggs and a bagel - all was as expected, came out quick and was good counter style diner food. Johnny is very nice and the staff is very attentive - highly recommend!
We had Donner kebab with the lamb and the Turkish bread it was awesome Thanks for guiding us there

One of the strangest dinning concepts I've ever seen. Bolt an iPad to the table so that there isn't room for the plate and force you to tip when you order. Food was good but the service and experience left much to be desired.
Always fresh and super tasty.  If you want to try really yummy mexican food check this place out. I am going to come there always. Friendly personal and good prices.

We had our company Holiday Party at Alta last night in their private room upstairs- the food and service were really superb!! Rocco and the entire staff were super nice & helpful- meeting every need that we had and and accommodating for any food allergies/issues. I definitely plan to return with friends to try the cocktails and relive the ecstasy of the Fried Goat Cheese Balls!

We've been twice and it's already one of our favorites in Princeton, an instant classic. The Savory crepes are the highlight (especially the Everything's Better with Bacon). Quality of the food is excellent and fresh, and flavors are creative and fun. The interior is very comforting, clean and seating is appropriate. Only two downsides: no real Nutella (their homemade is dry) and no Amex.

This place is a great find! The creamy crab and corn soup is to die for. I find myself regularly thinking about it.  It's very heavy, so you might want to share it with one other person.  You'll definitely want to save room for their other amazing dishes.   Get the burrata as an appetizer. You won't be disappointed.  I've tried a number of their entrees.   My favorite is probably the gnocchi genovese because I LOVE gnocchi.  The meat sauce on the dumplings is so flavorful and hearty.  The "slaps of pasta" and shrimp nuovi are also very good.  They have incredible specials every night, so be sure to try one.  The one dish I had that I did not like was the chicken parm.  I was surprised because everything else is so delicious.  The chicken was dry and bland.

Came here for dinner with a friend. For our appetizer we ordered the crawfish hush puppies. They were excellent! Ordered the special for my entree. It was Indian themed with grilled chicken. The waffle had a great mix of spices. While it was delicious, I wish I had ordered something with fried chicken because my friend ordered the classic fried chicken and waffles and I had food jealously all throughout dinner. I take comfort in the fact that I can go back and order the classic anytime, but who knows when they will serve the same special! Our waiter was beyond friendly! He was really attentive and didn't rush us out the door even after we finished our meals. I will be back for sure- my friend and I have made it a personal goal to try every single chicken/waffle item on that dinner menu!
Love, love, love the Manhattans here! the cheese is so fresh, so are the sausages. Very small but worth it.
Great atmosphere, great drinks, pizza was mediocre. Service was good. Definitely a good place for happy hour!
God dammit. This place, and the pulled pork. It was just so damned good. And the Truffle Burger, dammit. The Truffle Burger! So good. Ugh.

Amazing food and atmosphere! First of all, I love the interior and decoration of the Pines. The beautiful paintings of the staff gives the space a personal touch. Everything is well put together and makes me feel very comfortable. The bread was the best I've ever had! They had different kinds of rustic bread with amazing homemade butter (I could eat that everyday!) The restaurant uses local and seasonal products, so everything was super fresh and tasty. I ordered some grilled lettuce with nasturtium, with an wonderful dressing. I had a great combination of soft, crispy and crunchy. The agnolotti was cooked to perfection. Divine! The pasta was the most all dente I've ever tasted and the stuffing was rich of flavor. For dessert I had a chocolate cake, one of the best! It was still a bit soft and had a rich texture. Every dish had a perfect portion and I didn't feel stuffed at all. The wine pairing is definitely a recommendation! They have beautiful biological wines that go perfect with the meals. The restaurant manager (I think his name was Anthony) was great! Super friendly and hospitable. He explained every dish to us and our waters were filled when they were empty. To be short: go to the Pines because it is an AMAZING place.
Excellent food, service and ambiance! Great wine list. I got the eggs Benedict and the brochette. Delicious. I'll come back! Thanks!

I came here with a bunch of friends and we did the set menu where they bring out a variety of dishes and you share it family style. The food is average, nothing mind blowing, but overpriced.  We all had about two drinks, and when it was all said and done, it came out to a little over $100 per person.  For that kind of money, you can eat very well at any steak house in the city.

Top class freshly prepared food for an extremely reasonable price. Decor is beautiful and stunning. Service in impeccable. Food is prepared in a professional kitchen and is outstanding. The menu is interesting, combining different types of Mediterranean cuisine. You must try it.

I came here before a NJPAC show. I had called ahead to see what time I should be there to comfortably make a 7:30 show, they advised 6pm so I made a reservation. Upon arrival, the place was jam packed and there was a line of folks who had reservations as well. We stood there for a good 10 minutes before anyone even acknowledged us, and were then told that a lot of reservations were taken, but for some reason they were not written down. Fortunately ours was written down, and we grabbed the last table at around 6:30. Service was on the slow side in taking orders. The sangria came out in a reasonable amount of time and was OK for the price, as were the spring roll appetizers. As we watched the clock tick away, I finally went up to the kitchen to see where our meal was. It came out at about 7:10, which gave us 20 minutes to eat, pay, and get back to NJPAC and get seated. Needless to say, we ate the food so quickly that it was impossible to enjoy, although the eggplant parm sandwich from what I remember wasn't bad. Had to take some of the quesadilla home, which didn't travel well. So the food was ok but not remarkable, might have enjoyed it more if we had more than 2 minutes to eat...the service was pretty bad which is most of what my rating is based on. If you are going here before a show, make reservations on the early side and make sure they write them down. Who knows, maybe a lot of people going to shows just walk in and claim they made a reservation when they see it's crowded? I would giv
Deliciousness. Service is quick. Cheesecake factory is no competition, if you want the best cheesecake come here.

IZAKAYA is the best restaurant ever i had before. The food is awsome and service too. There is NO more BYOB, it is really sad. But it is worth to pay for drinks. Also their Sake is perfect for their food espacially Yamahai was good price and good match with food!!
Great food and great service :) very authentic Venezuelan food. Never tried it or heard about it before. It was absolutely delicious!!!
Wow the prices are amazing. And yes there is always a wait but it is well worth it. And the food is prepared so fast.

I am sorry about these stars (or lack thereof). I really really wanted it to be good. So badly, in fact, that I visited TWICE. I CREATED A YELP ACCOUNT JUST TO SHARE MY THOUGHTS. That is how baffled I am at this moment. Once for dinner - I got the Caesar salad which was DRENCHED in dressing and made me feel disgusted after a few bites - my boyfriend got the chicken and waffles which was equally disgusting (the waffle was incredible dense and flavorless). Oh, and did I mention our food took a full 50 minutes? Our waiter pretended to be upset and I think he comped out appetizer of fried pickles. Second time: I was baffled that the line was STILL so long after being so underwhelmed, but my friend insisted we go for brunch. Alright - maybe I had ordered wrong, yes? I mean, they're known for biscuits. And really, who can mess up an egg-biscuit-cheese sandwich? Welp. Apparently they can. "Fried egg" it was not - more of a briefly heated gooey mess. And a pile of cold shredded white cheddar. None of it melted because the dish was so cold. And the biscuit was totally lifeless and underwhelming. Even worse, the ketchup left a water trail on my plate. PEOPLE PLEASE STOP WAITING IN LINE FOR THIS OVERRATED CRAP. There are so many other worthwhile restaurants in this city - stop being confused by the long lines. It's just not good.

Food is pretty good, however every time I put my half full beer down, the bartenders would snag it while I wasn't looking so I would have to pay for another one. Finally I said something and got a free beer, which was nice- but I'm sure they do that to other people who don't notice!

My husband and i came here a few months ago. We did the tasting menu, oh....my....word.... best decision ever! We had so much food! I loved not knowing what was going to come out next, and everything was so delish!

Okay, so food was alright, but the service? Horrible! I walked in here to have no one greet me, no one to check on how the food was after it was served, and then had to wait nearly 20 minutes after finishing my food for the bill to come!! Is this normal for this place? Went here twice, each time with terrible experiences

The food  and atmosphere  is good. I think  the  only werid thing was the yelp deal for this restaurant.  You HAVE to spend  $50  in order to use the deal and it has to be food. If you are a dollar shy  you cant use the deal.... I would come agsin foe drinks and pool...

Very good food - service needs some work. 3 of the 12 beers were not available (weird they were the specials), no orange even offered for my blue moon (maybe everyone does not do this), no variations from the menu (I wanted meatballs on my pizza - no. Well can I order a side of meatballs...) and then, no basil for the margarita, but they did not tell is until they brought the pizza out (so I guess you can make exceptions from the menu. Food is good... Someone may want to help the management. Ps - the kitchen is open and I can hear you talking about us.

It's amazing how paninis and crostinis can be prepared in a way that can become a real and intense culinary experience, that's what this place does. My goodness, the roast mushroom panini, I'd eat that everyday.
The best roast pork sandwich around. I love the original way with sharp provolone and broccoli rabe

I'm not ashamed to admit that one of the things I looked forward to the most about visiting Philadelphia for the first time were the cheese steaks and Sonny's did not disappoint! I got a cheese steak with provolone, hot peppers and onions and I loved every single bite! The fries were delicious also. They were cooked perfectly and came out hot. There was a line since we went right at lunchtime and a small wait for the food, but  I would have stood in a line of 100 people to eat there! If you are visiting Philadelphia then this is a must to add to your list! A little tip is if you go at a busy time, have someone save some seats while another person orders. The restaurants is on the small side so seating may be a little hard to find.

I went here last night for a birthday dinner.  We arrived late and were greeted warmly, the staff was friendly and were able to sit us within five minutes. The food we ordered: Raw Oysters- This was my first time trying them and I decided they are not for me, however a friend that was there who does enjoy them said they were just okay. (I did enjoy the sauces that came with it) Baked Clams- These were small, and had too much bacon (I know there can never be too much bacon but in this case it overpowered the baked clam). New York Strip Steak- I described this as something I would say was good if I had it at a wedding, and knew it was mass produced. However knowing it was individually made for us at that moment...well it fell short. Salmon- This was the most disappointing,  absolutely no flavor and in my opinion a little fishy. The mustard sauce looked like mayo and did nothing to add flavor. Shrimp Provencal- This was absolutely delightful. I was on the fence on whether or not I would enjoy this dish, however the cheese filling in the ravioli was delicious! There was also an incident that I can only describe as "The most awkward conversation of all time"  that happened concerning our drinks. When our drinks arrived we felt that they were watered down. We told our waiter, and moments later we were greeted by someone I will assume is the manager. He informed us that their drinks were all measured and that we were... for lack of better words.. completely wrong about its content . To which I responded with "Lets agree to disagree", and this led to what felt like a 2-3 minute conversation /stare off that felt uncomfortable. I understand the business aspect of it, but if a customer is not happy with a product maybe you should, I don't know....ask if they would like something else? Maybe not make them feel uncomfortable for the rest of the night by having this confrontational conversation? Just my opinion.. Anyway, the food was blah, the waiting staff was nice, but overall I wouldn't recommend it. Unless of course you wanted to try the Shrimp Provencal, which was pretty great.

Both banquets we had there were amazing! Family owned. We had our function in the legacy room. It was beautiful! Food was very good! Ask for Tom the owner to set up your party. Our guests are still raving over my sisters wedding shower and our bosses retirement party!! Thank you!!!

Great place for healthy Chinese. I have to eat gluten free and the staff always accommodates my needs. It is slightly pricier than your normal Chinese take out but the quality is definitely worth the extra money.

What an incredible meal my wife and I just had here. The hummus and bread were a great intro to whet the appetite. The dish with an egg on top with a tomato based sauce and lamb sausage links was truly to die for. Service was exemplary and prices quite reasonable.
Great atmosphere, the staff were very welcoming and the food was delicious!  Very nice spot to go eat, drink and listen to jazz.
Yummy, yummy, yummy! I can't wait to go back. The grits are delicious! :)

I love habana it has an awesome atmosphere great drinks and authentic Mexican food. I highly recommend going here on a cool summer or spring night with a group of friends or it would be a cute spot for a date.
Fabulous food and very nice ambiance. We will definitely be back!!!!
Too expensive for what it is. The $17 vegetable risotto is made from those frozen vegetables in a bag (cubed carrots, peas, etc.), with no fresh vegetables at all. Small portions, too. Disappointing.

The talented duo that brought you the acclaimed 'Traif' a few doors down, Xixa features Mexican faire without using traditional Mexican ingredients. The whimsical approach to the menu will take you on a flavor rollar coaster and present classic dishes in a unconvential and innovative manner. For example, their "Steak Taco" is a flavorful Steak Tartare with buttery bone marrow.

I have celiac disease and this is the best place to have safe gluten free food. In my opinion it is the best gluten free restaurant in North Jersey. You can always feel confident that the meal was prepared in a safe gluten free environment. I highly recommend this place for Italian food regardless if you need to eat gluten free or not.
Ceviche is seriously on point. Not really sure about the other dishes, but the ceviche is really, really on point. Kind of reminds me of La Mar in San Francisco.... real heads know the deal.
Mediocre, overpriced food. Nice ambiance, good location. Service was slow. Meh. ::shrug::

We went a couple weeks ago and were pleasantly surprised by the service. We couldn't decide if we wanted the hot tea or water so the waiter immediately told us not to worry he was bringing us both and we could decide what we liked. He also offered to help us read through the menu when he noticed we couldn't make a decision on what to get. We finally ended up going with the small pho appetizer and one of the apps on the specials menu - stuffed fried chicken wings. They were stuffed with some kind of delicious ground meat (beef?) and came with two dipping sauces. Amazing. The pho was also delish, with a full plate of sprouts, basil etc on the side. Plenty of meat in it for an appetizer. For entrees he got the pan fried seafood noodles. They were great -crunchy on the outside and soft in the center where it was drenched in the yummy sauce. The only complaint was that there could have been a little more seafood. I had the banh hoi with grilled shrimp. Essentially it was the same as those amazing summer rolls you can get as an app, but you roll them yourselves with lettuce. Overall I have to say I am so happy this place has opened. It was so delicious and we will be coming back often. Also don't forget it's byo!
You have to love this place.  Perfect for couples. Extremely Romantic, it has to be one of the most romantic restaurant in the city. Delicious Food, great for a date night or dinner with friends.
The three different guacs were amazing! Small portioned- a bit pricey. Definitely great for celebrations.

One of the best pizza places I've ever been to.  Don't live there anymore so I still search for the next Grand Apizza wherever I go.  Can't comment on anything else they serve because I always get the Pizza.  If you are looking for non-greasy semi-healthy pizza, this place is not for you.  Keep up the good work!
Awesome food and drinks - definitely recommended! this is my favorite place to meet and take friends.

Great place for vegan food and breakfast especially. The service is good most of the time. But the food is a bit of a one trick pony. Think junk food for vegans. The wait is sometimes long for breakfast.
Great Food, I tried the Chef's testing in dinner.

Went there this past Saturday and the place was packed.  Thankfully I had made reservations. For an appetizer I had the Roasted Cauliflower and Terhune Apple Soup, which I thought was very good. Also had the Arugula Salad which was a nice sized portion and also very good. For my entree I had the Braised Short Rib which was fall apart tender and absolutely delicious! Also ordered a side of polenta and it was very good. I've been to Acacia several times over the years but this was the first time since the new chef / owner took over. I'd have to say that this was my favorite time and best meal there yet. Will definitely be going back again.

Wonderful experience at Ai Fiori. Our choice (highly recommended): i) Per cominciare Insalata di Astice (nova scotia lobster, sunchokes, pine nuts, golden raisins, truffle vinaigrette) Piccione (roasted breast of squab, leek bread pudding, apple walnut puree, bitter greens, mustard jus) ii) Pasta e Risotto Spaghetti (blue crab, lemon, bottarga, chilies) iii)Pesce Ippoglosso (line caught atlantic halibut, sea urchin crema, leeks, apples, arugula) iv) Carne Capriolo (pan roasted venison chop, sweet potato, chestnut, parsnip, golden oak mushrooms) v) Dolci Mela (caramel apple confit, brown butter torta, vanilla, cider sorbetto) Tartaletta (Loma Sotavento 72% ganache, chocolate chiboust, tiramisu gelato) Would definitely come again to try other dishes.
truly chinese favor dishes. and clean environment. i will recommend it to my friends.
This is my fav in the neighborhood-always a good beat/pulse/vibe-very comfortable -perfect blend of intimate and lively-best staff-always enjoy myself there!

Went there for pre-theatre dinner - all right, but wouldn't go back - limited selection, small tables sized for snacks, not dinner.  Interesting decor, place overfilled on a Thursday night as offices emptied out; the BS flowed as much as the Chardonnay
I really enjoyed the creative dishes and drinks. This place offered an excellent atmosphere, and I would totally recommend.
Get the skirt steak sandwich.

We cousins were driving from Hartford back to DC  where we live. Suddenly one of them sowed the thought of Indian Food in our minds.. So we hunted for an HSB. A Monday evening and the crowd being much lesser worked at our favor. We ordered for a Sambhar Vadai, Bisi Belebath, Parota with 2 curries, and a Milagaipodi Dosa. The waiting time wasn't much at all and the food, needless to say was at its best. The Sambhar was full of flavor and blended well for the Bisi Belebath. My craving for the Parota was definitely justified. Simply loved the authentic vegetable korma and the potato curry. We finished the food sharing a Butter Milk and my cousins opted for a steaming Masala Milk. My only disappointment was the service. They servers hardly showed interest and  weren't communicative enough. Not that it stopped us from getting what we want, but a restaurant meal isn't complete without a good service. I definitely left the place with my tummy full and would recommend this for the taste of food.

I went here because I love tapa style restaurants and the yelp reviews were amazing. However, our experience was sub par. We ordered the croquettes, scallops, empanada, and chorizo (all tapa style). Out of all the dishes the croquettes was the only one that seemed to be worth the price. The scallops were over cooked and definitely not worth it. Empanada was average... The chorizo wasn't bad but still nothing I would write home about. They forgot to put in our order for the empanada as well at first. Also I felt as if our server was not very attentive as we would have empty plates sitting for 10-15 min and the restaurant was not busy (only 2 other parties besides us). I had an empty glass of water that was never offered to be refilled and felt almost as if we were being ignored for the most part and we felt as if the waitress was not being friendly towards us.   I was very surprised because I usually agree with yelp reviews and I have been to a lot of the top reviewed places in my area. Definitely not a place I would go back to again and not worth the extra price.

WAYYY overpriced for what it was... the spot is lovely, very romantic and cute, probably better for a glass of wine and an appetizer. but definitely NOT for a dinner... went with a group of friends for an after work dinner and wine.. the food was terribly mediocre, and the entree portions were way too small for the price. ended up leaving hungry and with a big hole in our pocket! totally NOT worth it...

Do it. Great place to take friends or a casual date. Nice and cozy decor, relaxed vibe, tasty food, and surprisingly inexpensive considering the portion sizes. If you live in the area (as I do), this will definitely be one of your go-to neighborhood spots. I recommend the chicken empanadas as an appetizer. Great flavor, nice size, and only $2! As far as the rest of the menu, I've eaten here on several occasions and ordered something different each time...I've yet to be disappointed :)
Blows all the diners pancakes out of the water, everything is home made down to the ketchup. A must check out!!!!!!

For Burlington this is a 4 star place.  It is much better than its sister restaurants.  It delivers a better product in a much nicer atmosphere.  The pizza is stone oven rather than traditional take out pie so in my opinion it is better pizza.  The pasta is far better than the other locations.   They did a great job converting an old KFC to a casual Italian restaurant.  Whether eating at a table or bar, this is a perfect neighborhood alternative to the Downtown restaurants.
Lunch was AMAZING Thank you to the staff for an amazing experience. Delicious.

I recently had a party there.  The food was very good.  The service was fine (tapered off as the evening went on and food/liquor started to disappear far too early in the night when the party was still in full swing). Major issues working with the management to settle party details, pricing, etc. When the final bill came, the headcount was off (they counted high) and they charged the per person price higher than what was agreed. They tax food/liquor and more importantly warrant 18% gratuity on both.  (I have family in the restaurant business .... never seen anyone charge gratuity on liquor). They were unrelenting to do the right thing and adjust it accordingly.  Mind you, we're talking $150 on a $2,500 bill.  Hope that money goes a long way cause you just lost a customer (not to mention, I won't recommend the place to any of my 40, errrr 39 guests).  Hope it was worth it.  Sad. Get a contract with these people including details.and don't let them do business without it.  Otherwise, you'll regret it. I've thrown many a party and spent some big dollars in the process.  Never dealt with people like this who put the dollar before customer satisfaction. These are the types of places that no matter how good the food is, you take your experience and run the other way.

My husband and I love this place. If you go the tater tots with bacon aioli is to die for. The Cobb salad is a steal. I actually take half home for lunch tomorrow. The pork chop there is my favorite go to and I return at least 2x a month to get it. Hubby likes shrimp fra diablo and roasted chicken. Vodka rigatoni is great and the new short rib flat bread is delicious. Great place, nice atmosphere. Ask for Jen she is our favorite server ( fri and sat only)

i always love a place that serves eggs benedict on days other than saturday and sunday.  at first i was a little disappointed that they didn't have eggs benedict with a type of meat (canadian bacon, bacon, ham) on the menu, so i settled for the smoked salmon benedict.  i was a little skeptical at first because i've tried smoked salmon benedict and i wasn't really a fan.  however, it was so good, i devoured all of it (i almost never finish my food.) if you love eggs benedict, i suggest you try it here! i've eaten many eggs benedicts from different places and this is one of the best! the only problem i had was that there was a weird stench, it was some type of wet towel smell lingering throughout the restaurant that bothered me. besides that everything else was good!

Went there for lunch. Service and decoration is good. Tried one tasting menu. Ingredients is very fresh. Like the dessert with the tasting menu. Also tried a lamb entree and a pasta appetizer. Lamb is perfect, but the pasta is so salty and even worse than some normal restaurant. Pasta is a mess, and shouldn't be on the menu. But overall the food is good and tasty.

This market is great and has so much to choose from. I just wish I had a cooler to buy things to bring home with me. I ate a small bite at multiple establishments in the market and was not disappointed. They even h a different a muffletta as good as new Orleans!
My favorite spot in Philly ... Hands down. Great food and the employees are great.

This place is a beautiful indoor marketplace with delis, restaurants, butchers, bakeries... You could really go in here and have a free-for-all for hours. Everything is delicious and beautiful here, and my wife and I drive a long distance from Jersey to get here, but it's totally worth it. We love the breakfast at the Dutch Eating Place, but everything we have ever tried here is first class. You could walk around in here for hours and enjoy all the food.
Even though I live in Denver now, I never miss an opportunity to visit RTM when I'm home in Philly. It's one of my favorite places in the city - if only there was one here!
Wonderful polish home cooking at great prices! I will be back when I'm in town again.
The staff is incredibly nice, the ambience is cozy and fun, and the guacamole is out of this world. Carino is one of the most consistently delicious restaurants on the south side.

I'm tempted to give this place 4 stars--because how can a make-your-own pizza joint garner a perfect score? But for what Red Tomado is it's basically the best it can be at it. You pick your own toppings down the line, or choose one from the menu. You can also get salads and small bites. It's nothing super-revolutionary, but boy is it good. What makes it stand out... 1) bright and clean, modern atmosphere 2) beer on tap 3) a gelato wheel 4) really fresh ingredients The night I went my pizza was just delicious. I also had a Greek salad and it was honestly one of the freshest I've ever had; real crisp. I also got a local Two Roads beer on tap. The staff was also very nice which is appreciated. Side note: while we were eating a less fortunate (and fairly drunk) man came into the place. He graciously left with some free food.
Great breakfast, diner style. Expertly prepared eggs. Great sandwiches. Counter seating. Eat here.

Not bad.  Dishes didn't totally work yet it wasn't a ripoff.  Will try it again... it's really quite expensive though - $26 for a "large" chicken parmigiana, which was composed of two thinly sliced breasts that were of decent size.  Still, it's chicken... it's not that expensive and shouldn't be north of 25 bucks anywhere.  The pork chop, which was $29, was a better value.  That said, I've had better chicken parms and better pork chops at lower price points.  The menu is huge which always gives you a little bit of concern.  Service is excellent and ambiance is upscale and perhaps a little cheesy but no complaints.  The bathrooms are tiny for such a large restaurant.
That's awesome place!I was surprised really delicious food! The biscuit was amazing! Good music! Nice service and ppl. I want to recommend everyone to visit you!

My review is 3.5 stars for food and 4.0 stars for service. My boyfriend and I went to this restaurant before seeing a show last weekend at the Wellmont Theater. We called ahead to make sure there were open tables and said we only had about 45 minutes to eat. They assured us this wouldn't be a problem, so we quickly got some wine and headed over. When we arrived the restaurant was not crowded at all, so we were a bit suspicious since it was about 7:00pm on a Friday. However, when we walked in we were warmly greeted by the hostess. She sat us right away, and told us about the specials before our waiter arrived. We ordered the stuffed mushrooms on special and arugula salad to start. The mushrooms were very tastey but only luke warm. The arugula salad was very basic and I think there could have been more flavor. I would not get this salad again. For entrees my boyfriend got chicken florentine and I got a risotto special with salmon. I often to do not order chicken out and when trying his I would not recommend this dish. The chicken lacked in flavor and was a bit dry. My risotto was better, but rather than getting pieces of salmon there was a piece of salmon on top of the risotto. This was not my favorite dish but was decent. I would consider going back, but I do not dine in Montclair often so would likely give another restaurant a shot instead.

Most Italian Restaurants in the area are pretty decent but this place wins not only for the taste but also for the price and portions! Ive ordered wings, wraps, salads, entrees and of course, pizza from them and I have never been disappointed! They're also pretty accomodating of u needed a tray of food in a hurry too! Dining room is very small but i usually order to go anyway
This place was good.  We had a group of ~10 that shared the big piece of pork.  Really good.  I'm going to check out all of David Chang's restaurants.

I came to the market with my sisters this past weekend. I had ordered a sandwich from another stand while my sisters ordered from Meltkraft. Let me just say I will be ordering from here again! My sister gave me a big piece and it was so delicious!! I hope to eat here again soon; in the meantime, the Brielle will be in my dreams!!

This place is so cool and has such a great vibe!  The bartenders are so nice and the margaritas excellent - I feel as if I'm on an island away from all the hustle and bustle. You'll love the music and smiling faces - super friendly staff and excellent service - It's a must if you're looking for a place to wind down and enjoy.  My favorite is the ceviche, the mojitos, the brown rice bowl with Duck and the grilled fish tacos!

Small small space, but great food and great service. It might be a little more expensive but totally worth it, very unique, fresh ingredients, and thick slices that are super filling! They're also open late at night, so if you're around and need a quick bite, this is the place to be.
Great Amish food in the Reading Terminal Market

Though the wait was very longggg the hostess was super entertaining.  The long wait was a reflection of how popular this place was. The food was good especially  the cheesy tots.  The service was good but not great bc of how busy the place was. I would def. Recommend trying this place out.

Excellent meal, excellent service!!!  I met friends here for dinner and we had a fabulous evening!  From the cocktails to the dessert... Everything was outstanding!  I have been to the sister restaurant in Palm Beach, Il Bellagio, and Villagio is 10 times better!!!  Try the linguine del Selvaggio!!  And the burrata, fig and prosciutto appetizer!!!  Delicious!!

What a disappointment- the service was nonexistent, the owner was arrogant, and the food was mediocre.  Explanation? "We're busy"... Guess that's unusual, I understand why now.  Had such high expectations, won't go back.

Great place to watch a game and grab some drinks. Had the pot pie which was nice and flaky. Eamon was my bartendor and did a great job all night, very friendly and I always had a full drink. Fun place to hang out for a night.

The confusingly named "Smith" is quite a deceiving restaurant. I went to this large, white building expecting a place to buy fine steel. Unfortunately, all that was in this so-called Smith was food. I will give the place that it has the best brunch in midtown, but had the Mongols been invading, we all would have been slaughtered. I recommend the food, but do not go there if you want a fine blade to defend Tarnovo with.
Hole is the wall, but delicious viet sandwiches.

Lovely ambience, fantastic tapas, great wine selection, and charming staff! This is a great neighborhood spot that is wafting with wonderful energy. Don't miss out on the roasted eggplant and sautéed spinach - they go great together. And make sure you chat with the owner(s) - they are welcoming and have a great sense or humor!

Someone else on here said it's a must visit if you like Chinese food. I say yes, but also it's a must visit even if you do NOT like Chinese food. For most of my life I've been one of the second kind. Until someone took me here and now I'm a convert. I realized I do, in fact, love this stuff, (at least the fresh, authentic Sichuan stuff). The flavours in the dishes here knock my socks off. Some of the dishes I've had are the fried intestine, ants climbing a tree, beef noodle soup, oxtail and tripe salad appetizer, chicken lettuce wraps, lamb curry, and sea bass stew. Eat here. Do it!

This is one of my favorite spots in the city!  They Always have what I want,  and Fresh to, every time!! When I get a chance to pass by I stop and eat here!!  It is always pretty busy but the way they work it, you can usually get your order within 20 to 30 minutes and nice & hot! Like some of the girls that work as well as eat there! lol Give it 5 APPLES!!

Vilken service, och till det gott vin och god mat. Beställde steak som var perfekt tillagat enligt våra önskemål. Ett missförstånd vid beställningen klarades smidigt upp av personalen som var hjälpsamma och tillmötesgående till våra beställningar. Rekommderas varmt.
Pros: GREAT Mac and Cheese; fun and unique menu items Cons: Cash only and operation hrs.
The lobster mac and cheese was the best I ever had!!!! They also had so many different lobster rolls to choose from, and the oysters were cheep and fresh!

Our holiday party was great here! The food was excellent, drinks were even better. The service was awesome. I would certainly come back for drinks with friends & plan another corporate party/event here. Norman and Hannah were the best!
We went in on a Saturday afternoon the place was kind of empty. For Princeton, the prices aren't bad but the food isn't spectacular. Not bad.

I thought that the Pho here was good, and the price was really reasonable. That being said, the amount of 5 star reviews for this place is pretty surprising. I thought the service was nothing special, and the atmosphere itself wasn't great. I wouldn't go back here unless I was in the area and really really needed a Pho fix.

This place is just great! I spent a week at my moms house in Queens, and looked for some nice tacos in Brookyln while visiting a friend, I turned to Yelp and found this nearby and open, it was really a sweet experience , and while it might be a while till I get back to NY this trip has welcomed me to Yelp as it is not really common where im from, and also the great Tacos ElBronco. it was a great ride

wonderful experience here at a specially themed prohibiition dinner.   A friend told us about it and thought we'd give it a try, and we were very happy we did.  The place  was papered over with a faux-prohibition notice in the window and a password to get in;  staff dressed in 1930s attire.  It made for a fun and different ambience, which set the tone for the delicious cocktails and food.  What made it still more enjoyable were the talks the chef made before each course, explaining the historical context for the dishes.  His enthusiasm for both his food and the history of it all was infectious, really enjoyed the evening immensely.  And the wonderful and well priced bottle of barolo only added to the experience.  Look forward to returning for another themed dinner -- they evidently have them once a month -- and also to try them for their regular menu.  Highly recommend.

I had to feed 15 people on a location shoot in Brooklyn and although they do not deliver we were able to send 2 interns to pick up at The Meatball Shop and the food saved the day!  It was awesome and we will absolutely use them again. I pre-paid for the entire oder over the phone, got what I paid for and they haven't stopped talking about the food yet in my office. The food was fresh, ready at the appointed time, cost efficient, and really, really yummy!  ALL OF IT WAS GONE !!!!   Many kudos to this organization.  They do it right!
I love the Humita de Camerones and several of the ceviches.
Love this place! Food is great AND the service is always good. Best happy hour in Fishtown.

Nice ambiance, decent food, OK waitstaff, NOT the place to go if you have other plans for the day. Went in for Sunday brunch last weekend and ordered the "Gringo Burrito"; my boyfriend had the nutella/banana/caramel french toast. The food was OK but nothing spectacular and bit overpriced. By the time I got my first cup of coffee it was lukewarm and we waited 40 minutes for our food and about 10 minutes to receive the check after requesting it despite our expressed need to get going. Granted, it was busy and brunch is  typically a leisurely event, however, 40 minutes is a stretch. Definitely not the place to go for unlimited mimosas unless you're looking to consume about 2!

Creative Health conscious Vegan friendly Cuisine From a former White House Chef who once crafted custom presidential dishes. You can taste these amazing creations in this Bayonne hidden gem unassuming restaurant. Well worth the trip or visit, especially if you are vegetarian or Vegan! For the carnivores there are many meaty dishes as well.

Cafe Chismosa has always been on my list of restaurants to visit. Finally after a few months of waiting, my husband and I experienced Cafe Chismosa. The key word is experience - it is more than just one of a kind food but from the time you walk in Cafe Chismosa to the time your car waits for you when you are done! Holy cow! It was worth every single penny. My husband was worried the ambiance and servers would be a little stuffy but we were pleasantly surprised. Everything was so well thought out from the pine trees (Dec 23) as we enter to the utensils specially made for each course. The servers were working in harmony like a dance troupe all male staff I noticed. I won't give it away but if you ever get a chance to visit Alinea, be ready to be WOWed! You will never witness something so magical elsewhere. Thank you Cafe Chismosa.

This place was a super cute mom and pops breakfast joint. The owner sat us and was super friendly and you could tell that she was really passionate about her restaurant, which I loved. Our waitress was adorable and made some great recommendations and provided excellent service. I had the goat cheese mushroom quiche and it was really good.

This market is so awesome. It was my first spot after checking into my hotel and I spent almost two hours exploring this amazing place. Upon entering the market, I was overcome by all the various shops. In every direction, it seemed never-ending. There was soul food, Chinese food, donuts, bakeries, fresh produce, fresh seafood, hoagies, cheesesteaks, crepes, etc.

love love love!!!  How could you not enjoy this smorgasbord of amazing vendors and foods all under one roof.  Bring your appetite and your wallet (it's not cheap)....oh and wear those comfy jeans one size too big.  You will thank me later.
As always never seizes to amaze me. I always stop by here for dinner whenever I visit NY.
Great food! Great prices! You could literally feed a family of four for between $12 - $14! Awesome!!!

So glad Mundo is back! We loved it in its old location and are so pleased to see them reopened in a beautiful new location. The food and service are just as wonderful, if not more so, and we had a fantastic time here a few weeks ago. Red Sonja, I've missed you! And the Zen cocktail is delicious. Go, enjoy! We can't wait to return.

All I can say is that I love this place. When my friend and I went it was packed but since it was just the two of us we got seated at a tiny corner. Yay, atleast we didn't have to wait... The service was excellent and IT IS A MUST to get the corn!!!
The food is fantastic. The chef has not only created a unique menu but an absolutely delicious one! Personally, I recommend the SouthHouse burger for dinner and the Pretzel French Toast for brunch.

Pizza here is alright I could take it or leave it not the best slice I ever had but I guess that's the pizza in this neighborhood It was small inside as well tables were tight and I'm a small person myself it was pretty clean the service was fast the bathroom is like a broom closet way too small it was also dirty in the bathroom street parking only hard to find spots also
Skip the bistro. Glorified bar fare.  Bland. Over cooked .... Not good. Hopefully the drinks are strong.
The steaks were good, I ordered some cheesesteaks the last time I was down the way.

Went to this restaurant on a whim and found it to be just average. Portions were small and expensive even considering it was Tapas. We ordered several of the regular size plates and they were also what I would consider small. When we ordered I specifically told the waitress that I didn't want the meal rushed. We ordered soup and salads to start and the tapas plates started arriving before we had even finished the starters. Then the main  plates arrived while we were still on the Tapas. All told we were in and out in one hour for a party of four. Won't be going back.

I work in Newark and pass this place everyday going to and from my office.  I went on Yelp and read some"Not so great" reviews and was a little worried.  I finally stopped in about 3 weeks ago for lunch and let me tell you these people could not be more wrong.  The service was amazing, the food was delicious, and the prices are very resonable for the amount of food you get.  Needless to say i have been back a few times since then and have had the same GREAT experience every time.  I highly recommend this place and am looking forward to going back again soon.

Wow! Words can't even describe the white pizza but amazing and to die for come across my mind. The staff was awesome and the atmosphere on devils game days is amazing. If you like good food and good people this is for you!!

Greek salad was amazing: large chunks of feta, lovely dressing, beautifully seared calamari and octopus. The spanakopita was almost all dough though which is why they lost a star. Otherwise it was awesome!

This was OK. Service was pleasant but not friendly and the server forgot to enter one of our items. Price is not cheap for what you get. Brunch plates were not the size that is shown in the pictures on here. I arrived very hungry and left hungry, $12 for an appetizer portion. It also did not come with fresh orange like other reviews stated. The sausage gravy was very nice, but the biscuit was dry. If you are looking for an excellent biscuit I would go to Pies and thighs or Brooklyn Star, but in all honesty most places in the area are better than this.

First off, this is my favorite spot in the area and my go to for dinner or drinks. I discovered this spot on a whim as I was looking at an apartment in the neighborhood, and cannot deny this place influenced my decision. The bartenders are great people and very attentive, and waitstaff is experienced and friendly. I have celebrated birthdays and have so many great memories at this spot! I go there at least once a week, so I can attest to their consistency. Get the pork chops!!!

OMG THE SLOPPY JOE! Amazing! Cool little place with a fun vibe. Between super friendly Mike and the board games behind the counter, they seem to be creating this "where everybody knows your name" atmosphere which I love. Clean. Fun. Great staff. Great service. Sandwiches are stellar and its hard to be creative with a grilled cheese. Cooked to perfection. Inexpensive booze. I like this place. Go there! But please..... ADD DELIVERY!!!!!!!!!! That would be perfection.
The goulash here is terrible- very watery! I was shocked - the sauce was water and salt. Terrible. The beef was old crumbly chuck cubes- whoever cooks such a goulash hates life!
I've been coming here for years and years, the food is really good and I love the desserts.  Is East Hartford's best land mark.

Giving 5 stars !!! Food is outstanding, I've eaten in a different restaurants, from high end to a hole in the wall type . Cooks in this restaurant deserve a special reword.  Sangria won my heart. I've had sangria before, but whatever they do to it ... It's magic!!! We had two pitchers for three of us, and wasn't enough. Not watery at all , refreshing and flavorful with a lot of fresh fruits. Highly recommend this place if you looking for authentic  Portuguese food and not also if you like seafood this is the restaurant for you.
Love the atmosphere and hidden place:) their pizza is delicious!

Michele (s?) wears the cutest make-up and only takes the best care of us. I haven't met a person as on it and together as Michele. I honestly have to be real, people who know me, know..if my food isn't right-we have issues. Michele didn't even have to check in with me. She handled everything and made my experience beyond delicious. Blend on the water already has a better menu than the other one. Michele is a TOTAL gem. If you have her, you are beyond lucky to be in her section. If you want your food done correctly, fast, amazing and awesome you should with out a doubt request Michele. I have requested her AND WAITED. It is totally worth it. SHE CARES.
Meat was good. I like family style but they made it a little difficult to decide. They also ran out of everything on the night we went.

First of all, stop rating the restaurant based on the racism allegation; let the court be the judge and, most importantly, let Chef Cesar Ramirez's food be the voice on Yelp.  Be aware - it's a chef's table style....so don't expect table cloth, chandelier, etc.  Enjoy the action in the kitchen.  I could not leave my eyes off and I thought one of the handsome chefs was hitting on me.  Wow.....seriously - "a racist" restaurant hitting a gay Asian?  Come on.....people.  Let the food be the judge.  Oh....Chef Cesar Ramirez actually had time to go around and greeted his customers individually.  He did not single us out nor gave us extra attention. Secondly, I am NOT going to mention how much of my bill for 4 people just for wine.  We opened two bottles of champagne and 1 bottle of Burgundy - I have to say.....the prices on the wine list were a bargain if you're truly into food and wine.  David, the sommelier, surprised us (even me) with the Burgundy. Now.....for the food: Japanese-inspired 15-course dinner  brilliantly brought out the freshness of fish and Waygu beef.  While many of the reviewers liked the one-bite sea urchin with black truffle.  It was actually the ONLY dish that I felt lukewarm.  I loved both black truffle and sea urchin.  However, the aroma and taste of black truffle overpowered the sea urchin (in my opinion).  I also liked the apple smoke infused caviar with potatoes in this winter weather.  While I saw the preparation of green ice-cream, I thought it would be green-tea sorbet......NO NO NO - it was yuzu sorbet!  What a great idea having that yuzu taste stay in the palate toward the end of the meal.   What I did not enjoy: - I had no idea what I would be eating.  Thus, ordering wine was difficult for me.  Sommelier first gave me lecture about the upcoming fish dishes and my mind was like....."really - you are telling me what to drink?  Go to Twitter and find me first...." However, he was helpful to guide customers.   - I wished the chef would have the menu (what we ate) when we left the restaurant.....a little memory. - I did not understand the reservation system even though I did not make tonight reservation 6 weeks ahead.  I heard that customers needed to call Monday only for reservation. Tonight was our first time to this restaurant.  YES - I am Asian; my spouse is Brazilian; we married last month at the NY Carnegie Hall (first wedding at the Carnegie Hall).  So....Asian, Brazilian, and gay......yet we did not feel any discrimination.  We look forward to returning to this restaurant for consistency and outstanding meal.
Best bowl of Ramen I have ever had. Get the Mega Ramen bowl or the Spicy Ramen with an egg and corn and avocado added!

If your definition of good food is fast-food style, big serves and something you could make at home (and probably with more flavor and less oil) then eat here. If your definition of good food is a meal prepared with fresh ingredients, good flavors and something that actually tastes nice, then this won't be your place. Coffee was that dirty dishwater type common across NY (the telltale sign is the super fluffy, aerated milk of a cappuccino). Will give them credit for the friendly staff, but sadly service is only a small component when looking for a nice brunch.

Ya Ya is the type of Chinese restaurant you go to on a night where you really don't want to eat Chinese food. Most of what used to pass as authentic has become less so in recent times. Moreover, portion size has been getting smaller and smaller. Recent bad experiences include really soggy mango chicken, and extremely oversalted noodles. The quality of the bubble tea has high variance, and I will admit, I raised my eyebrows when I saw that they started serving sushi. Though the ambiance is worse, Yao's restaurant across the street serves significantly better food, whether you are talking about something like General Tso's, or if you are looking for more legit Chinese food. This is hearsay, but the owner has even complained about the lack of Chinese patrons, and how they have been slowly moving to accommodate Americanized tastes.
Fantastic dinner.... 2 thumbs up..... I will be back!!
Wonderful service wonderful octopus need i say more PS I have an octopus fetish.  My how to say this was one of the best octopus dishes I've had

I've been here several times and as always this time was no exception, I usually get the Cuban but this time tried the fish tacos. They were great as well, next time I may try the pork tacos, mix it up a little!!
Nice. I like it.

Good food. Good drinks. Service wasn't. I came for brunch and it is extremely busy, while I am understanding of that, it still doesn't mean our waitress should take orders from surrounding tables that came AFTER us. I am thinking she is new, because management ended up waiting on my table. I wouldn't return:
Orders are always on point . Drinks always on point. NEVER any issues with you guys!!!
Must get mashed potatoe bacon pizza one of the best slices of pie you will have in nh. You can wash it down with their own brewed toasted blonde

Excellent Food!! Authentic Kerala cuisine...Good service...decent ambience and good value for money price..What else do you need in a restaurant.? Will definitely go there again and will recommend it to anyone who likes Indian Kerala cuisine.

Went there yesterday with my friend for dinner. Firstly , on the website it says that Thursday's are ladies night and drinks are 2$. It wound up being full price drinks. I wouldn't have minded but the drinks sucked. My friend ordered a bulldog and it was so strong it was disgusting and nothing to drink with dinner. I also ordered a sangrita which was sangria and a margarita mixed. That too was strong I didn't even drink it. The guac was like sour and bitter I think it was old. The food also took like an hour to come just to make 2 damn quesadillas. The waitress was beyond nice though. She changed my friends drink for another but that too was strong. Probably wouldn't go back for dinner again. Maybe the bar.
A rude water lady/table cleaner and try picking up the garbage outside once in a while.Don't waste your money...terrible! !!!!
Family run business, food is presented beautifully and more than that DELICIOUS!!! The shrimp was perfectly cooked, rice was tender & sauces so flavorful!!!
I'm a fan. I've visited several times and have never been disappointed. Brunch and dinner both, equally delicious. I'll be back soon! PW

Last night was my 3rd time going to Blend as we went to toast to my baby sis engagement with a small group of friends. We chose Blend cuz it's a hidden treasure on the Hudson waterfronts overlooking the city skylines. AMAZING location, GREAT food, Hip music playing in the background...couldn't asked for a better atmosphere. The music makes you wanna get up and salsa...and after the third drink...WE DID! You MUST try the Jalapeno Margaritas and the Coconut Mojitos. Had the shrimp prawns as appetizers...yummy! My girls loved the arepas and tostones. The fish selection is good and the chicken fried rice...amazing. Had that before when I came on a date...great location by the way...very romantic.   Iman...the manager....all 5'1 of her cuteness was adorable and catering all night. She walks around table to table like a mother hen making sure everyone is taken care of. We were comp for the occasion and for the wait...thank you Lance as well. The entire staff was great. Iman even surprised us and toasted with some shots of some secret concoction...delish! Thank you Blend for making our celebration fantastic! Mitzi, Eritza, Yocana, Desire, Karina, Raven, Karin, Patricia, .

A super social spot, the coziest in the winter but also great in the summer when it feels very open air. The beer selection is always interesting and the layout makes it very easy to meet new people. I don't go here for the food so I can't say that it's five star worthy, but the fun vibe of this spot and the fact that I've never had a bad time here is enough for me!
Not bad food, but nothing worth the prices. Fast service but as a small restaurant it's too crowded and no privacy. I wouldn't go again
Pretty authentic Taiwanese breakfast. Like Salty Soy Bean Soup and Fried Cruller. A lot of fusion items. Combines a few Asian cooking styles. Some Thai, Taiwanese, Shanghai food items.

The brunch menu was okay. I had the Eggs Benedict and honestly have had better else where. The muffin on the bottom was hard as a rock and impossible to cut through which was so disappointing. I gave up trying to cut through it and just ate everything else.

Food is amazing but customer service sucks. The waitresses took my food without asking me if I was done. Very rude service but food was amazing. That was my first and last time there because customer service matters more to me.
came here this past sunday and it was AWESOME! The drinks and service were amazing the food was detailed and delicious! This place deserves all the hype, I will definitely be back

They don't need me to write a review but I had such an amazing experience! The place was PACKED but the service was still amazing! We went to celebrate my Mother's birthday and it was dinner and a show! Everyone moved with grace and speed and everyone was so nice and attentive! The food was out of this world and it just kept coming! An amazing experience I would repeat over and over again!

Food- Simple. Delicious. Traditional. The pozole was nothing short of scrumptious, and I think that was the first time I've seen Horchata in a Mexican restaurant. Everything from the chips and salsa to the tamales were delicious. Ambiance- Homey and comfortable, the minute you walk in the door you feel safe and peaceful, the music is great and although the furnishings are nothing spectacular it does not talk away from the experience. Service- Like everything else, the service was spectacular. A kind waitress helped us out with everything and never stopped smiling, the staff inside the kitchen are also very quick and your food comes out in minutes, over all great experience, a must try if you are in the area!
It doesn't get any better. The parking and location are perfect. Prices are in line with portions and  pig wings!!!! I always knew they could fly. Get the plate of meat. It is soooo good.
Fantastic food, great service

We were seated quickly but requested to move away from the door and the congestion near it. The place is quite small/intimate and you will feel the draft from any seat! You will be forced to speak to the people sitting next to (on top of )you. We asked the waiter for his suggestion and he said they were known for the chicken, which was a plus because my friend wanted to order that and I asked how the Shrimp were prepared with the grits. He said they were sauteed in barbecued sauce. I didn't care for that combo (bbq'd shrimp  really) so i ordered the chicken sandwich with fries also. The food arrived quickly and was hot like I like it.  The chicken was juicy, crunchy and small but  not well seasoned.  It was a boneless thigh to my surprise, the fries were fries lightly salted and good. We tasted the bun which was great but did not eat the whole bun, we should have because we were still hungry.  We tried the French Toast and bacon. The toast was ok the peach compote is the highlight of that meal.  If you can't cook and don't  mind being in a sardine can this is your place.

Delicious food. Got there 10 or so minutes late for our reservation, and had to wait at the back. The manager kept coming by to talk to us, and made us feel very welcome. It Made the wait go by very fast. Service was fantastic!
had better chicken then this place.

Had the Posole Rojo aka a beef stew. Delicious meal BUT $17 for what is considered the poor man's food in Mexico is just a little absurd. At least give me the whole avocado if you are going to charge that much. Overpriced with little appeal to go back.

Great service, fun atmosphere, delicious food. We are repeat customers and being vegan, often opt for the same menu items, which we never tire of! Guacamole, plantains, spicy cucumber salad, roasted mushroom tacos, mushroom tamale, roasted cauliflower taco...so delicious. Wine list could use a little help but five star food...all the way.

Amazing amazing amazing ! Only a short walk from the ferry stop. Check out the specials board for incred options. We got the guinness burger. Drewl worthy! A true American feed. AND the barmaid is a doll. She basically gave us the best recommendation for buffalo wings and where to go on the rest of our Staten Island adventure. P.s. Try the flagship beer. It's a Staten Island native and absolutely perfect with a burger !
Stella 34 Trattoria has some of the most unique Italian dishes in New York! Great view from the 6th fl of Macy's too.

BAD EXPERIENCE.  LIKE I TOLD THEM, I'LL NEVER GO BACK.  The sushi is good but nothing extra special.  For the price, the servings are smaller than most places I go.  And I go to a LOT of sushi places.  The tables are small, and it's dark in there.  I've gone probably five times since they opened.  It was always an OK experience.  We went last night because we bought a Groupon.  That is literally the only reason we went there instead of the many sushi places between here and there.  The Groupon said that you had to have reservations to use it but I've had TONS of Groupons honored where the situation didn't meet all the criteria listed in the small print.  Plus, there was no need for reservations.  When we arrived, only one table had customers in it!  When we left 40 minutes later, there were two other tables with customers.  Still, when I showed the waitress the Groupon, she looked at it for a moment and said "Did you make a reservation?"  I said "No.  That's not usually a problem though."  I probably should have pointed out that the place was empty.  Now she could have just honored the Groupon without even bringing up the small print.  Instead, she took the Groupon (in other words, she took my phone) into the kitchen and returned 35 seconds later saying "You can't use this because you didn't make a reservation."  I said, "Really?"  She said, "Yeah.  I"m sorry."  I said, "Well that's OK but I'll never come back here again."  Her response:  "Oh."  Apparently they don't need the business (despite all the empty tables).  Thing is:  We don't need them either.  There must be several HUNDRED places in Philadelphia to get sushi.  Good sushi can be made quite crappy when served by a restaurant that doesn't care about the customer experience.  So one star.  I'll never go back.  When the restaurant goes out of business, I'll contact Groupon and ask them to refund the price I paid for the deal.  Cest la vie!

I can't understand the obsequious reviews. The food was ok, nothing groundbreaking though. The desserts were bad. For $60 a person, It's kind of a rip off.  The portions size are downright minuscule, as if there's some rule that says the smaller the portion size, the fancier and better the food gets.  (No.) The food is much more along the lines of what I'd call skilled amateur cooking -- the same sort of stuff I do at home. If you're looking for a kitschy, hipster decor and the farm table setting -- and you've got money to burn -- you might enjoy it. If you're looking for excellent food and a real culinary experience, don't be fooled by the reviews, there are far better options.

Perfect place to take my wife for her birthday. If you like meat - take the cote de boeuf. If you don't like meat - take the cote de boeuf. You'll like meat afterwards. Sat in the front room and Leslie was a star. Glasses never got close to empty and answers came before the questions.
Fun place to go, eat  and shop. Can purchase all kinds of food and treats. They  really cleaned it up from years ago. More bathrooms would be nice.

Love, love love this place!  best BBQ in Queens!  I love their Burnt Ends, and the Sweet Potato wedges and the Mac and cheese are my go to sides!  They just opened up a new space next door with s full liquor bar featuring Bourbons, Whiskeys and Moonshine!  The Apple Moonshine is my favorite!  Can't wait for the summer so I can hang out in their cool backyard!

Cannot say enough good things about this place. The food is absolutely delicious, from the pastries to the sandwiches to the homemade salads. Everything is very fresh and the ingredients are excellent. It is moderately priced for the area as well. Seating is a little bit of an issue but the staff is very friendly.
Great value for lunch pastas. Also decent for dinner if you want a quick meal especially if on the go. Great sauce!
Such a delicious gem in the city! Perfect for a date or a night out with the girls! Highly recommend the vegetarian pasta dish alongside a glass or two of pinot noir!
Such an interesting little place! Great food, great drinks. The confessional wall is fun and interesting to read. Music was excellent was well.

I recently stopped in for a quick meal and wow was I impressed. The food came out quick, hot and was absolutely fantastic. I've had other really great Neapolitan like pizza before but this place is hands down the best I've had thus far. You can really tell they're serious about their emphasis on fresh natural ingredients.   It should be obvious from the upscale atmosphere in the restaurant that the food your getting will be equally upscale in both quality and taste. The service was great as well. The staff was friendly, attentive and quick. Upscale and quick normally don't go hand in hand but 900 and the staff really nail this concept down. Bravo. I'll be coming back as often as I can and certainly recommending the place.

we waited in the cold almost 20 minutes but the home fries were worth it.  VERY SMALL place but all of our food was good!  the cinnamon roll pancake thing was really good as well.  we sat at the bar and the door was opened so often, we were cold for most of the time. it was good overall though.
Great place for brunch or lunch. Nice menu that will please anyone with very different tastes.

New place opened up down the block from work. Very interesting decor and cool artwork. Staff was very friendly, the chef/owner even walks the floor and talks to everyone. Nice guy (I assume you will see less of him as they get busier, but nice to see him engaging). We went for after work drinks b/c of the crazy happy hour deals and they always seem to have a fun crowd. Great pork belly sliders, sick fried oysters (maybe the best I've had) and very cool drinks list. We ended up sticking around for dinner and didn't disappoint. We split steak frites and rotisserie chicken. Both were excellent cooked well. We tried the two new side dishes staff recommended (shaded shaved brussel sprouts in habanero infused olive oil with bacon and jalapeño cheddar buttermilk biscuits) and ended up ordering another of each. Not sure where this place came from but will be regulars for sure now that we know about it...P.S. they need to do more marketing, we only happened by it on our way to another place!
Awesome food! Great atmosphere! Smaller portions but the quality makes up for it.
Red Eye is the bomb. The staff are great, coffee is well made and food is tasty. Brunch can be really busy, but overall, a mainstay of Montclair! Plus wifi to do work!

Great food, awesome people/staff, perfect location!  We went for brunch and shared the pork chop and grits since I wasn't feeling all that great BUT for having a cold and taste buds being a little off, I still thought this mean was amazzzing dish!  Environment is great, they are accommodating & super clean.. great experience overall.  Will be back when I return to Philly!
Great food, great drinks! The duck papardelle was outstanding! Very cool atmosphere
Great experience. Very happy place. Owned by a family, obvious they have passion and love for their business. Definitely recommend "Ajarian khachapuri"  and carrot cake!
Went to Rats happy hour last Friday.      Awesome bartenders. Friendly  on top of things.  Will be going back to see them.     Prices were good

The burger is the Bomb. If you ever want something super greasy and a heart attack this is the place to be. Crispy cheese fries to cure your drunkness. If you watching your diet this is not a place for you. I would recommend this place.  Good eats. Ps you can get alcohol here too.

I will always stand by Gopi. This new branch has the EXACT same food as the Orange street one, and it's even bigger and brighter. So happy. This institution offers some of the freshest, guilt-free Indian take out I have ever had. His staff are so polite and I always feel like I will have a great day/evening if I get Tikkaway. I usually get the paneer/aloo/channa combo with all the veg and the vindaloo sauce and a side of papad. It only adds up to $7.99 for a mountain of food. It's a fail safe, spicy combo that warms the stomach especially in the winter. It is the one thing I will miss the most when I leave New Haven.

Good lord!!! My salmon eggs benedict way exceeded my expectations. Seriously the best I've ever had! They use a biscuit instead of an English muffin and it is amaze. I will be dreaming about this breakfast when I return back to LA

Yelp should have six stars reserved for exceptional restaurants like Cookshop. Friendly, professional staff, excellent food, reasonable prices and best of all, it isn't in the least pretentious! I'll be returning soon.

The greatest pizza place in new haven. I know that is saying a lot consider what's available- but I stand by my word. In addition to the amazing pizza, all the small dishes are out of this world. If you are looking for greasy Italian food, this is not the place for you. But if you are a foodie who loves different flavors and appreciates a good brick oven pizza- this is your spot. They also have a great happy hour with half priced bottles of wine until 6 Monday- Wednesday. I just moved to new haven last year and I take everyone here when they come to visit. It really is a hidden gem.

So I decided to go and check this place out. It had just opened and I want to see what it was all about. I walk in, I was greeted by the bouncer who by the way was a very nice guy. I proceeded to check the place out and decided to approach the bar. I ordered a drink and apparently the bartender made the wrong type of drink. I then waited there for about 12 minutes to try to get a hold of the waitress. Finally when she saw that I was trying to get a hold of her she asked me what I wanted and I explained to her my problem. She stated that it wasn't her problem and that I would have to pay for a new drink. Meanwhile the drink was right in front of me untouched and she still want me to buy another drink. I personally have never in my life had this type of experience. I asked her if I would be able to speak to the manager. The manager on duty was behind the bar.  I was told that he would talk to me when he had a chance. He actually never came over to introduce himself. He ac never came over at all. I spent the rest of my night which was only another hour giving  the place a second chance. No manager ever came by and left the worst taste in my mouth. I would never go to this place again. Any type of new business that can care less about the customer experience does not deserve my business or anyones for that matter. I will continue giving my business to other places that actually appreciate my presence and have customer loyalty.

Whenever someone asks me to recommend one of my favorite restaurants in NYC for fine dining or just a nice place to eat, this is the place. I originally came here for a nice steak meal but I came during lunch and it was a slightly altered menu so I didn't end up with a succulent steak. Worry not, basically anything you order here is delicious and plated beautifully. I had my first experience eating sweetbreads here and it was a good first time, though had I known what sweetbreads actually was prior to ordering it I probably wouldn't know would taste like and be missing out. Their duck leg was cooked perfectly and the dish was flavorful. P.s. Save room for dessert!! (I'm serious) P.p.s. You can cap your meal off with a coffee to help digest a bit. Their cortado was  well made.

Great restaurant with great food and plenty of variety on the menu. You are sure to find something fantastic for everyone here! My only complaint is the temperature of the dining room, which is WAY too hot. Even in a light sweater I was wishing I had a t-shirt underneath because about half way through my meal I was so hot I could no longer enjoy the food or the company I was in. I could see that other patrons were also uncomfortable as many of them were fanning themselves with menus.
Excellent variety of dishes.  Good Service and Decor.

This is the best Ramen in New York (and I eat Ramen an average of 1.5 times a week). They torch the pork after putting it on the soup! The place is small and loud, though, so expect a wait on weekends.

Firstly I have to say that the food and the service were of the highest standard. My daughter and I shared a full portion of Crab Risotto and Kale and wild mushroom paella. They were excellent choices and our waiter was extremely attentive but I have to confess that at about $28 per portion, the portions were far too small and would not satisfy a hungry person. Overall a good experience but not sure if I would make the journey from mid town or uptown.

I wish I had listened to previous reviews because they were mostly right. I had a reservation a month ahead. Called to confirm a few days before n to update that we were going to be less people on the day off. Me and my party got there on time and even though the whole restaurant was empty they didn't have our table ready! Cocktail at the bar was terrible. Told the bartender, he offered to change it with such a fake halfhearted apology I sticked to my drink so I could avoid more contact with him. He was very awkward in his interaction. Pasta was delicious but overpriced. Dessert was bad. I did not understand what they were going for. The 2 stars are for the good waiter n the pasta. nothing else was good and for the prices they have you would expect outstanding food n service.
Pretty good Italian. I got the special (3 cheese ravioli with house meat sauce) and my wife got gluten free chicken alfredo. They were accommodating to our 2 kids!

Great lil place, had lunch today the calamari was excellent we had a couple of sandwiches with salad, apple crumb cake with vanilla gelato and terrific coffee! The waiter was adorable, I mentioned I was involved in a restaurant with a wood burning oven, he walked me over and explained the coal.oven, too cute!
All wings over are great but this place was until about 1 year ago their chicken started being dry. Possibly overcooked slightly? Wouldn't order out any longer.
Cozy atmosphere, fabulous cocktails, and some of the best food I've ever had.  A perfect place to try on your next date night:)

This is not a good cheese steak. Regardless of how famous it may be, this is not a good steak. I can promise you that virtually any little corner place in Philly has a better steak than Pat's or Geno's. If a place puts cheese whiz on it instead of provolone or american cheese, you are not getting a real...

So I am here eating a cheesesteak and I am a cowboys fan and the owner of the cowboys pulls up in a black bus and the yet out to eat a cheesesteak Food was amazing Saw this place on food channel and was really excited to try it Was amazing

Came here for dinner on a Tuesday night. I arrived a little after 6:30 and it was packed. The couple ahead of me were quoted over an hour to be seated. I was dining solo on a work trip so luckily they could seat me within 10 minutes. The food was amazing! I had the raw wasabi octopus and then a ramen, delicious. They paired a Saki for me to have with it which was lovely. The food comes out very quick, I was out in less than an hour. I highly recommend but give yourself time to wait.

I'm very picky with Thai food. This place just opened barely two weeks and I decided to try it out. I have to say that I had such a pleasant experience. The service was great and the food was good. I ordered the pork chops and red curry - delicious! Then I ordered the fried ice cream for dessert. Even though I haven't tried everything on the menu I would recommend it! It all looks so good! And from what I've tasted, I really like it.
Wanted to give a shout out to the amazing bar staff, Randy, Jacob and Vala. They are hands down the best! Try 'The Other Woman'!

Awesome little corner spot! I love how from the outside it looks dark and unnoticeable but once you walk in it it's comfortable and relaxed! The decor is pretty cool! Our female bartender was wearing a mustache! Lol. The wedge salad was awesome! Very fresh. Wings were amazing. My favorite dish by far is the baked Mac and cheese! SOOOOO good!
