Some one the best Mac ad cheese I've ever had. I had a great experience at North Third! I would recommend it to anybody who's in the area looking for a fun, quaint atmosphere and yummy food!
Fun atmosphere. And hmmm that smell of chocolate is so inviting. Friendly and knowledgeable staff. Will definitely go back and recommend!!
Other than our rude waitress, this place was GREAT. Dishes came out superbly, and were delicious. We'll be back.
Simply the best pizza ANYWHERE!!!   BYOB makes for a great evening for a casual dinner.  By the way---they have some excellent salads too.
I loved this place!! It is in such a cozy and cute location. The service was amazing and the owner was so kind to my friends and me. The TNT, Happy, Dashiwaki rolls were so good.

- Went there for lunch, Dec 16, given holiday lunches in full swing, not many people. - Quiet place, good for conversation. - Food was usual - Staff was friendly - Good view of Freedom tower and world financial center - reason for 3 star would be limited generic menu for an upscale restaurant

Per Guy's recommendation on Food Network, our family had our first brunch last Saturday. All four of us ordered the waffle and wings and we really enjoyed it. The waffles were presented warm with a touch of cranberries and cinnamon butter cream? The chicken was fresh and seasoned just right! Was worth the drive!

infini-T is perhaps one of my favorite businesses in the Princeton area. Not only do they have a plethora of teas to choose from, but it also makes for a very good place to study. Try the rooibos teas if you get the chance. They also make a pretty mean guacamole if you want to snack while enjoying your tea. It tends to be a fairly quiet establishment, unlike the bustling air of a place like Small World. Be aware that there is no cell reception inside infini-T, but that is often for the best if you're trying to get work done. If you're not trying to get work done, there's Apples to Apples.
I have no idea who reviewed this place, but it was mediocre at best. Nice, friendly staff, but I won't be returning.
Maybe one the he best meals I have ever had, I had the pork chop  The staff was great .
Great food, ambience, service, location and staff--unbeatable combination!

How can you not love Lombardi's? For one thing, it was the first pizza joint in America, and they still cook their pizzas in the original brick ovens. Lombardi's defined and set the standard for pizza. The crusts are perfect -- crispy on the bottom, soft on the edges. All their  toppings are consistently fresh and tasty. Even when they're busy, service is quick, and the staff is pleasant. Lombardi's is as much an experience and a trip back in time as it is a restaurant. It's justifiably famous, and even born-and-bred New Yorkers should have been there at least once for a taste of genuine history.
Really good food. Cheap and tasty!
We had the opportunity to experience one of the best meals we've ever had. Food was outstanding, but the experience and service was even better! The next time we're in NY... we WILL be back!!!
Finally an authentic ramen restaurant.  Well priced and delicious.  Wish they were open more, but what can you do...  I highly recommend.

Great set of meatballs! I had their buffalo meatballs with the white sauce and spicy sauce. GAME CHANGER. I also appreciated their selection of beer and wine. Everyone should try out this location because it happens to be the ORIGINAL meatball shop. I shall come back for the kitchen sink next time

Best Indian food I've ever had and was extremely reasonable! I got the chicken tikka masala and it was so delicious. The naan here is also out of this world. The waiter was so nice and very attentive. Best meal I've had in a while.

My go-to place for cheap noodle soup. They also have other very good, cheap dishes. For soup, you can choose either  shaved or hand drawn noodles. I always go with the shaved because they're fatter. I wouldn't recommend anywhere else for noodle soup for this price. Service is quick and efficient. Don't be surprised if, due to the place being crowded, you're seated only inches away from other people.

Came here for lunch, took them 15 minutes to bring us menus and they don't have draft beer. Pretty sure there is only one person working. I would have left but my coworkers voted to stay. The menus are photocopied paper, not even sure if I should eat here.

They're pizza is awesome, best around here (I think). But, the service first time around could be more accurate. I don't think I've ordered something without something being wrong (delivered to the wrong place, ordering buffalo chix but getting bbq chix instead). The redeeming characteristic is they're happy to fix it. I just make sure I'm not in a rush when I order from there.

I rarely write in on restaurants, but felt compelled to do so. I have eaten here quite often as of late and now bring a group every week and the group has grown from 12-18 to 46 people last night. The staff was awesome, our regular girl is vacationing so she selected her replacement and the 2 girls got hit with a HUGE group. They handled it like pro's not one complaint. As always the food was better than average and the staff was so awesome. Julio the manager is always on the move making sure all (not just our group) are attended to. Just want to say for our group we alll give you 2 thumbs up!

I came to this place because of their positive reviews on yelp. I got beef pho with vegetables of my choice. It is very cool to see them make the noodle at the spot and they are super fast too. The staffs were super friendly as well. I ended up eating my noodle at the upstairs sitting which is super clean and relaxing. I will def recommend this place for anyone who is in a rush and want to get something good to eat!
Must go for happy hour drinks and dancing
Great place and great food! Its gluten free friendly and has gluten free beers, something that i struggle to find. My favorite dish is parsley risotto and highly recommended to try their pizzas too!

Food was good but I had a crab cake for $13.00  and a dip for 8.00 and mimosa  and tip and all I paid $35.00 ... Food was ok and the prices are to high..... I'm still in shock with the price of a small crab cake ...service was not good also ... We wanted a both to sit in and because it was 3 of us they would not accommodate us at all .. Poor service it was empty and they still refuse to sit us where we wanted ....

Hands down the best bbq place in this city. Real meats, properly marinated, smoked and barbequed for your carnal pleasure. Amazing sides (beans and sweet potatoes), good selection of beers. In fact this place is soooo good you can easily overlook hipster infestation.
Perhaps I am so fond of the traditional kongfu style (小籠包) and my expectation was too high. Kind of disappointed when I really tried it. But generally a good place for some food.
Excellent quiche

If you love spicy Jamaican food then this is the place for you! I think this is the best Island food in NY and it is worth the trip for authentic Jamaican food. I took my whoe family last week and there was something that we al ordered and enjoyed! Try the fish dishes and also the patties...ENJOY!

Being a San Franciscan I've been spoiled by chicken and waffles from a number of places. But here in the LES Sweet Chick takes a new spin with awesome signature waffles and chicken recipes. You have to try the Parmesan Chicken and Waffles!

There were 15 of us going here for a Christmas lunch. It was excellent. The waitress was spot on, the food was delicious, and the place was clean and welcoming. It was great to be able to make a reservation and have real pub food instead of the microwaved dreck at the Chili's type places. We will see you again Grasshopper Too!

Alva was great! We had the mussels and the short rib entree. The mussels were plump and the short ribs were tender and delicious with a yummy sauce. The service was excellent. This was such a surprise gem to find in Newark, but I would definitely recommend it!
One of my favorite places in the neighborhood. The pasta is freshly made. My favorite Veal Milanese is the best. Good wine selection. Overall recommended.
Great food and atmosphere. Worth the hassle of looking for parking.
Good food.great atmosphere what else can you ask. Home like feeling makes this place special.

Visited with the family (4 children) on a Friday night.  It was very quiet in the restaurant.  We were the first group to sit and only two others say the entire time we were there.  There was a healthy take-out business though.   The restaurant is very clean and nicely decorated. We sat at a large coffee table with a nice sofa and some interesting chairs.   Ordering is at the register. The choices are many.  My wife and I really enjoyed the clam chowder and house salad (mesclun with blue cheese and bacon!).  We each had a panini (Cubano and the Steak).  Both were very good.  The kids had a grilled ham and cheese, pizza and chicken nuggets. The kids food was excellent and $4 each (including drink and side).  What a deal!  Restaurant is BYO and has wine glasses, cork screws, frosted mugs and buckets of ice!   The staff was very nice. Food was brought to the table and tables were bussed.   We find it to be a great place to get a high quality meal at a reasonable price in a comfortable setting.  Will definitely be back!

Well I came to Saigon Pho, for the first time today, and although I only had to things the were both very good. I had the Beef Satay as an appetizer $6.95, it was good it came on a skewer and served with a sauce, the beef was really tender and had good flavor. Then I had a large Rare Beef Pho, which is a soup with clear noodles, some aromatics and the beef; its served with a side dish of shoots, and sliced jalapeños. I really enjoyed it. It was different. The restaurant itself is very tastefully done, they did a nice job.

First time in Philadelphia and I'm amazed! This place was awesome. A little overwheling, but that just means you get to try something new everyday. If I lived here I would absolutely shop at the farmers market and other shops. Everything looked so fresh and delicious. Very cool place. A must see (and eat!)
If you pass by Philly, you have to stop here. Coming from the old Europe, for me USA is not an historical country. But this place is rich of the local history and you can feel it.
I order delivery from this place sometimes. It's aight but usually super slow.

Absolutely amazing, plentiful, delicious food.  Service is efficient and friendly. The wait can be lengthy since they don't take reservations, but enjoy the free wine they supply waiting customers, outside and in. Our faves:  octopus appetizer, fried cheese, peasant salad, broiled scallops, sardines (yes, there are bones, but fillet those suckers and have at them, carefully, they're amazing), LEMON POTATOES. We always take home leftovers, and it's all great the second time around, too. Completely reasonable prices.  Go there!  GO THERE RIGHT NOW!
This is the best place you can ever be in Jackson heights. Great staff great food and most of all great music. Just experience this place for once and you will be addicted to this place.

Better options for the price and service offered here. Food is good but not worth the wait, or the awful service accompanying it. I'd recommend other spots in new haven before heading here. Might be back because friends seem to love it.

I've only come here drunk but I remember the shrimp and chorizo and the burger to be real good. The kitchen's open til late which is awesome, since this area really only has bars that are open at 1am.

I just left, and am in a cab as I'm writing this. Everything was great until they told me they were cutting me off. Despite the fact that I was there less than colleagues and drank less than colleagues I was told I would not be served anymore. I don't know if it had to do with the fact that I ordered for others or the fact that I had recently lost my voice- but either way I was mortified. Even when I had a conversation with the manager in which I explained that I had ordered drinks for others, lost my voice, and only had 2 drinks she told me she could not serve me for my own safety. This is the most embarrassing experience I've ever had.

I ordered a salmon dinner. It is delicious! Everything about this place, from interior design to service to food, is excellent, much better rendition compared to the old Montclair Station. (It used to be very loud due to lack of sound insulation.) however I gave it 4 stars because I was not asked how I would like my salmon cooked. I'm sure for best practice reasons, the chef cooked the salmon through. Not my personal preference, but it still tasted very good. I was also impressed with the inclusion of salmon skin. If I had the option, I would've given them 4.5 stars.

Hate the ordering system. Wanted a beer while I was figuring out what to eat. Asked the barman if I could get the beer I ordered while I was deciding and the answer was "no". It then snuck in a tip on the bill that I wasn't aware of until my receipt was emailed. What am I tipping?  An ordering system I don't like?  I thought tipping was based on service. Beer selection is good and they have Sculpin. That's why they get any points. Steak tartare was decent but soup was cold. I tried complaining to the iPad but it doesn't seem to care.  This place could be ok if they get rid of the ordering system.

Everyone goes gaga over the crispy okra and the pani puri so decided to try it. The okra was decent but the pani puri was a major disappointment to an indian. I found this bar to be extremely expensive for serving run of the mill food which you can get for 1/3rd the price at other indian restaurants. The drink i ordered also was not as boozy as i expected so that was also a disappointment. Had heard a lot of good things about it but don't think their food or drinks make sense to my indian tastebuds.

Three stars because the people there are very nice otherwise I would have rated them a two. I ordered a simple sandwich, a sausage parm.  I've had them at many places and this is the only place I've had that it's a hybrid sausage parm/sausage peppers & onions. It seems to me they cook one batch for either sandwich, a bit lazy I think.
Had a drink at the bar.  Bartender was good and chatty after we got his attention.  Pretty bar, would go back and try the food.

Great restaurant with great service, atmosphere and delicious food. I've came here several times and anything I  would order would be a hit. Whether it be halibut to polenta to pasta to salad.  My personal recommendation would be the Halibut special and the cheese ravioli in tomato sauce.

Hands down the best restaurant in Philadelphia. Sally and her team are amazing! The service is excellent, the new location is gorgeous and the food is always on point. I wish I could give them a million stars!

Man! They serve big portions for only $6. Try the Chicken and Lamb with rice combo with the white sauce and a pinch of the HOT SAUCE. By HOT SAUCE..yes trust me it's spicy. Also, try the Chicken Sandwich..meat, rice stuffed with pita. Thumbs up.
Chavelas is cool. Weird service sometimes

I leave very close to Mood and it is one of my favorite places in West Philly. The Salad Chaat is my fave and it's even better when you add chicken. The rice pudding they keep in the fridges opposite of the counter is killer.

This place is awesome! They have great service and make us feel like part of the family. The owner is always around and he's so nice. The food is delicious and they make sure you have a great time. The service is impeccable and the portions are awesome. If you come to little Italy, make sure you come by here.

Went to Raymond's for breakfast with high expectations coming from Yelp but was disappointed. I was in the mood for some simple diner fare, but the food prep was executed poorly. My order: Eggs scrambled with cheddar cheese, potatoes, an english muffin, a side of bacon and coffee. The eggs were the only thing to be served well and came out well done. the potatoes were on the edge of uncooked, the english muffin was barely toasted and almost cold, the bacon was very very done, not burnt but was like eating pork rinds. The coffee tasted burnt. It may be that the items exclusive to Raymond's are better (such as the chorizo cheese grits), but missing the staples and being charged an arm and a leg for it left me with a bad taste in my mouth. The service was average, nothing bad to note.

Fabulous decor, great location, & amazing food. The only reason this place doesn't get five stars from me is because of the slow service. Also, don't be scared of the prices their portions make it worth it!
One of the very few places I can order new things because I know that whatever I order will be absolutely delicious. I LOVE this place.

Great Victorian holiday ambiance. Ornate and decorative. The staff are a little tightly wound; I brought in outside food and drink. It was immediately brought to my attention that neither were allowed. I politely requested that I be able to eat my food, especially since I was with a party of five who were going to indulge in alcoholic drinks. The manager stepped in and relayed the same information that the waiter did. I put my food away and ordered off the menu. I was the only one in my party to order food, which took 30 minutes to arrive - much longer than my party cared to sit and drink. I can't bring my own food but if I order off the menu, my party and I are held hostage by the wait of my order? My mistake was thinking it was a dive bar in which I could sneak a bite of my own meal while my comrades ordered drinks. Not that kind of place.

Experienced by far the worst server I have ever had in a very long time!! A few friends and I decided to grab dinner before leaving Philadelphia for the holidays and we decided on Amada since we enjoyed the whole ambiance, food and drinks the last time we were here. When we arrived for our reservation at this establishment, the hostess greeted us with a warm smile and offered to take our coats and sat us at our table right away.  Then, after getting settled at our table, Karey, the server/waitress, came to offer us water.  After we ordered the sangría blanca, a few tapas and the paella valenciana, the waitress/ server did not visit our table and asked to see if there was a possibility that we needed anything else or even how the food and drinks were.  We thought this was just the type of service she provided, but during the whole time in which we were waitress-less, we noticed that she was selectively not visiting our table.  After we noticed this stark contrast in service we asked a nice gentlemen who was bring out food to another table for a manager.  After speaking with the manager and explaining our horrible experience with the waitress, the manager was very attentive to our concerns with the waitress and handled the situation in a very professional manner.   Overall, the ambiance of this establishment is great and not too loud.  The sangría blanca was very flavorful and pretty on point in terms of sangría I have had in España and the paella valenciana was by far the best paella I have had in the states. Wish we could have had better service to accompany the wonderful and scrumptious food and drinks.  So, if you do not want to experience horrible service that was selectively delegated by the waitress, then avoid Karey.

Atmosphere upscale yet casual; great for family or couple who appreciate great food.   Portions were large and food quality was excellent.  The carbonara was possibly the best I ever had.   My husbands steak came with full plate: asparagus potato croquette & beautiful large mushroom cap.   This place is not close to home, but we can't wait to go back.

Very disappointed. Two pizzas and a salad--$$56 bucks! including their "old smokey"- shoulda been called "old salty ", truly inedible!- and we eat anything! At least the beer takeout store across the street is excellent.

Been here several times, sometimes when it's a small crowd not such a long wait for food. The food  I would consider very good for a "quick" meal, however the last couple times I have been  I almost got ill waiting so long for the food I was ready to leave without it. Not worth the wait, considering it's not cheap and there are plenty of great options in Burlington.

Came here for my sisters birthday (my sister and her friends love this place) LOVED IT. Being from a Spanish background it's hard to find authentic Spanish food, this place is good! The staff is very friendly too! I recommend the guacamole!!

This is a small noodle shop. There are about 12 seats at the counter and 3 tables there. I believe you will have to wait at any time of the day, I waited about 30 minutes in the rain. There is a sign up sheet and you will have to go through waiting people to sign your name. I choose a spicy noodle and it was worth the wait. Each noodle was between $11 and $13. I thought it was reasonable in New York City, but they only accept cash. Most of the staff are Japanese and truly great Japanese noodle shop. I will visit again when I come back to New York.

Just got back from my first time at Luca's. Cannot say enough about it. Everything was fantastic! Our waiter was very professional and knowledgeable and described all our dishes in great detail. The bread basket was a goodc starter. The prosciutto wrapped figs and fried mozzarella appetizers were awesome. The chocolate stuffed (with butternut squash)  agnolotti was indescribable! If you are a chocolate and pasta lover this is nirvana!  The other main courses were equally delicious. The marscapone cannoli drizzled with orange zest was the perfect end to a perfect evening. I highly recommend Luca's.
This was a really cool spot to meet up with some coworkers to get some food and drinks while watching the game. Great atmosphere and the staff was nothing but pleasant! Will definitely be back!
The pad Thai is very good and the service is fast. One of the best places for Thai food in the area. I wish they were on grub hub!
Friendly service, quick drinks. $3 beers before 9pm.
Great food and surprisingly economical.

I just gave my grandson his 8 birthday party with Games2u and boy was he so surprised. His friends enjoyed it so much and Alan was a wonderful host. My other grandson is now interested in his party for May. Thanks for making my grandson and his friends very, very happy.

This place is so tacky. I walked into this restaurant earlier this week and presented the manager with a 2 for 1 coupon from Entertainment.com. The coupon allowed me to purchase one meal (up to $9) and get another meal free. The manager told me the coupon was for dine-in only. I was OK with that. I ordered a sandwich. After I finished eating the sandwich, the manager walked up and told me I was not getting a 2nd sandwich because the coupon was for full meals only, not sandwiches. He said I forgot to read the fine print. After I payed for the sandwich, he handed the coupon back and told me to use it next time. Trust me, there isn't going to be a next time.

I'm not a person that usually will wait an hour and a half for a spot in a restaurant but I became a convert for the Spotted Pig. The Spotted Pig is a great date spot and I can see why Piper Chapman on OITNB wanted to pay it a visit on her break from prison. This is definitely where I would want to come. The shoe string fries with Rosemary were amazing. Don't be intimated by the large pile, you will finish them. The burger was mind blowing - juicy and buttery with just the right amount of blue cheese and a perfectly toasted bun. The servers give great beer recommendations to boot! I saved half my burger for dinner the next day and was seriously upset when I realized I forgot to put in into the fridge after returning home in the wee hours of the morning. The memory of the burger was so good that I put serious consideration into whether heating the burger would kill the bacteria that may have flourished over the last ten hours at room temperature but decided I'll just have to make my way back soon. There's a great easy-going outdoor bar around the corner to pass the time while you wait.

Great byob that's on the smaller side (what you see from the window is what you get), with some great dishes, that you can turn into a great next day leftover by ordering a side of glass noodles or extra rice.  Waitstaff is very friendly and helpful.

Shit. I don't want to write a bad review, because I LOVE this place.....but apparently it is only good for dinner. Brunch..is...awful. My god. Just....no.  Trust me when I say that I *LOVE* this place for a late-night romantic dinner and that all the DINNER food is good. The brunch? Well, the space itself looks weird, dark, and empty in the stark morning light.  The music is way too intense for brunch time.  No body is really there.  And the food....over priced and my fried chicken was BLOODY. The waffle was gross and flavorless- I literally ate one berry from my plate and moved on to the fried chicken and took a bite.  It was lukewarm and didn't taste like anything.  Like the absence of flavor.  So weird.  Anyway, being a trooper and also starving- I started to cut into it and I saw red.  Like big streaks of red all in the middle. HELL. NO. I should have complained.  I didn't touch my food and left my TWO bloody chicken pieces on top of my untouched waffle and still had to pay. They should really just not be open for brunch.  I say this with love- don't ruin your flawless DINNER reputation with a shitty brunch.  It's not worth it.

Best vodka rigatoni I've ever had. The tomato pies are really good too. I can't think of anything that I haven't enjoyed there (I admit that I mostly stick to pastas). Table service is great because the place is small, and take out is timely too. As far as the building, what everyone else says is true. It's outdated, but I think it makes it feel homey. It doesn't affect the food, and the chef always comes out to say hi and ask how everything is. If you're looking for trendy, this isn't it, but if you're looking for a great locally-owned italian restaurant, Mama Rosa's is top notch.

Great, authentic northern Chinese grilled skewers! If you've been to Beijing or other northern areas of China, you'd know the smell and taste of those cumin fragrant lamb skewers. This place delivers the flavors and taste of those same tasty street snacks. So glad I found this place! A tasty snack that you don't find too often outside of China. And the owners were extremely friendly too!
Had the vegetable pizza. Ingredients were fresh and crust was really good.. the servers were very friendly.  Went in jeans and a tshirt and felt a little out of place but overall good spot.
Strong sangria!!! The calamari and cheese balls are delicious! I always revived good service but sometimes when it's packed it can be a little slow. Try the sangria!!
We had such a great time! The place has a ton of character and if you are lucky to sit by the bar, the man behind was very knowledgable and friendly. I would definitely go back.

Had one great experience with their gluten free pizza, the last three times however have been horrible. We just ordered and were charged for a Margherita pizza which was supposed to have fresh mozzarella, basil and sliced tomato. Instead we received a cold plain cheese pizza that looks like charcoal. It really makes me sad the the service and pizza here has gone downhill. Before I found out I had Celiacs I used to eat their regular pizza all the time and had little to no issues. I most likely will not try to give them another chance, three times too many.

This was our first time at the this place and it w a s fabulous. I ordered the fried calamari for an appetizer . It was  served with dressed red onions and tomatoes. The calamari was perfectly cooked and extremely tender and was absolutely  fantastic. My wife ordered the chicken empanados and they we're equally  delicious. The main course was rack of lamb. I tell you this was the best lamb I have ever eaten. Cooked to perfection and absolutely the most flavorful lamb I've ever tasted. The sauteed vegetables that came with the entre were also unbelievably delicious. This a small but nicely decorated dinning venue. I think I counted 12 tables. It had softly playing music and considered it a very intimate atmosphere. This is not an inexpensive place but  when the food and service is that good it is worth it. I don't eat out that much but with food tasting this  good I will make an effort to eat here at least once a month and maybe more. I can't believe a restaurant of this quality exist in Lake Hiawatha I guarantee you will not be disappointed  if you go and I can't wait until I return
Good taste. We loved the Mediterranean pizza. The only gripe was that they would not accept the yelp check in offer. Even the manager was not aware of any such offer and asked us for a coupon code.

My friends and I had the best time! Our server Sarah S. was great and knew exactly what we needed and made beer recommendations for us. Definitely request her and try the curly fries! The happy hour specials were on par! Definitely coming back soon!

As for the Pizza served at the Godfather, I couldn't hardly understand what the big deal about it was. I'm sure the Seafood and other meal options are good for I haven't tried it. I came here with my sister and old man, because my sister was craving a good old, nice, fast serving of pizza. It was a place we've always seen and thought it was another Asian restaurant along the strip. I had the Sicilian, and I was rather disappointed because the crust was burnt and the bottom crust was tough and hard. My sister and dad had a Buffalo slice, something that you would expect to give a kick in your mouth but they were also disappointed. The pizza was floppy and dry. Now of course, I thought, wow, the Village Trattoria in South Orange would never serve Buffalo slices, or any slices for that matter, in this manner. Above all, it was overpriced($4.50 for one buffalo slice) and shameful in flavor. I did however like the people who attended us at the counter. Nice people lol
I've actually only ever ordered the Kimchee Bokum Rice with Pork to go but that has always been delicious and from passing through, I can say the interior of the restaurant is very cozy.

Beautiful hidden gem. With it's otherworldly charm, one feels like you're a part of history in this previous glass factory. The ambiance is lovely, the staff is equally as charming as the space. The open kitchen is really cool. The infamous rabbit was not on the menu when I was there however my table had one dish of every meat and it was to die for. Excellent food. Lovely space. I recommend it simply for the ambiance alone.

Really great noodles in pork soy sauce. They give you a large portion and these are really fresh. A clear standout in Philly Chinatown and a good choice for a stop near Reading Terminal Market. You could even bring the noodles over to the tables in the market if you want the real Philly experience.

Great Thai for very reasonable price, especially for NYC. Cocktails were $6 and beers for $3, can't beat that! The atmosphere was great for a date or just a dinner out with friends! Would recommend! Take a couple blocks walk and get away from Times Square!
No one's pizza is as good as Zavino. I feed my addiction monthly and last night had the pear salad and polpettini pizza. I love the cozy atmosphere, the wonderful aroma, and the friendly service.

Great margaritas and guacamole! Any drink you order will be delicious! Have not really tried the menu other than the veggie chili which was great! Already have another date with the girls for drinks! See you soon!
Get the crab fries.

Good food decent service. Good beer selection.  Even though they gave me a bud light instead of a kona. An I called them out and they still try to play it off as a kona I'm a beer expert I know the difference. I watch them pour another bud light into it an say it was kona again. Other than that excellent place.

Had an incredible meal and experience at this restaurant. My fiance and I did the chef tasting, and they were very accommodating to food allergies. They also let us choose the entrees we wanted. The food was delicious! We had a play to catch at 8, so they made sure we were finished our meal by 730. I highly recommend this restaurant.

This food was decent but the building itself was decrepit and should be condemned. I dont know who their landlords are but i plan to find out. I didnt want my daughter eating their food after i saw the bathroom and the kitchen. Completey filthy...update..it it run by a starrs inc and a co pany named biscuitts inc that have since gone out of business out of new haven. Landlord is deana reichentahl

I absolutely love Stamna!  My fiancé and I  have been coming here for quite a while now and can't get enough.  First of all, eating there is better than take out because they give you this delicious grilled bread with olives right when you sit down, and it's incredible.  I usually get the chicken souvlaki platter - the sandwich is big and tasty and comes with a greek salad and your choice of potatoes (the lemon potatoes are to die for, but if you like something more fried get the Greek fries which are also tasty).  The portions are pretty big, I've never finished an entire meal and always have some left over to take home.   Overall: Great fresh food, prices can be a little high but it's well worth it because of the quality and the large portions...and their tzatziki sauce is AWESOME! Everyone who works there is has always been friendly to us, and the service is quick.  The enclosed porch seating area is my favorite, it's nice and heated in winter and cool in the summer.   Oh and it's BYOB, so that's a plus!
Best beef chow fun and fried dumbling!!!!  Not a good place for Dim sum it's very limited.
Had a blast here. Great beers on tap. Great pretzels, fries and Sausages.  Good music. Love this place.
Good food. Good service. Good drinks. Great place to wat and hang out with friends. Make sure to order the hush puppies and jambalaya

Hidden gem in the heart of a neighborhood whose only other options are pubs or tourist traps. Great beer and wine selection and solid food. It's a long bar so you can usually find a stool or at least a little room to call your own. Will keep coming back.
2 donuts , small and a large coffee  for $9 ? Beiler's Donuts at Reading terminal market have better and cheaper donuts .

I've been a frequent customer for the past two years, willing to overlook some shortcomings because I liked the concept, the commitment to healthy food and the experimentation with different ingredients/flavors. But the quality is inconsistent, the food isn't always fresh and everything is overpriced. While I like knowing the frittatas are made with fresh eggs, I'm really mad when I get egg shell in almost every one I buy.

We were walking around SoHo and we just came across this place without even reading any reviews about it, the service was amazing and the food was flavorful. The vegetarian Lasagna was Da Bomb , and the dessert was ridiculously good!!
Moved to 32 on west 32 street!!!! Great place. Nice atmosphere. Soup was very tasty and big. Chicken pot was very special. Restrooms quite clean.

I felt the the execution of the pre fixe menu for this season was not worthy of a Michelin Star. I feel this restaurant would do well as a casual night out type place, but I can't see returning guest from the neighborhood for a pre fixe menu. The staff was super friendly and the restaurant itself had a cozy ambiance.
Entire pie of pizza was undercooked and the sauce was dripping everywhere. Atmosphere: 8 Pizza: 4
First time visiting Vermont. Very family friendly with a great ambiance. I highly recommend the medicine wheel Flatbread. I'd say it's found a new place in my heart right next to Brooklyn Pizza!
Love the gluten-free options here.  So many things to choose from (including desserts) and they even have gluten-free bread for the beginning of the meal.   Service has always been great.

Just ate lunch at nosh borough and it was awesome. Finally found a real nice place for ordering lunch. Will soon be back to try the rest of the menu. I thought I had to go to Brooklyn to get stuff as good.
Cool bartenders, cool atmosphere, and the honey sriracha wrap is DELICIOUS.
Food is Excellent. Love the chuletas, mofongo, rice, etc!! You can't go wrong with anything.
Fabulous experience. Food was delicious, service was excellent and hostess was so friendly and helpful. I would definitely go back. The lemon cheesecake was amazing!

One of my favorite places to eat and shop in the City!  The fair trade organic produce market is a favorite of mine, in addition to the Dutch shops, tea and coffee stores.  They seriously have the best produce (greens) I have ever tasted.  They also carry grass fed organic milk in glass bottles at fair prices.

The food was good, place homey. Wasn't  impressed with the speed of serving food and getting bills. Been there more than once, and the best to be said about their service pleasantry and speed is one word: inconsistency.

This is a place to return to since the menu changes almost daily. Food is fantastic and not your every day fare. First came with my wife and split a striped bass. Came back a second time with friends and split some of the appetizers - pig croquettes,
Taïm's falafel is unmatched anywhere else. Perfectly spiced and never dry, with all the toppings & sides. The red falafel is my fave, but all are yummy. Excellent smoothies, too!
Very high quality food and varied selection. The shrimp appetizer was spiced perfectly and the chicken entrée was very tender and flavorful. Everything exceeded expectations. Portions were large too.
Simply the BEST coffee shop in Northern Liberties.  Customer service is top notch, unlike in One Shot.
Food was fine, and you could find some value on the menu. I was on expense account and didn't order cheap, but the whole time I felt I was treated indifferently. It's not like they were busy.

Churrasco is awesome and Jose the owner is always on point.  I've never been a fan of skirt steak but the way they do the Churrasco is awesome.  It is always cooked right and is really tasty.  Baby octopus is great as well.

Ambiance is great.  But, it may be that people are so desperate to experience a superior meal in this town, that they over rate The Pine.  The food is not exceptional, nor is the menu all that interesting.  My short ribs were dry and that was a bummer as I was looking to it, as were the vegetables on the side.  My other three companions said their meal was "good" but not "bravo" ..... Best to go for many fewer, but exceptional choices, which change every few months.

One of the better Thai places around this area.  Has become a goto place for me in terms of Thai food for the Plainsboro area.  Their menu is not limited to the typical Thai dishes.  The service is quick and the food is on-point in terms of pretty much anything you order.  From Pad Thai to the variety of rice or noodle entrees to their specialty dishes, chances are you won't go wrong with whatever you decide to order.  My favorite is the Crispy Basil Chicken.  The proportion of the entree's are reasonable.   They don't have a free-refill soda policy, which is a bummer and probably the only issue I have with this place.
I love pasta and I'm so glad we decided to eat here. My boyfriend and I love it! The ricotta and spinish ravioli was delicious! The bread was okay and I wish I had dessert.

Aside from the high prices I was a fan....until they went ahead and took just about everything that I loved off of the menu.  Fried pickles? Gone.  Breakfast Tacos? Noticeably absent.   I live a few blocks away but I definitely won't be visiting as much.  Shame.

We had our holiday office party of 30 at the Trading Post last Wednesday night and it was spectacular! we began drinks at the bar downstairs overseen by really terrific bartenders making great drinks and then moved up to the private dining room for dinner and more revelry.  The menu for our group was really great...we had a choice of salmon, steak or vegetable risotto and EVERYTHING was perfectly cooked and presented. The wines were fabulous and the service was as well.  We continue to get compliments from our staff, one week later, on what a great venue this was for our holiday party, super service and how delicious the food was.  We turned on a lot of our staff to visiting again!

First time here, and I don't think I'll be back. The servers are so careless that I wouldn't even give them a $0 tip! If I didn't call them every time I needed something, they would have totally forgotten that they had a customer in there.

Oh my god. Where do I start with this place. I LOVE IT! The mole chicken enchiladas are on point! Our server is always so nice! Very friendly ! He had a strand of white hair lmao sorry I forgot his name! AMAZING! The environment is very chill and quiet. Good proportions of food, I just simply love it! If I could add an extra star I'd do it!

This place has potential. The wait staff was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu and overall polite and helpful. My husband tried the curry night buffet and seemed to enjoy most of the items. Although, he was skeptical initially since the entire buffet area was quite small and it didn't seem like there was much to choose from. I was more keen on trying out the dosa so I ordered it from their menu. We took a samosa chaat appetizer,  which was good. For my main course, I ordered the onion rava masala dosa. When it came, it was very soft, undone, and stuck to my plate. The chutneys and sambar were very good though. But the fact that the dosa wasn't well made ruined the entire course for me. If only it were crispy! I know what a good dosa is... I am a South Indian and make them quite frequently for my family. I believe the chef is a South Indian, and therefore there is no reason why should have served it like this. I appreciated the owner making her way around the tables and asking everyone how their orders were. After some chit chat, I subtly mentioned to her that my dosa is very soft and stuck to the plate, since she asked for suggestions/ ways they could do better. However, she didn't really address the issue and rather casually thwarted off the topic. She insisted (a few times) that we hit a "like" on her restaurant page in Facebook. I know she wants to get the word out there, but first impressions are important! Overall, I think I would be willing to give this place another try, but probably not anytime soon. The next time I'm here and my dosa is actually well-made, maybe I will hit a like on their page!

Ever since it opened, this has been one of my favorite spots in Greenpoint; I just love the pizzas! They remind me of the pizza I enjoyed on my many trips to Italy...but better in a way, as the ingredients that top these pizzas are a delightful mix of the unexpected! The atmosphere is dark and romantic and you get your pizza right out of the brick oven that's on display. It's really nice that the owner is almost always there, and he stops by the tables to have little chats to make sure everyone's enjoying themselves. I highly recommend it.
Interesting take on healthy fast casual. You really cannot go wrong here!

I can't wait to have a real Lunch here. I stopped in yesterday after shopping at Termini's across the street. Did not have lunch yet, but just wanted a little something. Last time I was here, It was just a little cafe, small bites. The place was packed. Everyone had  gorgeous plates of Italian Food, wine glasses in hand. I said I was one, the owner took me to the counter. I told him I just wanted a little something, did not know it grew into a full fledged restaurant. He told me to sit down, take my coat off and have a bowl of soup. So sweet! A treasure. Only in S Philly!
A visit to Alice's Arbor is worth it just to spend time with Dominique. The food is good too.
Roll up your sleeves and dive into the wings.  Could be the best in the city.  With a pitcher of beer, you can finish a 25 wing order by yourself.

This place is an emblem of my adolescence. Now, many years later (and much more mature), I am still transported back to those days but enjoy their delicious falafel, wrapped in a warm pita bread with lettuce, hummus, tahini and hot sauce just as much.
Best fried chicken in Montclair. Would totally recommend to anyone that lives in the Montclair area.
Great spot for great food and a nice ambience. The patatas bravas, octopus, and coconut flan are especially delicious!
This place provide very traditional and typical Korean food, to midnight! !! Last night several friends went there after 1 am , the restaurant still full of people
Nice bar but overrated. Nothing extra ordinary. One u Kaur thing is that they serve some finger food with cocktails for free.

Going here is half about getting some food and half about "people-watching".  There's always something interesting or crazy going on, especially if you go at night.  The service is fine and grub is always hearty. I recommend this diner if you're on the west side!

Went to a show at the Prudential Center and most of the other restaurants in the areas had long lines. We were able to get a table without any issue. We ordered a regular tomato pie and we ordered a medium pie with mushroom. I'm used to very good pizza (NYC and Brooklyn) and I wasn't too impressed with Mercato. The sauce was bland and the pies needed some sort of additional flavoring. Somewhat disappointed but the food was enough to satisfy a group of 5. The waitstaff was very slow. One of my party members got a soda and was only able to get a refill once since the waitress never came over.

I was not impressed at all. They took forever to serve my food and when I finally got my meal it was cold. I told the waiter it was cold and he brought it back warmer but it was black. It looked like charcoal. The rice was also disgusting. And on top of everything my meal was very pricey. I've been sitting in here for 3 hours. I give this place a thumbs down. I will never come here again and I don't recommend anyone to come here.

If you really want the best Korean food you have to go. My favorite dish is "Galbi Jim" theire side dishes are really good. The best waitress is Katie she is awesome and Sam is really nice and funny. The atmosphere is really good and it feels authentic as well!

Oh God! Best drinks I have had in my lifeeeee!! Bartenders arethe best I've seen in a long time, and the food is pretty good too, so what else to say? The steak is amazing and the potatos as well. Didn't really like the oysters, but everything else i have tried it pretty down to the point. Again I got to say, hats down to the bartenders! it is not too big, which I like, but it gets pretty crowded so be sure to save yourself a seat on time!!

Love love love this place! So glad a great sushi place opened up nearby. My husband and I have enjoyed the food, the presentation and the service. The staff is so great and accommodating. Definitely should come check them out!
Love this restaurant! The food is so delicious , I have been to several Peruvian restaurants and this one is on my top 3.

I went to the market for the second time. There are lots of places to eat and purchase fresh fruit and produce. It is crowded especially during the holiday seasons. overall, I like reading terminal market and will come back when I back to philly.

Service there was great! The two servers were amazing at making me feel good even with the crowd. Food was amazing! Elotes were delicious with lots of mayo! I ordered the shrimp tacos with tostones, they were not cheap on the guac and the shrimp was AMAZING! With a great pitcher of sangria, I'll be come back!
Great taste, nice variety.
Everything is so tasty. What do they put in the butter that makes it better than regular butter? Pizza is so yummy. Service is very slow.

On 12/23 I took my family to this retaurant before going to a show. Everything started out great. We ordered appetizers that came out in a reasonable amount of time and were very good. After that everything went down hill fast. The main courses came out next. All dishes were room temperature at best. My son ordered one of their veal dishes and they gave him Rigatoni instead. After a little arguing they finally agreed to make what he ordered. We all now waited for his food to come out. By the time it did all of our food went from room temperature to cold. I ordered a full portion of Fettuccini Alfredo which I was going to share with my son. The full portion would fill a small salad plate. My daughter's Squid Inked pasta was mush, over over cooked. The waiter kept banging hard into my seat every time he would walk by without an excuse me or apology. The staff made no attempt to apologize for the poor service and the poor quality of food. They must have recognized their screw ups however because on a party of 5 where the tip is never figured in they made a point to give themselves 20%. I did not make a big issue of our poor dining experience out of fear we would miss our show. I will definitely not go back.

Went there last night for an event. The place is really nice and comfortable- I absolutely love what they did with it. Crowd was good, food was delish, and the drinks were great! I recommend this place to anyone looking for a good night out in a great location. The atmosphere is very chillaxed and classy at the same time.
Delicious! Best tasting Thai delivery in New Haven for sure. The staff is super sweet and accommodating to vegans and carnivores alike
I would say give a try. The menu items are good Kai Chi is my favs from the appetizers. The ambience is good and can get loud when it's packed. Overall I will go here again...

Very small and insanely popular. No bookings are taken so it took a few visits before we got in but certainly worth the effort. Great authentic French dishes well prepared. And hooray. .....great coffee!!!!! Will  be going back again!!!
Amazing bartenders! Their skate is DELICIOUS! Their beet salad is superb! The salmon platter tastes amazing and looks beautiful!

Dinner review: Just moved to Sunnyside, thought we'd give the highest rated restaurant in Sunnyside a try. I was dissapointed. Ordered hanger steak, scallops, and korean bbq wraps for 2 people. Portions are small with Manhattan prices. Air of pretentiousness with the ambiance. Feels like they are just trying too hard to be Manhattan Chic. I'm not a big fan of paying for ambiance, and I felt like thats what I did. Plating was pretty, which I never care about with my food. Not my cup of tea, when I'm in Queens, I want great soul touching food, big portion, at a good price. Of the things we ordered though, Hanger Steak was pretty good, but then again it is a small piece of steak at 21 bucks, and I was starving.

I came with my parents about an hour after they opened, it was empty, so the staff was very attentive. The specials are written and shown on a blackboard with the actual prices, no surprises will be seen on the bill. The platter of meats was great and large in quantity for its price compared to most places. The pasta presentation in a pan is different and the homemade quality of the pasta is great. Lastly, the tiramisu was small but great too.

I love Mario's La Mozza wine. The Deli has great mortadella.  Brought the family to the Seafood Reastaurant.  How can they mess up fried calamari?? Tasted like they used spoiled buttermilk. Will go to the wine shop if in the area. Tourist place Will go to authentic places from now on.
awesome drinks and the bar tender Josh is the best!!
Wide array of food! Can't go wrong with a dinics roast pork or an Amish breakfast. The wait in line is worth it so don't get frustrated.
The lasagna was tasty. The mint iced tea also had a lovely flavor.   Gigantic portions

well its always the burger its always the table upstairs behind the curtain Its always the cool staff Its always the great drinks And its always ***** 5 stars Ken Friedman and April Bloomfield take a bow
Delish!!!!! Best hummus in town.. Homemade by talented Israeli chef. Healthy too! Awesome juice bar  :)

Absolutely fabulous place.  I have never had haggis before, having heard all kinds of jokes about how bad it is.  Boy am I glad that I decided to try it out.  It was delicious.  I also had a bottle of the best hard cider that I have ever tasted.  My family and I plan to always dine here whenever we are in the area. My only request is that the kitchen stay open later than 9:00 PM on weekdays.

One of my favorite restaurants in NB! Delicious, consistent homemade Lebanese food. I always get the chicken kebab sandwich (the hummus is amazing!) and some rice pilaf. Food takes a little while to make but you can be sure it's always made fresh. I also really like their new location, it's much easier to get to!
Correction
Great montaditos!! My daughter loved the chocolate bread and the pepper who works there! I love " Elías TINTO DE VERANO
The service was fantastic and the service was incredible. Definitely recommend this place! Can't wait to go back.

Yamada sushi is amazing, I have been coming here for over 13 years and the food is wonderful! The fish is so fresh, and the service is great. Every time I try something different their food never ceases to amaze me. Their special rolls, chicken teriyaki and appetizers are excellent. I highly recommend coming here if you want fresh sushi.
Great Thai food and the staff is always friendly to me. Don't ask for "hot" unless you want it REALLY hot! they will accommodate you if you like it mild or medium heat.

Chicken was so dry it was next to impossible to cut it, let alone eat it. The amount of rice in the dish was little, as if child's portion. The waitress asked how's the food during my struggle eating the chicken, I told her honestly that it's dry. The old lady sitting next to me confirmed it, she was eating salad with chicken in it. The waitress asked do you want me to bring you some sause to make it easier to eat that chicken? I said can you ask the to cook this dish again but this time without overcooking? She said, "no, he's gonna cook it the same way, trust me you're not gonna like it", while taking that dish away from me. "This is what you tell your customers?", said I. It was my first time there. I was left with no choice but to get up and leave.

Well, let's start with the positive. Really nice location. Attractive interior and good service. It just looked like it would be great! Sadly, it wasn't. My mother, a friend and I visited on a Friday night around 7:00 pm. We were the only ones in the place. This was a BAD omen. I choose a burger called the fire expecting something flavorful and juicy and for my side, sweet potato chips. My friend had the same and my mother choose the sliders. The food came out quickly and looked appetizing enough. Again, appearances can be deceiving. The brioche roll was as hard as a rock. The burger was well overdone and the chips were soggy and coated with a sickening amount of balsamic vinegar that leaked through their basket and onto the table. Absolutely nothing had flavor. I was starving and choked it down out of necessity and limited time but didn't enjoy a single bite. My mother and friend's experiences were similar though my friend seemed to enjoy her duck fat fries. Perhaps I'm spoiled living in Western Mass with an amazing selection of hamburger joints here but this place just doesn't deliver. A $12.00 or $13.00 sandwich SHOULD be very good. This place just wasn't. It was the first and last meal we will have here which is sad as it's location is so convenient and we visit the city regularly.

Like other reviews point out but poorly state, this place can provide a little bit of everything.  I have been here for a quick bite (small plate offerings, and the food is amazing) I have been here late night to dance and have a great time.  I have also been here with my company for a small gathering where they catered our event.  I also want to point out they have a patio for out door enjoyment when the weather is nice.  Everytime I have been the service has been top notch, very accomodating, and consistent.  The drinks and specials are great, and the food is unbelievable.  If you have not been definitely need to check it out.
Good Peruvian spot. We shared the Matador(more than enough for 2). Try the Cristal beer it's light & smooth.
Great happy hour, good beer selection, food is decent - mussels and wings are very good. I've seen a few shows here and music wise it's a solid intimate venue
Awesome food, impeccable service and of course very expensive!
Had many meals here and take out as well, always great/friendly service. Great BYOB spot and very good Thai food as well.
If you ask for spicy, you WILL get spicy. Very affordable and quick with your order. The cha siu banh mi is where it's at for me, though they have a nice variety of other fillings too.
Over-hyped and expensive pizza

Whether you are going for prepared food or for ingredients, this is a must stop for anyone in town. It can get crowded around the usual times, but the finds and the fresh produce, along with the immense variety of food stands to choose from will make it worth your while.

First time in Philadelphia and I'm amazed! This place was awesome. A little overwheling, but that just means you get to try something new everyday. If I lived here I would absolutely shop at the farmers market and other shops. Everything looked so fresh and delicious. Very cool place. A must see (and eat!)
Always a stop for us when in Philly.   Wide variety of different types of food.  Have some time to spend and enjoy.
One of my favorite restaurants in Philadelphia. Some dislike Steven Starr - not me I love him - overall this place may be his best. Best baguette in the city period.
this resturant with the authentic hawaiian cuisine  and onomea was great the ahi tuna rolls is good tasty but it just too much rice,, but the dessert coconut custard are very good !

For as long as I can remember, my family and I have been going to Bella Italia for Christmas Eve dinner. The food is always on point and the owner is always so nice. However, the past few years we had a nasty waitress. She's inconsiderate, inattentive and forgetful. While clearing the table, she hit me in my face and said nothing... She didn't even notice. I love Bella Italia, but some of the waitress could use a reality check instead of a paycheck
Hands down the best place to get an arepa in NYC.
I've been here at least 10 times and never had a bad experience. Some of the best Chinese food I've ever had. I would definitely recommend the pork chow fun and wonton soup.

My family and I choose this restaurant after reading the reviews.  We chose appetizers and entrees to share What a disappointment.   The appetizer portions were very small.....spread out over the plate in an artistic presentation, and expensive.  The chick pea fritters were good.....but tiny.  And they were out of sweet potatoes. How could that be when the restaurant was almost empty? The steak dinner was good with delicious sauce and so was the fish entree. The pork loin was very chewy and dry. We did not eat it. The chocolate dessert was yummy but had a weird presentation with small pieces scattered around the plate. The appearance of the restaurant was modern and attractive. Obviously our experience was different than other reviewers. I thought it was very expensive for what we got.

Excellent food Exception service Imaginative combinations Was there yesterday with a party of 7 We could not have been happier Only negative comment:  the French toast is fried...it should say that On the menu. Otherwise, it was perfect. I have read the negative reviews....I guess you can't make everyone happy Waitress was outstanding

Great food, great service .. If you plan on getting there at 12pm on the dot, go a little earlier for less of a wait. The place is PACKED at lunch which to me points towards the great food and service. I go there once ever week or every other week. The prices are very affordable

Awesome pizza. Basic pizza comes with cheese, sauce and basil, basically a margerita. We asked for a sausage topping. Got our pizza in no time. It was huge and though we ate 2 slices each, we also look 2 home for dinner. The coal fired oven adds to the great taste and service is excellent. We are at the downtown Grimaldis but it is great anywhere. A staple must do if you want the real New York pizza.

The YARDLEY INN     The  BAR - A   Uber cool vibe - 30 + crowd - not cheap - strong pours     The FOOD  - B+  Like most places not everything is great but a number ( more than a few) are very good ( much more than adequate for 30+ bar crowd ). The SERVICE - B Pleasant and competent but can be a bit chatty MY CONCLUSION - If you are 30+ and not  heading  to Philadelphia then forget driving along the river and wasting gas because you won't find a better place in Bucks County.
Had the halibut and truffled mashed potatoes last night.....they were outstanding!!!  Very nice place great atmosphere and staff were very friendly!!!

Slooooowwwww. Mid day. Light traffic. 35 min waiting for appetizers. The waitress casually goes by  mumbling automatically "is everything ok here?" and moves on without even realizing table is still empty. Yup. So much for training your waiting staff... Food was ok and they did compensate with a cheesecake on the house which was nice. Probably they are better as a late night bar thing.

Visiting the city and I found great reviews on Pylos.  It didn't disappoint!!!!  It was absolutely amazing!!  The food, ambience and location were wonderful.  The appetizers were more than enough for three.  Highly recommended!
Great food! Great service! Great wine selection! Perfect for a date! Highly recommended..to the max!
If you're wanting great tapas with a unique atmosphere this place is a must!

Sounds strange I know but a Chinese owned Mexican joint. Serves authentic cuisine.  The cooks are Latinos. I get the shrimp fajita platter with two sides and a drink for under $10. Not much to look at tho. It looks like a renovated fast food place.
Brunch is awesome here!!!
Food was always very good,but I think new owners took over, noticed a big difference in the quality and taste of the food. The fried food is extremely greasy. Not the same food.

Yay, thank you Yelp for leading me to this great tasting pizza amid a lot of Asian food!  I had a Sicilian cheese piece and it literally melted in my mouth.  Plus, the crust was crispy and the cheese was plentiful.
Excellent banh mi sandwiches for under $5. Large serving sizes and great flavor. A small hole in the wall so there isn't much area to sit.

My fiance and I just had breakfast here.  Delicious!  I had a Taylor Ham, egg, and cheese sandwich with a side of homefries and a coffee and he had the big breakfast sampler (came with two eggs, bacon, sausage, Taylor Ham, homefries, and pancakes) and an orange juice.   Everything was made fresh to order and their homefries had a little hint of nutmeg to them - really gave it a nice flavor.  And they were crispy, too! They give you a TON of food - we ended up bringing home leftovers for breakfast tomorrow.  Our total bill was $20.  Great food and great value.  We will definitely be back!!
Super unique!  Multiple shops that allow you to do organic grocery shoping, get fresh cuts of meat, buy some wine and last-minute gifts :)  I LOVED living within walking distance!

Forget about pies that go straight to your thighs for a day and check this place out. After scoping out all the chicken and waffles in Williamsburg for the week this one takes the cake ( or should I say donut). Start off with one of their famous donuts, preferably the cake doughnuts. Expect friendly prompt service in a "cozy" environment. Bathrooms are pretty close to the open kitchen which was strange to me but the waffles were perfectly prepared and topped with cranberries. As a chicken joint, you would expect this level of tasty chicken. While it doesn't look like much from the street, this place was a treat.
Excellent food served with a smile! :) Only reason I gave it a 4 star instead of a 5 is because how small the place is, but overall it's a great place!
That fried chicken was the best I've ever had.

Their menu is very eye catching but the food does not deliver. Notably the duck confit carbonara was not a carbonara sauce in the slightest, it tasted like a watered down Alfredo and the duck flavor did not carry through. All dishes we ordered were at best mediocre.

I didn't give one star because I thought people might skip over it. The whole reason we chose Galli was because we were on our honeymoon and Yelp reviews said it was a cool spot for date night. Had dinner here tonight. We called ahead to see if we needed reservations, they said they had a large party in the back and to come in an hour and a half. We show up at 8:45 on a Sunday and they put us in a booth next to the kitchen doors. Rap music is blaring and the party in back is so loud we literally cannot hear each other. People from the party are running from the back to the bar, right past our table. After about five minutes, our waiter comes to the table to give us water and take our drink and appetizer orders. The apps come out before our drinks! This party has gotten out of hand, we have stopped trying to have a conversation. The waiter never stops by to see how the apps are, so we can't complain. The mini rice balls are fine, the spicy calamari is terribly average. Our entrees come out and we have finished our cocktails. No waiter. Eventually he passes by the table and we ask him to bring over a manager. The manager says the rap music isn't his cup of tea but the loud crowd are his friends/colleagues and their open bar is ending in ten minutes. He says he will get us a glass of wine. Dinner was pretty middle of the road. We ask for the check. We wait. The loud party is still out of control 40 minutes after their open bar has supposedly ended. We ask for the check a second time. We have just stared at each other for the last hour and a half because speaking was impossible, we told the manager how we were having an awful time, and we were not moved to a quieter table, we didn't receive better service, and then we paid full price at the end of the meal. So much for a romantic dinner.

Happened to be in the area and yelp reviews led me to this place. Got there just before the early dinner rush unfolded. Ordered a large pie with pancetta, pepperoni, sausage and mushroom. The crust was just right both thickness and consistency. Meats were evenly cooked with my fav being the itilan sausage. Even the Parmesan cheese had a certain level of freshness. I have tasted New York pizza from many places but endorse this place as to try if you are ever on this part of Manhattan. My only gripe is the tables are very small, and I came very close to having an entire pie land in my lap due to the limited eating space clearance between my plate and pie on the pedestal. (I know comes with the territory eating at similar restaurants.)

Decided to try their pizza for a change of pace from Italian pizza.  Very good but it took a long time to be served.  The restaurant is small and quaint and service is slow even though the place was not extremely busy.  Would definitely try them again for their other dishes.

Mediocre food and mediocre service. Ordered the meat and cheese platter as an appetizer... was not impressed. Order a whiskey flight and the server did not know how to use a jigger to pour whiskey (at a whiskey bar). Management doesn't seem to care about training their employees. We were offered water once, had to get up and get a server to ask for more.  You use an app via an iPad to order. The app is pretty user friendly but be aware that it defaults to 18% tip when you order.

This place is AWESOME! Food is cooked just right...the fish? Amazing! Place is small but if you go in alil later in the day...you will get a seat almost immediately! Prices are a tad bit on the high side BUT well worth it and really not that significant! They don't sell pork if you like that. But the turkey bacon is good. (I love pork bacon) but don't notice it missing when eating here! It's a good and bad thing that this place is literally 3 minutes from me!

Being from the Bay Area, Orange County, and LA... I've tried it all. Ippudo is by far the best ramen I've ever had. It is actually the sole reason I would go back to New York. Not too salty. Good portion (it leaves you wanting more). Every bowl is delicious. That wasabi raw squid thing is pretty solid too. Can't go wrong with anything.

The egg sandwiches do the trick and they are friendly. It was great go-to place that remembers your name. Sorry this is so late but wrote this on yelp before They allowed you to post to the mobile app and just saved it as a draft. I'd give it 5 stars but I know savvy yelpers have a slight disbelief with 5 stars haha.
Excellent food, super authentic. I would have given it 5 stars if it wasn't because we were expecting to sit at the table in front of the chefs
Love how the place is stylish! The food is good, specially the meatballs pizza! Great place for a group or date nite!!

Ok.  So here is my problem with this place. Simple menu, decent food.  Good burgers, ribs, salads and wings. My problem is the service and how they serve food. I ordered a salad, burger, side of onion rings. In MOST restaurants, including divey diners they know that when you order a salad it should come first! Not here.  First came out my onion rings, then a few minutes later my burger, then 10 minutes later my salad, which by then I didn't want! Suzy!  Get your process together.  This is the second time this happened to me here and it really is the little things like this that make me not want to come back! Oh, and we asked our server 2x for our check.  AND, it took him 15 minutes to take our order even though he walked by us a few times.  I had to go up to the not so charming hostess to ask her if there was someone that could take our order. Again, my problem with this place is not the food, its the service and their processes.  They need alot of work!

Six of us dined at the restaurant on a Monday at 4:30 P.M.. Service was courteous and prompt. The food was very good and plentiful. We all enjoyed our meal. The restaurant is large and very clean. Highly recommend!
The best french toast! Yum!

Two of my friends and I split a 16" Joe over lunch and were very pleased with the pizza.  It is a small place.  Kinda cramped and easy to miss.  The only real drawback is that all of the drinks are bottled or canned and, as most of Montclair, BYOB. Knowing my friends were satisfied, I was happy to finish the last slice of the pie and leave quite full.
My wife daughter and myself had dinner last night and it was wonderful. More than half the menu is gluten free and can be seasoned to taste. The service was warm and helpful.

The food here is spectacular, the chef is gluten intolerant so there are gluten free options galore.  The staff are super nice and engaged, and likely will have a real Australian accent. Maybe my favorite mimosa ever :)

Without a doubt, this was the best Russian/Ukrainian restaurant I have ever been too- and I am a person who seeks out these types of establishments where ever I travel. The venue is small and quaint, adorned with a very attentive staff with thick (but easily understandable) accents adding to the restaurants authenticity. We started with flavor infused vodka and pickles- what else? Then came caviar and blini's as an appetizer... sublime. Followed by a procession of traditional favorites that did not disappoint including a salad course, chicken Kiev, beef stroganoff, and cabbage rolls! Dessert course included a cake flown in from Russia that my father described as "light as air" and "the best cake I have ever tasted". All of this washed down with traditional cups of tea. I recognize that the restaurant dynamic NYC creates highly favors the clientele, meaning that it is very hard to have a bad dining experience because competition sifts out the undesirables. That being said... The stars did aligned for us on Friday December 26th and the result was an epic evening of culinary extravagance a la mother Russia.

Staff and service was excellent! We had the meatballs to start and they were delicious! The vanilla French toast was also very good. I also ordered the scrambled egg in the croissant and that was just ok. I would go back for the good service, appetizers and French toast!
The Writing Room is a great place for dinner and drinks above 86th street. For a more detailed review, please click the link below: halsteadproperty.tumblr.…
This place needs no introduction, no comments, nada! JUST GO! ;-) Cheese, Seafood, Chocolate, Veggies, Meats, Flowers, the list goes on and on... LOVE IT!

It's a preserved historic landmark for a reason. The prepared foods, fish, and meats, and poultry, and baked goods are fresh, the prices are inexpensive, and the selection and variety are without compare. I found it too crowded at lunchtime, but greatly enjoyed breakfast there.
Food is fabulous, layout of the customer service line is poor. Clearly front staff have not been trained: no eye contact, no acknowledgment, do know their own menu. Risky business for the owner!
Most items on the menu are great. However, the kale Caesar salad looked like it was gonna be the jump off, but was actually too salty.

The food tasted bland.  It was just A-OK. I'm also not giving it any more stars because I noticed that the juice man behind the counter was not removing the stickers on the apples before placing them in the juicer! Unfortunately I noticed this after having gulped down my juice.  I paid close attention, and the 3 juices I witnessed him making, he did not remove the stickers at all!  I was a little turned off by that! If you want sticker in your juice, this is the restaurant for you!

The reviews aren't lying: this place is tiny. The Sloppy Johny is overrated, the banana pancakes actually have TOO MANY bananas, but regular pancakes and bacon are good. And get the home fries well done: they turned out really tasty.

I've been here twice & I love this restaurant! The food is pretty good and so are the drinks. The only thing I don't like is that even if we have reservations we still have to wait about 30mins to be seated. Other than that our waiter was also very kind.
So so good.

I was taken to Dig Inn for the first time yesterday. Not always easy to find such excellent good late on a Sunday night, I was pleased to be able to choose from so many appealing options. As someone always looking for Gluten Free options, this was a hit. In addition to the delicious food, the staff was delicious as well. The Sunday night crew - Felicia, Ty, France's and Jamie were great...super welcoming and helpful to this first timer. As we were preparing to cash out, Felicia discovered it was my birthday and led all in a chorus of Happy Birthday and informed me that my meal was on the house. Is that great or what? So, if your in the mood for some great food and fantastic service, head to this Dig Inn location today.

We have been here several times over the years for special occasions.  On top the exceptional preparation and ingredients, its very consistent.  We've never had a mediocre meal or experience and the chef always stops by to catch up with us.  We usually split the aged rib-eye and share another entrée and salad. I am happy they've done well over the years and wish them continued success!

Simple elegance.         How about getting an email 10 days before your daughter's wedding reception letting you know there was a new manager.   Jules immediately put us at ease and even though he was new to the Hartness House, he was not new at hospitality.  Jules and Brad are gracious innkeepers that have great plans for this venue.     The reception was held in the Ballroom, it was clean and fresh.  Brad did a wonderful job decorating the inn.  We had a tremendous time.   The back motel rooms are for the budget minded (nothing fancy but served the purpose).  The main inn rooms are elegant and historic. Jules and Brad did everything to make this event memorable.  The food was hot and moist.  We also had brunch the next morning in the Governor's Room.   Jules recommended the lasagna and it was a hit.     If you want a true Vermont experience, let Hartness House (Jules and Brad) especially be your innkeepers.   You will not be disappointed.           We can't wait to get back to see Jules vision transform this inn to the next level.

Hands down one of the best noodle soup place in New York City! I've been coming to NY Noodletown for many years. Their noodle soups are consistently pretty amazing plus it's open til 4am! How could you beat that??
Cool looking place. The ramen noodles and broth flavor is not bad. Left feeling hungry though. I think Ivan Ramen tastes better. Very expensive.
AMAZING pizza and great mixed green salad! Everything was super fresh. A guilty must have if your in the area!

When we first walked in it was a little confusing but a very friendly young man gave us the low down and showed us where we would sit which was marked with a handkerchief. I loved the concept and when it was our turn to order I was blown away by the friendliness and how genuine the staff was. Then the food, AMAZING! A must stop!

Awesome name and I expected nothing short of awesomeness.  Glad that I was only  here for a party.  The food was quite unappealing.  We got the awesome party room on the side and I was impressed by how beautiful this place looked.  High ceilings, lovely decor; again, awesome name, etc.   I had some bacon wrapped somethings, some soup, very cold and undercooked vegetables, and cheese and bread.  The bread tasted stale and the vegetables were worse than what I cooked as a 7 year old.  I had lots of free drinks so by my 4th drink the food tasted better, but you can say that about almost anyplace.   Not a bad place for a party, but those that had dinner said they were underwhelmed.  If you think about this when you are in town, think about a better place to go.

Not worth the wait or the $$. I took two friends here for brunch and the experience was laughable. First, they forgot our name and only remembered when we asked how much longer it'd take to get seated. It was an honest mistake since they use chalk on the sides of the door to write people's names and people can easily erase these names by just leaning against the door. We probably waited close to 1.5 hours. Second, we literally sat a table for children. I'm a small person, but I still felt like we were seated the children's table akin to Thanksgiving when I was 11. One person is our party is a large guy, so it was particularly uncomfortable for him. Thirdly, understanding it's French, the place is overpriced. We got 2 bit-sized croissants for $7. They were great, but not worth it. My waffle was good, particularly the sweet maple syrup with bacon and eggs. However it was not worth waiting for over an hour to sit at a tiny table, and have ok service. I asked for salt and pepper that never came. Overall, I did not find it charming, intimate and cute to sit in a cramped space with little servings of overpriced food.
